       _NOTIFY_            = \\\&quot;=== NOTIFICATIONS ===\\\&quot;;\\ninput bool              Notify_ON           = false;\\ninput bool              Notify_Emergency    = false;\\ninput bool              Notify_CircuitBreaker = false;\\ninput bool              Notify_TP1          = false;\\n\\n//--- 3.15 RISK MANAGEMENT\\ninput string            _RISK_              = \\\&quot;=== RISK ===\\\&quot;;\\ninput double            RiskPercent         = 1.0;\\ninput int               MaxOpenPositions    = 5;\\ninput double            MaxTotalLot         = 0.5;\\ninput double            MaxDrawdownPct      = 20.0;\\ninput double            DailyLossPct        = 5.0;\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 4: Global Variables Template\\n\\n```mql5\\nstruct SRZone\\n{\\n    double price;\\n    int    strength;\\n    bool   isResistance;\\n};\\n\\nSRZone   SR_Zones[];\\nint      SR_ZoneCount       = 0;\\ndatetime LastBarTime        = 0;\\ndouble   DailyStartEquity   = 0;\\ndouble   InitialBalance     = 0;\\nbool     HedgeActive        = false;\\nint      HedgeOrderCount    = 0;\\nint      GridOrderCount     = 0;   // \\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48 Reset \\u0e40\\u0e21\\u0e37\\u0e48\\u0e2d Hedge \\u0e1b\\u0e34\\u0e14\\nbool     CircuitBreakerActive = false;\\ndatetime CircuitBreakerUntil  = 0;\\nbool     TP1_Hit[];                // Track TP1 status per ticket\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 7: OnTick() Template\\n\\n```mql5\\nvoid OnTick()\\n{\\n    ResetDailyStats();\\n\\n    // 7.1 Emergency Exit\\n    if(!CheckEmergencyExit())     return;\\n    // 7.2 Drawdown Check\\n    if(!CheckDrawdownLimit())     return;\\n    // 7.3 Daily Loss Check\\n    if(!CheckDailyLossLimit())    return;\\n    // 7.4 Circuit Breaker\\n    if(!CheckCircuitBreaker())    return;\\n    // 7.5 Spread Spike Hard Cap\\n    if(!CheckSpreadSpike())       return;\\n    // 7.6 Current Bar TR Spike\\n    if(!CheckCurrentBarSpike())   return;\\n    // 7.7 Price Gap\\n    if(!CheckPriceGap())          return;\\n    // 7.8 ATR Baseline Filter\\n    if(!CheckATRFilter())         return;\\n    // 7.9 Session Filter\\n    if(!CheckSessionFilter())     return;\\n\\n    // 7.10 S/R Update \\u2014 New Bar Only\\n    if(IsNewBar()) UpdateSR();\\n\\n    // 7.11 Hedge Management\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_OFF)\\n    {\\n        bool hedgeTrigger = false;\\n        switch(HedgeMode)\\n        {\\n            case HEDGE_GRID_REVERSAL:\\n                hedgeTrigger = CheckHedgeActivation(); break;\\n            case HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE:\\n                hedgeTrigger = CheckCandleHedgeTrigger(); break;\\n            case HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND:\\n                hedgeTrigger = CheckTrendHedgeTrigger(); break;\\n        }\\n        if(hedgeTrigger)\\n        {\\n            HedgeActive = true;\\n            ManageHedgePartialClose();\\n            OpenHedgeOrder();\\n        }\\n        if(HedgeActive &amp;&amp; CheckHedgeDeactivation())\\n        {\\n            HedgeActive     = false;\\n            HedgeOrderCount = 0;\\n            // GridOrderCount \\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48\\u0e41\\u0e15\\u0e30 \\u2014 \\u0e15\\u0e48\\u0e2d\\u0e08\\u0e32\\u0e01\\u0e40\\u0e14\\u0e34\\u0e21\\n            Print(\\\&quot;Hedge OFF | Grid resumes from #\\\&quot;, GridOrderCount);\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    // 7.12 Entry Logic\\n    // *** Generated from Spec Card Entry Condition ***\\n\\n    // 7.13 Grid Logic \\u2014 \\u0e40\\u0e1b\\u0e34\\u0e14\\u0e15\\u0e48\\u0e2d\\u0e44\\u0e14\\u0e49\\u0e40\\u0e2a\\u0e21\\u0e2d \\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48\\u0e2a\\u0e19\\u0e27\\u0e48\\u0e32 Hedge Active \\u0e44\\u0e2b\\u0e21\\n    if(GridMode != GRID_NONE &amp;&amp; GridOrderCount &lt; GridMaxOrders)\\n        ShouldOpenGridOrder(0);\\n\\n    // 7.14 Exit Logic\\n    CheckExitLogic();\\n\\n    // 7.15 Dashboard\\n    ShowDashboard();\\n}\\n\\nbool IsNewBar()\\n{\\n    datetime currentBar = iTime(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 0);\\n    if(currentBar != LastBarTime)\\n    {\\n        LastBarTime = currentBar;\\n        return true;\\n    }\\n    return false;\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 8: Filter Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n// Spread Hard Cap \\u2014 Real-time \\u0e17\\u0e35\\u0e48\\u0e2a\\u0e38\\u0e14\\nbool CheckSpreadSpike()\\n{\\n    long spread = SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD);\\n    if(spread &gt; MaxSpread_Hard)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Spread Spike: \\\&quot;, spread, \\\&quot; pts \\u2192 Block\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n// Current Bar True Range Spike \\u2014 \\u0e40\\u0e23\\u0e47\\u0e27 \\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48\\u0e23\\u0e2d Average\\nbool CheckCurrentBarSpike()\\n{\\n    if(!VolSpike_Filter_ON) return true;\\n    double highNow   = iHigh (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);\\n    double lowNow    = iLow  (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);\\n    double prevClose = iClose(_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 1);\\n    double currentTR = MathMax(highNow - lowNow,\\n                       MathMax(MathAbs(highNow - prevClose),\\n                               MathAbs(lowNow  - prevClose)));\\n    double atrNormal = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    if(currentTR &gt; atrNormal * VolatilitySpikeMulti)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;TR Spike detected | TR:\\\&quot;, currentTR, \\\&quot; ATR:\\\&quot;, atrNormal);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n// Price Gap Detection\\nbool CheckPriceGap()\\n{\\n    if(!GapProtection_ON) return true;\\n    if(!IsNewBar()) return true;\\n    double prevClose = iClose(_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 1);\\n    double currOpen  = iOpen (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);\\n    double gap       = MathAbs(currOpen - prevClose);\\n    double maxGap    = MaxGap_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    if(gap &gt; maxGap)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Gap detected: \\\&quot;, gap/(_Point*10), \\\&quot; pips \\u2192 Circuit Breaker\\\&quot;);\\n        ActivateCircuitBreaker();\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n// Session Filter\\nbool CheckSessionFilter()\\n{\\n    if(!SessionFilter_ON) return true;\\n    MqlDateTime dt;\\n    TimeToStruct(TimeGMT(), dt);\\n    int hour = dt.hour;\\n    int minNow = hour * 60 + dt.min;\\n    bool london  = (hour &gt;= 7  &amp;&amp; hour &lt; 16);\\n    bool newYork = (hour &gt;= 13 &amp;&amp; hour &lt; 22);\\n    bool tokyo   = (hour &gt;= 0  &amp;&amp; hour &lt; 9);\\n    bool sydney  = (hour &gt;= 21 || hour &lt; 6);\\n    if(SessionTransition_Block)\\n    {\\n        bool nearLondon = (minNow &gt;= (7*60 - TransitionBuffer_Mins) &amp;&amp;\\n                           minNow &lt;= (7*60 + TransitionBuffer_Mins));\\n        bool nearNY     = (minNow &gt;= (13*60 - TransitionBuffer_Mins) &amp;&amp;\\n                           minNow &lt;= (13*60 + TransitionBuffer_Mins));\\n        if(nearLondon || nearNY) return false;\\n    }\\n    if(Allow_London  &amp;&amp; london)  return true;\\n    if(Allow_NewYork &amp;&amp; newYork) return true;\\n    if(Allow_Tokyo   &amp;&amp; tokyo)   return true;\\n    if(Allow_Sydney  &amp;&amp; sydney)  return true;\\n    return false;\\n}\\n\\n// Circuit Breaker\\nvoid ActivateCircuitBreaker()\\n{\\n    if(!CircuitBreaker_ON) return;\\n    CircuitBreakerActive = true;\\n    CircuitBreakerUntil  = TimeCurrent() + 1440 * 60; // 24 hr fixed\\n    if(Notify_CircuitBreaker)\\n        SendAlert(\\\&quot;CIRCUIT BREAKER ON | Resume: \\\&quot;\\n            + TimeToString(CircuitBreakerUntil));\\n    Print(\\\&quot;Circuit Breaker ON | Resume: \\\&quot;, TimeToString(CircuitBreakerUntil));\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckCircuitBreaker()\\n{\\n    if(!CircuitBreaker_ON || !CircuitBreakerActive) return true;\\n    if(TimeCurrent() &gt;= CircuitBreakerUntil)\\n    {\\n        CircuitBreakerActive = false;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Circuit Breaker OFF\\\&quot;);\\n        return true;\\n    }\\n    return false;\\n}\\n\\n// ATR Baseline Filter\\nbool CheckATRFilter()\\n{\\n    double atr = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    return (atr &gt;= ATR_MinValue);\\n}\\n\\n// Get ATR Value\\ndouble GetATR(ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf, int period)\\n{\\n    int handle = iATR(_Symbol, tf, period);\\n    double buf[];\\n    ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);\\n    if(CopyBuffer(handle, 0, 0, 1, buf) &lt; 1) return 0;\\n    return buf[0];\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 12: TP/SL/Exit Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n// Calculate TP Level by Mode\\ndouble CalcTPLevel(ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type, double entry,\\n                   ENUM_TP_LEVEL_MODE mode, double value)\\n{\\n    double atr  = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    double sl   = CalcSL(type);\\n    double dist = 0;\\n    switch(mode)\\n    {\\n        case TP_LEVEL_PIPS: dist = value * _Point * 10; break;\\n        case TP_LEVEL_RR:   dist = MathAbs(entry - sl) * value; break;\\n        case TP_LEVEL_ATR:  dist = atr * value; break;\\n    }\\n    return (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY) ? entry + dist : entry - dist;\\n}\\n\\n// Partial TP Manager\\nvoid CheckPartialTP()\\n{\\n    if(!PartialTP_ON) return;\\n    for(int i = PositionsTotal()-1; i &gt;= 0; i--)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);\\n        double bid       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);\\n        double volume    = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_VOLUME);\\n        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type =\\n            (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);\\n        double tp1 = CalcTPLevel(type, openPrice, TP1_Mode, TP1_Value);\\n        double tp2 = CalcTPLevel(type, openPrice, TP2_Mode, TP2_Value);\\n        bool tp1Hit = (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)\\n                    ? bid &gt;= tp1 : bid &lt;= tp1;\\n        if(tp1Hit)\\n        {\\n            double closeLot = NormalizeDouble(volume*(TP1_ClosePercent/100.0),2);\\n            Trade.PositionClosePartial(ticket, closeLot);\\n            if(BreakEven_ON)\\n            {\\n                double bePips = BreakEven_Buffer * _Point * 10;\\n                double newSL  = (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)\\n                              ? openPrice + bePips\\n                              : openPrice - bePips;\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, tp2);\\n            }\\n            if(Notify_TP1)\\n                SendAlert(\\\&quot;TP1 HIT | \\\&quot; + _Symbol + \\\&quot; #\\\&quot; + IntegerToString(ticket));\\n            Print(\\\&quot;TP1 Hit | Partial Close \\\&quot;, TP1_ClosePercent, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n// Dynamic TP \\u2014 Net Profit \\u0e23\\u0e27\\u0e1a\\u0e17\\u0e38\\u0e01\\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e49\\nvoid CheckDynamicTP_Grid()\\n{\\n    if(TPMode != TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE) return;\\n    double totalProfit = 0;\\n    for(int i = 0; i &lt; PositionsTotal(); i++)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        totalProfit += PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)\\n                    +  PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SWAP);\\n    }\\n    double target = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE) * (TPBalancePct/100.0);\\n    if(totalProfit &gt;= target)\\n    {\\n        CloseAllOrders();\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Dynamic TP Hit | Net Profit: \\\&quot;, totalProfit, \\\&quot; Target: \\\&quot;, target);\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n// ATR Trailing Stop \\u2014 Adaptive\\nvoid ManageATRTrail()\\n{\\n    if(!TrailingStop_ON) return;\\n    double atr       = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    double atrNormal = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period * 3);\\n    double trailDist;\\n    if(Trail_Mode == TRAIL_ATR)\\n        trailDist = (atr &gt; atrNormal * 2.0)\\n                  ? atr * (TrailATR_Multi * 0.5)  // Spike = Trail \\u0e0a\\u0e34\\u0e14\\n                  : atr * TrailATR_Multi;\\n    else\\n        trailDist = TrailFixed_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    double trailStart = TrailStart_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    for(int i = PositionsTotal()-1; i &gt;= 0; i--)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);\\n        double currentSL = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SL);\\n        double bid       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);\\n        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type =\\n            (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);\\n        if(type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)\\n        {\\n            if(bid - openPrice &lt; trailStart) continue;\\n            double newSL = bid - trailDist;\\n            if(newSL &gt; currentSL)\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);\\n        }\\n        else\\n        {\\n            double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);\\n            if(openPrice - ask &lt; trailStart) continue;\\n            double newSL = ask + trailDist;\\n            if(newSL &lt; currentSL || currentSL == 0)\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n// Master Exit Logic \\u2014 3 Levels\\nvoid CheckExitLogic()\\n{\\n    CheckPartialTP();        // Level 1: Partial TP\\n    ManageATRTrail();        // Level 2: Trailing Stop\\n    CheckDynamicTP_Grid();   // Level 3: Dynamic TP (Net)\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 13: Risk Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\nvoid ApplyPreset()\\n{\\n    // Style Preset\\n    switch(TradeStyle)\\n    {\\n        case STYLE_SCALPING:\\n            TPFixedPips=15; StructureLookback=5;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=10; ATR_MinValue=0.0003;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=10; TrailATR_Multi=0;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_INTRADAY:\\n            TPFixedPips=40; StructureLookback=10;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=20; ATR_MinValue=0.0005;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=20; TrailATR_Multi=1.0;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_SWING:\\n            TPFixedPips=100; StructureLookback=20;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=30; ATR_MinValue=0.0008;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=50; TrailATR_Multi=1.5;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_TREND:\\n            TPFixedPips=200; StructureLookback=20;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=30; ATR_MinValue=0.0010;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=80; TrailATR_Multi=2.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n    // Risk Preset\\n    switch(RiskLevel)\\n    {\\n        case RISK_SAFE:\\n            RiskPercent=0.5; MaxDrawdownPct=10.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=3.0; MaxOpenPositions=3;\\n            MaxTotalLot=0.1; CB_DD_Trigger=8.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_MEDIUM:\\n            RiskPercent=1.0; MaxDrawdownPct=20.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=5.0; MaxOpenPositions=5;\\n            MaxTotalLot=0.5; CB_DD_Trigger=15.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_AGGRESSIVE:\\n            RiskPercent=2.0; MaxDrawdownPct=35.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=10.0; MaxOpenPositions=10;\\n            MaxTotalLot=1.0; CB_DD_Trigger=25.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\ndouble GetCurrentDD()\\n{\\n    double equity  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double balance = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    if(balance &lt;= 0) return 0;\\n    return ((balance - equity) / balance) * 100.0;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckDrawdownLimit()\\n{\\n    if(GetCurrentDD() &gt;= MaxDrawdownPct)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;DD LIMIT HIT: \\\&quot;, GetCurrentDD(), \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckDailyLossLimit()\\n{\\n    double equity    = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double dailyLoss = ((DailyStartEquity - equity) / DailyStartEquity) * 100.0;\\n    if(dailyLoss &gt;= DailyLossPct)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;DAILY LOSS HIT: \\\&quot;, dailyLoss, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\nvoid ResetDailyStats()\\n{\\n    MqlDateTime dt;\\n    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);\\n    if(dt.hour == 0 &amp;&amp; dt.min == 0)\\n        DailyStartEquity = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckMargin(double lot)\\n{\\n    double marginRequired;\\n    if(!OrderCalcMargin(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, _Symbol, lot,\\n                        SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK),\\n                        marginRequired))\\n        return false;\\n    double freeMargin = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE);\\n    return (freeMargin &gt;= marginRequired * 1.5);\\n}\\n\\ndouble AdjustLotForMaxSL(double lot, double slPips)\\n{\\n    double maxSL = MaxSL_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    if(slPips &gt; maxSL)\\n    {\\n        double balance      = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n        double maxRiskMoney = balance * (RiskPercent / 100.0);\\n        double pipValue     = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE);\\n        lot = maxRiskMoney / (MaxSL_Pips * pipValue);\\n        Print(\\\&quot;SL too wide \\u2192 Lot adjusted: \\\&quot;, lot);\\n    }\\n    return NormalizeDouble(MathMax(lot, 0.01), 2);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 14: Hedge Module\\n\\n```mql5\\n// FOLLOW_CANDLE Trigger\\nbool CheckCandleHedgeTrigger()\\n{\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE) return false;\\n    double atr      = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    double bodySize = MathAbs(iOpen(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1)\\n                   -          iClose(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1));\\n    bool bigBearish = (iClose(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1)\\n                    &lt;  iOpen (_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1))\\n                   &amp;&amp; (bodySize &gt; atr * HedgeCandle_ATRMulti);\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; bigBearish);\\n}\\n\\n// FOLLOW_TREND Trigger\\nbool CheckTrendHedgeTrigger()\\n{\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND) return false;\\n    double fast0 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_FastEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 0);\\n    double fast1 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_FastEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 1);\\n    double slow0 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_SlowEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 0);\\n    double slow1 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_SlowEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 1);\\n    bool bearishCross = (fast1 &gt; slow1) &amp;&amp; (fast0 &lt; slow0);\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; bearishCross);\\n}\\n\\n// GRID_REVERSAL Trigger\\nbool CheckHedgeActivation()\\n{\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; GetCurrentDD() &gt;= HedgeActivationDD);\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckHedgeDeactivation()\\n{\\n    double equity       = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double balance      = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    double floatLossPct = ((balance - equity) / balance) * 100.0;\\n    return (HedgeActive &amp;&amp; floatLossPct &lt;= HedgeDeactivateDD);\\n}\\n\\ndouble GetHedgeRatio(double dd)\\n{\\n    if(dd &gt;= 25.0) return 1.00;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 20.0) return 0.70;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 15.0) return 0.50;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 10.0) return 0.30;\\n    return 0.0;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckEmergencyExit()\\n{\\n    if(GetCurrentDD() &gt;= EmergencyExitDD)\\n    {\\n        CloseAllOrders();\\n        if(Notify_Emergency)\\n            SendAlert(\\\&quot;EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: \\\&quot;\\n                + DoubleToString(GetCurrentDD(),1) + \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        Print(\\\&quot;EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: \\\&quot;, GetCurrentDD(), \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 16: Notification Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\nvoid SendAlert(string message)\\n{\\n    if(!Notify_ON) return;\\n    SendNotification(message);   // Push \\u2192 MT5 Mobile App\\n    Print(\\\&quot;[ALERT] \\\&quot;, message);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 17: Dashboard\\n\\nDashboard \\u0e41\\u0e2a\\u0e14\\u0e07\\u0e17\\u0e38\\u0e01 Tick:\\n\\n- Equity / Balance / DD%\\n- Spread / ATR\\n- Trade Style / Risk Profile\\n- Open Positions / Grid Order Count\\n- Hedge Status (Active / Inactive)\\n- Circuit Breaker Status\\n- SR Zone Count\\n- TP1 Hit Status\\n\\n---\\n\\n# GridOrderCount       = 0;   // \\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48 Reset \\u0e40\\u0e21\\u0e37\\u0e48\\u0e2d Hedge \\u0e1b\\u0e34\\u0e14\\nbool     CircuitBreakerActive = false;\\ndatetime CircuitBreakerUntil  =  ApplyPreset();\\n\\n    //--- \\u0e15\\u0e31\\u0e49\\u0e07\\u0e04\\u0e48\\u0e32 Trade Object\\n    Trade.SetExpertMagicNumber(MagicNumber);\\n    Trade.SetDeviationInPoints(10);\\n    Trade.SetTypeFilling(ORDER_FILLING_FOK);\\n\\n    //--- \\u0e1a\\u0e31\\u0e19\\u0e17\\u0e36\\u0e01 Initial Balance\\n    InitialBalance   = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    DailyStartEquity = symbol \\\&quot;, _Symbol);\\n        return INIT_FAILED;\\n    }\\n\\n    //--- Initialize S/R Module\\n    ArrayResize(SR_Zones, MAX_SR_ZONES);\\n    UpdateSR();\\n\\n    Print(\\\&quot;EA \\\&quot;, EnumToString(RiskLevel),\\n          \\\&quot; | Balance: \\\&quot;, InitialBalance);\\n\\n    return INIT_SUCCEEDED;\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 7: OnTick() Template\\n\\n```mql5\\nvoid OnTick()\\n{\\n    ResetDailyStats();\\n\\n    // 7.1 Emergency Exit\\n    if(!CheckEmergencyExit())     return;\\n    // 7.2 Drawdown Check\\n    if(!CheckDrawdownLimit())     return;\\n    // 7.3 Daily Loss Check\\n    if(!CheckDailyLossLimit())    return;\\n    // 7.4 Circuit Breaker\\n    if(!CheckCircuitBreaker())    return;\\n    // 7.5 Spread Spike Hard Cap (Real-time)\\n    if(!CheckSpreadSpike())       return;\\n    // 7.6 Current Bar TR Spike\\n    if(!CheckCurrentBarSpike())   return;\\n    // 7.7 Price Gap (New Bar Only)\\n    if(!CheckPriceGap())          return;\\n    // 7.8 ATR Baseline Filter\\n    if(!CheckATRFilter())         return;\\n    // 7.9 Session Filter\\n    if(!CheckSessionFilter())     return;\\n\\n    // 7.10 S/R Update \\u2014 New Bar Only\\n    if(IsNewBar()) UpdateSR();\\n\\n    // 7.11 Hedge Management\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_OFF)\\n    {\\n        bool hedgeTrigger = false;\\n        switch(HedgeMode)\\n        {\\n            case HEDGE_GRID_REVERSAL:\\n                hedgeTrigger = CheckHedgeActivation();   break;\\n            case HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE:\\n                hedgeTrigger = CheckCandleHedgeTrigger(); break;\\n            case HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND:\\n                hedgeTrigger = CheckTrendHedgeTrigger();  break;\\n        }\\n        if(hedgeTrigger)\\n        {\\n            HedgeActive = true;\\n            ManageHedgePartialClose();\\n            OpenHedgeOrder();\\n        }\\n        if(HedgeActive &amp;&amp; CheckHedgeDeactivation())\\n        {\\n            HedgeActive     = false;\\n            HedgeOrderCount = 0;\\n            // GridOrderCount \\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48\\u0e41\\u0e15\\u0e30 \\u2192 \\u0e15\\u0e48\\u0e2d\\u0e08\\u0e32\\u0e01\\u0e40\\u0e14\\u0e34\\u0e21\\n            Print(\\\&quot;Hedge OFF | Grid resumes from order #\\\&quot;, GridOrderCount);\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    // 7.12 Entry Logic\\n    // *** Generated from Spec Card Entry Condition ***\\n\\n    // 7.13 Grid Logic \\u2014 \\u0e40\\u0e1b\\u0e34\\u0e14\\u0e15\\u0e48\\u0e2d\\u0e44\\u0e14\\u0e49\\u0e40\\u0e2a\\u0e21\\u0e2d \\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48\\u0e2a\\u0e19\\u0e27\\u0e48\\u0e32 Hedge Active \\u0e44\\u0e2b\\u0e21\\n ShowDashboard();\\n}\\n\\nbool IsNewBar()\\n{\\n    datetime currentBar = iTime(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 0);\\n    if(currentBar != LastBarTime)\\n    {\\n        LastBarTime = currentBar;\\n        return true;\\n    }\\n    return false;\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 8: Filter Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- Spread Hard Cap \\u2014 Real-time \\u0e17\\u0e38\\u0e01 Tick\\nbool CheckSpreadSpike()\\n{\\n    long spread = SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD);\\n    if(spread &gt; MaxSpread_Hard)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Spread Spike: \\\&quot;, spread, \\\&quot; pts \\u2192 Block\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Current Bar TR Spike \\u2014 \\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48\\u0e23\\u0e2d Average \\u0e40\\u0e2b\\u0e21\\u0e37\\u0e2d\\u0e19 ATR\\nbool CheckCurrentBarSpike()\\n{\\n    if(!VolSpike_Filter_ON) return true;\\n    double highNow   = iHigh (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);\\n    double lowNow    = iLow  (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);\\n    double prevClose = iClose(_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 1);\\n    double currentTR = MathMax(highNow - lowNow,\\n                       MathMax(MathAbs(highNow - prevClose),\\n                               MathAbs(lowNow  - prevClose)));\\n    double atrNormal = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    if(currentTR &gt; atrNormal * VolatilitySpikeMulti)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;TR Spike | TR:\\\&quot;, currentTR, \\\&quot; ATR:\\\&quot;, atrNormal);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Price Gap Detection (New Bar)\\nbool CheckPriceGap()\\n{\\n    if(!GapProtection_ON) return true;\\n    if(!IsNewBar()) return true;\\n    double prevClose = iClose(_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 1);\\n    double currOpen  = iOpen (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);\\n    double gap       = MathAbs(currOpen - prevClose);\\n    double maxGap    = MaxGap_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    if(gap &gt; maxGap)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Gap: \\\&quot;, gap/(_Point*10), \\\&quot; pips \\u2192 Circuit Breaker\\\&quot;);\\n        ActivateCircuitBreaker();\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Session Filter\\nbool CheckSessionFilter()\\n{\\n    if(!SessionFilter_ON) return true;\\n    MqlDateTime dt;\\n    TimeToStruct(TimeGMT(), dt);\\n    int hour   = dt.hour;\\n    int minNow = hour * 60 + dt.min;\\n    bool london  = (hour &gt;= 7  &amp;&amp; hour &lt; 16);\\n    bool newYork = (hour &gt;= 13 &amp;&amp; hour &lt; 22);\\n    bool tokyo   = (hour &gt;= 0  &amp;&amp; hour &lt; 9);\\n    bool sydney  = (hour &gt;= 21 || hour &lt; 6);\\n    if(SessionTransition_Block)\\n    {\\n        bool nearLondon = (minNow &gt;= (7*60-TransitionBuffer_Mins) &amp;&amp;\\n                           minNow &lt;= (7*60+TransitionBuffer_Mins));\\n        bool nearNY     = (minNow &gt;= (13*60-TransitionBuffer_Mins) &amp;&amp;\\n                           minNow &lt;= (13*60+TransitionBuffer_Mins));\\n        if(nearLondon || nearNY) return false;\\n    }\\n    if(Allow_London  &amp;&amp; london)  return true;\\n    if(Allow_NewYork &amp;&amp; newYork) return true;\\n    if(Allow_Tokyo   &amp;&amp; tokyo)   return true;\\n    if(Allow_Sydney  &amp;&amp; sydney)  return true;\\n    return false;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Circuit Breaker \\u2014 \\u0e2b\\u0e22\\u0e38\\u0e14 24hr Fixed\\nvoid ActivateCircuitBreaker()\\n{\\n    if(!CircuitBreaker_ON) return;\\n    CircuitBreakerActive = true;\\n    CircuitBreakerUntil  = TimeCurrent() + 1440 * 60;\\n    if(Notify_CircuitBreaker)\\n        SendAlert(\\\&quot;CIRCUIT BREAKER ON | Resume: \\\&quot;\\n            + TimeToString(CircuitBreakerUntil));\\n    Print(\\\&quot;Circuit Breaker ON | Resume: \\\&quot;, TimeToString(CircuitBreakerUntil));\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckCircuitBreaker()\\n{\\n    if(!CircuitBreaker_ON || !CircuitBreakerActive) return true;\\n    if(TimeCurrent() &gt;= CircuitBreakerUntil)\\n    {\\n        CircuitBreakerActive = false;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Circuit Breaker OFF \\u2014 waiting for new signal\\\&quot;);\\n        return true;\\n    }\\n    return false;\\n}\\n\\n//--- ATR Baseline Filter\\nbool CheckATRFilter()\\n{\\n    double atr = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    return (atr &gt;= ATR_MinValue);\\n}\\n\\n//--- Get ATR Value\\ndouble GetATR(ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf, int period)\\n{\\n    int    handle = iATR(_Symbol, tf, period);\\n    double buf[];\\n    ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);\\n    if(CopyBuffer(handle, 0, 0, 1, buf) &lt; 1) return 0;\\n    return buf[0];\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 12: TP/SL/Exit Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- Calculate TP Level by Mode\\ndouble CalcTPLevel(ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type, double entry,\\n                   ENUM_TP_LEVEL_MODE mode, double value)\\n{\\n    double atr  = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    double sl   = CalcSL(type);\\n    double dist = 0;\\n    switch(mode)\\n    {\\n        case TP_LEVEL_PIPS: dist = value * _Point * 10;          break;\\n        case TP_LEVEL_RR:   dist = MathAbs(entry - sl) * value;  break;\\n        case TP_LEVEL_ATR:  dist = atr * value;                  break;\\n    }\\n    return (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY) ? entry + dist : entry - dist;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Partial TP Manager\\nvoid CheckPartialTP()\\n{\\n    if(!PartialTP_ON) return;\\n    for(int i = PositionsTotal()-1; i &gt;= 0; i--)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);\\n        double bid       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);\\n        double volume    = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_VOLUME);\\n        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type =\\n            (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);\\n        double tp1 = CalcTPLevel(type, openPrice, TP1_Mode, TP1_Value);\\n        double tp2 = CalcTPLevel(type, openPrice, TP2_Mode, TP2_Value);\\n        bool tp1Hit = (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY) ? bid &gt;= tp1 : bid &lt;= tp1;\\n        if(tp1Hit)\\n        {\\n            double closeLot = NormalizeDouble(volume*(TP1_ClosePercent/100.0),2);\\n            Trade.PositionClosePartial(ticket, closeLot);\\n            if(BreakEven_ON)\\n            {\\n                double bePips = BreakEven_Buffer * _Point * 10;\\n                double newSL  = (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)\\n                              ? openPrice + bePips\\n                              : openPrice - bePips;\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, tp2);\\n            }\\n            if(Notify_TP1)\\n                SendAlert(\\\&quot;TP1 HIT | \\\&quot; + _Symbol\\n                    + \\\&quot; #\\\&quot; + IntegerToString(ticket));\\n            Print(\\\&quot;TP1 Hit | Partial Close \\\&quot;, TP1_ClosePercent, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Dynamic TP \\u2014 Net Profit \\u0e23\\u0e27\\u0e1a\\u0e17\\u0e38\\u0e01\\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e49\\nvoid CheckDynamicTP_Grid()\\n{\\n    if(TPMode != TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE) return;\\n    double totalProfit = 0;\\n    for(int i = 0; i &lt; PositionsTotal(); i++)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        totalProfit += PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)\\n                    +  PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SWAP);\\n    }\\n    double target = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE) * (TPBalancePct/100.0);\\n    if(totalProfit &gt;= target)\\n    {\\n        CloseAllOrders();\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Dynamic TP Hit | Net: \\\&quot;, totalProfit, \\\&quot; Target: \\\&quot;, target);\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- ATR Trailing Stop \\u2014 Adaptive + Spike Mode\\nvoid ManageATRTrail()\\n{\\n    if(!TrailingStop_ON) return;\\n    double atr       = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    double atrNormal = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period * 3);\\n    double trailDist;\\n    if(Trail_Mode == TRAIL_ATR)\\n        trailDist = (atr &gt; atrNormal * 2.0)\\n                  ? atr * (TrailATR_Multi * 0.5)  // Spike \\u2192 Trail \\u0e0a\\u0e34\\u0e14\\n                  : atr * TrailATR_Multi;\\n    else\\n        trailDist = TrailFixed_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    double trailStart = TrailStart_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    for(int i = PositionsTotal()-1; i &gt;= 0; i--)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);\\n        double currentSL = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SL);\\n        double bid       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);\\n        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type =\\n            (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);\\n        if(type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)\\n        {\\n            if(bid - openPrice &lt; trailStart) continue;\\n            double newSL = bid - trailDist;\\n            if(newSL &gt; currentSL)\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);\\n        }\\n        else\\n        {\\n            double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);\\n            if(openPrice - ask &lt; trailStart) continue;\\n            double newSL = ask + trailDist;\\n            if(newSL &lt; currentSL || currentSL == 0)\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Master Exit Logic \\u2014 3 Levels\\nvoid CheckExitLogic()\\n{\\n    CheckPartialTP();       // Level 1: Partial TP + Break Even\\n    ManageATRTrail();       // Level 2: Trailing Stop\\n    CheckDynamicTP_Grid();  // Level 3: Dynamic TP (Net Profit)\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 13: Risk Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- Apply Preset \\u2014 \\u0e40\\u0e23\\u0e35\\u0e22\\u0e01\\u0e43\\u0e19 OnInit() \\u0e01\\u0e48\\u0e2d\\u0e19\\u0e17\\u0e38\\u0e01\\u0e2d\\u0e22\\u0e48\\u0e32\\u0e07\\nvoid ApplyPreset()\\n{\\n    switch(TradeStyle)\\n    {\\n        case STYLE_SCALPING:\\n            TPFixedPips=15; StructureLookback=5;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=10; ATR_MinValue=0.0003;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=10; TrailATR_Multi=0;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_INTRADAY:\\n            TPFixedPips=40; StructureLookback=10;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=20; ATR_MinValue=0.0005;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=20; TrailATR_Multi=1.0;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_SWING:\\n            TPFixedPips=100; StructureLookback=20;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=30; ATR_MinValue=0.0008;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=50; TrailATR_Multi=1.5;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_TREND:\\n            TPFixedPips=200; StructureLookback=20;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=30; ATR_MinValue=0.0010;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=80; TrailATR_Multi=2.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n    switch(RiskLevel)\\n    {\\n        case RISK_SAFE:\\n            RiskPercent=0.5; MaxDrawdownPct=10.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=3.0; MaxOpenPositions=3;\\n            MaxTotalLot=0.1; CB_DD_Trigger=8.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_MEDIUM:\\n            RiskPercent=1.0; MaxDrawdownPct=20.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=5.0; MaxOpenPositions=5;\\n            MaxTotalLot=0.5; CB_DD_Trigger=15.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_AGGRESSIVE:\\n            RiskPercent=2.0; MaxDrawdownPct=35.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=10.0; MaxOpenPositions=10;\\n            MaxTotalLot=1.0; CB_DD_Trigger=25.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\ndouble GetCurrentDD()\\n{\\n    double equity  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double balance = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    if(balance &lt;= 0) return 0;\\n    return ((balance - equity) / balance) * 100.0;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckDrawdownLimit()\\n{\\n    if(GetCurrentDD() &gt;= MaxDrawdownPct)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;DD LIMIT: \\\&quot;, GetCurrentDD(), \\\&quot;% &gt;= \\\&quot;, MaxDrawdownPct, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckDailyLossLimit()\\n{\\n    double equity    = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double dailyLoss = ((DailyStartEquity - equity) / DailyStartEquity) * 100.0;\\n    if(dailyLoss &gt;= DailyLossPct)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;DAILY LOSS: \\\&quot;, dailyLoss, \\\&quot;% &gt;= \\\&quot;, DailyLossPct, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\nvoid ResetDailyStats()\\n{\\n    MqlDateTime dt;\\n    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);\\n    if(dt.hour == 0 &amp;&amp; dt.min == 0)\\n        DailyStartEquity = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckMargin(double lot)\\n{\\n    double marginRequired;\\n    if(!OrderCalcMargin(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, _Symbol, lot,\\n                        SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK),\\n                        marginRequired))\\n        return false;\\n    double freeMargin = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE);\\n    return (freeMargin &gt;= marginRequired * 1.5); // Safety Buffer 150%\\n}\\n\\ndouble AdjustLotForMaxSL(double lot, double slPips)\\n{\\n    if(slPips &lt;= MaxSL_Pips) return lot;\\n    double balance      = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    double maxRiskMoney = balance * (RiskPercent / 100.0);\\n    double pipValue     = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE);\\n    lot = maxRiskMoney / (MaxSL_Pips * pipValue);\\n    Print(\\\&quot;SL too wide \\u2192 Lot adjusted: \\\&quot;, lot);\\n    return NormalizeDouble(MathMax(lot, 0.01), 2);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 14: Hedge Module\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- GRID_REVERSAL Trigger (DD Based)\\nbool CheckHedgeActivation()\\n{\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; GetCurrentDD() &gt;= HedgeActivationDD);\\n}\\n\\n//--- FOLLOW_CANDLE Trigger\\nbool CheckCandleHedgeTrigger()\\n{\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE) return false;\\n    double atr      = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    double bodySize = MathAbs(iOpen(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1)\\n                   -          iClose(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1));\\n    bool bigBearish = (iClose(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1)\\n                    &lt;  iOpen (_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1))\\n                   &amp;&amp; (bodySize &gt; atr * HedgeCandle_ATRMulti);\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; bigBearish);\\n}\\n\\n//--- FOLLOW_TREND Trigger (EMA Cross)\\nbool CheckTrendHedgeTrigger()\\n{\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND) return false;\\n    double fast0 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_FastEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 0);\\n    double fast1 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_FastEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 1);\\n    double slow0 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_SlowEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 0);\\n    double slow1 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_SlowEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 1);\\n    bool bearishCross = (fast1 &gt; slow1) &amp;&amp; (fast0 &lt; slow0);\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; bearishCross);\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckHedgeDeactivation()\\n{\\n    double equity       = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double balance      = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    double floatLossPct = ((balance - equity) / balance) * 100.0;\\n    return (HedgeActive &amp;&amp; floatLossPct &lt;= HedgeDeactivateDD);\\n}\\n\\ndouble GetHedgeRatio(double dd)\\n{\\n    if(dd &gt;= 25.0) return 1.00;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 20.0) return 0.70;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 15.0) return 0.50;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 10.0) return 0.30;\\n    return 0.0;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckEmergencyExit()\\n{\\n    if(GetCurrentDD() &gt;= EmergencyExitDD)\\n    {\\n        CloseAllOrders();\\n        if(Notify_Emergency)\\n            SendAlert(\\\&quot;EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: \\\&quot;\\n                + DoubleToString(GetCurrentDD(),1) + \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        Print(\\\&quot;EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: \\\&quot;, GetCurrentDD(), \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 15: S/R Module\\n\\n```mql5\\nENUM_TIMEFRAMES GetSR_Timeframe()\\n{\\n    if(!SR_AutoHTF) return SR_ManualTF;\\n    switch(EntryTimeframe)\\n    {\\n        case PERIOD_M1:\\n        case PERIOD_M5:\\n        case PERIOD_M15: return PERIOD_H1;\\n        case PERIOD_H1:  return PERIOD_H4;\\n        case PERIOD_H4:  return PERIOD_D1;\\n        case PERIOD_D1:  return PERIOD_W1;\\n        default:         return PERIOD_H4;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nvoid UpdateSR()\\n{\\n    if(SR_Mode == SR_NONE) return;\\n    ENUM_TIMEFRAMES htf = GetSR_Timeframe();\\n    DetectSwingPoints(htf);\\n    MergeSRZones(htf);\\n    Print(\\\&quot;S/R Updated | HTF: \\\&quot;, EnumToString(htf),\\n          \\\&quot; | Zones: \\\&quot;, \\u2192 MT5 Mobile App\\n    Print(\\\&quot;[ALERT] \\\&quot;, message);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 17: Dashboard\\n\\nDashboard \\u0e41\\u0e2a\\u0e14\\u0e07\\u0e17\\u0e38\\u0e01 Tick \\u2014 # 📋 Step 1: Config ที่ต้องกรอกเอง

ส่วนที่ **ไม่มี Auto-fill** — ต้องระบุเองครับ

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
║      HALF TREND EA — CONFIG          ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════╣
║ [ HALF TREND PARAMETERS ]            ║
║ Amplitude         : (default = 2)    ║
║ Channel Deviation : (default = 2.0)  ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════╣
║ [ GRID ]                             ║
║ Grid Mode    : NONE/FIX/DYNAMIC/PA   ║
║ Grid Max     : (default = 5)         ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════╣
║ [ TP / SL ]                          ║
║ TP Mode      : FIXED/RR/DYNAMIC      ║
║ SL Mode      : STRUCTURE/RANGE_TREND ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════╣
║ [ HEDGE ]                            ║
║ Hedge Mode   : OFF/GRID_REV/         ║
║                CANDLE/TREND          ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════╣
║ [ ACCOUNT ]                          ║
║ Balance      : $                     ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════╝
```

# 🎯 ที่คุณต้องการคือแบบนี้

```
ใน MT5 Strategy Tester → Tab "Inputs"
├── TradeStyle   : [Dropdown] SCALPING / INTRADAY / SWING / TREND
├── RiskLevel    : [Dropdown] SAFE / MEDIUM / AGGRESSIVE
├── EntryTF      : [Dropdown] M5 / M15 / H1 / H4 / D1
├── GridMode     : [Dropdown] NONE / FIX / DYNAMIC / PA
├── TPMode       : [Dropdown] FIXED / RR / DYNAMIC
├── SLMode       : [Dropdown] STRUCTURE / RANGE_TREND
├── HedgeMode    : [Dropdown] OFF / GRID_REV / CANDLE / TREND
└── ...

แล้วตอน Optimize → ติ๊ก ✅ ทุกตัว
→ MT5 จะ Run ทุก Combination ให้อัตโนมัติ
```

# ✅ ทำได้ใน MQL5 — ใช้ ENUM

นี่คือสิ่งที่ **ENUM ใน MQL5 ทำได้อยู่แล้ว** ครับ ไม่ต้องทำอะไรพิเศษ

```mql5
// Enum = Dropdown อัตโนมัติใน MT5 Input Tab

enum ENUM_TRADE_STYLE
{
    STYLE_SCALPING,   // Scalping
    STYLE_INTRADAY,   // Intraday
    STYLE_SWING,      // Swing
    STYLE_TREND       // Trend Following
};

input ENUM_TRADE_STYLE  TradeStyle  = STYLE_INTRADAY;
//     ↑ MT5 แสดงเป็น Dropdown ให้อัตโนมัติเลย
```

## หน้าตาใน MT5 จะเป็นแบบนี้

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Strategy Tester — Input Parameters         │
├──────────────────┬──────────┬───────────────┤
│ Parameter        │ Value    │ Optimize      │
├──────────────────┼──────────┼───────────────┤
│ TradeStyle       │ Intraday │ ☐ (ติ๊กได้)  │
│ RiskLevel        │ Medium   │ ☐             │
│ EntryTimeframe   │ H1       │ ☐             │
│ GridMode         │ None     │ ☐             │
│ TPMode           │ TP_RR    │ ☐             │
│ SLMode           │Structure │ ☐             │
│ HedgeMode        │ Off      │ ☐             │
│ MMMode           │ Fixed    │ ☐             │
└──────────────────┴──────────┴───────────────┘

ตอน Optimize → ติ๊ก ✅ ทุกแถว
→ MT5 Run ทุก Combination อัตโนมัติ
```

---

# 📐 Enum ที่ต้องมีทั้งหมด — สำหรับ Half Trend EA

```mql5
//=== PRESET LAYER ===

enum ENUM_TRADE_STYLE
{
    STYLE_SCALPING,     // Scalping
    STYLE_INTRADAY,     // Intraday
    STYLE_SWING,        // Swing
    STYLE_TREND         // Trend Following
};

enum ENUM_RISK_LEVEL
{
    RISK_SAFE,          // Safe
    RISK_MEDIUM,        // Medium
    RISK_AGGRESSIVE     // Aggressive
};

//=== GRID ===

enum ENUM_GRID_MODE
{
    GRID_NONE,          // No Grid
    GRID_FIX,           // Fixed Pips
    GRID_DYNAMIC,       // ATR Based
    GRID_PA             // Price Action
};

//=== MM ===

enum ENUM_MM_MODE
{
    MM_FIXED,           // Fixed Lot
    MM_LINEAR,          // Linear Step
    MM_MARTINGALE,      // Martingale
    MM_LOG              // Logarithmic
};

//=== TP ===

enum ENUM_TP_MODE
{
    TP_FIXED,           // Fixed Pips
    TP_RR,              // Risk:Reward Ratio
    TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE  // % of Balance
};

enum ENUM_TP_LEVEL_MODE
{
    TP_LEVEL_PIPS,      // Pips
    TP_LEVEL_RR,        // RR Ratio
    TP_LEVEL_ATR        // ATR Multiple
};

//=== SL ===

enum ENUM_SL_MODE
{
    SL_STRUCTURE,       // Swing High/Low
    SL_RANGE_TREND      // ADX Based
};

//=== TRAILING ===

enum ENUM_TRAIL_MODE
{
    TRAIL_ATR,          // ATR Multiple
    TRAIL_FIXED         // Fixed Pips
};

//=== HEDGE ===

enum ENUM_HEDGE_MODE
{
    HEDGE_OFF,              // No Hedge
    HEDGE_GRID_REVERSAL,    // DD Based
    HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE,    // Candle Signal
    HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND      // EMA Cross
};

enum ENUM_HEDGE_LOT_MODE
{
    HEDGE_LOT_SYMMETRIC,    // All lots equal ratio
    HEDGE_LOT_ASYMMETRIC    // First lot 30%, rest symmetric
};

//=== S/R ===

enum ENUM_SR_MODE
{
    SR_NONE,            // No S/R
    SR_SWING,           // Swing Points
    SR_SWING_STRENGTH   // Swing + Strength Filter
};
```

---

# 🔧 Input Section ที่ได้ — Dropdown ทุกตัว

```mql5
//--- 3.1 PRESET LAYER — Dropdown ทั้งหมด
input string            _PRESET_        = "=== PRESET ===";
input ENUM_TRADE_STYLE  TradeStyle      = STYLE_INTRADAY;
// ↑ Dropdown: Scalping / Intraday / Swing / Trend

input ENUM_RISK_LEVEL   RiskLevel       = RISK_MEDIUM;
// ↑ Dropdown: Safe / Medium / Aggressive

input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES   EntryTimeframe  = PERIOD_H1;
// ↑ Dropdown: M1/M5/M15/H1/H4/D1/W1 (MT5 Built-in)

//--- 3.4 GRID — Dropdown
input ENUM_GRID_MODE    GridMode        = GRID_NONE;
// ↑ Dropdown: No Grid / Fixed Pips / ATR Based / Price Action

//--- 3.5 MM — Dropdown
input ENUM_MM_MODE      MMMode          = MM_FIXED;
// ↑ Dropdown: Fixed / Linear / Martingale / Log

//--- 3.6 TP — Dropdown
input ENUM_TP_MODE      TPMode          = TP_FIXED;
// ↑ Dropdown: Fixed Pips / RR Ratio / % Balance

input ENUM_TP_LEVEL_MODE TP1_Mode       = TP_LEVEL_RR;
// ↑ Dropdown: Pips / RR / ATR

input ENUM_TP_LEVEL_MODE TP2_Mode       = TP_LEVEL_RR;
// ↑ Dropdown: Pips / RR / ATR

//--- 3.7 SL — Dropdown
input ENUM_SL_MODE      SLMode          = SL_STRUCTURE;
// ↑ Dropdown: Swing High/Low / ADX Based

//--- 3.8 TRAIL — Dropdown
input ENUM_TRAIL_MODE   Trail_Mode      = TRAIL_ATR;
// ↑ Dropdown: ATR Multiple / Fixed Pips

//--- 3.9 HEDGE — Dropdown
input ENUM_HEDGE_MODE   HedgeMode       = HEDGE_OFF;
// ↑ Dropdown: Off / DD Based / Candle / EMA Cross

input ENUM_HEDGE_LOT_MODE HedgeLotMode  = HEDGE_LOT_SYMMETRIC;
// ↑ Dropdown: Symmetric / Asymmetric

//--- 3.10 S/R — Dropdown
input ENUM_SR_MODE      SR_Mode         = SR_NONE;
// ↑ Dropdown: None / Swing / Swing+Strength

//--- 3.11 ATR TF — Dropdown (MT5 Built-in)
input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES   ATR_TF_Filter   = PERIOD_CURRENT;
input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES   ATR_TF_Grid     = PERIOD_H1;
// ↑ ทั้งสองเป็น Dropdown TF อัตโนมัติ
```

---

# 🧪 Optimization Workflow ที่ได้

```
MT5 Strategy Tester → Optimization Mode

Step 1: ติ๊ก Optimize ทุก Dropdown
┌─────────────────────┬────────────────────────┐
│ TradeStyle          │ ✅ All 4 options        │
│ RiskLevel           │ ✅ All 3 options        │
│ EntryTimeframe      │ ✅ M15 / H1 / H4       │
│ GridMode            │ ✅ All 4 options        │
│ MMMode              │ ✅ All 4 options        │
│ TPMode              │ ✅ All 3 options        │
│ SLMode              │ ✅ All 2 options        │
│ HedgeMode           │ ✅ All 4 options        │
└─────────────────────┴────────────────────────┘

Step 2: MT5 คำนวณ Combinations
4 × 3 × 3 × 4 × 4 × 3 × 2 × 4 = 13,824 combinations

Step 3: ดู Result
→ Sort by Profit Factor / Sharpe Ratio
→ เลือก Top 10 Combination
→ Forward Test ต่อ
```

Form\\n\\nกรอกครั้งเดียวจบ — ช่องที่มี [auto] จะถูก fill จาก Preset ใน Step 0\\n\\n## [ GENERAL ]\\n- Symbol          : _Symbol (any)\\n- Entry TF        : M5 / M15 / H1 / H4 / D1\\n- ATR TF Filter   : [auto = Entry TF]\\n- ATR TF Grid     : [auto จาก Style] หรือ Config เอง\\n- Trade Style     : SCALPING / INTRADAY / SWING / TREND\\n- Risk Profile    : SAFE / MEDIUM / AGGRESSIVE\\n- AllowBuy        : true\\n- AllowSell       : true\\n\\n## [ ENTRY LOGIC ]\\n- Entry Indicator : [ระบุ เช่น HalfTrend / EMA / RSI / BB / MACD]\\n- Entry Condition : [ระบุ Condition ให้ชัดเจน]\\n- Entry Type      : EMA Period : [21]\\nSignal          : Fast ตัด Slow ขึ้น → Buy / ลง → Sell\\n```\\n\\n#### RSI\\n```\\nRSI Period  : [14]\\nBuy Signal  : RSI &lt; [30]\\nSell Signal : RSI &gt; [70]\\n```\\n\\n#### MACD\\n```\\nFast / Slow / Signal : [12/26/9]\\nBuy  : MACD Line ตัด Signal Line ขึ้น\\nSell : MACD Line ตัด Signal Line ลง\\n```\\n\\n#### Bollinger Bands\\n```\\nPeriod / Deviation : [20 / 2.0]\\nBuy  : ราคาแตะ Lower Band + ปิดกลับเข้า\\nSell : ราคาแตะ Upper Band + ปิดกลับเข้า\\n```\\n\\n#### Candle Pattern\\n```\\nPattern     : PIN_BAR / ENGULFING / INSIDE_BAR / DOJI / CUSTOM\\nDirection   : Bullish / Bearish / Both\\nConfirm TF  : [ระบุ]\\n```\\n\\n## [ GRID MODULE ]\\n- Grid Mode       : NONE / FIX / DYNAMIC / PA\\n- Grid Fix Pips   : [auto จาก Style] default=50\\n- Grid ATR Multi  : 1.5\\n- Grid PA Signal  : PIN_BAR / ENGULFING / INSIDE_BAR / DOJI / CUSTOM\\n- Grid Max Orders : 5\\n- Grid Direction  : Same Direction Only / Both\\n\\n## [ MONEY MANAGEMENT ]\\n- MM Mode         : FIXED / LINEAR / MARTINGALE / LOG\\n- Base Lot        : [คำนวณจาก Balance × Risk% / SL pips × PipValue]\\n- Martingale Multi: 1.5\\n- Linear Step     : 0.01\\n- Account Balance : [ระบุ]\\n\\n&gt; สูตร: Lot = (Balance × Risk%) / (SL_pips × PipValue)\\n\\n## [ TAKE PROFIT ]\\n- TP Mode         : TP_FIXED / TP_RR / TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE\\n- TP Fixed Pips   : [auto จาก Style]\\n- TP RR Ratio     : [auto จาก Style]\\n- TP Balance Pct  : 1.0%\\n\\n## [ PARTIAL TP + BREAK EVEN ]\\n- PartialTP_ON        : false\\n- TP1 Mode            : PIPS / RR / ATR\\n- TP1 Value           : 30\\n- TP1 Close Percent   : 50%\\n- TP2 Mode            : PIPS / RR / ATR\\n- TP2 Value           : 60\\n- BreakEven_ON        : false\\n- BreakEven Buffer    : 5 pips (หลัง Entry)\\n\\n### Partial TP Logic\\n```\\nTP1 Hit:\\n├── ปิด TP1_ClosePercent% ของ Position\\n├── ย้าย SL → Break Even (Entry + Buffer) ถ้า BreakEven_ON\\n└── ปล่อยส่วนที่เหลือวิ่งต่อไป TP2\\n\\nTP2 Hit:\\n└── ปิดที่เหลือทั้งหมด\\n```\\n\\n## [ STOP LOSS ]\\n- SL Mode             : SL_STRUCTURE / SL_RANGE_TREND\\n- Structure Lookback  : [auto จาก Style]\\n- ADX Period          : 14\\n- ADX Threshold       : 25.0\\n- Max SL Pips         : 200 (ถ้า SL กว้างกว่านี้ → Lot จะถูกลดอัตโนมัติ)\\n\\n## [ TRAILING STOP ]\\n- TrailingStop_ON     : false\\n- Trail Mode          : ATR / FIXED\\n- Trail ATR Multi     : [auto จาก Style]\\n- Trail Fixed Pips    : 20\\n- Trail Start Pips    : [auto จาก Style]\\n\\n### Trail Logic\\n```\\nATR Mode  : Trail Distance = ATR × Multi\\n            Spike เกิด (ATR &gt; ATRNormal×2) → Trail ชิดขึ้น (×0.5)\\nFIXED Mode: Trail Distance = Fixed Pips คงที่\\n```\\n\\n## [ HEDGE MODULE ]\\n- Hedge Mode      : OFF / GRID_REVERSAL / FOLLOW_CANDLE / FOLLOW_TREND\\n\\n### GRID_REVERSAL Parameters\\n- Activation DD%  : 10%\\n- Deactivation DD%: 2%\\n- Emergency DD%   : 70%\\n- Hedge Lot Mode  : SYMMETRIC / ASYMMETRIC\\n- Partial Close Pips: 10\\n\\n### FOLLOW_CANDLE Parameters\\n- HedgeCandle ATR Multi : 2.0\\n  (Candle Body &gt; ATR × Multi → Trigger)\\n\\n### FOLLOW_TREND Parameters\\n- HedgeTrend Fast EMA : 9\\n- HedgeTrend Slow EMA : 21\\n  (EMA Cross สวนทาง → Trigger)\\n\\n### Common — ทุก Hedge Mode\\n- Emergency DD%      : 70%\\n- Partial Close Pips : 10\\n- Hedge Lot Mode     : SYMMETRIC / ASYMMETRIC\\n  - SYMMETRIC  : ทุกไม้ Lot ตาม Buy Grid × Ratio\\n  - ASYMMETRIC : ไม้แรก = 30% ของ baseLot, ไม้ถัดไป Symmetric\\n\\n### Hedge + Grid Behavior (สำคัญ)\\n```\\n✅ Grid เปิดต่อได้แม้ Hedge Active จนถึง Max Grid Orders\\n✅ Hedge Partial Close แล้ว Grid เปิดต่อได้ทันที\\n✅ Hedge ปิดแล้ว GridOrderCount ต่อจากเดิม — ไม่ Reset\\n```\\n\\n### Hedge Scale Ladder (GRID_REVERSAL)\\n| DD% | Hedge Ratio | หมายเหตุ |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| 10–15% | 30% ของ Total Exposure | เริ่ม Hedge เบา |\\n| 15–20% | 50% ของ Total Exposure | Hedge ปานกลาง |\\n| 20–25% | 70% ของ Total Exposure | Hedge หนัก |\\n| &gt; 25% | 100% Full Hedge | Grid ยังเปิดต่อได้จนถึง Max |\\n\\n### Hedge Option เปรียบเทียบ\\n| | GRID_REVERSAL | FOLLOW_CANDLE | FOLLOW_TREND |\\n|---|---|---|---|\\n| Trigger | DD% | Candle Body &gt; ATR×Multi | |\\n\\n## [ BLACK SWAN PROTECTION ]\\n- VolSpike Filter ON  : false\\n- VolSpike Multi      : 3.0 (Current Bar TR &gt; ATR × Multi → Block ทันที)\\n- MaxSpread Hard      : 50 pts (Hard Cap Real-time TP Level by Mode\\ndouble CalcTPLevel(ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type, double entry,\\n                   ENUM_TP_LEVEL_MODE mode, double value)\\n{\\n    double atr  = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n dist;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Partial TP Manager\\nvoid CheckPartialTP()\\n{\\n    if(!PartialTP_ON) return;\\n    for(int i = PositionsTotal()-1; i &gt;= 0; i--)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = NormalizeDouble(volume*(TP1_ClosePercent/100.0),2);\\n            Trade.PositionClosePartial(ticket, closeLot);\\n            if(BreakEven_ON)\\n            {\\n                double bePips = BreakEven_Buffer * _Point * 10;\\n                double newSL  = (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)\\n                              ? openPrice + bePips\\n                              : openPrice -  + \\\&quot; #\\\&quot; + IntegerToString(ticket));\\n            Print(\\\&quot;TP1 Hit | Partial Close \\\&quot;, TP1_ClosePercent, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Dynamic TP — Net Profit รวบทุกไม้\\nvoid CheckDynamicTP_Grid()\\n{\\n    if(TPMode != TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE) return;\\n    double totalProfit = 0;\\n    for(int i = 0; i &lt; PositionsTotal(); i++)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        totalProfit += PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)\\n                    +  PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SWAP);\\n    }\\n    double target = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE) * (TPBalancePct/100.0);\\n Trailing Stop — Adaptive + Spike Mode\\nvoid ManageATRTrail()\\n{\\n    if(!TrailingStop_ON) return;\\n    double atr       = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    double atrNormal = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period * 3);\\n    double trailDist;\\n    if(Trail_Mode == TRAIL_ATR)\\n        trailDist = (atr &gt; atrNormal * 2.0)\\n                  ? atr * (TrailATR_Multi * 0.5)  //          if(bid - openPrice &lt; trailStart) continue;\\n            double newSL = bid - trailDist;\\n            if(newSL &gt; currentSL)\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);\\n        }\\n        else\\n        {\\n            double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);\\n            if(openPrice - ask &lt; trailStart) continue;\\n            double newSL = ask + trailDist;\\n            if(newSL &lt; currentSL || currentSL == 0)\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Master Exit Logic — 3 Levels\\nvoid Profit)\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 13: Risk Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- Apply Preset — เรียกใน OnInit() ก่อนทุกอย่าง\\nvoid ApplyPreset()\\n{\\n    switch(TradeStyle)\\n    {\\n        case     case STYLE_INTRADAY:\\n            TPFixedPips=40; StructureLookback=10;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=20; ATR_MinValue=0.0005;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=20; TrailATR_Multi=1.0;\\n           break;\\n        case STYLE_TREND:\\n            TPFixedPips=200; StructureLookback=20;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=30; ATR_MinValue=0.0010;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=80; TrailATR_Multi=2.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n    switch(RiskLevel)\\n    {\\n        case RISK_SAFE:\\n            RiskPercent=0.5; MaxDrawdownPct=10.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=3.0; MaxOpenPositions=3;\\n            MaxTotalLot=0.1; CB_DD_Trigger=8.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_MEDIUM:\\n            RiskPercent=1.0; MaxDrawdownPct=20.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=5.0; MaxOpenPositions=5;\\n            MaxTotalLot=0.5; CB_DD_Trigger=15.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_AGGRESSIVE:\\n            RiskPercent=2.0; MaxDrawdownPct=35.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=10.0; MaxOpenPositions=10;\\n            MaxTotalLot=1.0; CB_DD_Trigger=25.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\ndouble GetCurrentDD()\\n{\\n    double equity  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double balance = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    if(balance &lt;= 0) return 0;\\n    return ((balance - equity) / balance) * 100.0;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckDrawdownLimit()\\n{\\n    if(GetCurrentDD() &gt;= MaxDrawdownPct)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;DD LIMIT: \\\&quot;, GetCurrentDD(), \\\&quot;% &gt;= \\\&quot;, MaxDrawdownPct, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckDailyLossLimit()\\n{\\n    double equity    = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double dailyLoss = ((DailyStartEquity - equity) / DailyStartEquity) * 100.0;\\n    if(dailyLoss &gt;= DailyLossPct)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;DAILY LOSS: \\\&quot;, dailyLoss, \\\&quot;% &gt;= \\\&quot;, DailyLossPct, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\nvoid ResetDailyStats()\\n{\\n    MqlDateTime dt;\\n    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);\\n    if(dt.hour == 0 &amp;&amp; dt.min == 0)\\n        DailyStartEquity = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckMargin(double lot)\\n{\\n    double marginRequired;\\n    if(!OrderCalcMargin(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, _Symbol, lot,\\n                        SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK),\\n                        marginRequired))\\n        return false;\\n    double freeMargin = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE);\\n    return (freeMargin &gt;= marginRequired * 1.5); // Safety Buffer 150%\\n}\\n\\ndouble AdjustLotForMaxSL(double lot, double slPips)\\n{\\n    if(slPips &lt;= MaxSL_Pips) return lot;\\n    double balance      = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    double maxRiskMoney = balance * (RiskPercent / 100.0);\\n    double pipValue     = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE);\\n    lot = maxRiskMoney / (MaxSL_Pips * pipValue);\\n    Print(\\\&quot;SL too wide → Lot adjusted: \\\&quot;, lot);\\n    return NormalizeDouble(MathMax(lot, 0.01), 2);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 14: Hedge Module\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- GRID_REVERSAL Trigger (DD Based)\\nbool CheckHedgeActivation()\\n{\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; GetCurrentDD() &gt;= HedgeActivationDD);\\n}\\n\\n//--- FOLLOW_CANDLE Trigger\\nbool CheckCandleHedgeTrigger()\\n{\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE) return false;\\n    double atr      = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    double bodySize = MathAbs(iOpen(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1)\\n                   -          iClose(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1));\\n    bool bigBearish = (iClose(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1)\\n                    &lt;  iOpen (_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1))\\n                   &amp;&amp; (bodySize &gt; atr * HedgeCandle_ATRMulti);\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; bigBearish);\\n}\\n\\n//--- FOLLOW_TREND Trigger (EMA Cross)\\nbool CheckTrendHedgeTrigger()\\n{\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND) return false;\\n    double fast0 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_FastEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 0);\\n    double fast1 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_FastEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 1);\\n    double slow0 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_SlowEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 0);\\n    double slow1 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_SlowEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 1);\\n    bool bearishCross = (fast1 &gt; slow1) &amp;&amp; (fast0 &lt; slow0);\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; bearishCross);\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckHedgeDeactivation()\\n{\\n    double equity       = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double balance      = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    double floatLossPct = ((balance - equity) / balance) * 100.0;\\n    return (HedgeActive &amp;&amp; floatLossPct &lt;= HedgeDeactivateDD);\\n}\\n\\ndouble GetHedgeRatio(double dd)\\n{\\n    if(dd &gt;= 25.0) return 1.00;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 20.0) return 0.70;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 15.0) return 0.50;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 10.0) return 0.30;\\n    return 0.0;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckEmergencyExit()\\n{\\n    if(GetCurrentDD() &gt;= EmergencyExitDD)\\n    {\\n        CloseAllOrders();\\n        if(Notify_Emergency)\\n            SendAlert(\\\&quot;EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: \\\&quot;\\n                + DoubleToString(GetCurrentDD(),1) + \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        Print(\\\&quot;EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: \\\&quot;, GetCurrentDD(), \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 15: S/R Module\\n\\n```mql5\\nENUM_TIMEFRAMES GetSR_Timeframe()\\n{\\n    if(!SR_AutoHTF) return SR_ManualTF;\\n    switch(EntryTimeframe)\\n    {\\n PERIOD_D1:  return PERIOD_W1;\\n        default:         return PERIOD_H4;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nvoid UpdateSR()\\n{\\n    if(SR_Mode == SR_NONE) return;\\n    ENUM_TIMEFRAMES htf = GetSR_Timeframe();\\n    DetectSwingPoints(htf);\\n    MergeSRZones(htf);\\n    Print(\\\&quot;S/R Updated | HTF: \\\&quot;, EnumToString(htf),\\n          \\\&quot; | Zones: \\\&quot;, MT5 Mobile App\\n    Print(\\\&quot;[ALERT] \\\&quot;, message);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 17: Dashboard\\n\\nDashboard แสดงทุก Tick — ใช้ ObjectCreate บน Chart:\\n- Equity / Balance / DD%\\n- Spread / ATR (Filter + Grid)\\n- Trade Style / Risk Profile\\n- Open Positions / Grid Order Count / Grid Max\\n- Hedge Status: Active / Inactive + Mode\\n- Circuit Breaker: ON (Resume time) / OFF\\n- SR Zone Count\\n- TP1 Hit Status\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Coding Rules (บังคับทุก EA)\\n\\n## ✅ Must Have\\n- ทุก Function มี Comment ภาษาอังกฤษ\\n- ทุก OpenOrder ผ่าน `CheckMargin()` ก่อน\\n- OnTick() ผ่าน Safety Check ตามลำดับใน Section 7 เสมอ\\n- `ApplyPreset()` เรียกใน `OnInit()` ก่อนทุกอย่าง\\n- SL ต้องมีทุก Order — ห้าม SL = 0\\n- S/R Update เฉพาะ New Bar\\n- `GridOrderCount` ไม่ Reset เมื่อ Hedge Symbol — ใช้ `_Symbol` เสมอ\\n- ❌ เปิด Order โดยไม่เช็ค Free Margin\\n- ❌ ใช้ Magic Number ซ้ำกับ EA อื่น\\n- ❌ คำนวณ S/R ทุก Tick\\n- ❌ เริ่มเขียนโค้ดก่อนได้รับ Spec Card สมบูรณ์\\n- ❌ สร้าง Logic ทั้งหมด + Default + คำอธิบาย\\n3. **Backtest Settings** — Setting แนะนำสำหรับ MT5 Strategy Tester\\n4. **Risk Warning** — แจ้งถ้า Combination มีความเสี่ยงสูง\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Version History\\n| ## ⚠️ สิ่งที่ยังขาด — สำคัญ

### 1. Optimize ง่ายขึ้นได้อีก — ตรงประเด็นที่ถาม

```
ปัญหาตอนนี้:
ENUM Dropdown มีแล้ว ✅
แต่ตอน Optimize MT5 จะ Run ทุก Combination
รวมถึง Combination ที่ "ไม่ Valid" ด้วย

เช่น:
├── TradeStyle = SCALPING + HedgeMode = FOLLOW_TREND
│   → ไม่เหมาะกัน แต่ MT5 ก็ยัง Run
├── GridMode = NONE + MMMode = MARTINGALE
│   → Martingale โดยไม่มี Grid = ไม่มีความหมาย
└── TPMode = TP_DYNAMIC + TrailingStop = ON
    → ซ้ำซ้อน Exit Signal

วิธีแก้ → เพิ่ม Combination Guard ใน ApplyPreset()
```

```mql5
// เพิ่มใน ApplyPreset() — ล้าง Combination ที่ไม่ Valid
void ValidateCombination()
{
    // SCALPING ไม่ควรใช้ FOLLOW_TREND Hedge
    if(TradeStyle == STYLE_SCALPING &&
       HedgeMode  == HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND)
    {
        HedgeMode = HEDGE_OFF;
        Print("WARN: SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND → Hedge OFF");
    }

    // NONE Grid ไม่ควรใช้ MARTINGALE
    if(GridMode == GRID_NONE &&
       MMMode   == MM_MARTINGALE)
    {
        MMMode = MM_FIXED;
        Print("WARN: No Grid + MARTINGALE → MM_FIXED");
    }

    // Dynamic TP + Trailing ซ้ำซ้อน → เลือก Dynamic TP
    if(TPMode          == TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE &&
       TrailingStop_ON == true)
    {
        TrailingStop_ON = false;
        Print("WARN: DYNAMIC_TP + Trail → Trail OFF");
    }
}
```

## 💡 วิธี Optimize ที่ง่ายกว่าตอนนี้

### แนวทางที่ 1: Preset Combination Matrix (เพิ่มใน .md)

```
แทนที่จะ Optimize ทุก Combination
→ กำหนด Valid Combinations ไว้ล่วงหน้า

| Style    | Grid    | MM          | Hedge          | TP Mode  |
|----------|---------|-------------|----------------|----------|
| SCALPING | NONE    | FIXED       | OFF            | FIXED    |
| SCALPING | FIX     | LINEAR      | FOLLOW_CANDLE  | FIXED    |
| INTRADAY | NONE    | FIXED       | OFF            | RR       |
| INTRADAY | DYNAMIC | LINEAR      | GRID_REVERSAL  | RR       |
| SWING    | DYNAMIC | MARTINGALE  | GRID_REVERSAL  | RR       |
| TREND    | NONE    | FIXED       | FOLLOW_TREND   | DYNAMIC  |

→ Optimize เฉพาะ Valid Rows = ลด Run Time มาก
```

### แนวทางที่ 2: 2-Phase Optimization (เพิ่มใน .md)

```
Phase 1: Macro Optimize (ENUM Dropdown)
─────────────────────────────────────
Vary: TradeStyle / RiskLevel / GridMode / HedgeMode
Fix : Parameter ตัวเลขทั้งหมด (ใช้ Default)
Goal: หา Combination ที่ Profitable

Phase 2: Micro Optimize (ตัวเลข)
──────────────────────────────────
Fix : ENUM ที่ดีที่สุดจาก Phase 1
Vary: ATR_Multi / GridPips / TrailStart / RRRatio
Goal: Fine-tune Parameter
```

MACD\\n```\\nFast / Slow / Signal : [12/26/9]\\nBuy  : MACD Line ตัด Signal Line ขึ้น\\nSell : MACD Line ตัด Signal Line ลง\\n```\\n\\n#### Bollinger Bands\\n```\\nPeriod / Deviation : [20 / 2.0]\\nBuy  : ราคาแตะ Lower Band + ปิดกลับเข้า\\nSell : ราคาแตะ Upper Band + ปิดกลับเข้า\\n```\\n\\n#### Candle Pattern\\n```\\nPattern     : PIN_BAR / ENGULFING / INSIDE_BAR / DOJI / CUSTOM\\nDirection   : Bullish / Bearish / Both\\nConfirm TF  : [ระบุ]\\n```\\n\\n## [ GRID MODULE ]\\n- Grid Mode       : NONE / FIX / DYNAMIC / PA\\n- Grid Fix Pips   : [auto จาก Style] |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| 10–15% | 30% ของ Total Exposure | เริ่ม Hedge เบา |\\n| 15–20% | 50% ของ Total Exposure | Hedge ปานกลาง |\\n| 20–25% | 70% ของ Total Exposure | Hedge หนัก |\\n| &gt; 25% | 100% \\u0e15\\u0e23\\u0e27\\u0e08\\u0e2a\\u0e2d\\u0e1a Symbol\\n    if(!SymbolSelect(_Symbol, true))\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;ERROR: Cannot select symbol \\\&quot;, _Symbol);\\n        return \\\&quot; | Magic: \\\&quot;, MagicNumber,\\n          \\\&quot; | Style: \\\&quot;, EnumToString(TradeStyle),\\n          \\\&quot; | Risk: \\\&quot;, EnumToString(RiskLevel),\\n          \\\&quot; | Balance: \\\&quot;, InitialBalance);\\n\\n    return INIT_SUCCEEDED;\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 7: OnTick() Template\\n\\n```mql5\\nvoid OnTick()\\n{\\n    ResetDailyStats();\\n\\n    // 7.1 Emergency Exit\\n    if(!CheckEmergencyExit())     return;\\n    // 7.2 Drawdown Check\\n    if(!CheckDrawdownLimit())     return;\\n    // 7.3 Daily Loss Check\\n    if(!CheckDailyLossLimit())    return;\\n    // 7.4 Circuit Breaker\\n    if(!CheckCircuitBreaker())    return;\\n    // 7.5 Spread Spike Hard Cap (Real-time)\\n    if(!CheckSpreadSpike())       return;\\n    // 7.6 Current Bar TR Spike\\n    if(!CheckCurrentBarSpike())   return;\\n    // 7.7 Price Gap (New Bar Only)\\n    if(!CheckPriceGap())          return;\\n    // 7.8 ATR Baseline Filter\\n    if(!CheckATRFilter())  if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_OFF)\\n    {\\n        bool hedgeTrigger = false;\\n        switch(HedgeMode)\\n        {\\n            case HEDGE_GRID_REVERSAL:\\n                hedgeTrigger = CheckHedgeActivation();    break;\\n            case HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE:\\n                hedgeTrigger = CheckCandleHedgeTrigger(); break;\\n            case HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND:\\n                hedgeTrigger = CheckTrendHedgeTrigger();  break;\\n        }\\n        if(hedgeTrigger)\\n        {\\n            HedgeActive = true;\\n            ManageHedgePartialClose();\\n            OpenHedgeOrder();\\n        }\\n        if(HedgeActive &amp;&amp; CheckHedgeDeactivation())\\n        {\\n            HedgeActive     = false;\\n            HedgeOrderCount = 0;\\n            // \\u0e40\\u0e1b\\u0e34\\u0e14\\u0e15\\u0e48\\u0e2d\\u0e44\\u0e14\\u0e49\\u0e40\\u0e2a\\u0e21\\u0e2d \\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48\\u0e2a\\u0e19\\u0e27\\u0e48\\u0e32 Hedge Active \\u0e44\\u0e2b\\u0e21\\n ShowDashboard();\\n}\\n\\nbool IsNewBar()\\n{\\n    datetime currentBar = iTime(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 0);\\n    if(currentBar != LastBarTime)\\n    {\\n        LastBarTime = currentBar;\\n        return true;\\n    }\\n    return false;\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 8: Filter Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- Spread Hard Cap \\u2014 Real-time \\u0e17\\u0e38\\u0e01 Tick\\nbool CheckSpreadSpike()\\n{\\n    long spread = SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD);\\n    if(spread &gt; MaxSpread_Hard)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Spread Spike: \\\&quot;, spread, \\\&quot; pts \\u2192 Block\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Current Bar TR Spike \\u2014 \\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48\\u0e23\\u0e2d Average \\u0e40\\u0e2b\\u0e21\\u0e37\\u0e2d\\u0e19 ATR\\nbool CheckCurrentBarSpike()\\n{\\n    if(!VolSpike_Filter_ON) return true;\\n    double highNow   = iHigh (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);\\n    double MathMax(MathAbs(highNow - prevClose),\\n                               MathAbs(lowNow  - prevClose)));\\n    double atrNormal = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    if(currentTR &gt; atrNormal * VolatilitySpikeMulti)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;TR Spike | TR:\\\&quot;, currentTR, \\\&quot; ATR:\\\&quot;, atrNormal);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Price currOpen  = iOpen (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);\\n    double gap       = MathAbs(currOpen - prevClose);\\n    double maxGap    = MaxGap_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    if(gap &gt; maxGap)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Gap: \\\&quot;, gap/(_Point*10), \\\&quot; pips \\u2192 Circuit Breaker\\\&quot;);\\n        ActivateCircuitBreaker();\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Session Filter\\nbool CheckSessionFilter()\\n{\\n    if(!SessionFilter_ON) return true;\\n    MqlDateTime dt;\\n    TimeToStruct(TimeGMT(), dt);\\n    int hour   = dt.hour;\\n    int minNow = hour * 60 + dt.min;\\n    bool london  = (hour &gt;= 7  &amp;&amp; hour &lt; 16);\\n    bool newYork = (hour &gt;= 13 &amp;&amp; hour &lt; 22);\\n    bool tokyo   = (hour &gt;= 0  &amp;&amp; hour &lt; 9);\\n    bool sydney  = (hour &gt;= 21 || hour &lt; 6);\\n    if(SessionTransition_Block)\\n    {\\n        bool nearLondon = (minNow &gt;= (7*60-TransitionBuffer_Mins) &amp;&amp;\\n (13*60+TransitionBuffer_Mins));\\n        if(nearLondon || nearNY) return false;\\n    }\\n    if(Allow_London  &amp;&amp; london)  return true;\\n    if(Allow_NewYork &amp;&amp; newYork) return true;\\n    if(Allow_Tokyo   &amp;&amp; tokyo)   return true;\\n    if(Allow_Sydney  &amp;&amp; sydney)  return true;\\n    return false;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Circuit Breaker \\u2014 \\u0e2b\\u0e22\\u0e38\\u0e14 24hr Fixed\\nvoid ActivateCircuitBreaker()\\n{\\n    if(!CircuitBreaker_ON) return;\\n    CircuitBreakerActive = true;\\n    CircuitBreakerUntil  = TimeCurrent() + 1440 * 60;\\n    if(Notify_CircuitBreaker)\\n        SendAlert(\\\&quot;CIRCUIT BREAKER ON | Resume: \\\&quot;\\n            + TimeToString(CircuitBreakerUntil));\\n    Print(\\\&quot;Circuit Breaker ON | Resume: \\\&quot;, TimeToString(CircuitBreakerUntil));\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckCircuitBreaker()\\n{\\n    if(!CircuitBreaker_ON || !CircuitBreakerActive) return true;\\n    if(TimeCurrent() &gt;= CircuitBreakerUntil)\\n    {\\n        CircuitBreakerActive = false;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Circuit Breaker OFF \\u2014 waiting for new signal\\\&quot;);\\n        return true;\\n    }\\n    return return 0;\\n    return buf[0];\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 12: TP/SL/Exit Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- Calculate TP Level by Mode\\ndouble CalcTPLevel(ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type, double entry,\\n                   ENUM_TP_LEVEL_MODE mode, double value)\\n{\\n    double atr  = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    double sl   = CalcSL(type);\\n    double dist = 0;\\n    switch(mode)\\n    {\\n        case TP_LEVEL_PIPS: dist = value * _Point * 10;          break;\\n        case TP_LEVEL_RR:   dist = MathAbs(entry - sl) * value;  break;\\n        case TP_LEVEL_ATR:  dist = atr * value;                  break;\\n    }\\n    return (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY) ? entry + dist : entry - dist;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Partial TP Manager\\nvoid CheckPartialTP()\\n{\\n    if(!PartialTP_ON) return;\\n    for(int i = PositionsTotal()-1; i &gt;= 0; i--)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);\\n        double bid       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);\\n        double volume    = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_VOLUME);\\n        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type =\\n            (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);\\n        double      if(BreakEven_ON)\\n            {\\n                double bePips = BreakEven_Buffer * _Point * 10;\\n                double newSL  = (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)\\n                              ? openPrice + bePips\\n                              : openPrice - bePips;\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, tp2);\\n            }\\n            if(Notify_TP1)\\n                SendAlert(\\\&quot;TP1 HIT | \\\&quot; + _Symbol\\n                    + \\\&quot; #\\\&quot; + IntegerToString(ticket));\\n            Print(\\\&quot;TP1 Hit | Partial Close \\\&quot;, TP1_ClosePercent, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Dynamic TP \\u2014 Net Profit \\u0e23\\u0e27\\u0e1a\\u0e17\\u0e38\\u0e01\\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e49\\nvoid CheckDynamicTP_Grid()\\n{\\n    if(TPMode != TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE) return;\\n    double totalProfit = 0;\\n    for(int i = 0; i &lt; PositionsTotal(); i++)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        totalProfit += PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)\\n                    +  PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SWAP);\\n    }\\n    double target = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE) * (TPBalancePct/100.0);\\n    if(totalProfit &gt;= target)\\n    {\\n        CloseAllOrders();\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Dynamic TP Hit | Net: \\\&quot;, totalProfit, \\\&quot; Target: \\\&quot;, target);\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- ATR Trailing Stop \\u2014 Adaptive + Spike Mode\\nvoid ManageATRTrail()\\n{\\n    if(!TrailingStop_ON) return;\\n    double atr       = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    double atrNormal = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period * 3);\\n    double trailDist;\\n    if(Trail_Mode == TRAIL_ATR)\\n        trailDist = (atr &gt; atrNormal * 2.0)\\n                  ? atr * (TrailATR_Multi * 0.5)  // Spike \\u2192 Trail \\u0e0a\\u0e34\\u0e14\\n                  : atr * TrailATR_Multi;\\n    else\\n        trailDist = TrailFixed_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    double trailStart = TrailStart_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    for(int i = PositionsTotal()-1; i &gt;= 0; i--)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);\\n        double currentSL = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SL);\\n        double bid       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);\\n        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type =\\n            (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);\\n        if(type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)\\n        {\\n            if(bid - openPrice &lt; trailStart) continue;\\n            double newSL = bid - trailDist;\\n            if(newSL &gt; currentSL)\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);\\n        }\\n        else\\n        {\\n            double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);\\n            if(openPrice - ask &lt; trailStart) }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Master Exit Logic \\u2014 3 Levels\\nvoid CheckExitLogic()\\n{\\n    CheckPartialTP();       // Level 1: Partial TP + Break Even\\n    ManageATRTrail();       // Level 2: Trailing Stop\\n    CheckDynamicTP_Grid();  // Level 3: Dynamic TP (Net Profit)\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 13: Risk Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- Apply Preset \\u2014 \\u0e40\\u0e23\\u0e35\\u0e22\\u0e01\\u0e43\\u0e19 OnInit() \\u0e01\\u0e48\\u0e2d\\u0e19\\u0e17\\u0e38\\u0e01\\u0e2d\\u0e22\\u0e48\\u0e32\\u0e07\\nvoid ApplyPreset()\\n{\\n    switch(TradeStyle)\\n    {\\n        case STYLE_SCALPING:\\n            TPFixedPips=15; StructureLookback=5;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=10; ATR_MinValue=0.0003;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=10; TrailATR_Multi=0;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_INTRADAY:\\n            TPFixedPips=40; StructureLookback=10;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=20; ATR_MinValue=0.0005;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=20; TrailStart_Pips=50; TrailATR_Multi=1.5;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_TREND:\\n            TPFixedPips=200; StructureLookback=20;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=30; ATR_MinValue=0.0010;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=80; TrailATR_Multi=2.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n    switch(RiskLevel)\\n    {\\n        case RISK_SAFE:\\n            RiskPercent=0.5; MaxDrawdownPct=10.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=3.0; MaxOpenPositions=3;\\n            MaxTotalLot=0.1; CB_DD_Trigger=8.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_MEDIUM:\\n            RiskPercent=1.0; MaxDrawdownPct=20.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=5.0; MaxOpenPositions=5;\\n            MaxTotalLot=0.5; CB_DD_Trigger=15.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_AGGRESSIVE:\\n            RiskPercent=2.0; MaxDrawdownPct=35.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=10.0; MaxOpenPositions=10;\\n            MaxTotalLot=1.0; CB_DD_Trigger=25.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Validate Combination \\u2014 \\u0e15\\u0e31\\u0e14 Invalid Config \\u0e2d\\u0e31\\u0e15\\u0e42\\u0e19\\u0e21\\u0e31\\u0e15\\u0e34\\nvoid ValidateCombination()\\n{\\n    // SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND = Signal \\u0e0a\\u0e49\\u0e32\\u0e40\\u0e01\\u0e34\\u0e19\\n    if(TradeStyle == STYLE_SCALPING &amp;&amp;\\n       HedgeMode  == HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND)\\n    {\\n        HedgeMode = HEDGE_OFF;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND \\u2192 Hedge forced OFF\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // TREND + FOLLOW_CANDLE = False Signal \\u0e2a\\u0e39\\u0e07\\n    if(TradeStyle == STYLE_TREND &amp;&amp;\\n       HedgeMode  == HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE)\\n    {\\n        HedgeMode = HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: TREND + FOLLOW_CANDLE \\u2192 Hedge forced FOLLOW_TREND\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // GRID_NONE + MARTINGALE = \\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48\\u0e21\\u0e35 Grid \\u0e43\\u0e2b\\u0e49 Scale\\n    if(GridMode == GRID_NONE &amp;&amp;\\n       MMMode   == MM_MARTINGALE)\\n    {\\n        MMMode = MM_FIXED;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: No Grid + MARTINGALE \\u2192 MM forced FIXED\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // TP_DYNAMIC + Trail ON = Exit \\u0e0b\\u0e49\\u0e33\\u0e0b\\u0e49\\u0e2d\\u0e19\\n    if(TPMode          == TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE &amp;&amp;\\n       TrailingStop_ON == true)\\n    {\\n        TrailingStop_ON = false;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: DYNAMIC_TP + Trail \\u2192 Trail forced OFF\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // SCALPING + SWING SL = SL \\u0e01\\u0e27\\u0e49\\u0e32\\u0e07\\u0e40\\u0e01\\u0e34\\u0e19 TP \\u0e41\\u0e04\\u0e1a\\n    if(TradeStyle == STYLE_SCALPING &amp;&amp;\\n       SLMode     == SL_RANGE_TREND)\\n    {\\n        SLMode = SL_STRUCTURE;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: SCALPING + AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    if(balance &lt;= 0) return 0;\\n    return ((balance - equity) / balance) * 100.0;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckDrawdownLimit()\\n{\\n    if(GetCurrentDD() &gt;=
