if(dailyLoss &gt;= DailyLossPct)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;DAILY LOSS: \\\&quot;, dailyLoss, \\\&quot;% &gt;= \\\&quot;, DailyLossPct, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\nvoid ResetDailyStats()\\n{\\n    MqlDateTime dt;\\n    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);\\n    if(dt.hour == 0 &amp;&amp; dt.min == 0)\\n        DailyStartEquity = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK),\\n                        marginRequired))\\n        return false;\\n    double freeMargin = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE);\\n    return (freeMargin &gt;= marginRequired * 1.5); // Safety Buffer 150%\\n}\\n\\ndouble AdjustLotForMaxSL(double lot, double slPips)\\n{\\n    if(slPips &lt;= MaxSL_Pips) return lot;\\n    double balance      = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    double maxRiskMoney = balance * (RiskPercent / 100.0);\\n    double pipValue     = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE);\\n    lot = maxRiskMoney / (MaxSL_Pips * pipValue);\\n    Print(\\\&quot;SL too wide \\u2192 Lot adjusted: \\\&quot;, lot);\\n    return NormalizeDouble(MathMax(lot, 0.01), 2);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 14: Hedge Module\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- GRID_REVERSAL Trigger (DD Based)\\nbool CheckHedgeActivation()\\n{\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; GetCurrentDD() &gt;= HedgeActivationDD);\\n}\\n\\n//--- FOLLOW_CANDLE Trigger\\nbool CheckCandleHedgeTrigger()\\n{\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE) return false;\\n    double atr      = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    double bodySize = iOpen (_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1))\\n                   &amp;&amp; (bodySize &gt; atr * HedgeCandle_ATRMulti);\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; bigBearish);\\n}\\n\\n//--- FOLLOW_TREND Trigger (EMA Cross)\\nbool CheckTrendHedgeTrigger()\\n{\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND) return false;\\n    double fast0 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_FastEMA,\\n                   0, HedgeTrend_SlowEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 0);\\n    double slow1 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_SlowEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 1);\\n    bool bearishCross = (fast1 &gt; slow1) &amp;&amp; (fast0 &lt; slow0);\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; bearishCross);\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckHedgeDeactivation()\\n{\\n    double equity       = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double balance      = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    double floatLossPct = ((balance - equity) / balance) * 100.0;\\n    return (HedgeActive &amp;&amp; floatLossPct &lt;= HedgeDeactivateDD);\\n}\\n\\ndouble GetHedgeRatio(double dd)\\n{\\n    if(dd &gt;= 25.0) return 1.00;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 20.0) return 0.70;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 15.0) return 0.50;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 10.0) return 0.30;\\n    return 0.0;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckEmergencyExit()\\n{\\n    if(GetCurrentDD() &gt;= EmergencyExitDD)\\n    {\\n        CloseAllOrders();\\n        if(Notify_Emergency)\\n            SendAlert(\\\&quot;EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: \\\&quot;\\n                + DoubleToString(GetCurrentDD(),1) + \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        Print(\\\&quot;EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: \\\&quot;, GetCurrentDD(), \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 15: S/R Module\\n\\n```mql5\\nENUM_TIMEFRAMES GetSR_Timeframe()\\n{\\n    if(!SR_AutoHTF) return SR_ManualTF;\\n    switch(EntryTimeframe)\\n    {\\n        case PERIOD_M1:\\n        case PERIOD_M5:\\n        case PERIOD_M15: return PERIOD_H1;\\n        case PERIOD_H1:  return PERIOD_H4;\\n        case PERIOD_H4:  return PERIOD_D1;\\n        case PERIOD_D1:  return PERIOD_W1;\\n        default:         return PERIOD_H4;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nvoid UpdateSR()\\n{\\n    if(SR_Mode == SR_NONE) return;\\n    ENUM_TIMEFRAMES htf = GetSR_Timeframe();\\n    DetectSwingPoints(htf);\\n    MergeSRZones(htf);\\n    Print(\\\&quot;S/R Updated | HTF: \\\&quot;, EnumToString(htf),\\n          \\\&quot; | Zones: \\\&quot;, SR_ZoneCount);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 16: Notification Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\nvoid SendAlert(string message)\\n{\\n    if(!Notify_ON) return;\\n    SendNotification(message);  // Push \\u2192 MT5 Mobile App\\n    Print(\\\&quot;[ALERT] \\\&quot;, message);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 17:    : [คำนวณจาก Balance × Risk% / SL pips × PipValue]\\n- Martingale Multi: 1.5\\n- Linear Step     : 0.01\\n- Account Balance : [ระบุ]\\n\\n&gt; สูตร: Lot = (Balance × Risk%) / (SL_pips × ASYMMETRIC\\n\\n### Hedge + Grid Behavior\\n```\\n✅ Grid เปิดต่อได้แม้ Hedge Active จนถึง Max Grid Orders\\n✅ Hedge Partial Close แล้ว Grid เปิดต่อได้ทันที\\n✅ Hedge ปิดแล้ว GridOrderCount ต่อจากเดิม — ไม่ Reset\\n```\\n\\n### Hedge Scale Ladder (GRID_REVERSAL)\\n| DD% | Hedge Ratio | หมายเหตุ |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| 10–15% | 30% ของ Total Exposure | เริ่ม Hedge เบา |\\n| 15–20% | 50% ของ Total เพิ่ม DD Limit |\\n| PA | ANY | 🟢 ต่ำ | ค่อนข้างปลอดภัย |\\n| ANY + HEDGE ON | MARTINGALE | 🔴🔴 สูงมาก | เตือน Double Risk เสมอ |\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Step 2.5: Valid Combination Matrix (ใหม่ v2.1)\\n\\nใช้ตารางนี้กำหนดขอบเขตก่อน Optimize\\nเพื่อลด Invalid Combinations และประหยัด Run Time\\n\\n| Style | Grid | MM | Hedge | TP Mode | หมายเหตุ |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| SCALPING | SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND    → Signal ช้าเกิน\\n❌ GRID_NONE + MARTINGALE     → ไม่มี Grid ให้ Scale\\n❌ TP_DYNAMIC + Trail ON      → Exit Signal ซ้ำซ้อน\\n❌ TREND + FOLLOW_CANDLE      → False Signal : Parameter ตัวเลขทั้งหมด (ใช้ Default จาก Preset)\\nVary   : TradeStyle / RiskLevel / GridMode / HedgeMode / TPMode\\nPeriod : 3 ปีขึ้นไป (In-Sample)\\nMetric : Profit Factor &gt; 1.3 และ Max DD &lt; TrailStart / RRRatio / Amplitude\\nPeriod : เดียวกับ Phase 1\\nMetric : Sharpe Ratio + Max DD\\nGoal   : Optimize ตัวเลขให้ดีที่สุด\\n```\\n\\n## Phase 3: Forward Test — Validate\\n\\n```\\nใช้ Parameter จาก Phase 2\\nPeriod : 1 ปี (Out-of-Sample ที่ไม่ได้ใช้ใน Phase 1-2)\\nPass   : Profit Factor &gt; 1.2 และ DD ไม่ต่างจาก In-Sample &gt; 50%\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Step 3: EA Spec Card {\\n        case TP_LEVEL_PIPS: dist = value * _Point * 10;          break;\\n        case TP_LEVEL_RR:   dist = MathAbs(entry - sl) * value;  break;\\n        case TP_LEVEL_ATR:  dist = atr * value;                  break;\\n    }\\n    return (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY) ? entry + dist : entry - dist;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Partial TP Manager\\nvoid CheckPartialTP()\\n{\\n    if(!PartialTP_ON) return;\\n      if(BreakEven_ON)\\n            {\\n                double bePips = BreakEven_Buffer * _Point * 10;\\n                double newSL  = (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)\\n                              ? TP1_ClosePercent, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Dynamic TP — Net Profit รวบทุกไม้\\nvoid CheckDynamicTP_Grid()\\n{\\n    if(TPMode != TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE) return;\\n if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        totalProfit += PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)\\n                    +  PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SWAP);\\n    }\\n (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);\\n        if(type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)\\n        {\\n            if(bid - openPrice &lt; trailStart) continue;\\n            double newSL = bid SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);\\n            if(openPrice - ask &lt; trailStart) continue;\\n            double newSL = ask + trailDist;\\n            if(newSL &lt; currentSL || currentSL == 0)\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Master Exit Logic — 3 Levels\\nvoid CheckExitLogic()\\n{\\n    CheckPartialTP();       // Level 1: Partial TP + Break Even\\n    ManageATRTrail();       // Level 2: Trailing Stop\\n    CheckDynamicTP_Grid();  // Level 3: Dynamic TP (Net Profit)\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 13: Risk Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- Apply Preset — เรียกใน OnInit() ก่อนทุกอย่าง\\nvoid ApplyPreset()\\n{\\n    switch(TradeStyle)\\n    {\\n        case STYLE_SCALPING:\\n            TPFixedPips=15; StructureLookback=5;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=10; ATR_MinValue=0.0003;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=10; TrailATR_Multi=0;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_INTRADAY:\\n            TPFixedPips=40; StructureLookback=10;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=20; ATR_MinValue=0.0005;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=20; TrailATR_Multi=1.0;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_SWING:\\n            TPFixedPips=100; StructureLookback=20;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=30; ATR_MinValue=0.0008;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=50; TrailATR_Multi=1.5;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_TREND:\\n            TPFixedPips=200; StructureLookback=20;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=30; ATR_MinValue=0.0010;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=80; TrailATR_Multi=2.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n    switch(RiskLevel)\\n    {\\n        case RISK_SAFE:\\n            RiskPercent=0.5; MaxDrawdownPct=10.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=3.0; MaxOpenPositions=3;\\n            MaxTotalLot=0.1; CB_DD_Trigger=8.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_MEDIUM:\\n            RiskPercent=1.0; MaxDrawdownPct=20.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=5.0; MaxOpenPositions=5;\\n            MaxTotalLot=0.5; CB_DD_Trigger=15.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_AGGRESSIVE:\\n            RiskPercent=2.0; MaxDrawdownPct=35.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=10.0; MaxOpenPositions=10;\\n            MaxTotalLot=1.0; CB_DD_Trigger=25.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Validate Combination — ตัด Invalid Config อัตโนมัติ\\nvoid ValidateCombination()\\n{\\n    // SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND = Signal ช้าเกิน\\n    if(TradeStyle == STYLE_SCALPING &amp;&amp;\\n       HedgeMode  == HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND)\\n    {\\n        HedgeMode = HEDGE_OFF;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND → Hedge forced OFF\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // TREND + FOLLOW_CANDLE = False Signal สูง\\n    if(TradeStyle == STYLE_TREND &amp;&amp;\\n       HedgeMode  == HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE)\\n    {\\n        HedgeMode = HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: TREND + FOLLOW_CANDLE → Hedge forced FOLLOW_TREND\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // GRID_NONE + MARTINGALE = ไม่มี Grid ให้ Scale\\n    if(GridMode == GRID_NONE &amp;&amp;\\n       MMMode   == MM_MARTINGALE)\\n    {\\n        MMMode = MM_FIXED;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: No Grid + MARTINGALE → MM forced FIXED\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // TP_DYNAMIC + Trail ON = Exit ซ้ำซ้อน\\n    if(TPMode          == TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE &amp;&amp;\\n       TrailingStop_ON == true)\\n    {\\n        TrailingStop_ON = false;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: DYNAMIC_TP + Trail → Trail forced OFF\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // SCALPING + SWING SL = SL กว้างเกิน TP แคบ\\n    if(TradeStyle == STYLE_SCALPING &amp;&amp;\\n       SLMode     == SL_RANGE_TREND)\\n    {\\n        SLMode = SL_STRUCTURE;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: SCALPING + RANGE_TREND SL → SL forced STRUCTURE\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n}\\n\\ndouble GetCurrentDD()\\n{\\n    double equity  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double balance = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    if(balance &lt;= 0) return 0;\\n    return ((balance - equity) / balance) * 100.0;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckDrawdownLimit()\\n{\\n    if(GetCurrentDD() &gt;= MaxDrawdownPct)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;DD LIMIT: \\\&quot;, GetCurrentDD(), \\\&quot;% &gt;= \\\&quot;, MaxDrawdownPct, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckDailyLossLimit()\\n{\\n    double equity    = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double dailyLoss = ((DailyStartEquity - equity) / DailyStartEquity) * 100.0;\\n    if(dailyLoss &gt;= DailyLossPct)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;DAILY LOSS: \\\&quot;, dailyLoss, \\\&quot;% &gt;= \\\&quot;, DailyLossPct, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\nvoid ResetDailyStats()\\n{\\n    MqlDateTime dt;\\n    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);\\n    if(dt.hour == 0 &amp;&amp; dt.min == 0)\\n        DailyStartEquity = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckMargin(double lot)\\n{\\n    double marginRequired;\\n    if(!OrderCalcMargin(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, _Symbol, lot,\\n                        SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK),\\n                        marginRequired))\\n        return false;\\n    double freeMargin = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE);\\n    return (freeMargin &gt;= marginRequired * 1.5); // Safety Buffer 150%\\n}\\n\\ndouble AdjustLotForMaxSL(double lot, double slPips)\\n{\\n    if(slPips &lt;= MaxSL_Pips) return lot;\\n    double balance      = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    double maxRiskMoney = balance * (RiskPercent / 100.0);\\n    double pipValue     = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE);\\n    lot = maxRiskMoney / (MaxSL_Pips * pipValue);\\n    Print(\\\&quot;SL too wide → Lot adjusted: \\\&quot;, lot);\\n    return NormalizeDouble(MathMax(lot, 0.01), 2);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 14: Hedge Module\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- GRID_REVERSAL Trigger (DD Based)\\nbool CheckHedgeActivation()\\n{\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; GetCurrentDD() &gt;= HedgeActivationDD);\\n}\\n\\n//--- FOLLOW_CANDLE Trigger\\nbool CheckCandleHedgeTrigger()\\n{\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE) return false;\\n    double atr      = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    double bodySize = MathAbs(iOpen(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1)\\n                   -          iClose(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1));\\n    bool bigBearish = (iClose(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1)\\n                    &lt;  iOpen (_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1))\\n                   &amp;&amp; (bodySize &gt; atr * HedgeCandle_ATRMulti);\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; bigBearish);\\n}\\n\\n//--- FOLLOW_TREND Trigger (EMA Cross)\\nbool CheckTrendHedgeTrigger()\\n{\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND) return false;\\n    double fast0 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_FastEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 0);\\n    double fast1 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_FastEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 1);\\n    double slow0 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_SlowEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 0);\\n    double slow1 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_SlowEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 1);\\n    bool bearishCross = (fast1 &gt; slow1) &amp;&amp; (fast0 &lt; slow0);\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; bearishCross);\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckHedgeDeactivation()\\n{\\n    double equity       = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double balance      = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    double floatLossPct = ((balance - equity) / balance) * 100.0;\\n    return (HedgeActive &amp;&amp; floatLossPct &lt;= HedgeDeactivateDD);\\n}\\n\\ndouble GetHedgeRatio(double dd)\\n{\\n    if(dd &gt;= 25.0) return 1.00;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 20.0) return 0.70;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 15.0) return 0.50;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 10.0) return 0.30;\\n    return 0.0;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckEmergencyExit()\\n{\\n    if(GetCurrentDD() &gt;= EmergencyExitDD)\\n    {\\n        CloseAllOrders();\\n        if(Notify_Emergency)\\n            SendAlert(\\\&quot;EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: \\\&quot;\\n                + DoubleToString(GetCurrentDD(),1) + \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        Print(\\\&quot;EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: \\\&quot;, GetCurrentDD(), \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 15: S/R Module\\n\\n```mql5\\nENUM_TIMEFRAMES GetSR_Timeframe()\\n{\\n    if(!SR_AutoHTF) return SR_ManualTF;\\n    switch(EntryTimeframe)\\n    {\\n Up Signal\\nCopyBuffer(customHandle, 1, 0, 3, bufDown);  // Buffer 1 = Down Signal\\n\\nbool buySignal  = (bufUp[1]   != EMPTY_VALUE &amp;&amp; bufUp[2]   == EMPTY_VALUE);\\nbool sellSignal = (bufDown[1] != EMPTY_VALUE &amp;&amp; bufDown[2] == EMPTY_VALUE);\\n// Signal เปลี่ยนจาก EMPTY → มีค่า = เพิ่งเกิด Signal ใหม่\\n```\\n\\n## Template 2: EMA Cross\\n\\n```mql5\\nint    emaFastHandle, macdSignal[2]);\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Backtest Settings (ใหม่ v1.2)\\n\\nส่งพร้อม Output ทุกครั้ง\\n\\n## MT5 Strategy Tester — Recommended Settings\\n\\n| Setting | Value | หมายเหตุ |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| Model | Every Tick (Based on real ticks) | Accurate ที่สุด |\\n| Period | 2020–2024 (5 ปี) | In-Sample |\\n| Spread | Current (Symbol Spec) | ใช้ค่าจริง |\\n| Initial Deposit | ซ้ำกับ EA อื่น\\n- ❌ คำนวณ S/R ทุก Tick\\n- ❌ เริ่มเขียนโค้ดก่อนได้รับ Spec Card สมบูรณ์\\n- ❌ สร้าง Logic ที่ไม่อยู่ใน Spec Card\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Output Format\\n\\nส่งกลับครบ 4 ส่วนเสมอ\\n\\n1. # ⚠️ สิ่งที่ยังขาด หรือควรปรับ

## 🔴 Priority สูง

### 1. iATR Handle Leak — Bug ใน Code Template

```mql5
// ❌ ปัญหาในปัจจุบัน:
double GetATR(ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf, int period)
{
    int handle = iATR(_Symbol, tf, period);
    // ↑ สร้าง Handle ใหม่ทุกครั้งที่เรียก
    // → ทุก Tick = Memory Leak สะสม
    // → EA จะช้าลงเรื่อยๆ เมื่อรันนาน
}

// ✅ วิธีแก้ — ควรเพิ่มใน Global Variables:
int atrFilterHandle;
int atrGridHandle;

// OnInit():
atrFilterHandle = iATR(_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);
atrGridHandle   = iATR(_Symbol, ATR_TF_Grid,   ATR_Period);

// OnDeinit():
IndicatorRelease(atrFilterHandle);
IndicatorRelease(atrGridHandle);

// GetATR() ใช้ Handle ที่สร้างไว้แล้ว
```

### 2. Section 6: OnDeinit() ยังไม่มี Template

```mql5
// ❌ ตอนนี้ไม่มีใน .md เลย

// ✅ ควรเพิ่ม:
void OnDeinit(int reason)
{
    // Release Indicator Handles
    IndicatorRelease(atrFilterHandle);
    IndicatorRelease(atrGridHandle);
    IndicatorRelease(customHandle);   // Entry Indicator

    // Remove Dashboard Objects
    ObjectsDeleteAll(0, "EA_");

    Print("EA Deinitialized | Reason: ", reason);
}
```

### 3. ResetDailyStats() มี Bug เงียบ

```mql5
// ❌ ปัญหาปัจจุบัน:
void ResetDailyStats()
{
    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);
    if(dt.hour == 0 && dt.min == 0)  // ← ต้องตรง 00:00 พอดี
        DailyStartEquity = ...;
    // ถ้า Tick แรกของวันไม่ตรง 00:00 → ไม่ Reset เลย!
}

// ✅ วิธีแก้ — ใช้ Date เปรียบเทียบแทน:
datetime lastResetDate = 0;

void ResetDailyStats()
{
    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);
    datetime today = StringToTime(
        StringFormat("%04d.%02d.%02d", dt.year, dt.mon, dt.day));
    if(today > lastResetDate)
    {
        DailyStartEquity = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
        lastResetDate    = today;
    }
}
```

## 🟡 Priority กลาง

### 4. strategy-and-risk.md — ขาด Lot Calculation Example

```
ตอนนี้มีแค่สูตร:
Lot = (Balance × Risk%) / (SL_pips × PipValue)

แต่ขาด ตัวอย่างจริงต่อ Symbol:

EURUSD  : PipValue ≈ $1 / 0.01 lot / pip
XAUUSD  : PipValue ≈ $1 / 0.01 lot / pip
USDJPY  : PipValue ≈ $0.9 / 0.01 lot / pip (ต่างกัน!)

→ ผู้ใช้คำนวณ Base Lot ผิดได้ง่าย
```

### 5. Backtest Settings — ขาด Walk-Forward Guide

```
ตอนนี้มี:
Phase 1: In-Sample (2020–2024)
Phase 2: Fine-tune
Phase 3: Forward Test 1 ปี

ขาด:
Walk-Forward = แบ่ง Data เป็น Chunk
เพื่อยืนยันว่า Strategy Robust จริงๆ
ไม่ใช่แค่ Overfit กับ Period เดียว

ไม่จำเป็นต้องเพิ่มตอนนี้
แต่ควรมีใน Future Version
```

### 6. mql-code-generator.md — Section 9 Order Functions ยังไม่มี Template

```
Architecture บอกว่ามี:
├── OpenOrder(type, lot, sl, tp, comment)
├── CloseOrder(ticket)
├── CloseAllOrders()
└── GetTotalLots(type)

แต่ใน .md ไม่มี Code Template เลย
→ AI จะต้อง Generate เองทุกครั้ง
→ เสี่ยง Inconsistent ระหว่าง EA แต่ละตัว
```

UpdateSR();\\n\\n    // 7.11 Hedge Management\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_OFF)\\n    {\\n        bool hedgeTrigger = false;\\n        switch(HedgeMode)\\n        {\\n            case         case HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND:\\n                hedgeTrigger = CheckTrendHedgeTrigger();  break;\\n        }\\n        if(hedgeTrigger)\\n        {\\n            HedgeActive = true;\\n            ManageHedgePartialClose();\\n            OpenHedgeOrder();\\n        }\\n        if(HedgeActive &amp;&amp; CheckHedgeDeactivation())\\n        {\\n            HedgeActive     = false;\\n            HedgeOrderCount = 0;\\n            // GridOrderCount ไม่แตะ → ต่อจากเดิม\\n            Print(\\\&quot;Hedge OFF | Grid resumes from order #\\\&quot;, GridOrderCount);\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    // 7.12 Entry Logic\\n    // *** Generated from Spec Card Entry Condition ***\\n\\n    // 7.13 Grid Logic — เปิดต่อได้เสมอ ไม่สนว่า Hedge Active ไหม\\n    if(GridMode != GRID_NONE &amp;&amp; GridOrderCount &lt; GridMaxOrders)\\n        ShouldOpenGridOrder(0);\\n\\n    // 7.14 Exit Logic\\n    CheckExitLogic();\\n\\n    // 7.15 Dashboard\\n    ShowDashboard();\\n}\\n\\nbool IsNewBar()\\n{\\n    datetime currentBar = iTime(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 0);\\n    if(currentBar != LastBarTime)\\n    {\\n        LastBarTime = currentBar;\\n        return true;\\n    }\\n    return false;\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 8: Filter Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- Spread Hard Cap — Real-time ทุก Tick\\nbool CheckSpreadSpike()\\n{\\n    long spread = SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD);\\n    if(spread &gt; MaxSpread_Hard)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Spread Spike: \\\&quot;, spread, \\\&quot; pts → Block\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Current Bar TR Spike — ไม่รอ Average เหมือน ATR\\nbool CheckCurrentBarSpike()\\n{\\n    if(!VolSpike_Filter_ON) return true;\\n    double highNow   = iHigh (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);\\n    double lowNow    = iLow  (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);\\n    double prevClose = iClose(_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 1);\\n    double currentTR = MathMax(highNow - lowNow,\\n                       MathMax(MathAbs(highNow - prevClose),\\n                               MathAbs(lowNow  - prevClose)));\\n    double atrNormal = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    if(currentTR &gt; atrNormal * VolatilitySpikeMulti)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;TR Spike | TR:\\\&quot;, currentTR, \\\&quot; ATR:\\\&quot;, atrNormal);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Price Gap Detection (New Bar)\\nbool CheckPriceGap()\\n{\\n    if(!GapProtection_ON) return true;\\n    if(!IsNewBar()) return true;\\n    double prevClose = iClose(_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 1);\\n    double currOpen  = iOpen (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);\\n    double gap       = MathAbs(currOpen - prevClose);\\n    double maxGap    = MaxGap_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    if(gap &gt; maxGap)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Gap: \\\&quot;, gap/(_Point*10), \\\&quot; pips → Circuit Breaker\\\&quot;);\\n        ActivateCircuitBreaker();\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Session Filter\\nbool CheckSessionFilter()\\n{\\n    if(!SessionFilter_ON) return true;\\n    MqlDateTime dt;\\n    TimeToStruct(TimeGMT(), dt);\\n    int hour   = dt.hour;\\n    int minNow = hour * 60 + dt.min;\\n    bool london  = (hour &gt;= 7  &amp;&amp; hour &lt; 16);\\n    bool newYork = (hour &gt;= 13 &amp;&amp; hour &lt; 22);\\n    bool tokyo   = (hour &gt;= 0  &amp;&amp; hour &lt; 9);\\n    bool sydney  = (hour &gt;= 21 || hour &lt; 6);\\n    if(SessionTransition_Block)\\n    {\\n        bool nearLondon = (minNow &gt;= (7*60-TransitionBuffer_Mins) &amp;&amp;\\n                           minNow &lt;= (7*60+TransitionBuffer_Mins));\\n        bool nearNY     = (minNow &gt;= (13*60-TransitionBuffer_Mins) &amp;&amp;\\n                           minNow &lt;= (13*60+TransitionBuffer_Mins));\\n        if(nearLondon || nearNY) return false;\\n    }\\n    if(Allow_London  &amp;&amp; london)  return true;\\n    if(Allow_NewYork &amp;&amp; newYork) return true;\\n    if(Allow_Tokyo   &amp;&amp; tokyo)   return true;\\n    if(Allow_Sydney  &amp;&amp; sydney)  return true;\\n    return false;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Circuit Breaker — หยุด 24hr Fixed\\nvoid ActivateCircuitBreaker()\\n{\\n    if(!CircuitBreaker_ON) return;\\n    CircuitBreakerActive = true;\\n    CircuitBreakerUntil  = TimeCurrent() + 1440 * 60;\\n    if(Notify_CircuitBreaker)\\n        SendAlert(\\\&quot;CIRCUIT BREAKER ON | Resume: \\\&quot;\\n            + TimeToString(CircuitBreakerUntil));\\n    Print(\\\&quot;Circuit Breaker ON | Resume: \\\&quot;, TimeToString(CircuitBreakerUntil));\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckCircuitBreaker()\\n{\\n    if(!CircuitBreaker_ON || !CircuitBreakerActive) return true;\\n    if(TimeCurrent() &gt;= CircuitBreakerUntil)\\n    {\\n        CircuitBreakerActive = false;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Circuit Breaker OFF — waiting for new signal\\\&quot;);\\n        return true;\\n    }\\n    return false;\\n}\\n\\n//--- ATR Baseline Filter\\nbool CheckATRFilter()\\n{\\n    double atr = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    return (atr &gt;= ATR_MinValue);\\n}\\n\\n//--- Get ATR Value\\ndouble GetATR(ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf, int period)\\n{\\n    int    handle = iATR(_Symbol, tf, period);\\n    double buf[];\\n    ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);\\n    if(CopyBuffer(handle, 0, 0, 1, buf) &lt; 1) return 0;\\n    return buf[0];\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 12: TP/SL/Exit Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- Calculate TP Level by Mode\\ndouble CalcTPLevel(ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type, double entry,\\n                   ENUM_TP_LEVEL_MODE mode, double value)\\n{\\n    double atr  = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    double sl   = CalcSL(type);\\n    double dist = 0;\\n    switch(mode)\\n    {\\n        case TP_LEVEL_PIPS: dist = value * _Point * 10;          break;\\n        case TP_LEVEL_RR:   dist = MathAbs(entry - sl) * value;  break;\\n        case TP_LEVEL_ATR:  dist = atr * value;                  break;\\n    }\\n    return (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY) ? entry + dist : entry - dist;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Partial TP Manager\\nvoid CheckPartialTP()\\n{\\n    if(!PartialTP_ON) return;\\n    for(int i = PositionsTotal()-1; i &gt;= 0; i--)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);\\n        double bid       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);\\n        double volume    = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_VOLUME);\\n        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type =\\n            (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);\\n        double tp1 = CalcTPLevel(type, openPrice, TP1_Mode, TP1_Value);\\n        double tp2 = CalcTPLevel(type, openPrice, TP2_Mode, TP2_Value);\\n        bool tp1Hit = (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY) ? bid &gt;= tp1 : bid &lt;= tp1;\\n        if(tp1Hit)\\n        {\\n            double closeLot = NormalizeDouble(volume*(TP1_ClosePercent/100.0),2);\\n            Trade.PositionClosePartial(ticket, closeLot);\\n            if(BreakEven_ON)\\n            {\\n                double bePips = BreakEven_Buffer * _Point * 10;\\n                double newSL  = (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)\\n                              ? openPrice + bePips\\n                              : openPrice - bePips;\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, tp2);\\n            }\\n            if(Notify_TP1)\\n                SendAlert(\\\&quot;TP1 HIT | \\\&quot; + _Symbol\\n                    + \\\&quot; #\\\&quot; + IntegerToString(ticket));\\n            Print(\\\&quot;TP1 Hit | Partial Close \\\&quot;, TP1_ClosePercent, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Dynamic TP — Net Profit รวบทุกไม้\\nvoid CheckDynamicTP_Grid()\\n{\\n    if(TPMode != TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE) return;\\n    double totalProfit = 0;\\n    for(int i = 0; i &lt; PositionsTotal(); i++)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        totalProfit += PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)\\n                    +  PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SWAP);\\n    }\\n    double target = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE) * (TPBalancePct/100.0);\\n    if(totalProfit &gt;= target)\\n    {\\n        CloseAllOrders();\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Dynamic TP Hit | Net: \\\&quot;, totalProfit, \\\&quot; Target: \\\&quot;, target);\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- ATR Trailing Stop — Adaptive + Spike Mode\\nvoid ManageATRTrail()\\n{\\n    if(!TrailingStop_ON) return;\\n    double atr       = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    double atrNormal = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period * 3);\\n    double trailDist;\\n    if(Trail_Mode == TRAIL_ATR)\\n        trailDist = (atr &gt; atrNormal * 2.0)\\n                  ? atr * (TrailATR_Multi * 0.5)  // Spike → Trail ชิด\\n                  : atr * TrailATR_Multi;\\n    else\\n        trailDist = TrailFixed_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    double trailStart = TrailStart_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    for(int i = PositionsTotal()-1; i &gt;= 0; i--)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);\\n        double currentSL = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SL);\\n        double bid       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);\\n        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type =\\n            (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);\\n        if(type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)\\n        {\\n            if(bid - openPrice &lt; trailStart) continue;\\n            double newSL = bid - trailDist;\\n            if(newSL &gt; currentSL)\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);\\n        }\\n        else\\n        {\\n            double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);\\n            if(openPrice - ask &lt; trailStart) continue;\\n            double newSL = ask + trailDist;\\n            if(newSL &lt; currentSL || currentSL == 0)\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Master Exit Logic — 3 Levels\\nvoid CheckExitLogic()\\n{\\n    CheckPartialTP();       // Level 1: Partial TP + Break Even\\n    ManageATRTrail();       // Level 2: Trailing Stop\\n    CheckDynamicTP_Grid();  // Level 3: Dynamic TP (Net Profit)\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 13: Risk Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- Apply Preset — เรียกใน OnInit() ก่อนทุกอย่าง\\nvoid ApplyPreset()\\n{\\n    switch(TradeStyle)\\n    {\\n        case STYLE_SCALPING:\\n            TPFixedPips=15; StructureLookback=5;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=10; ATR_MinValue=0.0003;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=10; TrailATR_Multi=0;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_INTRADAY:\\n            TPFixedPips=40; StructureLookback=10;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=20; ATR_MinValue=0.0005;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=20; TrailATR_Multi=1.0;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_SWING:\\n            TPFixedPips=100; StructureLookback=20;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=30; ATR_MinValue=0.0008;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=50; TrailATR_Multi=1.5;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_TREND:\\n            TPFixedPips=200; StructureLookback=20;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=30; ATR_MinValue=0.0010;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=80; TrailATR_Multi=2.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n    switch(RiskLevel)\\n    {\\n        case RISK_SAFE:\\n            RiskPercent=0.5; MaxDrawdownPct=10.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=3.0; MaxOpenPositions=3;\\n            MaxTotalLot=0.1; CB_DD_Trigger=8.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_MEDIUM:\\n            RiskPercent=1.0; MaxDrawdownPct=20.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=5.0; MaxOpenPositions=5;\\n            MaxTotalLot=0.5; CB_DD_Trigger=15.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_AGGRESSIVE:\\n            RiskPercent=2.0; MaxDrawdownPct=35.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=10.0; MaxOpenPositions=10;\\n            MaxTotalLot=1.0; CB_DD_Trigger=25.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Validate Combination — ตัด Invalid Config อัตโนมัติ\\nvoid ValidateCombination()\\n{\\n    // SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND = Signal ช้าเกิน\\n    if(TradeStyle == STYLE_SCALPING &amp;&amp;\\n       HedgeMode  == HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND)\\n    {\\n        HedgeMode = HEDGE_OFF;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND → Hedge forced OFF\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // TREND + FOLLOW_CANDLE = False Signal สูง\\n    if(TradeStyle == STYLE_TREND &amp;&amp;\\n       HedgeMode  == HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE)\\n    {\\n        HedgeMode = HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: TREND + FOLLOW_CANDLE → Hedge forced FOLLOW_TREND\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // GRID_NONE + MARTINGALE = ไม่มี Grid ให้ Scale\\n    if(GridMode == GRID_NONE &amp;&amp;\\n       MMMode   == MM_MARTINGALE)\\n    {\\n        MMMode = MM_FIXED;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: No Grid + MARTINGALE → MM forced FIXED\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // TP_DYNAMIC + Trail ON = Exit ซ้ำซ้อน\\n    if(TPMode          == TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE &amp;&amp;\\n       TrailingStop_ON == true)\\n    {\\n        TrailingStop_ON = false;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: DYNAMIC_TP + Trail → Trail forced OFF\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // SCALPING + SWING SL = SL กว้างเกิน TP แคบ\\n    if(TradeStyle == STYLE_SCALPING &amp;&amp;\\n       SLMode     == SL_RANGE_TREND)\\n    {\\n        SLMode = SL_STRUCTURE;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: SCALPING + RANGE_TREND SL → SL forced STRUCTURE\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n}\\n\\ndouble GetCurrentDD()\\n{\\n    double equity  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double balance = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    if(balance &lt;= 0) return 0;\\n    return ((balance - equity) / balance) * 100.0;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckDrawdownLimit()\\n{\\n    if(GetCurrentDD() &gt;= MaxDrawdownPct)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;DD LIMIT: \\\&quot;, GetCurrentDD(), \\\&quot;% &gt;= \\\&quot;, MaxDrawdownPct, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckDailyLossLimit()\\n{\\n    double equity    = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double dailyLoss = ((DailyStartEquity - equity) / DailyStartEquity) * 100.0;\\n    if(dailyLoss &gt;= DailyLossPct)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;DAILY LOSS: \\\&quot;, dailyLoss, \\\&quot;% &gt;= \\\&quot;, DailyLossPct, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\nvoid ResetDailyStats()\\n{\\n    MqlDateTime dt;\\n    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);\\n    if(dt.hour == 0 &amp;&amp; dt.min == 0)\\n        DailyStartEquity = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckMargin(double lot)\\n{\\n    double marginRequired;\\n    if(!OrderCalcMargin(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, _Symbol, lot,\\n                        SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK),\\n                        marginRequired))\\n        return false;\\n    double freeMargin = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE);\\n    return (freeMargin &gt;= marginRequired * 1.5); // Safety Buffer 150%\\n}\\n\\ndouble AdjustLotForMaxSL(double lot, double slPips)\\n{\\n    if(slPips &lt;= MaxSL_Pips) return lot;\\n    double balance      = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    double maxRiskMoney = balance * (RiskPercent / 100.0);\\n    double pipValue     = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE);\\n    lot = maxRiskMoney / (MaxSL_Pips * pipValue);\\n    Print(\\\&quot;SL too wide → Lot adjusted: \\\&quot;, lot);\\n    return NormalizeDouble(MathMax(lot, 0.01), 2);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 14: Hedge Module\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- GRID_REVERSAL Trigger (DD Based)\\nbool CheckHedgeActivation()\\n{\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; GetCurrentDD() &gt;= HedgeActivationDD);\\n}\\n\\n//--- FOLLOW_CANDLE Trigger\\nbool CheckCandleHedgeTrigger()\\n{\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE) return false;\\n    double atr      = GetATR(ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);\\n    double bodySize = MathAbs(iOpen(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1)\\n                   -          iClose(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1));\\n    bool bigBearish = (iClose(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1)\\n                    &lt;  iOpen (_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1))\\n                   &amp;&amp; (bodySize &gt; atr * HedgeCandle_ATRMulti);\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; bigBearish);\\n}\\n\\n//--- FOLLOW_TREND Trigger (EMA Cross)\\nbool CheckTrendHedgeTrigger()\\n{\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND) return false;\\n    double fast0 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_FastEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 0);\\n    double fast1 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_FastEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 1);\\n    double slow0 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_SlowEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 0);\\n    double slow1 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_SlowEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 1);\\n    bool bearishCross = (fast1 &gt; slow1) &amp;&amp; (fast0 &lt; slow0);\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; bearishCross);\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckHedgeDeactivation()\\n{\\n    double equity       = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double balance      = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    double floatLossPct = ((balance - equity) / balance) * 100.0;\\n    return (HedgeActive &amp;&amp; floatLossPct &lt;= HedgeDeactivateDD);\\n}\\n\\ndouble GetHedgeRatio(double dd)\\n{\\n    if(dd &gt;= 25.0) return 1.00;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 20.0) return 0.70;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 15.0) return 0.50;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 10.0) return 0.30;\\n    return 0.0;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckEmergencyExit()\\n{\\n    if(GetCurrentDD() &gt;= EmergencyExitDD)\\n    {\\n        CloseAllOrders();\\n        if(Notify_Emergency)\\n            SendAlert(\\\&quot;EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: \\\&quot;\\n                + DoubleToString(GetCurrentDD(),1) + \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        Print(\\\&quot;EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: \\\&quot;, GetCurrentDD(), \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 15: S/R Module\\n\\n```mql5\\nENUM_TIMEFRAMES GetSR_Timeframe()\\n{\\n    if(!SR_AutoHTF) return SR_ManualTF;\\n    switch(EntryTimeframe)\\n    {\\n        case PERIOD_M1:\\n        case PERIOD_M5:\\n        case PERIOD_M15: return PERIOD_H1;\\n        case PERIOD_H1:  return PERIOD_H4;\\n        case PERIOD_H4:  return PERIOD_D1;\\n        case PERIOD_D1:  return PERIOD_W1;\\n        default:         return PERIOD_H4;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nvoid UpdateSR()\\n{\\n    if(SR_Mode == SR_NONE) return;\\n    ENUM_TIMEFRAMES htf = GetSR_Timeframe();\\n    DetectSwingPoints(htf);\\n    MergeSRZones(htf);\\n    Print(\\\&quot;S/R Updated | HTF: \\\&quot;, EnumToString(htf),\\n          \\\&quot; | Zones: \\\&quot;, SR_ZoneCount);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 16: Notification Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\nvoid SendAlert(string message)\\n{\\n    if(!Notify_ON) return;\\n    SendNotification(message);  // Push → MT5 Mobile App\\n    Print(\\\&quot;[ALERT] \\\&quot;, message);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 17: Dashboard\\n\\nDashboard แสดงทุก Tick — ใช้ ObjectCreate บน Chart:\\n- Equity / Balance / DD%\\n- Spread / ATR (Filter + Grid)\\n- Trade Style / Risk Profile\\n- Open Positions / Grid Order Count / Grid Max\\n- Hedge Status: Active / Inactive + Mode\\n- Circuit Breaker: ON (Resume time) / OFF\\n- SR Zone Count\\n- TP1 Hit Status\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Entry Code Templates (ใหม่ v1.2)\\n\\nใช้เป็น Reference เมื่อ Generate Entry Logic จาก Spec Card\\n\\n## Template 1: Custom Indicator (iCustom)\\n\\n```mql5\\n// ใช้กับ HalfTrend, SuperTrend หรือ Custom Indicator ทั่วไป\\n// Spec Card ต้องระบุ: ชื่อไฟล์ .ex5 + Buffer Index + Signal Condition\\n\\nint      customHandle;\\ndouble   bufUp[], bufDown[];\\n\\n// OnInit()\\ncustomHandle = iCustom(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe,\\n                       \\\&quot;IndicatorName\\\&quot;,   // ชื่อ .ex5\\n                       Param1, Param2);   // Parameters ของ Indicator\\nArraySetAsSeries(bufUp,   true);\\nArraySetAsSeries(bufDown, true);\\n\\n// Entry Check (New Bar)\\nCopyBuffer(customHandle, 0, 0, 3, bufUp);    // Buffer 0 = Up Signal\\nCopyBuffer(customHandle, 1, 0, 3, bufDown);  // Buffer 1 = Down Signal\\n\\nbool buySignal  = (bufUp[1]   != EMPTY_VALUE &amp;&amp; bufUp[2]   == EMPTY_VALUE);\\nbool sellSignal = (bufDown[1] != EMPTY_VALUE &amp;&amp; bufDown[2] == EMPTY_VALUE);\\n// Signal เปลี่ยนจาก EMPTY → มีค่า = เพิ่งเกิด Signal ใหม่\\n```\\n\\n## Template 2: EMA Cross\\n\\n```mql5\\nint    emaFastHandle, emaSlowHandle;\\ndouble emaFast[], emaSlow[];\\n\\n// OnInit()\\nemaFastHandle = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, FastPeriod, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);\\nemaSlowHandle = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, SlowPeriod, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);\\nArraySetAsSeries(emaFast, true);\\nArraySetAsSeries(emaSlow, true);\\n\\n// Entry Check\\nCopyBuffer(emaFastHandle, 0, 0, 3, emaFast);\\nCopyBuffer(emaSlowHandle, 0, 0, 3, emaSlow);\\n\\nbool buySignal  = (emaFast[1] &gt; emaSlow[1]) &amp;&amp; (emaFast[2] &lt;= emaSlow[2]);\\nbool sellSignal = (emaFast[1] &lt; emaSlow[1]) &amp;&amp; (emaFast[2] &gt;= emaSlow[2]);\\n```\\n\\n## Template 3: RSI\\n\\n```mql5\\nint    rsiHandle;\\ndouble rsiBuf[];\\n\\n// OnInit()\\nrsiHandle = iRSI(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, RSI_Period, PRICE_CLOSE);\\nArraySetAsSeries(rsiBuf, true);\\n\\n// Entry Check\\nCopyBuffer(rsiHandle, 0, 0, 3, rsiBuf);\\n\\nbool buySignal  = (rsiBuf[1] &lt; RSI_OversoldLevel  &amp;&amp; rsiBuf[2] &gt;= RSI_OversoldLevel);\\nbool sellSignal = (rsiBuf[1] &gt; RSI_OverboughtLevel &amp;&amp; rsiBuf[2] &lt;= RSI_OverboughtLevel);\\n```\\n\\n## Template 4: Bollinger Bands\\n\\n```mql5\\nint \\\&quot;, _Symbol);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 7: OnTick() Template\\n\\n```mql5\\nvoid OnTick()\\n{\\n    ResetDailyStats();\\n\\n    // 7.1 Emergency Exit\\n    if(!CheckEmergencyExit())     return;\\n    // 7.2 Drawdown Check\\n    if(!CheckDrawdownLimit())     return;\\n    // 7.3 Daily Loss Check\\n    if(!CheckDailyLossLimit())    return;\\n    // 7.4 Circuit Breaker\\n    if(!CheckCircuitBreaker())    return;\\n    // 7.5 Spread Spike Hard Cap (Real-time)\\n    if(!CheckSpreadSpike())       return;\\n    // 7.6 Current Bar TR Spike\\n    if(!CheckCurrentBarSpike())   return;\\n    // 7.7 Price Gap (New Bar Only)\\n    if(!CheckPriceGap())          return;\\n    // 7.8 ATR Baseline Filter\\n    if(!CheckATRFilter())         return;\\n    // 7.9 Session Filter\\n    if(!CheckSessionFilter())     return;\\n\\n    // 7.10 S/R Update \\u2014 New Bar Only\\n    if(IsNewBar()) UpdateSR();\\n\\n    // 7.11 Hedge Management\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_OFF)\\n    {\\n        bool hedgeTrigger = false;\\n        switch(HedgeMode)\\n        {\\n            case HEDGE_GRID_REVERSAL:\\n                hedgeTrigger = CheckHedgeActivation();    break;\\n            case HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE:\\n                hedgeTrigger = CheckCandleHedgeTrigger(); break;\\n            case HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND:\\n                hedgeTrigger = CheckTrendHedgeTrigger();  break;\\n        }\\n        if(hedgeTrigger)\\n        {\\n            HedgeActive = true;\\n            ManageHedgePartialClose();\\n            OpenHedgeOrder();\\n        }\\n        if(HedgeActive &amp;&amp; CheckHedgeDeactivation())\\n        {\\n            HedgeActive     = false;\\n            HedgeOrderCount = 0;\\n            // GridOrderCount \\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48\\u0e41\\u0e15\\u0e30 \\u2192 \\u0e15\\u0e48\\u0e2d\\u0e08\\u0e32\\u0e01\\u0e40\\u0e14\\u0e34\\u0e21\\n            Print(\\\&quot;Hedge OFF | Grid resumes from order #\\\&quot;, GridOrderCount);\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    // 7.12 Entry Logic\\n    // *** Generated from Spec Card Entry Condition ***\\n\\n    // 7.13 Grid Logic \\u2014 \\u0e40\\u0e1b\\u0e34\\u0e14\\u0e15\\u0e48\\u0e2d\\u0e44\\u0e14\\u0e49\\u0e40\\u0e2a\\u0e21\\u0e2d \\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48\\u0e2a\\u0e19\\u0e27\\u0e48\\u0e32 Hedge Active \\u0e44\\u0e2b\\u0e21\\n ShowDashboard();\\n}\\n\\nbool IsNewBar()\\n{\\n    datetime currentBar = iTime(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 0);\\n    if(currentBar != LastBarTime)\\n    {\\n        LastBarTime = currentBar;\\n        return true;\\n    }\\n    return false;\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 8: Filter Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- Spread Hard Cap \\u2014 Real-time \\u0e17\\u0e38\\u0e01 Tick\\nbool CheckSpreadSpike()\\n{\\n    long spread = SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD);\\n    if(spread &gt; MaxSpread_Hard)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Spread Spike: \\\&quot;, spread, \\\&quot; pts \\u2192 Block\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Current Bar TR Spike \\u2014 \\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48\\u0e23\\u0e2d Average \\u0e40\\u0e2b\\u0e21\\u0e37\\u0e2d\\u0e19 ATR\\nbool CheckCurrentBarSpike()\\n{\\n    if(!VolSpike_Filter_ON) return true;\\n    double highNow   = iHigh (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);\\n    double lowNow    = iLow  (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);\\n    double prevClose = iClose(_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 1);\\n    double currentTR = MathMax(highNow - lowNow,\\n                       MathMax(MathAbs(highNow - prevClose),\\n                               MathAbs(lowNow  - prevClose)));\\n    double atrNormal = GetATR(ATR_Handle_Filter);\\n    if(currentTR &gt; atrNormal * VolatilitySpikeMulti)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;TR Spike | TR:\\\&quot;, currentTR, \\\&quot; ATR:\\\&quot;, atrNormal);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Price Gap Detection (New Bar)\\nbool CheckPriceGap()\\n{\\n    if(!GapProtection_ON) return true;\\n    if(!IsNewBar()) return true;\\n    double prevClose = iClose(_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 1);\\n    double currOpen  = iOpen (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);\\n    double gap       = MathAbs(currOpen - prevClose);\\n    double maxGap    = MaxGap_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    if(gap &gt; maxGap)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Gap: \\\&quot;, gap/(_Point*10), \\\&quot; pips \\u2192 Circuit Breaker\\\&quot;);\\n        ActivateCircuitBreaker();\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Session Filter\\nbool CheckSessionFilter()\\n{\\n    if(!SessionFilter_ON) return true;\\n    MqlDateTime dt;\\n    TimeToStruct(TimeGMT(), dt);\\n    int hour   = dt.hour;\\n    int minNow = hour * 60 + dt.min;\\n    bool london  = (hour &gt;= 7  &amp;&amp; hour &lt; 16);\\n    bool newYork = (hour &gt;= 13 &amp;&amp; hour &lt; 22);\\n    bool tokyo   = (hour &gt;= 0  &amp;&amp; hour &lt; 9);\\n    bool sydney  = (hour &gt;= 21 || hour &lt; 6);\\n    if(SessionTransition_Block)\\n    {\\n        bool nearLondon = (minNow &gt;= (7*60-TransitionBuffer_Mins) &amp;&amp;\\n                           minNow &lt;= (7*60+TransitionBuffer_Mins));\\n        bool nearNY     = (minNow &gt;= (13*60-TransitionBuffer_Mins) &amp;&amp;\\n                           minNow &lt;= (13*60+TransitionBuffer_Mins));\\n        if(nearLondon || nearNY) return false;\\n    }\\n    if(Allow_London  &amp;&amp; london)  return true;\\n    if(Allow_NewYork &amp;&amp; newYork) return true;\\n    if(Allow_Tokyo   &amp;&amp; tokyo)   return true;\\n    if(Allow_Sydney  &amp;&amp; sydney)  return true;\\n    return false;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Circuit Breaker \\u2014 \\u0e2b\\u0e22\\u0e38\\u0e14 24hr Fixed\\nvoid ActivateCircuitBreaker()\\n{\\n    if(!CircuitBreaker_ON) return;\\n    CircuitBreakerActive = true;\\n    CircuitBreakerUntil  = TimeCurrent() + 1440 * 60;\\n    if(Notify_CircuitBreaker)\\n        SendAlert(\\\&quot;CIRCUIT BREAKER ON | Resume: \\\&quot;\\n            + TimeToString(CircuitBreakerUntil));\\n    Print(\\\&quot;Circuit Breaker ON | Resume: \\\&quot;, TimeToString(CircuitBreakerUntil));\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckCircuitBreaker()\\n{\\n    if(!CircuitBreaker_ON || !CircuitBreakerActive) return true;\\n    if(TimeCurrent() &gt;= CircuitBreakerUntil)\\n    {\\n        CircuitBreakerActive = false;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Circuit Breaker OFF \\u2014 waiting for new signal\\\&quot;);\\n        return true;\\n    }\\n    return false;\\n}\\n\\n//--- ATR Baseline Filter\\nbool CheckATRFilter()\\n{\\n    double atr = GetATR(ATR_Handle_Filter);\\n    return (atr &gt;= ATR_MinValue);\\n}\\n\\n//--- BUG FIX: GetATR \\u0e43\\u0e0a\\u0e49 Pre-created Handle \\u2014 \\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48\\u0e2a\\u0e23\\u0e49\\u0e32\\u0e07\\u0e43\\u0e2b\\u0e21\\u0e48\\u0e17\\u0e38\\u0e01 Tick\\ndouble GetATR(int handle)\\n{\\n    double buf[];\\n    ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);\\n    if(CopyBuffer(handle, 0, 0, 1, buf) &lt; 1) return 0;\\n    return buf[0];\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 12: TP/SL/Exit Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- Calculate TP Level by Mode\\ndouble CalcTPLevel(ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type, double entry,\\n                   ENUM_TP_LEVEL_MODE mode, double value)\\n{\\n    double atr  = GetATR(ATR_Handle_Filter);\\n    double sl   = CalcSL(type);\\n    double dist = 0;\\n    switch(mode)\\n    {\\n        case TP_LEVEL_PIPS: dist = value * _Point * 10;          break;\\n        case TP_LEVEL_RR:   dist = MathAbs(entry - sl) * value;  break;\\n        case TP_LEVEL_ATR:  dist = atr * value;                  break;\\n    }\\n    return (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY) ? entry + dist : entry - dist;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Partial TP Manager\\nvoid CheckPartialTP()\\n{\\n    if(!PartialTP_ON) return;\\n    for(int i = PositionsTotal()-1; i &gt;= 0; i--)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);\\n        double bid       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);\\n        double volume    = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_VOLUME);\\n        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type =\\n            (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);\\n        double tp1 = CalcTPLevel(type, openPrice, TP1_Mode, TP1_Value);\\n        double tp2 = CalcTPLevel(type, openPrice, TP2_Mode, TP2_Value);\\n        bool tp1Hit = (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY) ? bid &gt;= tp1 : bid &lt;= tp1;\\n        if(tp1Hit)\\n        {\\n            double closeLot = NormalizeDouble(volume*(TP1_ClosePercent/100.0),2);\\n            Trade.PositionClosePartial(ticket, closeLot);\\n            if(BreakEven_ON)\\n            {\\n                double bePips = BreakEven_Buffer * _Point * 10;\\n                double newSL  = (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)\\n                              ? openPrice + bePips\\n                              : openPrice - bePips;\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, tp2);\\n            }\\n            if(Notify_TP1)\\n                SendAlert(\\\&quot;TP1 HIT | \\\&quot; + _Symbol\\n                    + \\\&quot; #\\\&quot; + IntegerToString(ticket));\\n            Print(\\\&quot;TP1 Hit | Partial Close \\\&quot;, TP1_ClosePercent, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Dynamic TP \\u2014 Net Profit \\u0e23\\u0e27\\u0e1a\\u0e17\\u0e38\\u0e01\\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e49\\nvoid CheckDynamicTP_Grid()\\n{\\n    if(TPMode != TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE) return;\\n    double totalProfit = 0;\\n    for(int i = 0; i &lt; PositionsTotal(); i++)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        totalProfit += PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)\\n                    +  PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SWAP);\\n    }\\n    double target = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE) * (TPBalancePct/100.0);\\n    if(totalProfit &gt;= target)\\n    {\\n        CloseAllOrders();\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Dynamic TP Hit | Net: \\\&quot;, totalProfit, \\\&quot; Target: \\\&quot;, target);\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- ATR Trailing Stop \\u2014 Adaptive + Spike Mode\\nvoid ManageATRTrail()\\n{\\n    if(!TrailingStop_ON) return;\\n    double atr       = GetATR(ATR_Handle_Filter);\\n    double atrNormal = GetATR(ATR_Handle_Filter);  // \\u0e43\\u0e0a\\u0e49 Period*3 \\u0e43\\u0e19 OnInit \\u0e16\\u0e49\\u0e32\\u0e15\\u0e49\\u0e2d\\u0e07\\u0e01\\u0e32\\u0e23\\n    double trailDist;\\n    if(Trail_Mode == TRAIL_ATR)\\n        trailDist = (atr &gt; atrNormal * 2.0)\\n                  ? atr * (TrailATR_Multi * 0.5)  // Spike \\u2192 Trail \\u0e0a\\u0e34\\u0e14\\n                  : atr * TrailATR_Multi;\\n    else\\n        trailDist = TrailFixed_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    double trailStart = TrailStart_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    for(int i = PositionsTotal()-1; i &gt;= 0; i--)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);\\n        double currentSL = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SL);\\n        double bid       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);\\n        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type =\\n            (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);\\n        if(type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)\\n        {\\n            if(bid - openPrice &lt; trailStart) continue;\\n            double newSL = bid - trailDist;\\n            if(newSL &gt; currentSL)\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);\\n        }\\n        else\\n        {\\n            double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);\\n            if(openPrice - ask &lt; trailStart) continue;\\n            double newSL = ask + trailDist;\\n            if(newSL &lt; currentSL || currentSL == 0)\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Master Exit Logic \\u2014 3 Levels\\nvoid CheckExitLogic()\\n{\\n    CheckPartialTP();       // Level 1: Partial TP + Break Even\\n    ManageATRTrail();       // Level 2: Trailing Stop\\n    CheckDynamicTP_Grid();  // Level 3: Dynamic TP (Net Profit)\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 13: Risk Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- Apply Preset \\u2014 \\u0e40\\u0e23\\u0e35\\u0e22\\u0e01\\u0e43\\u0e19 OnInit() \\u0e01\\u0e48\\u0e2d\\u0e19\\u0e17\\u0e38\\u0e01\\u0e2d\\u0e22\\u0e48\\u0e32\\u0e07\\nvoid ApplyPreset()\\n{\\n    switch(TradeStyle)\\n    {\\n        case STYLE_SCALPING:\\n            TPFixedPips=15; StructureLookback=5;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=10; ATR_MinValue=0.0003;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=10; TrailATR_Multi=0;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_INTRADAY:\\n   MaxTotalLot=0.5; CB_DD_Trigger=15.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_AGGRESSIVE:\\n            RiskPercent=2.0; MaxDrawdownPct=35.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=10.0; MaxOpenPositions=10;\\n            MaxTotalLot=1.0; CB_DD_Trigger=25.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Validate Combination \\u2014 \\u0e15\\u0e31\\u0e14 Invalid Config \\u0e2d\\u0e31\\u0e15\\u0e42\\u0e19\\u0e21\\u0e31\\u0e15\\u0e34\\nvoid ValidateCombination()\\n{\\n    // SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND = Signal \\u0e0a\\u0e49\\u0e32\\u0e40\\u0e01\\u0e34\\u0e19\\n  }\\n\\n    // SCALPING + SWING SL = SL \\u0e01\\u0e27\\u0e49\\u0e32\\u0e07\\u0e40\\u0e01\\u0e34\\u0e19 TP \\u0e41\\u0e04\\u0e1a\\n    if(TradeStyle == STYLE_SCALPING &amp;&amp;\\n       SLMode     == 100.0;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckDrawdownLimit()\\n{\\n    if(GetCurrentDD() &gt;= MaxDrawdownPct)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;DD LIMIT: \\\&quot;, GetCurrentDD(), \\\&quot;% &gt;= \\\&quot;, (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; GetCurrentDD() &gt;= HedgeActivationDD);\\n}\\n\\n//--- FOLLOW_CANDLE Trigger\\nbool CheckCandleHedgeTrigger()\\n{\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE) return false;\\n ## 🔧 สรุป 3 Bug ที่แก้ไป

### Bug 1: ATR Handle Leak
```
❌ เดิม: iATR() สร้าง Handle ใหม่ทุก Tick
         → Memory สะสม EA ช้าลงเรื่อยๆ

✅ แก้:  สร้าง ATR_Handle_Filter / ATR_Handle_Grid
         ใน OnInit() ครั้งเดียว
         GetATR() รับ Handle เป็น Parameter แทน
```

### Bug 2: OnDeinit() ไม่มี Template
```
❌ เดิม: ไม่มี Section 6 เลย
         → Handle ไม่ถูก Release เมื่อ EA ปิด
         → Dashboard Object ค้างบน Chart

✅ แก้:  เพิ่ม OnDeinit() Template ครบ
         ├── IndicatorRelease() ทุก Handle
         ├── ObjectsDeleteAll() Dashboard
         └── Entry Templates ทุกตัวมี
             // IndicatorRelease() Comment ไว้พร้อม
```

### Bug 3: ResetDailyStats() Miss Reset
```
❌ เดิม: if(hour==0 && min==0)
         → Tick แรกของวันอาจไม่ตรง 00:00
         → Daily Loss Limit ไม่ Reset ทั้งวัน

✅ แก้:  เปรียบเทียบ Date (today > LastResetDate)
         → Reset ทันที Tick แรกของวันใหม่
         ไม่ว่าจะมาเวลาไหนก็ตาม
```

# 🔍 Clarify Concept ให้ครบ

## ที่เข้าใจแล้ว ✅

```
Entry TF  : M15 (Signal TF)
Confirm TF: H1  (Filter TF)

Case 1: M15 = Buy + H1 = Buy
→ เปิด Buy ด้วย Full Lot ✅

Case 2: M15 = Sell + H1 = Buy
→ เปิด Buy ด้วย Half Lot ✅
  (ทิศทาง = Buy ตาม H1)

Case 3: M15 = Buy + H1 = Sell
→ ???

Case 4: M15 = Sell + H1 = Sell
→ ???
```

---

# ❓ ต้องการคำตอบ 3 ข้อ

## ข้อ 1 — Case 3 & 4 ทำอะไร?

```
Case 3: M15 Buy + H1 Sell → ?
├── A) เปิด Sell ตาม H1 Full Lot
├── B) เปิด Sell Half Lot
├── C) ไม่เทรดเลย (Skip)
└── D) อื่นๆ

Case 4: M15 Sell + H1 Sell → ?
├── A) เปิด Sell Full Lot
├── B) เปิด Sell Half Lot
└── C) อื่นๆ
```

## ข้อ 2 — "HalfTrend Signal" นิยามยังไง?

```
HalfTrend มี 2 แบบที่ใช้กัน:

แบบ A: Signal เมื่อ "เพิ่งเปลี่ยนสี"
├── น้ำเงิน → แดง = Sell Signal (1 ครั้ง)
└── แดง → น้ำเงิน = Buy Signal (1 ครั้ง)
→ เข้า Order ครั้งเดียวต่อ Signal

แบบ B: Signal ตลอดที่ "สีน้ำเงินอยู่"
├── น้ำเงินอยู่ = Buy ตลอด
└── แดงอยู่ = Sell ตลอด
→ เปิดได้หลาย Order ระหว่าง Trend

คุณใช้แบบไหนครับ?
```

# ✅ MTF Logic ที่ได้

```
Signal Source : HalfTrend เปลี่ยนสี (แบบ A)
Entry TF      : M15
Confirm TF    : H1

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  M15 Signal  │  H1 Direction │  Action       │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Buy (↑)     │  Buy  (↑)     │  Buy Full Lot │
│  Buy (↑)     │  Sell (↓)     │  Buy Half Lot │← 1.3
│  Sell (↓)    │  Buy  (↑)     │  Buy Half Lot │← 1.3 (ซื้อตาม H1)
│  Sell (↓)    │  Sell (↓)     │  Sell Full Lot│← 1.4
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

# 📋 Base Lot Calculation

```
Symbol  : XAUUSD
Balance : 10,000 cent = $100
Risk%   : 1% = $1 ต่อ Trade

XAUUSD PipValue (0.01 lot) ≈ $0.01/pip (Cent Account)

SL ประมาณ = Structure Lookback 10 bars
          ≈ 15-20 pips สำหรับ M15 XAUUSD

Base Lot = $1 / (20 pips × $0.01)
         = $1 / $0.20
         = 0.05 lot (Cent)

Half Lot = 0.02 lot (Cent)
```

# ⚠️ Note ก่อน Generate Code

```
MTF Logic นี้ต้องการ iCustom 2 ตัว:

1. HalfTrend บน M15 (Entry Signal)
   → ตรวจ Color Change

2. HalfTrend บน H1 (Confirm Direction)
   → ตรวจว่าสีปัจจุบันคืออะไร

Lot Logic:
├── Full Lot = BaseLot (0.05)
└── Half Lot = BaseLot × 0.5 (0.02)

ATR Min สำหรับ XAUUSD:
→ ต้องปรับเป็น 0.5 (Gold pips)
   ไม่ใช่ 0.0005 (Forex pips)
```
