Condition ***\\n\\n    // 7.13 Grid Logic — เปิดต่อได้เสมอ ไม่สนว่า Hedge Active ไหม\\n    if(GridMode != GRID_NONE &amp;&amp; GridOrderCount &lt; GridMaxOrders)\\n        ShouldOpenGridOrder(0);\\n\\n    // 7.14 Exit Logic\\n    CheckExitLogic();\\n\\n    // 7.15 Dashboard\\n    ShowDashboard();\\n}\\n\\nbool IsNewBar()\\n{\\n    datetime currentBar = iTime(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 0);\\n    if(currentBar != LastBarTime)\\n    {\\n        LastBarTime = currentBar;\\n        return true;\\n    }\\n    return false;\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 8: Filter Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- Spread Hard Cap — Real-time ทุก Tick\\nbool CheckSpreadSpike()\\n{\\n    long spread = SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD);\\n    if(spread &gt; MaxSpread_Hard)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Spread Spike: \\\&quot;, spread, \\\&quot; pts → Block\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Current Bar TR Spike — ไม่รอ Average เหมือน ATR\\nbool CheckCurrentBarSpike()\\n{\\n    if(!VolSpike_Filter_ON) return true;\\n    double highNow   = iHigh (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);\\n    double lowNow    = iLow  (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);\\n    double prevClose = iClose(_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 1);\\n    double currentTR = MathMax(highNow - lowNow,\\n                       MathMax(MathAbs(highNow - prevClose),\\n                               MathAbs(lowNow  - prevClose)));\\n    double atrNormal = GetATR(ATR_Handle_Filter);\\n    if(currentTR &gt; atrNormal * VolatilitySpikeMulti)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;TR Spike | TR:\\\&quot;, currentTR, \\\&quot; ATR:\\\&quot;, atrNormal);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Price Gap Detection (New Bar)\\nbool CheckPriceGap()\\n{\\n    if(!GapProtection_ON) return true;\\n    if(!IsNewBar()) return true;\\n    double prevClose = iClose(_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 1);\\n    double currOpen  = iOpen (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);\\n    double gap       = MathAbs(currOpen - prevClose);\\n    double maxGap    = MaxGap_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    if(gap &gt; maxGap)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Gap: \\\&quot;, gap/(_Point*10), \\\&quot; pips → Circuit Breaker\\\&quot;);\\n        ActivateCircuitBreaker();\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Session Filter\\nbool CheckSessionFilter()\\n{\\n    if(!SessionFilter_ON) return true;\\n    MqlDateTime dt;\\n    TimeToStruct(TimeGMT(), dt);\\n    int hour   = dt.hour;\\n    int minNow = hour * 60 + dt.min;\\n    bool london  = (hour &gt;= 7  &amp;&amp; hour &lt; 16);\\n    bool newYork = (hour &gt;= 13 &amp;&amp; hour &lt; 22);\\n    bool tokyo   = (hour &gt;= 0  &amp;&amp; hour &lt; 9);\\n    bool sydney  = (hour &gt;= 21 || hour &lt; 6);\\n    if(SessionTransition_Block)\\n    {\\n        bool nearLondon = (minNow &gt;= (7*60-TransitionBuffer_Mins) &amp;&amp;\\n                           minNow &lt;= (7*60+TransitionBuffer_Mins));\\n        bool nearNY     = (minNow &gt;= (13*60-TransitionBuffer_Mins) &amp;&amp;\\n                           minNow &lt;= (13*60+TransitionBuffer_Mins));\\n        if(nearLondon || nearNY) return false;\\n    }\\n    if(Allow_London  &amp;&amp; london)  return true;\\n    if(Allow_NewYork &amp;&amp; newYork) return true;\\n    if(Allow_Tokyo   &amp;&amp; tokyo)   return true;\\n    if(Allow_Sydney  &amp;&amp; sydney)  return true;\\n    return false;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Circuit Breaker — หยุด 24hr Fixed\\nvoid ActivateCircuitBreaker()\\n{\\n    if(!CircuitBreaker_ON) return;\\n    CircuitBreakerActive = true;\\n    CircuitBreakerUntil  = TimeCurrent() + 1440 * 60;\\n    if(Notify_CircuitBreaker)\\n        SendAlert(\\\&quot;CIRCUIT BREAKER ON | Resume: \\\&quot;\\n            + TimeToString(CircuitBreakerUntil));\\n    Print(\\\&quot;Circuit Breaker ON | Resume: \\\&quot;, TimeToString(CircuitBreakerUntil));\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckCircuitBreaker()\\n{\\n    if(!CircuitBreaker_ON || !CircuitBreakerActive) return true;\\n    if(TimeCurrent() &gt;= CircuitBreakerUntil)\\n    {\\n        CircuitBreakerActive = false;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Circuit Breaker OFF — waiting for new signal\\\&quot;);\\n        return true;\\n    }\\n    return false;\\n}\\n\\n//--- ATR Baseline Filter\\nbool CheckATRFilter()\\n{\\n    double atr = GetATR(ATR_Handle_Filter);\\n    return (atr &gt;= ATR_MinValue);\\n}\\n\\n//--- BUG FIX: GetATR ใช้ Pre-created Handle — ไม่สร้างใหม่ทุก Tick\\ndouble GetATR(int handle)\\n{\\n    double buf[];\\n    ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);\\n    if(CopyBuffer(handle, 0, 0, 1, buf) &lt; 1) return 0;\\n    return buf[0];\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 12: TP/SL/Exit Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- Calculate TP Level by Mode\\ndouble CalcTPLevel(ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type, double entry,\\n                   ENUM_TP_LEVEL_MODE mode, double value)\\n{\\n    double atr  = GetATR(ATR_Handle_Filter);\\n    double sl   = CalcSL(type);\\n    double dist = 0;\\n    switch(mode)\\n    {\\n        case TP_LEVEL_PIPS: dist = value * _Point * 10;          break;\\n        case TP_LEVEL_RR:   dist = MathAbs(entry - sl) * value;  break;\\n        case TP_LEVEL_ATR:  dist = atr * value;                  break;\\n    }\\n    return (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY) ? entry + dist : entry - dist;\\n}\\n\\n//--- Partial TP Manager\\nvoid CheckPartialTP()\\n{\\n    if(!PartialTP_ON) return;\\n    for(int i = PositionsTotal()-1; i &gt;= 0; i--)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);\\n        double bid       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);\\n        double volume    = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_VOLUME);\\n        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type =\\n            (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);\\n        double tp1 = CalcTPLevel(type, openPrice, TP1_Mode, TP1_Value);\\n        double tp2 = CalcTPLevel(type, openPrice, TP2_Mode, TP2_Value);\\n        bool tp1Hit = (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY) ? bid &gt;= tp1 : bid &lt;= tp1;\\n        if(tp1Hit)\\n        {\\n            double closeLot = NormalizeDouble(volume*(TP1_ClosePercent/100.0),2);\\n            Trade.PositionClosePartial(ticket, closeLot);\\n            if(BreakEven_ON)\\n            {\\n                double bePips = BreakEven_Buffer * _Point * 10;\\n                double newSL  = (type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)\\n                              ? openPrice + bePips\\n                              : openPrice - bePips;\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, tp2);\\n            }\\n            if(Notify_TP1)\\n                SendAlert(\\\&quot;TP1 HIT | \\\&quot; + _Symbol\\n                    + \\\&quot; #\\\&quot; + IntegerToString(ticket));\\n            Print(\\\&quot;TP1 Hit | Partial Close \\\&quot;, TP1_ClosePercent, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Dynamic TP — Net Profit รวบทุกไม้\\nvoid CheckDynamicTP_Grid()\\n{\\n    if(TPMode != TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE) return;\\n    double totalProfit = 0;\\n    for(int i = 0; i &lt; PositionsTotal(); i++)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        totalProfit += PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)\\n                    +  PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SWAP);\\n    }\\n    double target = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE) * (TPBalancePct/100.0);\\n    if(totalProfit &gt;= target)\\n    {\\n        CloseAllOrders();\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Dynamic TP Hit | Net: \\\&quot;, totalProfit, \\\&quot; Target: \\\&quot;, target);\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- ATR Trailing Stop — Adaptive + Spike Mode\\nvoid ManageATRTrail()\\n{\\n    if(!TrailingStop_ON) return;\\n    double atr       = GetATR(ATR_Handle_Filter);\\n    double atrNormal = GetATR(ATR_Handle_Filter);  // ใช้ Period*3 ใน OnInit ถ้าต้องการ\\n    double trailDist;\\n    if(Trail_Mode == TRAIL_ATR)\\n        trailDist = (atr &gt; atrNormal * 2.0)\\n                  ? atr * (TrailATR_Multi * 0.5)  // Spike → Trail ชิด\\n                  : atr * TrailATR_Multi;\\n    else\\n        trailDist = TrailFixed_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    double trailStart = TrailStart_Pips * _Point * 10;\\n    for(int i = PositionsTotal()-1; i &gt;= 0; i--)\\n    {\\n        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);\\n        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;\\n        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;\\n        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);\\n        double currentSL = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SL);\\n        double bid       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);\\n        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE type =\\n            (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);\\n        if(type == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)\\n        {\\n            if(bid - openPrice &lt; trailStart) continue;\\n            double newSL = bid - trailDist;\\n            if(newSL &gt; currentSL)\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);\\n        }\\n        else\\n        {\\n            double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);\\n            if(openPrice - ask &lt; trailStart) continue;\\n            double newSL = ask + trailDist;\\n            if(newSL &lt; currentSL || currentSL == 0)\\n                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Master Exit Logic — 3 Levels\\nvoid CheckExitLogic()\\n{\\n    CheckPartialTP();       // Level 1: Partial TP + Break Even\\n    ManageATRTrail();       // Level 2: Trailing Stop\\n    CheckDynamicTP_Grid();  // Level 3: Dynamic TP (Net Profit)\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 13: Risk Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- Apply Preset — เรียกใน OnInit() ก่อนทุกอย่าง\\nvoid ApplyPreset()\\n{\\n    switch(TradeStyle)\\n    {\\n        case STYLE_SCALPING:\\n            TPFixedPips=15; StructureLookback=5;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=10; ATR_MinValue=0.0003;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=10; TrailATR_Multi=0;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_INTRADAY:\\n            TPFixedPips=40; StructureLookback=10;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=20; ATR_MinValue=0.0005;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=20; TrailATR_Multi=1.0;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_SWING:\\n            TPFixedPips=100; StructureLookback=20;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=30; ATR_MinValue=0.0008;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=50; TrailATR_Multi=1.5;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_TREND:\\n            TPFixedPips=200; StructureLookback=20;\\n            MaxSpreadPoints=30; ATR_MinValue=0.0010;\\n            TrailStart_Pips=80; TrailATR_Multi=2.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n    switch(RiskLevel)\\n    {\\n        case RISK_SAFE:\\n            RiskPercent=0.5; MaxDrawdownPct=10.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=3.0; MaxOpenPositions=3;\\n            MaxTotalLot=0.1; CB_DD_Trigger=8.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_MEDIUM:\\n            RiskPercent=1.0; MaxDrawdownPct=20.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=5.0; MaxOpenPositions=5;\\n            MaxTotalLot=0.5; CB_DD_Trigger=15.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_AGGRESSIVE:\\n            RiskPercent=2.0; MaxDrawdownPct=35.0;\\n            DailyLossPct=10.0; MaxOpenPositions=10;\\n            MaxTotalLot=1.0; CB_DD_Trigger=25.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n//--- Validate Combination — ตัด Invalid Config อัตโนมัติ\\nvoid ValidateCombination()\\n{\\n    // SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND = Signal ช้าเกิน\\n    if(TradeStyle == STYLE_SCALPING &amp;&amp;\\n       HedgeMode  == HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND)\\n    {\\n        HedgeMode = HEDGE_OFF;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND → Hedge forced OFF\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // TREND + FOLLOW_CANDLE = False Signal สูง\\n    if(TradeStyle == STYLE_TREND &amp;&amp;\\n       HedgeMode  == HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE)\\n    {\\n        HedgeMode = HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: TREND + FOLLOW_CANDLE → Hedge forced FOLLOW_TREND\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // GRID_NONE + MARTINGALE = ไม่มี Grid ให้ Scale\\n    if(GridMode == GRID_NONE &amp;&amp;\\n       MMMode   == MM_MARTINGALE)\\n    {\\n        MMMode = MM_FIXED;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: No Grid + MARTINGALE → MM forced FIXED\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // TP_DYNAMIC + Trail ON = Exit ซ้ำซ้อน\\n    if(TPMode          == TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE &amp;&amp;\\n       TrailingStop_ON == true)\\n    {\\n        TrailingStop_ON = false;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: DYNAMIC_TP + Trail → Trail forced OFF\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // SCALPING + SWING SL = SL กว้างเกิน TP แคบ\\n    if(TradeStyle == STYLE_SCALPING &amp;&amp;\\n       SLMode     == SL_RANGE_TREND)\\n    {\\n        SLMode = SL_STRUCTURE;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: SCALPING + RANGE_TREND SL → SL forced STRUCTURE\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n}\\n\\ndouble GetCurrentDD()\\n{\\n    double equity  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double balance = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    if(balance &lt;= 0) return 0;\\n    return ((balance - equity) / balance) * 100.0;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckDrawdownLimit()\\n{\\n    if(GetCurrentDD() &gt;= MaxDrawdownPct)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;DD LIMIT: \\\&quot;, GetCurrentDD(), \\\&quot;% &gt;= \\\&quot;, MaxDrawdownPct, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckDailyLossLimit()\\n{\\n    double equity    = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double dailyLoss = ((DailyStartEquity - equity) / DailyStartEquity) * 100.0;\\n    if(dailyLoss &gt;= DailyLossPct)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;DAILY LOSS: \\\&quot;, dailyLoss, \\\&quot;% &gt;= \\\&quot;, DailyLossPct, \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n//--- BUG FIX: ใช้ Date เปรียบเทียบ ไม่ใช่ hour==0 &amp;&amp; min==0\\n//--- เดิม: Reset เฉพาะถ้า Tick ตกที่ 00:00 พอดี → อาจ Miss ได้\\n//--- ใหม่: Reset ทุกครั้งที่วันเปลี่ยน ไม่ว่า Tick แรกจะมาเวลาไหน\\nvoid ResetDailyStats()\\n{\\n    MqlDateTime dt;\\n    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);\\n    datetime today = StringToTime(StringFormat(\\\&quot;%04d.%02d.%02d\\\&quot;,\\n                                  dt.year, dt.mon, dt.day));\\n    if(today &gt; LastResetDate)\\n    {\\n        DailyStartEquity = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n        LastResetDate    = today;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;Daily Stats Reset | Date: \\\&quot;, TimeToString(today),\\n              \\\&quot; | Equity: \\\&quot;, DailyStartEquity);\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckMargin(double lot)\\n{\\n    double marginRequired;\\n    if(!OrderCalcMargin(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, _Symbol, lot,\\n                        SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK),\\n                        marginRequired))\\n        return false;\\n    double freeMargin = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE);\\n    return (freeMargin &gt;= marginRequired * 1.5); // Safety Buffer 150%\\n}\\n\\ndouble AdjustLotForMaxSL(double lot, double slPips)\\n{\\n    if(slPips &lt;= MaxSL_Pips) return lot;\\n    double balance      = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    double maxRiskMoney = balance * (RiskPercent / 100.0);\\n    double pipValue     = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE);\\n    lot = maxRiskMoney / (MaxSL_Pips * pipValue);\\n    Print(\\\&quot;SL too wide → Lot adjusted: \\\&quot;, lot);\\n    return NormalizeDouble(MathMax(lot, 0.01), 2);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 14: Hedge Module\\n\\n```mql5\\n//--- GRID_REVERSAL Trigger (DD Based)\\nbool CheckHedgeActivation()\\n{\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; GetCurrentDD() &gt;= HedgeActivationDD);\\n}\\n\\n//--- FOLLOW_CANDLE Trigger\\nbool CheckCandleHedgeTrigger()\\n{\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE) return false;\\n    double atr      = GetATR(ATR_Handle_Filter);\\n    double bodySize = MathAbs(iOpen(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1)\\n                   -          iClose(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1));\\n    bool bigBearish = (iClose(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1)\\n                    &lt;  iOpen (_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1))\\n                   &amp;&amp; (bodySize &gt; atr * HedgeCandle_ATRMulti);\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; bigBearish);\\n}\\n\\n//--- FOLLOW_TREND Trigger (EMA Cross)\\nbool CheckTrendHedgeTrigger()\\n{\\n    if(HedgeMode != HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND) return false;\\n    double fast0 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_FastEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 0);\\n    double fast1 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_FastEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 1);\\n    double slow0 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_SlowEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 0);\\n    double slow1 = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, HedgeTrend_SlowEMA,\\n                   0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE, 1);\\n    bool bearishCross = (fast1 &gt; slow1) &amp;&amp; (fast0 &lt; slow0);\\n    return (!HedgeActive &amp;&amp; bearishCross);\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckHedgeDeactivation()\\n{\\n    double equity       = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n    double balance      = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);\\n    double floatLossPct = ((balance - equity) / balance) * 100.0;\\n    return (HedgeActive &amp;&amp; floatLossPct &lt;= HedgeDeactivateDD);\\n}\\n\\ndouble GetHedgeRatio(double dd)\\n{\\n    if(dd &gt;= 25.0) return 1.00;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 20.0) return 0.70;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 15.0) return 0.50;\\n    if(dd &gt;= 10.0) return 0.30;\\n    return 0.0;\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckEmergencyExit()\\n{\\n    if(GetCurrentDD() &gt;= EmergencyExitDD)\\n    {\\n        CloseAllOrders();\\n        if(Notify_Emergency)\\n            SendAlert(\\\&quot;EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: \\\&quot;\\n                + DoubleToString(GetCurrentDD(),1) + \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        Print(\\\&quot;EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: \\\&quot;, GetCurrentDD(), \\\&quot;%\\\&quot;);\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 15: S/R Module\\n\\n```mql5\\nENUM_TIMEFRAMES GetSR_Timeframe()\\n{\\n    if(!SR_AutoHTF) return SR_ManualTF;\\n    switch(EntryTimeframe)\\n    {\\n        case PERIOD_M1:\\n        case PERIOD_M5:\\n        case PERIOD_M15: return PERIOD_H1;\\n        case PERIOD_H1:  return PERIOD_H4;\\n        case PERIOD_H4:  return PERIOD_D1;\\n        case PERIOD_D1:  return PERIOD_W1;\\n        default:         return PERIOD_H4;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nvoid UpdateSR()\\n{\\n    if(SR_Mode == SR_NONE) return;\\n    ENUM_TIMEFRAMES htf = GetSR_Timeframe();\\n    DetectSwingPoints(htf);\\n    MergeSRZones(htf);\\n    Print(\\\&quot;S/R Updated | HTF: \\\&quot;, EnumToString(htf),\\n          \\\&quot; | Zones: \\\&quot;, SR_ZoneCount);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 16: Notification Functions\\n\\n```mql5\\nvoid SendAlert(string message)\\n{\\n    if(!Notify_ON) return;\\n    SendNotification(message);  // Push → MT5 Mobile App\\n    Print(\\\&quot;[ALERT] \\\&quot;, message);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Section 17: Dashboard\\n\\nDashboard แสดงทุก Tick — ใช้ ObjectCreate บน Chart:\\n- Equity / Balance / DD%\\n- Spread / ATR (Filter + Grid)\\n- Trade Style / Risk Profile\\n- Open Positions / Grid Order Count / Grid Max\\n- Hedge Status: Active / Inactive + Mode\\n- Circuit Breaker: ON (Resume time) / OFF\\n- SR Zone Count\\n- TP1 Hit Status\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Entry Code Templates (ใหม่ v1.2)\\n\\nใช้เป็น Reference เมื่อ Generate Entry Logic จาก Spec Card\\n\\n## Template 1: Custom Indicator (iCustom)\\n\\n```mql5\\n// ใช้กับ HalfTrend, SuperTrend หรือ Custom Indicator ทั่วไป\\n// Spec Card ต้องระบุ: ชื่อไฟล์ .ex5 + Buffer Index + Signal Condition\\n\\nint      customHandle;\\ndouble   bufUp[], bufDown[];\\n\\n// OnInit()\\ncustomHandle = iCustom(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe,\\n                       \\\&quot;IndicatorName\\\&quot;,   // ชื่อ .ex5\\n                       Param1, Param2);   // Parameters ของ Indicator\\nif(customHandle == INVALID_HANDLE)\\n{\\n    Print(\\\&quot;ERROR: Failed to create custom indicator handle\\\&quot;);\\n    return INIT_FAILED;\\n}\\nArraySetAsSeries(bufUp,   true);\\nArraySetAsSeries(bufDown, true);\\n\\n// OnDeinit()\\n// IndicatorRelease(customHandle);\\n\\n// Entry Check (New Bar Only)\\nCopyBuffer(customHandle, 0, 0, 3, bufUp);    // Buffer 0 = Up Signal\\nCopyBuffer(customHandle, 1, 0, 3, bufDown);  // Buffer 1 = Down Signal\\n\\nbool buySignal  = (bufUp[1]   != EMPTY_VALUE &amp;&amp; bufUp[2]   == EMPTY_VALUE);\\nbool sellSignal = (bufDown[1] != EMPTY_VALUE &amp;&amp; bufDown[2] == EMPTY_VALUE);\\n// Signal เปลี่ยนจาก EMPTY → มีค่า = เพิ่งเกิด Signal ใหม่\\n```\\n\\n## Template 2: EMA Cross\\n\\n```mql5\\nint    emaFastHandle, emaSlowHandle;\\ndouble emaFast[], emaSlow[];\\n\\n// OnInit()\\nemaFastHandle = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, FastPeriod, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);\\nemaSlowHandle = iMA(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, SlowPeriod, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);\\nArraySetAsSeries(emaFast, true);\\nArraySetAsSeries(emaSlow, true);\\n\\n// OnDeinit()\\n// IndicatorRelease(emaFastHandle);\\n// IndicatorRelease(emaSlowHandle);\\n\\n// Entry Check (New Bar Only)\\nCopyBuffer(emaFastHandle, 0, 0, 3, emaFast);\\nCopyBuffer(emaSlowHandle, 0, 0, 3, emaSlow);\\n\\nbool buySignal  = (emaFast[1] &gt; emaSlow[1]) &amp;&amp; (emaFast[2] &lt;= emaSlow[2]);\\nbool sellSignal = (emaFast[1] &lt; emaSlow[1]) &amp;&amp; (emaFast[2] &gt;= emaSlow[2]);\\n```\\n\\n## Template 3: RSI\\n\\n```mql5\\nint    rsiHandle;\\ndouble rsiBuf[];\\n\\n// OnInit()\\nrsiHandle = iRSI(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, RSI_Period, PRICE_CLOSE);\\nArraySetAsSeries(rsiBuf, true);\\n\\n// OnDeinit()\\n// IndicatorRelease(rsiHandle);\\n\\n// Entry Check (New Bar Only)\\nCopyBuffer(rsiHandle, 0, 0, 3, rsiBuf);\\n\\nbool buySignal  = (rsiBuf[1] &lt; RSI_OversoldLevel  &amp;&amp; rsiBuf[2] &gt;= RSI_OversoldLevel);\\nbool sellSignal = (rsiBuf[1] &gt; RSI_OverboughtLevel &amp;&amp; rsiBuf[2] &lt;= RSI_OverboughtLevel);\\n```\\n\\n## Template 4: Bollinger Bands\\n\\n```mql5\\nint    bbHandle;\\ndouble bbUpper[], bbLower[];\\n\\n// OnInit()\\nbbHandle = iBands(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, BB_Period, 0, BB_Deviation, PRICE_CLOSE);\\nArraySetAsSeries(bbUpper, true);\\nArraySetAsSeries(bbLower, true);\\n\\n// OnDeinit()\\n// IndicatorRelease(bbHandle);\\n\\n// Entry Check (New Bar Only)\\nCopyBuffer(bbHandle, 1, 0, 3, bbUpper);  // Buffer 1 = Upper\\nCopyBuffer(bbHandle, 2, 0, 3, bbLower);  // Buffer 2 = Lower\\n\\ndouble closeNow  = iClose(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1);\\ndouble closePrev = iClose(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 2);\\n\\nbool buySignal  = (closePrev &lt;= bbLower[2]) &amp;&amp; (closeNow &gt; bbLower[1]);\\nbool sellSignal = (closePrev &gt;= bbUpper[2]) &amp;&amp; (closeNow &lt; bbUpper[1]);\\n```\\n\\n## Template 5: MACD\\n\\n```mql5\\nint    macdHandle;\\ndouble macdMain[], macdSignal[];\\n\\n// OnInit()\\nmacdHandle = iMACD(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe,\\n                   MACD_Fast, MACD_Slow, MACD_Signal, PRICE_CLOSE);\\nArraySetAsSeries(macdMain,   true);\\nArraySetAsSeries(macdSignal, true);\\n\\n// OnDeinit()\\n// IndicatorRelease(macdHandle);\\n\\n// Entry Check (New Bar Only)\\nCopyBuffer(macdHandle, 0, 0, 3, macdMain);    // Buffer 0 = MACD Line\\nCopyBuffer(macdHandle, 1, 0, 3, macdSignal);  // Buffer 1 = Signal Line\\n\\nbool buySignal  = (macdMain[1] &gt; macdSignal[1]) &amp;&amp; (macdMain[2] &lt;= macdSignal[2]);\\nbool sellSignal = (macdMain[1] &lt; macdSignal[1]) &amp;&amp; (macdMain[2] &gt;= macdSignal[2]);\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Backtest Settings (ใหม่ v1.2)\\n\\nส่งพร้อม Output ทุกครั้ง\\n\\n## MT5 Strategy Tester — Recommended Settings\\n\\n| Setting | Value | หมายเหตุ |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| Model | Every Tick (Based on real ticks) | Accurate ที่สุด |\\n| Period | 2020–2024 (5 ปี) | In-Sample |\\n| Spread | Current (Symbol Spec) | ใช้ค่าจริง |\\n| Initial Deposit | ตาม Account Balance ใน Spec Card | |\\n| Leverage | 1:100 | Standard |\\n| Optimization | Slow (Complete Algorithm) | ครบทุก Combination |\\n| Optimization Criterion | Max Profit Factor | Phase 1 |\\n\\n## Phase 1 — Macro Optimize Parameters\\n\\n```\\nติ๊ก Optimize:\\n✅ TradeStyle      (4 options)\\n✅ RiskLevel       (3 options)\\n✅ GridMode        (4 options)\\n✅ HedgeMode       (4 options)\\n✅ TPMode          (3 options)\\n\\nFix (ไม่ติ๊ก):\\n❌ ตัวเลขทุกตัว — ใช้ Default จาก Preset\\n\\nExpected Combinations: 4×3×4×4×3 = 576 runs\\nValidateCombination() จะตัด Invalid ออกอัตโนมัติ\\n```\\n\\n## Phase 2 — Micro Optimize StructureLookback\\n\\nOptimization Criterion: Max Sharpe Ratio\\n```\\n\\n## Validation Criteria\\n\\n```\\nPass Condition:\\n✅ Profit Factor &gt; 1.3\\n✅ Max Drawdown &lt; ที่ตั้งไว้ใน Risk Profile\\n✅ Total Trades &gt; 100 (Statistical Significance)\\n✅ Win Rate &gt; 40% (หรือ RR &gt; 1:2 ถ้า Win Rate ต่ำกว่า)\\n\\nForward Test Pass:\\n✅ Profit Factor &gt; 1.2 (ยอมลดได้ 10%)\\n✅ DD ไม่เกิน In-Sample × 1.5\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Coding Rules (บังคับทุก EA)\\n\\n## ✅ Must Have\\n- ทุก Function มี Comment ภาษาอังกฤษ\\n- ทุก OpenOrder ผ่าน `CheckMargin()` ก่อน\\n- OnTick() ผ่าน Safety Check ตามลำดับใน Section 7 เสมอ\\n- `ApplyPreset()` เรียกใน `OnInit()` ก่อนทุกอย่าง\\n- `ValidateCombination()` เรียกหลัง `ApplyPreset()` เสมอ\\n- สร้าง Indicator Handles ทั้งหมดใน `OnInit()` — Leak\\n- ❌ ใช้ `hour==0 &amp;&amp; min==0` Reset Daily Stats — ใช้ Date Compare แทน\\n- ❌ ใช้ Sleep() ใน OnTick()\\n- ❌ Hardcode Symbol — ใช้ `_Symbol` เสมอ\\n- ❌ เปิด Order โดยไม่เช็ค Free Margin\\n- ❌ ใช้ Magic Number ซ้ำกับ EA อื่น\\n- ❌ คำนวณ S/R ทุก Tick\\n- ❌ เริ่มเขียนโค้ดก่อนได้รับ Spec Card สมบูรณ์\\n- ❌ สร้าง Logic ที่ไม่อยู่ใน Spec Card\\n\\n---\\n\\n# Output Format\\n\\nส่งกลับครบ 4 # 📝 Part 1 — Full MQL5 Code

```mql5
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| HalfTrend_MTF_EA.mq5                                            |
//| Generated from EA Spec Card v2.1                                 |
//| Strategy : HalfTrend MTF (M15 Signal + H1 Confirm)              |
//| Symbol   : XAUUSD | Balance: 10,000 cent                         |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
#property copyright   "Quant Trader"
#property version     "1.00"
#property strict

#include <Trade\Trade.mqh>
#include <Trade\PositionInfo.mqh>
#include <Trade\OrderInfo.mqh>

CTrade Trade;

#define INVALID_TICKET -1
#define MAX_SR_ZONES   50

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 2: ENUMS
//==========================================================================

enum ENUM_TRADE_STYLE
{
    STYLE_SCALPING,  // Scalping
    STYLE_INTRADAY,  // Intraday
    STYLE_SWING,     // Swing
    STYLE_TREND      // Trend Following
};

enum ENUM_RISK_LEVEL
{
    RISK_SAFE,       // Safe — 0.5%
    RISK_MEDIUM,     // Medium — 1.0%
    RISK_AGGRESSIVE  // Aggressive — 2.0%
};

enum ENUM_TP_MODE
{
    TP_FIXED,           // Fixed Pips
    TP_RR,              // Risk:Reward Ratio
    TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE  // % of Balance
};

enum ENUM_SL_MODE
{
    SL_STRUCTURE,   // Swing High/Low
    SL_RANGE_TREND  // ADX Based
};

enum ENUM_TRAIL_MODE
{
    TRAIL_ATR,   // ATR Multiple
    TRAIL_FIXED  // Fixed Pips
};

enum ENUM_MM_MODE
{
    MM_FIXED,      // Fixed Lot
    MM_LINEAR,     // Linear Step
    MM_MARTINGALE, // Martingale
    MM_LOG         // Logarithmic
};

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 3: INPUT PARAMETERS
//==========================================================================

//--- 3.1 PRESET LAYER
input string           _PRESET_         = "=== PRESET ===";
input ENUM_TRADE_STYLE TradeStyle        = STYLE_INTRADAY;
input ENUM_RISK_LEVEL  RiskLevel         = RISK_MEDIUM;
input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES  EntryTimeframe    = PERIOD_M15;

//--- 3.2 GENERAL
input string           _GENERAL_        = "=== GENERAL ===";
input string           EA_Comment       = "HT_MTF_v1";
input int              MagicNumber      = 20260001;
input bool             AllowBuy         = true;
input bool             AllowSell        = true;

//--- 3.3 ENTRY — HalfTrend MTF
input string           _ENTRY_          = "=== ENTRY ===";
input string           HT_FileName      = "HalfTrend"; // ชื่อไฟล์ .ex5
input int              HT_Amplitude     = 2;           // HalfTrend Amplitude
input double           HT_ChannelDev    = 2.0;         // Channel Deviation
input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES  ConfirmTimeframe = PERIOD_H1;   // MTF Confirm TF

//--- 3.4 GRID — ปิดไว้
input string           _GRID_           = "=== GRID (OFF) ===";
// Grid = NONE สำหรับ EA นี้

//--- 3.5 MM
input string           _MM_             = "=== MM ===";
input ENUM_MM_MODE     MMMode           = MM_FIXED;
input double           BaseLot          = 0.05;  // Full Lot
input double           HalfLotRatio     = 0.5;   // Half = BaseLot × 0.5

//--- 3.6 TP
input string           _TP_             = "=== TP ===";
input ENUM_TP_MODE     TPMode           = TP_RR;
input double           RRRatio          = 1.5;   // RR 1:1.5
input double           TPFixedPips      = 40;    // ใช้ถ้า TPMode=FIXED

//--- 3.7 SL
input string           _SL_             = "=== SL ===";
input ENUM_SL_MODE     SLMode           = SL_STRUCTURE;
input int              StructureLookback = 10;
input double           MaxSL_Pips       = 200;

//--- 3.8 TRAILING STOP
input string           _TRAIL_          = "=== TRAILING STOP ===";
input bool             TrailingStop_ON  = false;
input ENUM_TRAIL_MODE  Trail_Mode       = TRAIL_ATR;
input double           TrailATR_Multi   = 1.0;
input double           TrailFixed_Pips  = 20;
input double           TrailStart_Pips  = 20;

//--- 3.9 HEDGE — ปิดไว้
input string           _HEDGE_          = "=== HEDGE (OFF) ===";
input double           EmergencyExitDD  = 70.0;

//--- 3.11 FILTERS
input string           _FILTER_         = "=== FILTERS ===";
input int              MaxSpreadPoints  = 20;
input int              ATR_Period       = 14;
input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES  ATR_TF_Filter    = PERIOD_M15;
input double           ATR_MinValue     = 0.5;   // Gold: ขั้นต่ำ 0.5 point
input bool             SessionFilter_ON = true;
input bool             Allow_London     = true;
input bool             Allow_NewYork    = true;
input bool             Allow_Tokyo      = false;
input bool             Allow_Sydney     = false;
input bool             SessionTransition_Block = false;
input int              TransitionBuffer_Mins   = 15;

//--- 3.12 BLACK SWAN
input string           _BLACKSWAN_      = "=== BLACK SWAN ===";
input bool             VolSpike_Filter_ON   = false;
input double           VolatilitySpikeMulti = 3.0;
input int              MaxSpread_Hard       = 50;
input bool             GapProtection_ON     = false;
input double           MaxGap_Pips          = 100;

//--- 3.13 CIRCUIT BREAKER
input string           _CB_             = "=== CIRCUIT BREAKER ===";
input bool             CircuitBreaker_ON = false;
input double           CB_DD_Trigger    = 15.0;

//--- 3.14 NOTIFICATIONS
input string           _NOTIFY_         = "=== NOTIFICATIONS ===";
input bool             Notify_ON        = false;
input bool             Notify_Emergency = false;
input bool             Notify_CircuitBreaker = false;

//--- 3.15 RISK MANAGEMENT
input string           _RISK_           = "=== RISK ===";
input double           RiskPercent      = 1.0;
input int              MaxOpenPositions = 5;
input double           MaxTotalLot      = 0.5;
input double           MaxDrawdownPct   = 20.0;
input double           DailyLossPct     = 5.0;

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 4: GLOBAL VARIABLES
//==========================================================================

//--- Indicator Handles (สร้างครั้งเดียวใน OnInit)
int      HT_Handle_M15    = INVALID_HANDLE; // HalfTrend บน M15 (Entry)
int      HT_Handle_H1     = INVALID_HANDLE; // HalfTrend บน H1  (Confirm)
int      ATR_Handle_Filter = INVALID_HANDLE;

//--- HalfTrend Buffers
double   HT_Up_M15[];    // Buffer 0 = Up Arrow (Buy Signal)
double   HT_Dn_M15[];    // Buffer 1 = Down Arrow (Sell Signal)
double   HT_Up_H1[];     // Buffer 0 = Up on H1
double   HT_Dn_H1[];     // Buffer 1 = Down on H1

//--- Daily Reset
datetime LastResetDate        = 0;
double   DailyStartEquity     = 0;
double   InitialBalance       = 0;

//--- State
datetime LastBarTime          = 0;
bool     CircuitBreakerActive = false;
datetime CircuitBreakerUntil  = 0;

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 5: OnInit()
//==========================================================================

int OnInit()
{
    //--- Apply Preset
    ApplyPreset();
    ValidateCombination();

    //--- Trade Object Setup
    Trade.SetExpertMagicNumber(MagicNumber);
    Trade.SetDeviationInPoints(30); // Gold ต้องใช้ Deviation กว้างขึ้น
    Trade.SetTypeFilling(ORDER_FILLING_IOC);

    //--- Create ATR Handle
    ATR_Handle_Filter = iATR(_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, ATR_Period);
    if(ATR_Handle_Filter == INVALID_HANDLE)
    {
        Print("ERROR: Failed to create ATR handle");
        return INIT_FAILED;
    }

    //--- Create HalfTrend Handles (2 TF)
    HT_Handle_M15 = iCustom(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe,
                             HT_FileName,
                             HT_Amplitude,
                             HT_ChannelDev);
    HT_Handle_H1  = iCustom(_Symbol, ConfirmTimeframe,
                             HT_FileName,
                             HT_Amplitude,
                             HT_ChannelDev);

    if(HT_Handle_M15 == INVALID_HANDLE || HT_Handle_H1 == INVALID_HANDLE)
    {
        Print("ERROR: Failed to create HalfTrend handles. ",
              "Check HalfTrend.ex5 exists in Indicators folder.");
        return INIT_FAILED;
    }

    //--- Set Array Series
    ArraySetAsSeries(HT_Up_M15, true);
    ArraySetAsSeries(HT_Dn_M15, true);
    ArraySetAsSeries(HT_Up_H1,  true);
    ArraySetAsSeries(HT_Dn_H1,  true);

    //--- Initial Balance & Daily Reset Date
    InitialBalance   = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
    DailyStartEquity = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);

    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);
    LastResetDate = StringToTime(StringFormat("%04d.%02d.%02d",
                                 dt.year, dt.mon, dt.day));

    //--- Symbol Check
    if(!SymbolSelect(_Symbol, true))
    {
        Print("ERROR: Cannot select symbol ", _Symbol);
        return INIT_FAILED;
    }

    Print("=== HalfTrend MTF EA Initialized ===");
    Print("Symbol: ",    _Symbol,
          " | Entry TF: ", EnumToString(EntryTimeframe),
          " | Confirm TF: ", EnumToString(ConfirmTimeframe));
    Print("Balance: ",   InitialBalance,
          " | BaseLot: ", BaseLot,
          " | HalfLot: ", NormalizeDouble(BaseLot * HalfLotRatio, 2));

    return INIT_SUCCEEDED;
}

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 6: OnDeinit()
//==========================================================================

void OnDeinit(int reason)
{
    //--- Release Handles
    if(ATR_Handle_Filter  != INVALID_HANDLE)
        IndicatorRelease(ATR_Handle_Filter);
    if(HT_Handle_M15 != INVALID_HANDLE)
        IndicatorRelease(HT_Handle_M15);
    if(HT_Handle_H1  != INVALID_HANDLE)
        IndicatorRelease(HT_Handle_H1);

    //--- Clean Dashboard
    ObjectsDeleteAll(0, "HT_");

    Print("EA Deinitialized | Reason: ", reason);
}

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 7: OnTick()
//==========================================================================

void OnTick()
{
    // Daily Reset
    ResetDailyStats();

    // 7.1 Emergency Exit
    if(!CheckEmergencyExit())   return;
    // 7.2 Drawdown Check
    if(!CheckDrawdownLimit())   return;
    // 7.3 Daily Loss Check
    if(!CheckDailyLossLimit())  return;
    // 7.4 Circuit Breaker
    if(!CheckCircuitBreaker())  return;
    // 7.5 Spread Spike Hard Cap
    if(!CheckSpreadSpike())     return;
    // 7.6 Current Bar TR Spike
    if(!CheckCurrentBarSpike()) return;
    // 7.7 Price Gap
    if(!CheckPriceGap())        return;
    // 7.8 ATR Baseline Filter
    if(!CheckATRFilter())       return;
    // 7.9 Session Filter
    if(!CheckSessionFilter())   return;

    // 7.12 Entry Logic — New Bar Only
    if(!IsNewBar()) return;

    // --- Copy HalfTrend Buffers ---
    if(CopyBuffer(HT_Handle_M15, 0, 0, 3, HT_Up_M15) < 3) return;
    if(CopyBuffer(HT_Handle_M15, 1, 0, 3, HT_Dn_M15) < 3) return;
    if(CopyBuffer(HT_Handle_H1,  0, 0, 3, HT_Up_H1)  < 3) return;
    if(CopyBuffer(HT_Handle_H1,  1, 0, 3, HT_Dn_H1)  < 3) return;

    // --- Detect M15 Signal (Color Change) ---
    // Buy Signal  : Up buffer เพิ่งมีค่า (EMPTY→value)
    // Sell Signal : Dn buffer เพิ่งมีค่า (EMPTY→value)
    bool m15_Buy  = (HT_Up_M15[1] != EMPTY_VALUE &&
                     HT_Up_M15[2] == EMPTY_VALUE);
    bool m15_Sell = (HT_Dn_M15[1] != EMPTY_VALUE &&
                     HT_Dn_M15[2] == EMPTY_VALUE);

    // --- Detect H1 Direction (Current State) ---
    // H1 Buy  : Up buffer มีค่าอยู่ในปัจจุบัน
    // H1 Sell : Dn buffer มีค่าอยู่ในปัจจุบัน
    bool h1_Buy  = (HT_Up_H1[1] != EMPTY_VALUE);
    bool h1_Sell = (HT_Dn_H1[1] != EMPTY_VALUE);

    // --- MTF Logic ---
    // Case 1: M15 Buy  + H1 Buy  → Buy Full Lot
    // Case 2: M15 Buy  + H1 Sell → Buy Half Lot
    // Case 3: M15 Sell + H1 Buy  → Buy Half Lot
    // Case 4: M15 Sell + H1 Sell → Sell Full Lot

    double lotFull = NormalizeDouble(BaseLot, 2);
    double lotHalf = NormalizeDouble(BaseLot * HalfLotRatio, 2);
    lotHalf = MathMax(lotHalf, 0.01);

    // Check Max Positions
    if(PositionsTotal() >= MaxOpenPositions) return;

    if(m15_Buy && h1_Buy && AllowBuy)
    {
        // Case 1: Full Buy
        OpenOrder(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, lotFull, "HT_Buy_Full");
    }
    else if(m15_Buy && h1_Sell && AllowBuy)
    {
        // Case 2: Half Buy (M15 Buy สวนทาง H1 Sell)
        OpenOrder(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, lotHalf, "HT_Buy_Half");
    }
    else if(m15_Sell && h1_Buy && AllowBuy)
    {
        // Case 3: Half Buy (ตาม H1 Buy แม้ M15 Sell)
        OpenOrder(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, lotHalf, "HT_Buy_ContraHalf");
    }
    else if(m15_Sell && h1_Sell && AllowSell)
    {
        // Case 4: Full Sell
        OpenOrder(ORDER_TYPE_SELL, lotFull, "HT_Sell_Full");
    }

    // 7.14 Exit Logic
    CheckExitLogic();

    // 7.15 Dashboard
    ShowDashboard();
}

//--- New Bar Detection
bool IsNewBar()
{
    datetime currentBar = iTime(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 0);
    if(currentBar != LastBarTime)
    {
        LastBarTime = currentBar;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 8: FILTER FUNCTIONS
//==========================================================================

bool CheckSpreadSpike()
{
    long spread = SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD);
    if(spread > MaxSpread_Hard)
    {
        Print("Spread Spike: ", spread, " pts → Block");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool CheckCurrentBarSpike()
{
    if(!VolSpike_Filter_ON) return true;
    double highNow   = iHigh (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);
    double lowNow    = iLow  (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);
    double prevClose = iClose(_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 1);
    double currentTR = MathMax(highNow - lowNow,
                       MathMax(MathAbs(highNow - prevClose),
                               MathAbs(lowNow  - prevClose)));
    double atrNormal = GetATR(ATR_Handle_Filter);
    if(currentTR > atrNormal * VolatilitySpikeMulti)
    {
        Print("TR Spike | TR:", currentTR, " ATR:", atrNormal);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool CheckPriceGap()
{
    if(!GapProtection_ON) return true;
    double prevClose = iClose(_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 1);
    double currOpen  = iOpen (_Symbol, ATR_TF_Filter, 0);
    double gap       = MathAbs(currOpen - prevClose);
    double maxGap    = MaxGap_Pips * _Point * 10;
    if(gap > maxGap)
    {
        Print("Gap: ", gap / (_Point * 10), " pips → Circuit Breaker");
        ActivateCircuitBreaker();
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool CheckSessionFilter()
{
    if(!SessionFilter_ON) return true;
    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeGMT(), dt);
    int hour   = dt.hour;
    int minNow = hour * 60 + dt.min;
    bool london  = (hour >= 7  && hour < 16);
    bool newYork = (hour >= 13 && hour < 22);
    bool tokyo   = (hour >= 0  && hour < 9);
    bool sydney  = (hour >= 21 || hour < 6);
    if(SessionTransition_Block)
    {
        bool nearLondon = (minNow >= (7*60 - TransitionBuffer_Mins) &&
                           minNow <= (7*60 + TransitionBuffer_Mins));
        bool nearNY     = (minNow >= (13*60 - TransitionBuffer_Mins) &&
                           minNow <= (13*60 + TransitionBuffer_Mins));
        if(nearLondon || nearNY) return false;
    }
    if(Allow_London  && london)  return true;
    if(Allow_NewYork && newYork) return true;
    if(Allow_Tokyo   && tokyo)   return true;
    if(Allow_Sydney  && sydney)  return true;
    return false;
}

void ActivateCircuitBreaker()
{
    if(!CircuitBreaker_ON) return;
    CircuitBreakerActive = true;
    CircuitBreakerUntil  = TimeCurrent() + 1440 * 60;
    if(Notify_CircuitBreaker)
        SendAlert("CIRCUIT BREAKER ON | Resume: "
                  + TimeToString(CircuitBreakerUntil));
    Print("Circuit Breaker ON | Resume: ", TimeToString(CircuitBreakerUntil));
}

bool CheckCircuitBreaker()
{
    if(!CircuitBreaker_ON || !CircuitBreakerActive) return true;
    if(TimeCurrent() >= CircuitBreakerUntil)
    {
        CircuitBreakerActive = false;
        Print("Circuit Breaker OFF");
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool CheckATRFilter()
{
    double atr = GetATR(ATR_Handle_Filter);
    return (atr >= ATR_MinValue);
}

double GetATR(int handle)
{
    double buf[];
    ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);
    if(CopyBuffer(handle, 0, 0, 1, buf) < 1) return 0;
    return buf[0];
}

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 9: ORDER FUNCTIONS
//==========================================================================

void OpenOrder(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type, double lot, string comment)
{
    //--- Margin Check
    if(!CheckMargin(lot)) return;

    double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
    double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
    double sl  = CalcSL(type);
    double tp  = CalcTP(type, sl);

    //--- Validate SL
    if(sl == 0)
    {
        Print("ERROR: SL = 0, order blocked");
        return;
    }

    //--- Lot Adjustment for wide SL
    double slPips = MathAbs((type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY ? ask : bid) - sl)
                    / (_Point * 10);
    lot = AdjustLotForMaxSL(lot, slPips);

    if(type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
        Trade.Buy(lot, _Symbol, ask, sl, tp,
                  comment + " | M:" + IntegerToString(MagicNumber));
    else
        Trade.Sell(lot, _Symbol, bid, sl, tp,
                   comment + " | M:" + IntegerToString(MagicNumber));

    if(Trade.ResultRetcode() == TRADE_RETCODE_DONE)
        Print("Order Opened | ", EnumToString(type),
              " | Lot:", lot, " | SL:", sl, " | TP:", tp,
              " | Comment:", comment);
    else
        Print("Order Failed | Retcode:", Trade.ResultRetcode(),
              " | ", Trade.ResultComment());
}

void CloseAllOrders()
{
    for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;
        Trade.PositionClose(ticket);
    }
}

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 12: TP / SL / EXIT FUNCTIONS
//==========================================================================

double CalcSL(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type)
{
    //--- Structure SL: Swing High/Low Lookback
    double sl = 0;
    if(SLMode == SL_STRUCTURE)
    {
        if(type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
        {
            // SL = Lowest Low ใน Lookback bars
            double low = iLow(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1);
            for(int i = 2; i <= StructureLookback; i++)
                low = MathMin(low, iLow(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, i));
            sl = low - (10 * _Point); // Buffer 1 pip
        }
        else
        {
            // SL = Highest High ใน Lookback bars
            double high = iHigh(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1);
            for(int i = 2; i <= StructureLookback; i++)
                high = MathMax(high, iHigh(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, i));
            sl = high + (10 * _Point);
        }
    }
    return NormalizeDouble(sl, (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS));
}

double CalcTP(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type, double sl)
{
    double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
    double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
    double entry = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? ask : bid;
    double slDist = MathAbs(entry - sl);
    double tp = 0;

    if(TPMode == TP_RR)
        tp = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
           ? entry + slDist * RRRatio
           : entry - slDist * RRRatio;
    else if(TPMode == TP_FIXED)
    {
        double tpDist = TPFixedPips * _Point * 10;
        tp = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? entry + tpDist : entry - tpDist;
    }

    return NormalizeDouble(tp, (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS));
}

void ManageATRTrail()
{
    if(!TrailingStop_ON) return;
    double atr        = GetATR(ATR_Handle_Filter);
    double trailDist  = (Trail_Mode == TRAIL_ATR)
                      ? atr * TrailATR_Multi
                      : TrailFixed_Pips * _Point * 10;
    double trailStart = TrailStart_Pips * _Point * 10;

    for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;

        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);
        double currentSL = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SL);
        double bid       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE posType =
            (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);

        if(posType == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)
        {
            if(bid - openPrice < trailStart) continue;
            double newSL = bid - trailDist;
            if(newSL > currentSL)
                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);
        }
        else
        {
            double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
            if(openPrice - ask < trailStart) continue;
            double newSL = ask + trailDist;
            if(newSL < currentSL || currentSL == 0)
                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);
        }
    }
}

void CheckExitLogic()
{
    ManageATRTrail(); // Trailing Stop (ถ้าเปิด)
}

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 13: RISK FUNCTIONS
//==========================================================================

void ApplyPreset()
{
    // Style Preset — INTRADAY
    switch(TradeStyle)
    {
        case STYLE_SCALPING:
            MaxSpreadPoints = 10; ATR_MinValue = 0.3;
            TrailStart_Pips = 10; TrailATR_Multi = 0;
            break;
        case STYLE_INTRADAY:
            MaxSpreadPoints = 20; ATR_MinValue = 0.5;
            TrailStart_Pips = 20; TrailATR_Multi = 1.0;
            break;
        case STYLE_SWING:
            MaxSpreadPoints = 30; ATR_MinValue = 1.0;
            TrailStart_Pips = 50; TrailATR_Multi = 1.5;
            break;
        case STYLE_TREND:
            MaxSpreadPoints = 30; ATR_MinValue = 2.0;
            TrailStart_Pips = 80; TrailATR_Multi = 2.0;
            break;
    }
    // Risk Preset — MEDIUM
    switch(RiskLevel)
    {
        case RISK_SAFE:
            RiskPercent = 0.5; MaxDrawdownPct = 10.0;
            DailyLossPct = 3.0; MaxOpenPositions = 3;
            MaxTotalLot = 0.1; CB_DD_Trigger = 8.0;
            break;
        case RISK_MEDIUM:
            RiskPercent = 1.0; MaxDrawdownPct = 20.0;
            DailyLossPct = 5.0; MaxOpenPositions = 5;
            MaxTotalLot = 0.5; CB_DD_Trigger = 15.0;
            break;
        case RISK_AGGRESSIVE:
            RiskPercent = 2.0; MaxDrawdownPct = 35.0;
            DailyLossPct = 10.0; MaxOpenPositions = 10;
            MaxTotalLot = 1.0; CB_DD_Trigger = 25.0;
            break;
    }
}

void ValidateCombination()
{
    // ไม่มี Invalid Combination สำหรับ EA นี้
    // Grid = NONE, MM = FIXED, Hedge = OFF
    Print("ValidateCombination: OK | Style=", EnumToString(TradeStyle),
          " | Risk=", EnumToString(RiskLevel));
}

double GetCurrentDD()
{
    double equity  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
    double balance = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
    if(balance <= 0) return 0;
    return ((balance - equity) / balance) * 100.0;
}

bool CheckDrawdownLimit()
{
    if(GetCurrentDD() >= MaxDrawdownPct)
    {
        Print("DD LIMIT: ", GetCurrentDD(), "% >= ", MaxDrawdownPct, "%");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool CheckDailyLossLimit()
{
    double equity    = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
    double dailyLoss = ((DailyStartEquity - equity) / DailyStartEquity) * 100.0;
    if(dailyLoss >= DailyLossPct)
    {
        Print("DAILY LOSS: ", dailyLoss, "% >= ", DailyLossPct, "%");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

void ResetDailyStats()
{
    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);
    datetime today = StringToTime(StringFormat("%04d.%02d.%02d",
                                  dt.year, dt.mon, dt.day));
    if(today > LastResetDate)
    {
        DailyStartEquity = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
        LastResetDate    = today;
        Print("Daily Reset | Equity: ", DailyStartEquity);
    }
}

bool CheckMargin(double lot)
{
    double marginRequired;
    if(!OrderCalcMargin(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, _Symbol, lot,
                        SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK),
                        marginRequired))
        return false;
    return (AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE) >= marginRequired * 1.5);
}

double AdjustLotForMaxSL(double lot, double slPips)
{
    if(slPips <= MaxSL_Pips) return lot;
    double balance      = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
    double maxRiskMoney = balance * (RiskPercent / 100.0);
    double pipValue     = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE);
    lot = maxRiskMoney / (MaxSL_Pips * pipValue);
    Print("SL too wide → Lot adjusted: ", lot);
    return NormalizeDouble(MathMax(lot, 0.01), 2);
}

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 14: EMERGENCY EXIT
//==========================================================================

bool CheckEmergencyExit()
{
    if(GetCurrentDD() >= EmergencyExitDD)
    {
        CloseAllOrders();
        if(Notify_Emergency)
            SendAlert("EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: "
                      + DoubleToString(GetCurrentDD(), 1) + "%");
        Print("EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: ", GetCurrentDD(), "%");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 16: NOTIFICATIONS
//==========================================================================

void SendAlert(string message)
{
    if(!Notify_ON) return;
    SendNotification(message);
    Print("[ALERT] ", message);
}

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 17: DASHBOARD
//==========================================================================

void ShowDashboard()
{
    double equity   = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
    double balance  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
    double dd       = GetCurrentDD();
    long   spread   = SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD);
    double atr      = GetATR(ATR_Handle_Filter);
    int    positions= PositionsTotal();

    string cbStatus = CircuitBreakerActive
                    ? "ON | " + TimeToString(CircuitBreakerUntil)
                    : "OFF";

    // Dashboard Label (ObjectCreate)
    string info = StringFormat(
        "HT MTF EA | %s\n"
        "Balance: %.2f | Equity: %.2f | DD: %.1f%%\n"
        "Spread: %d pts | ATR: %.5f\n"
        "Positions: %d/%d | Style: %s | Risk: %s\n"
        "Session: %s | CB: %s",
        _Symbol,
        balance, equity, dd,
        spread, atr,
        positions, MaxOpenPositions,
        EnumToString(TradeStyle), EnumToString(RiskLevel),
        SessionFilter_ON ? "ON" : "OFF",
        cbStatus
    );

    // Create/Update Chart Comment
    Comment(info);
}
```

# ⚠️ Part 4 — Risk Warning

```
Risk Level: 🟢 ต่ำ

Configuration:
├── Grid   : NONE       ✅ ปลอดภัย
├── MM     : FIXED      ✅ ไม่ Scale Lot
├── Hedge  : OFF        ✅ ไม่มี Double Risk
└── TP     : RR 1.5     ✅ Risk/Reward สมดุล

⚠️ ข้อควรระวัง:
1. HalfTrend.ex5 ต้องอยู่ใน
   MT5/MQL5/Indicators/ folder
   → ถ้าไม่มี EA จะ INIT_FAILED

2. Cent Account:
   → BaseLot 0.05 = $0.05 ต่อ pip
   → ตรวจสอบ Broker Min Lot ก่อน

3. ATR_MinValue = 0.5:
   → ใช้กับ XAUUSD เท่านั้น
   → ถ้าย้ายไป EURUSD ต้องเปลี่ยนเป็น 0.0005

4. Case 3 Logic:
   M15 Sell + H1 Buy → Buy Half Lot
   → Counter-trend Trade มี Risk สูงกว่าปกติ
   → แนะนำ Monitor ผล Backtest Case นี้แยก
```

----- [user] -----
ผมไม่มี indicator นายทำสูตรรำนวนมาเลยได้ไหม ไม่ต้องติดตั้ง indicator backtest มันจุกจิก

----- [assistant] -----
