# 🔍 HalfTrend Algorithm

```
HalfTrend ทำงานยังไง:

1. คำนวณ Amplitude ด้วย ATR
2. ติดตาม High/Low สะสม (phigh/plow)
3. เปลี่ยน Trend เมื่อราคาทะลุ Threshold
4. Output: Trend Direction (Up/Down)
          + Arrow เมื่อเปลี่ยนทิศ
```

---

# 📝 Full MQL5 Code — Built-in HalfTrend

```mql5
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| HalfTrend_MTF_EA.mq5                                             |
//| HalfTrend คำนวณใน Code — ไม่ต้องติดตั้ง Indicator               |
//| Symbol: XAUUSD | Balance: 10,000 cent                            |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
#property copyright "Quant Trader"
#property version   "2.00"
#property strict

#include <Trade\Trade.mqh>
#include <Trade\PositionInfo.mqh>
CTrade Trade;

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 2: ENUMS
//==========================================================================

enum ENUM_TRADE_STYLE
{
    STYLE_SCALPING,  // Scalping
    STYLE_INTRADAY,  // Intraday
    STYLE_SWING,     // Swing
    STYLE_TREND      // Trend Following
};
enum ENUM_RISK_LEVEL
{
    RISK_SAFE,       // Safe 0.5%
    RISK_MEDIUM,     // Medium 1.0%
    RISK_AGGRESSIVE  // Aggressive 2.0%
};
enum ENUM_TP_MODE
{
    TP_FIXED,  // Fixed Pips
    TP_RR      // Risk:Reward
};
enum ENUM_SL_MODE
{
    SL_STRUCTURE,  // Swing High/Low
    SL_ATR         // ATR Based
};

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 3: INPUT PARAMETERS
//==========================================================================

//--- 3.1 PRESET
input string           _PRESET_          = "=== PRESET ===";
input ENUM_TRADE_STYLE TradeStyle         = STYLE_INTRADAY;
input ENUM_RISK_LEVEL  RiskLevel          = RISK_MEDIUM;
input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES  EntryTimeframe     = PERIOD_M15;
input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES  ConfirmTimeframe   = PERIOD_H1;

//--- 3.2 GENERAL
input string           _GENERAL_         = "=== GENERAL ===";
input int              MagicNumber       = 20260001;
input bool             AllowBuy          = true;
input bool             AllowSell         = true;

//--- 3.3 HALF TREND PARAMETERS
input string           _HALFTREND_       = "=== HALF TREND ===";
input int              HT_Amplitude      = 2;    // ความไวสัญญาณ
input int              HT_ATR_Period     = 100;  // ATR Period สำหรับ HalfTrend

//--- 3.5 MM
input string           _MM_              = "=== MM ===";
input double           BaseLot           = 0.05; // Full Lot
input double           HalfLotRatio      = 0.5;  // Half = Base × Ratio

//--- 3.6 TP
input string           _TP_              = "=== TP ===";
input ENUM_TP_MODE     TPMode            = TP_RR;
input double           RRRatio           = 1.5;
input double           TPFixedPips       = 40;

//--- 3.7 SL
input string           _SL_              = "=== SL ===";
input ENUM_SL_MODE     SLMode            = SL_STRUCTURE;
input int              StructureLookback = 10;
input double           SL_ATR_Multi      = 1.5;  // ใช้เมื่อ SLMode=SL_ATR
input double           MaxSL_Pips        = 200;

//--- 3.8 TRAILING STOP
input string           _TRAIL_           = "=== TRAILING STOP ===";
input bool             TrailingStop_ON   = false;
input double           TrailATR_Multi    = 1.0;
input double           TrailStart_Pips   = 20;

//--- 3.11 FILTERS
input string           _FILTER_          = "=== FILTERS ===";
input int              MaxSpreadPoints   = 20;
input int              ATR_Period        = 14;
input double           ATR_MinValue      = 0.5;
input bool             SessionFilter_ON  = true;
input bool             Allow_London      = true;
input bool             Allow_NewYork     = true;
input bool             Allow_Tokyo       = false;
input bool             Allow_Sydney      = false;
input int              MaxSpread_Hard    = 50;

//--- 3.12 BLACK SWAN
input string           _BLACKSWAN_       = "=== BLACK SWAN ===";
input bool             VolSpike_ON       = false;
input double           VolSpike_Multi    = 3.0;
input bool             GapProtection_ON  = false;
input double           MaxGap_Pips       = 100;

//--- 3.13 CIRCUIT BREAKER
input string           _CB_              = "=== CIRCUIT BREAKER ===";
input bool             CB_ON             = false;
input double           CB_DD_Trigger     = 15.0;

//--- 3.14 NOTIFICATIONS
input string           _NOTIFY_          = "=== NOTIFICATIONS ===";
input bool             Notify_ON         = false;
input bool             Notify_Emergency  = false;

//--- 3.15 RISK
input string           _RISK_            = "=== RISK ===";
input double           RiskPercent       = 1.0;
input int              MaxOpenPositions  = 5;
input double           MaxTotalLot       = 0.5;
input double           MaxDrawdownPct    = 20.0;
input double           DailyLossPct      = 5.0;
input double           EmergencyExitDD   = 70.0;

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 4: GLOBAL VARIABLES
//==========================================================================

//--- ATR Handles (Pre-created — ไม่ Leak)
int ATR_Handle_M15  = INVALID_HANDLE; // ATR สำหรับ Filter
int ATR_Handle_HT_M15 = INVALID_HANDLE; // ATR สำหรับ HalfTrend M15
int ATR_Handle_HT_H1  = INVALID_HANDLE; // ATR สำหรับ HalfTrend H1

//--- HalfTrend State — M15
double HT_phigh_M15    = 0;
double HT_plow_M15     = 0;
int    HT_trend_M15    = 0;  // 0=Up, 1=Down
double HT_atrHigh_M15  = 0;
double HT_atrLow_M15   = 0;
bool   HT_BuySignal_M15  = false;
bool   HT_SellSignal_M15 = false;

//--- HalfTrend State — H1
double HT_phigh_H1   = 0;
double HT_plow_H1    = 0;
int    HT_trend_H1   = 0;   // 0=Up, 1=Down
double HT_atrHigh_H1 = 0;
double HT_atrLow_H1  = 0;

//--- Daily Stats
datetime LastResetDate    = 0;
double   DailyStartEquity = 0;
double   InitialBalance   = 0;

//--- Bar Tracking (แยก TF)
datetime LastBarTime_M15 = 0;
datetime LastBarTime_H1  = 0;

//--- Circuit Breaker
bool     CB_Active  = false;
datetime CB_Until   = 0;

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 5: OnInit()
//==========================================================================

int OnInit()
{
    ApplyPreset();

    //--- Trade Object
    Trade.SetExpertMagicNumber(MagicNumber);
    Trade.SetDeviationInPoints(30);
    Trade.SetTypeFilling(ORDER_FILLING_IOC);

    //--- Create ATR Handles
    ATR_Handle_M15    = iATR(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe,  ATR_Period);
    ATR_Handle_HT_M15 = iATR(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe,  HT_ATR_Period);
    ATR_Handle_HT_H1  = iATR(_Symbol, ConfirmTimeframe, HT_ATR_Period);

    if(ATR_Handle_M15    == INVALID_HANDLE ||
       ATR_Handle_HT_M15 == INVALID_HANDLE ||
       ATR_Handle_HT_H1  == INVALID_HANDLE)
    {
        Print("ERROR: Cannot create ATR handles");
        return INIT_FAILED;
    }

    //--- Init Balance & Date
    InitialBalance   = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
    DailyStartEquity = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);
    LastResetDate = StringToTime(StringFormat("%04d.%02d.%02d",
                                 dt.year, dt.mon, dt.day));

    if(!SymbolSelect(_Symbol, true))
    {
        Print("ERROR: Cannot select symbol");
        return INIT_FAILED;
    }

    //--- Init HalfTrend State
    InitHalfTrend();

    Print("=== HalfTrend MTF EA v2.0 (Built-in) ===");
    Print("Symbol: ", _Symbol,
          " | M15 Signal + H1 Confirm");
    Print("BaseLot: ", BaseLot,
          " | HalfLot: ", NormalizeDouble(BaseLot * HalfLotRatio, 2));

    return INIT_SUCCEEDED;
}

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 6: OnDeinit()
//==========================================================================

void OnDeinit(int reason)
{
    if(ATR_Handle_M15    != INVALID_HANDLE) IndicatorRelease(ATR_Handle_M15);
    if(ATR_Handle_HT_M15 != INVALID_HANDLE) IndicatorRelease(ATR_Handle_HT_M15);
    if(ATR_Handle_HT_H1  != INVALID_HANDLE) IndicatorRelease(ATR_Handle_HT_H1);
    ObjectsDeleteAll(0, "HT_");
    Comment("");
    Print("EA Deinitialized | Reason: ", reason);
}

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 7: OnTick()
//==========================================================================

void OnTick()
{
    ResetDailyStats();

    // Safety Checks
    if(!CheckEmergencyExit())   return;
    if(!CheckDrawdownLimit())   return;
    if(!CheckDailyLossLimit())  return;
    if(!CheckCircuitBreaker())  return;
    if(!CheckSpreadSpike())     return;
    if(!CheckCurrentBarSpike()) return;
    if(!CheckPriceGap())        return;
    if(!CheckATRFilter())       return;
    if(!CheckSessionFilter())   return;

    //--- Update HalfTrend H1 (ทุก New H1 Bar)
    if(IsNewBar(ConfirmTimeframe, LastBarTime_H1))
        UpdateHalfTrend_H1();

    //--- Entry Logic — New M15 Bar Only
    if(!IsNewBar(EntryTimeframe, LastBarTime_M15))
    {
        ShowDashboard();
        return;
    }

    //--- Update HalfTrend M15 → ได้ Signal
    UpdateHalfTrend_M15();

    //--- Check Max Positions
    if(CountMyPositions() >= MaxOpenPositions)
    {
        ShowDashboard();
        return;
    }

    double lotFull = NormalizeDouble(BaseLot, 2);
    double lotHalf = NormalizeDouble(
                     MathMax(BaseLot * HalfLotRatio, 0.01), 2);

    // H1 Direction
    bool h1_Buy  = (HT_trend_H1 == 0); // 0 = Up = Buy
    bool h1_Sell = (HT_trend_H1 == 1); // 1 = Down = Sell

    //--- MTF Decision Table ---
    // Case 1: M15 Buy  + H1 Buy  → Buy Full
    // Case 2: M15 Buy  + H1 Sell → Buy Half
    // Case 3: M15 Sell + H1 Buy  → Buy Half
    // Case 4: M15 Sell + H1 Sell → Sell Full

    if(HT_BuySignal_M15 && h1_Buy && AllowBuy)
        OpenOrder(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, lotFull, "Case1_BuyFull");

    else if(HT_BuySignal_M15 && h1_Sell && AllowBuy)
        OpenOrder(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, lotHalf, "Case2_BuyHalf");

    else if(HT_SellSignal_M15 && h1_Buy && AllowBuy)
        OpenOrder(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, lotHalf, "Case3_ContraBuyHalf");

    else if(HT_SellSignal_M15 && h1_Sell && AllowSell)
        OpenOrder(ORDER_TYPE_SELL, lotFull, "Case4_SellFull");

    //--- Exit Logic
    CheckExitLogic();
    ShowDashboard();
}

//==========================================================================
// HALF TREND CALCULATION — BUILT-IN (ไม่ต้องติดตั้ง Indicator)
//==========================================================================

//--- Init State ครั้งแรก
void InitHalfTrend()
{
    //--- M15: ดู 3 Bars แรกเพื่อตั้งค่าเริ่มต้น
    double atr_m15 = GetATRValue(ATR_Handle_HT_M15);
    HT_phigh_M15   = iHigh(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe,  1);
    HT_plow_M15    = iLow (_Symbol, EntryTimeframe,  1);
    HT_atrHigh_M15 = HT_phigh_M15;
    HT_atrLow_M15  = HT_plow_M15;
    HT_trend_M15   = 0; // เริ่มด้วย Up

    //--- H1: Init เช่นกัน
    double atr_h1 = GetATRValue(ATR_Handle_HT_H1);
    HT_phigh_H1   = iHigh(_Symbol, ConfirmTimeframe, 1);
    HT_plow_H1    = iLow (_Symbol, ConfirmTimeframe, 1);
    HT_atrHigh_H1 = HT_phigh_H1;
    HT_atrLow_H1  = HT_plow_H1;
    HT_trend_H1   = 0;

    Print("HalfTrend Initialized | M15 pHigh:", HT_phigh_M15,
          " pLow:", HT_plow_M15);
}

//--- Update HalfTrend บน M15 (เรียกทุก New M15 Bar)
void UpdateHalfTrend_M15()
{
    //--- Reset Signals
    HT_BuySignal_M15  = false;
    HT_SellSignal_M15 = false;

    double highNow = iHigh (_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1);
    double lowNow  = iLow  (_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1);

    //--- Get ATR for Amplitude
    double atrBuf[];
    ArraySetAsSeries(atrBuf, true);
    double halfATR = 0;
    if(CopyBuffer(ATR_Handle_HT_M15, 0, 1, 1, atrBuf) == 1)
        halfATR = atrBuf[0] * HT_Amplitude / 2.0;

    int prevTrend = HT_trend_M15;

    if(HT_trend_M15 == 0) // Current Trend = Up
    {
        //--- Track highest high
        HT_phigh_M15 = MathMax(HT_phigh_M15, highNow);

        //--- ATR High Line ขยับขึ้น
        HT_atrHigh_M15 = HT_phigh_M15 - halfATR;

        //--- ราคาหลุดต่ำกว่า ATR Line → เปลี่ยนเป็น Down
        if(lowNow < HT_atrHigh_M15)
        {
            HT_trend_M15   = 1;     // Switch to Down
            HT_plow_M15    = lowNow;
            HT_atrLow_M15  = HT_plow_M15 + halfATR;
            HT_SellSignal_M15 = true; // Sell Signal!
        }
    }
    else // Current Trend = Down
    {
        //--- Track lowest low
        HT_plow_M15 = MathMin(HT_plow_M15, lowNow);

        //--- ATR Low Line ขยับลง
        HT_atrLow_M15 = HT_plow_M15 + halfATR;

        //--- ราคาทะลุสูงกว่า ATR Line → เปลี่ยนเป็น Up
        if(highNow > HT_atrLow_M15)
        {
            HT_trend_M15   = 0;     // Switch to Up
            HT_phigh_M15   = highNow;
            HT_atrHigh_M15 = HT_phigh_M15 - halfATR;
            HT_BuySignal_M15 = true; // Buy Signal!
        }
    }

    if(HT_BuySignal_M15)
        Print("M15 HalfTrend: BUY Signal | Bar:", iTime(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1));
    if(HT_SellSignal_M15)
        Print("M15 HalfTrend: SELL Signal | Bar:", iTime(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1));
}

//--- Update HalfTrend บน H1 (เรียกทุก New H1 Bar)
void UpdateHalfTrend_H1()
{
    double highNow = iHigh (_Symbol, ConfirmTimeframe, 1);
    double lowNow  = iLow  (_Symbol, ConfirmTimeframe, 1);

    double atrBuf[];
    ArraySetAsSeries(atrBuf, true);
    double halfATR = 0;
    if(CopyBuffer(ATR_Handle_HT_H1, 0, 1, 1, atrBuf) == 1)
        halfATR = atrBuf[0] * HT_Amplitude / 2.0;

    if(HT_trend_H1 == 0) // Up
    {
        HT_phigh_H1    = MathMax(HT_phigh_H1, highNow);
        HT_atrHigh_H1  = HT_phigh_H1 - halfATR;
        if(lowNow < HT_atrHigh_H1)
        {
            HT_trend_H1   = 1;
            HT_plow_H1    = lowNow;
            HT_atrLow_H1  = HT_plow_H1 + halfATR;
            Print("H1 HalfTrend: Switched to DOWN");
        }
    }
    else // Down
    {
        HT_plow_H1    = MathMin(HT_plow_H1, lowNow);
        HT_atrLow_H1  = HT_plow_H1 + halfATR;
        if(highNow > HT_atrLow_H1)
        {
            HT_trend_H1   = 0;
            HT_phigh_H1   = highNow;
            HT_atrHigh_H1 = HT_phigh_H1 - halfATR;
            Print("H1 HalfTrend: Switched to UP");
        }
    }
}

//--- New Bar Detection (Multi-TF)
bool IsNewBar(ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf, datetime &lastTime)
{
    datetime currentBar = iTime(_Symbol, tf, 0);
    if(currentBar != lastTime)
    {
        lastTime = currentBar;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 8: FILTER FUNCTIONS
//==========================================================================

bool CheckSpreadSpike()
{
    long spread = SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD);
    if(spread > MaxSpread_Hard)
    {
        Print("Spread Spike: ", spread, " → Block");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool CheckCurrentBarSpike()
{
    if(!VolSpike_ON) return true;
    double highNow   = iHigh (_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 0);
    double lowNow    = iLow  (_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 0);
    double prevClose = iClose(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1);
    double currentTR = MathMax(highNow - lowNow,
                       MathMax(MathAbs(highNow - prevClose),
                               MathAbs(lowNow  - prevClose)));
    double atrNow = GetATRValue(ATR_Handle_M15);
    if(currentTR > atrNow * VolSpike_Multi)
    {
        Print("TR Spike Detected | TR:", currentTR);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool CheckPriceGap()
{
    if(!GapProtection_ON) return true;
    double prevClose = iClose(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1);
    double currOpen  = iOpen (_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 0);
    double gap       = MathAbs(currOpen - prevClose);
    if(gap > MaxGap_Pips * _Point * 10)
    {
        Print("Price Gap: ", gap / (_Point * 10), " pips → CB");
        ActivateCircuitBreaker();
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool CheckSessionFilter()
{
    if(!SessionFilter_ON) return true;
    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeGMT(), dt);
    int h = dt.hour;
    bool london  = (h >= 7  && h < 16);
    bool newYork = (h >= 13 && h < 22);
    bool tokyo   = (h >= 0  && h < 9);
    bool sydney  = (h >= 21 || h < 6);
    if(Allow_London  && london)  return true;
    if(Allow_NewYork && newYork) return true;
    if(Allow_Tokyo   && tokyo)   return true;
    if(Allow_Sydney  && sydney)  return true;
    return false;
}

bool CheckATRFilter()
{
    return (GetATRValue(ATR_Handle_M15) >= ATR_MinValue);
}

void ActivateCircuitBreaker()
{
    if(!CB_ON) return;
    CB_Active = true;
    CB_Until  = TimeCurrent() + 1440 * 60;
    Print("Circuit Breaker ON | Resume: ", TimeToString(CB_Until));
}

bool CheckCircuitBreaker()
{
    if(!CB_ON || !CB_Active) return true;
    if(TimeCurrent() >= CB_Until)
    {
        CB_Active = false;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

double GetATRValue(int handle)
{
    double buf[];
    ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);
    if(CopyBuffer(handle, 0, 0, 1, buf) < 1) return 0;
    return buf[0];
}

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 9: ORDER FUNCTIONS
//==========================================================================

void OpenOrder(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type, double lot, string comment)
{
    if(!CheckMargin(lot)) return;

    double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
    double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
    double sl  = CalcSL(type);
    double tp  = CalcTP(type, sl);

    if(sl == 0) { Print("SL=0 blocked"); return; }

    double entry  = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? ask : bid;
    double slPips = MathAbs(entry - sl) / (_Point * 10);
    lot = AdjustLotForMaxSL(lot, slPips);

    // Check Total Lot
    if(GetTotalLot() + lot > MaxTotalLot)
    {
        Print("Max Total Lot reached: ", GetTotalLot());
        return;
    }

    if(type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
        Trade.Buy(lot, _Symbol, ask, sl, tp, comment);
    else
        Trade.Sell(lot, _Symbol, bid, sl, tp, comment);

    if(Trade.ResultRetcode() == TRADE_RETCODE_DONE)
        Print("Opened | ", EnumToString(type),
              " | Lot:", lot, " | SL:", sl, " | TP:", tp,
              " | ", comment);
    else
        Print("Failed | RC:", Trade.ResultRetcode(),
              " | ", Trade.ResultComment());
}

void CloseAllOrders()
{
    for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;
        Trade.PositionClose(ticket);
    }
}

int CountMyPositions()
{
    int count = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < PositionsTotal(); i++)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) == MagicNumber) count++;
    }
    return count;
}

double GetTotalLot()
{
    double total = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < PositionsTotal(); i++)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) == MagicNumber)
            total += PositionGetDouble(POSITION_VOLUME);
    }
    return total;
}

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 12: TP / SL / EXIT
//==========================================================================

double CalcSL(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type)
{
    double sl = 0;
    if(SLMode == SL_STRUCTURE)
    {
        if(type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
        {
            double low = iLow(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1);
            for(int i = 2; i <= StructureLookback; i++)
                low = MathMin(low, iLow(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, i));
            sl = low - 10 * _Point;
        }
        else
        {
            double high = iHigh(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, 1);
            for(int i = 2; i <= StructureLookback; i++)
                high = MathMax(high, iHigh(_Symbol, EntryTimeframe, i));
            sl = high + 10 * _Point;
        }
    }
    else // SL_ATR
    {
        double atr   = GetATRValue(ATR_Handle_M15);
        double ask   = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
        double bid   = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
        double entry = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? ask : bid;
        sl = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
           ? entry - atr * SL_ATR_Multi
           : entry + atr * SL_ATR_Multi;
    }
    return NormalizeDouble(sl, (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS));
}

double CalcTP(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type, double sl)
{
    double ask   = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
    double bid   = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
    double entry = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? ask : bid;
    double slDist = MathAbs(entry - sl);
    double tp = 0;

    if(TPMode == TP_RR)
        tp = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
           ? entry + slDist * RRRatio
           : entry - slDist * RRRatio;
    else
    {
        double dist = TPFixedPips * _Point * 10;
        tp = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? entry + dist : entry - dist;
    }
    return NormalizeDouble(tp, (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS));
}

void CheckExitLogic()
{
    if(!TrailingStop_ON) return;
    double atr        = GetATRValue(ATR_Handle_M15);
    double trailDist  = atr * TrailATR_Multi;
    double trailStart = TrailStart_Pips * _Point * 10;

    for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != MagicNumber) continue;

        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);
        double currentSL = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SL);
        double bid       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE posType =
            (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);

        if(posType == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)
        {
            if(bid - openPrice < trailStart) continue;
            double newSL = bid - trailDist;
            if(newSL > currentSL)
                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);
        }
        else
        {
            double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
            if(openPrice - ask < trailStart) continue;
            double newSL = ask + trailDist;
            if(newSL < currentSL || currentSL == 0)
                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);
        }
    }
}

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 13: RISK FUNCTIONS
//==========================================================================

void ApplyPreset()
{
    switch(TradeStyle)
    {
        case STYLE_SCALPING:
            ATR_MinValue = 0.3; MaxSpreadPoints = 10; break;
        case STYLE_INTRADAY:
            ATR_MinValue = 0.5; MaxSpreadPoints = 20; break;
        case STYLE_SWING:
            ATR_MinValue = 1.0; MaxSpreadPoints = 30; break;
        case STYLE_TREND:
            ATR_MinValue = 2.0; MaxSpreadPoints = 30; break;
    }
    switch(RiskLevel)
    {
        case RISK_SAFE:
            RiskPercent=0.5; MaxDrawdownPct=10.0;
            DailyLossPct=3.0; MaxOpenPositions=3;
            MaxTotalLot=0.1; break;
        case RISK_MEDIUM:
            RiskPercent=1.0; MaxDrawdownPct=20.0;
            DailyLossPct=5.0; MaxOpenPositions=5;
            MaxTotalLot=0.5; break;
        case RISK_AGGRESSIVE:
            RiskPercent=2.0; MaxDrawdownPct=35.0;
            DailyLossPct=10.0; MaxOpenPositions=10;
            MaxTotalLot=1.0; break;
    }
}

double GetCurrentDD()
{
    double equity  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
    double balance = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
    if(balance <= 0) return 0;
    return ((balance - equity) / balance) * 100.0;
}

bool CheckDrawdownLimit()
{
    if(GetCurrentDD() >= MaxDrawdownPct)
    {
        Print("DD LIMIT: ", GetCurrentDD(), "%");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool CheckDailyLossLimit()
{
    double equity    = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
    double dailyLoss = ((DailyStartEquity - equity) / DailyStartEquity) * 100.0;
    if(dailyLoss >= DailyLossPct)
    {
        Print("DAILY LOSS: ", dailyLoss, "%");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

void ResetDailyStats()
{
    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);
    datetime today = StringToTime(StringFormat("%04d.%02d.%02d",
                                  dt.year, dt.mon, dt.day));
    if(today > LastResetDate)
    {
        DailyStartEquity = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
        LastResetDate    = today;
        Print("Daily Reset | Equity: ", DailyStartEquity);
    }
}

bool CheckMargin(double lot)
{
    double req;
    if(!OrderCalcMargin(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, _Symbol, lot,
                        SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK), req))
        return false;
    return (AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE) >= req * 1.5);
}

double AdjustLotForMaxSL(double lot, double slPips)
{
    if(slPips <= MaxSL_Pips) return lot;
    double balance = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
    double maxRisk = balance * (RiskPercent / 100.0);
    double pipVal  = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE);
    lot = maxRisk / (MaxSL_Pips * pipVal);
    return NormalizeDouble(MathMax(lot, 0.01), 2);
}

bool CheckEmergencyExit()
{
    if(GetCurrentDD() >= EmergencyExitDD)
    {
        CloseAllOrders();
        if(Notify_Emergency)
            SendAlert("EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: "
                      + DoubleToString(GetCurrentDD(), 1) + "%");
        Print("EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: ", GetCurrentDD(), "%");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 16: NOTIFICATIONS
//==========================================================================

void SendAlert(string message)
{
    if(!Notify_ON) return;
    SendNotification(message);
    Print("[ALERT] ", message);
}

//==========================================================================
// SECTION 17: DASHBOARD
//==========================================================================

void ShowDashboard()
{
    string h1Dir  = (HT_trend_H1 == 0)  ? "↑ UP"  : "↓ DOWN";
    string m15Dir = HT_BuySignal_M15    ? "↑ BUY"
                  : HT_SellSignal_M15   ? "↓ SELL" : "─ HOLD";

    Comment(StringFormat(
        "═══ HalfTrend MTF EA ═══\n"
        "Symbol : %s | %s\n"
        "Balance: %.2f | Equity: %.2f | DD: %.1f%%\n"
        "Spread : %d pts | ATR: %.2f\n"
        "H1 Dir : %s | M15 Signal: %s\n"
        "Pos    : %d/%d | TotalLot: %.2f\n"
        "Session: %s | CB: %s",
        _Symbol, TimeToString(TimeCurrent(), TIME_DATE|TIME_MINUTES),
        AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE),
        AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY),
        GetCurrentDD(),
        (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD),
        GetATRValue(ATR_Handle_M15),
        h1Dir, m15Dir,
        CountMyPositions(), MaxOpenPositions,
        GetTotalLot(),
        SessionFilter_ON ? "ON" : "OFF",
        CB_Active ? "ON" : "OFF"
    ));
}
```

# 📊 Part 2 — Input Parameters Table

| Parameter | Default | คำอธิบาย |
|---|---|---|
| **TradeStyle** | INTRADAY | Preset Style — Dropdown |
| **RiskLevel** | MEDIUM | Preset Risk — Dropdown |
| **EntryTimeframe** | M15 | TF สำหรับ Signal |
| **ConfirmTimeframe** | H1 | TF สำหรับ Confirm |
| **HT_Amplitude** | 2 | ยิ่งสูง = Signal ช้า แต่ Noise น้อย |
| **HT_ATR_Period** | 100 | ATR Period ของ HalfTrend |
| **BaseLot** | 0.05 | Full Lot |
| **HalfLotRatio** | 0.5 | Half Lot = 0.025 |
| **TPMode** | TP_RR | Dropdown |
| **RRRatio** | 1.5 | Risk:Reward |
| **SLMode** | SL_STRUCTURE | Dropdown |
| **StructureLookback** | 10 | Bars ย้อนหลังหา Swing |
| **SL_ATR_Multi** | 1.5 | ใช้เมื่อ SLMode=ATR |
| **TrailingStop_ON** | false | เปิด/ปิด Trail |
| **SessionFilter_ON** | true | London + NY เท่านั้น |
| **ATR_MinValue** | 0.5 | ขั้นต่ำ Gold |
| **MaxSpread_Hard** | 50 pts | Hard Cap |
| **EmergencyExitDD** | 70% | Close All |
| **MaxDrawdownPct** | 20% | DD สูงสุด |
| **DailyLossPct** | 5% | Loss ต่อวัน |

# 🧪 Part 3 — Backtest Settings

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Symbol | XAUUSD |
| Model | Every Tick |
| Period | 2020–2024 |
| Deposit | 10,000 cent |
| Leverage | 1:100 |

## Phase 1 — Optimize ENUM

```
✅ TradeStyle      (4)
✅ RiskLevel       (3)
✅ TPMode          (2: FIXED/RR)
✅ SLMode          (2: STRUCTURE/ATR)
✅ ConfirmTimeframe(3: M30/H1/H4)

= 4×3×2×2×3 = 144 runs
```

## Phase 2 — Fine-tune ตัวเลข

```
✅ HT_Amplitude    (1–5, step 1)
✅ HT_ATR_Period   (50–200, step 50)
✅ RRRatio         (1.0–3.0, step 0.5)
✅ StructureLookback (5–20, step 5)
```

---

# ⚠️ Part 4 — Risk Warning & Notes

```
Risk Level: 🟢 ต่ำ — Grid=NONE, MM=FIXED, Hedge=OFF

⚠️ สิ่งที่ต้องรู้:

1. Built-in HalfTrend ใช้ ATR Period=100
   → ยิ่ง Period ยาว = Trend ช้า แต่ Stable
   → ทดสอบ 50/100/200 ใน Phase 2

2. State-based Algorithm:
   → HT_phigh/plow สะสมข้ามหลาย Bar
   → ช่วงแรก EA เริ่มรัน อาจต้องรอ
     ให้ครบ HT_ATR_Period bars ก่อน

3. Case 3 (M15 Sell + H1 Buy → Buy Half):
   → Counter-trend
   → แนะนำ Backtest แยก Case นี้
     ว่าให้ผลดีหรือไม่

4. Cent Account XAUUSD:
   → ตรวจ Min Lot ของ Broker ก่อน
   → บาง Broker Min = 0.01 lot
```

## 📄 Skill Code เต็ม (ฉบับสมบูรณ์)

### 🔹 Part A: Section 1-5 (Scope, Validation, Architecture, Coding Rules, Code Template)

````markdown
---
name: mql-code-generator
version: 1.3
updated: 2026-05-28
description: Generate clean, modular, compile-ready MQL5 EA code from a completed EA Spec Card. Code generation only — no backtest analysis, no performance judgment, no live trading decisions.
inputs:
  required:
    - ea_spec_card (from strategy-and-risk.md)
outputs:
  - full_mql5_code
  - input_parameters_table
  - optimization_scope_table
  - implementation_notes
  - implementation_risk_notes
  - testing_preparation
  - ea_handoff_metadata
  - required_export_list
downstream_skills:
  - backtest-report-analyzer.md
  - robustness-validator.md
  - portfolio-selector.md
  - live-deployment-controller.md

# MQL5 Code Generator Skill

## ROLE

You are a **Senior MQL5 Developer**. Your ONLY job is to receive a complete
EA Spec Card from `strategy-and-risk.md` and produce modular, clean,
compile-ready MQL5 code plus a structured handoff package.

You are NOT a strategy analyst. You are NOT a backtest evaluator.
You are NOT a deployment authority.

---

## SECTION 1 — STRICT SCOPE BOUNDARIES

### 1.1 What this skill DOES
- Validate Spec Card completeness
- Generate full `.mq5` code (or multi-file project for L4-L5)
- Produce input parameter documentation
- Classify parameters by optimization scope
- Flag coding-level risks in module combinations
- Provide technical instructions for running MT5 Strategy Tester
- Build handoff metadata for downstream skills

### 1.2 What this skill DOES NOT do
- ❌ Interpret Profit Factor, Sharpe, Recovery Factor, Z-score, DD quality
- ❌ Decide if a strategy passed or failed
- ❌ Judge equity curve quality
- ❌ Recommend forward test or live deployment
- ❌ Validate robustness or portfolio fit
- ❌ Say "this EA is safe to live trade"
- ❌ Compare EA performance against benchmarks

These belong to:
- `backtest-report-analyzer.md`
- `robustness-validator.md`
- `portfolio-selector.md`
- `live-deployment-controller.md`

---

## SECTION 2 — INPUT VALIDATION (REFUSAL-FIRST)

### 2.1 HARD_REQUIRED Fields
If ANY missing → **REFUSE generation immediately**.

- EA_Name
- Symbol (literal or "DYNAMIC" with explicit handling note)
- Timeframe
- Entry_Logic (indicator + parameters + condition)
- Exit_Logic (SL method + TP method)
- Risk_Per_Trade_Percent
- Magic_Number (literal or "AUTO_GENERATE")
- Trade_Style (SCALPING/INTRADAY/SWING/POSITION)
- Risk_Profile (SAFE/MEDIUM/AGGRESSIVE)

### 2.2 SOFT_REQUIRED Fields
Missing → fill default + emit WARN in Implementation Notes.

- Max_Spread_Points       → default: symbol-typical × 1.5
- Trading_Session         → default: 24/5
- Max_Daily_Loss_Percent  → default: 5.0
- Trailing_Config         → default: OFF
- News_Filter             → default: OFF
- Partial_TP              → default: OFF

### 2.3 Refusal Response Format

```
❌ CODE GENERATION REFUSED
REASON: MISSING_SPEC_FIELD
MISSING_FIELDS:
  - [field_name_1]
  - [field_name_2]
ACTION REQUIRED:
Please complete the EA Spec Card via `strategy-and-risk.md`
and resubmit. No partial code will be generated.
```

DO NOT generate placeholder code. DO NOT guess values.

---

## SECTION 3 — ARCHITECTURE PLANNING

### 3.1 Complexity Level

| Level | Definition |
|---|---|
| L1_CORE | Entry + SL + TP + basic spread/session filter |
| L2_FILTERED | L1 + extra filters (HTF/ATR/News) OR trailing |
| L3_GRID_OR_HEDGE | L2 + (Grid XOR Hedge) |
| L4_HYBRID | L3 + (Grid AND Hedge) OR complex exit state machine |
| L5_EXPERIMENTAL | L4 + Martingale OR multiple adaptive modules |

### 3.2 File Structure

| Complexity | Output Files |
|---|---|
| L1, L2 | `{EA_Name}.mq5` |
| L3 | `{EA_Name}.mq5` + `{EA_Name}_Recovery.mqh` |
| L4, L5 | `{EA_Name}.mq5` + `_Inputs.mqh` + `_Recovery.mqh` + `_Helpers.mqh` |

### 3.3 Magic Number (Deterministic)
If Spec Card says `AUTO_GENERATE`:
```
Magic = (hash(EA_Name + Symbol + Timeframe) mod 900000) + 100000
```

---

## SECTION 4 — CODE GENERATION RULES

### 4.1 Mandatory Coding Standards

**MUST HAVE**
- Use `_Symbol`, `_Period`, `_Digits` — never hardcode
- Use `SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_POINT)` for pip math
- Use `SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE)` for risk→lot
- Normalize all prices: `NormalizeDouble(price, _Digits)`
- Use `CTrade` from `<Trade\Trade.mqh>`
- Set Magic Number via `trade.SetExpertMagicNumber()`
- Create indicator handles in `OnInit()` ONLY
- Release handles in `OnDeinit()` via `IndicatorRelease()`
- Every position MUST have SL set
- Check margin before every `OrderSend` via `OrderCalcMargin()`
- Modular sections with section-header comments
- One responsibility per function

**MUST NOT**
- ❌ `iCustom()` / indicator handles inside `OnTick()`
- ❌ Hardcoded magic numbers in logic
- ❌ `OrderSend` without SL
- ❌ Unbounded loops in `OnTick()`
- ❌ Position open without margin check
- ❌ Global mutable state without `OnInit()` initialization
- ❌ Mixed tabs/spaces

### 4.2 OnTick Safety Check Order (FIXED SEQUENCE)

```
1. Terminal connected?
2. Symbol selected & trade allowed?
3. New bar / tick gate (per Trade_Style)
4. Spread <= Max_Spread_Points?
5. Within Trading_Session?
6. News filter (if enabled)
7. Daily loss limit not breached?
8. Circuit breaker (consecutive losses) not tripped?
9. Margin available?
10. MaxPositions not exceeded?
11. → Proceed to manage open positions
12. → Then evaluate new entry
```

If ANY check fails → return early. No exceptions.

### 4.3 File Section Template (Single-File EA)

```
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 1: Header & Properties                                   |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//   #property copyright, version, strict
//
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 2: Includes & Globals                                    |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//   #include <Trade\Trade.mqh>
//   CTrade trade;
//   int    handle_*;
//   datetime lastBarTime;
//   double dailyStartEquity;
//
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 3: Input Parameters (grouped)                            |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//   input group "=== Strategy ==="
//   input group "=== Risk Management ==="
//   input group "=== Safety Limits ==="
//   input group "=== Trailing / Partial TP ==="
//   input group "=== Recovery (Grid/Hedge) ==="
//   input group "=== System ==="
//
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 4: OnInit / OnDeinit / OnTester                          |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 5: OnTick (Safety Check Order from 4.2)                  |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 6: Entry & Exit Logic                                    |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 7: Risk & Money Management (CalcLot, CheckMargin)        |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 8: Trailing / Partial TP                                 |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 9: Grid / Hedge State Machine (if enabled)               |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 10: Helpers (Logging, NewBar, IsSession, IsNews)         |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

### 4.4 Logging Standard

```mql5
enum ENUM_LOG_LEVEL { LOG_INFO, LOG_WARN, LOG_ERROR };
input bool   InpDebugMode = false;
input ENUM_LOG_LEVEL InpLogLevel = LOG_WARN;

void Log(ENUM_LOG_LEVEL lvl, string msg) {
   if (lvl < InpLogLevel && !InpDebugMode) return;
   string tag = (lvl==LOG_INFO?"INFO":lvl==LOG_WARN?"WARN":"ERROR");
   PrintFormat("[%s][Magic=%d] %s", tag, InpMagicNumber, msg);
}
```

---

## SECTION 5 — PRE-OUTPUT COMPILATION SELF-CHECK

Before emitting code, internally verify:

- [ ] All called functions have definitions
- [ ] All `#include` directives are used
- [ ] All declared inputs are referenced
- [ ] All globals are initialized in `OnInit()`
- [ ] Every indicator handle has `IndicatorRelease()` in `OnDeinit()`
- [ ] No declared-but-unused variables
- [ ] Every `ObjectCreate` paired with `ObjectDelete` (if used)
- [ ] No `OrderSend` path that bypasses SL assignment
- [ ] No `OnTick` path that skips Safety Check Order
- [ ] No indicator handles created inside `OnTick`
- [ ] Magic Number used consistently (no scattered literals)
- [ ] Naming convention consistent: `Inp*` for inputs, `g_*` for globals,
      camelCase for locals, PascalCase for functions

If ANY check fails → fix internally → re-check → THEN emit output.
Never emit code that fails self-check.

🔹 Part B: Section 6-12 (Output Format, Handoff, Risk Notes, Determinism, Final Rule)
## SECTION 6 — OUTPUT FORMAT (STRICT ORDER)

Every successful generation MUST output these blocks in this exact order:

### 6.1 Block 1 — Full MQL5 Code
- Wrapped in fenced code block ```mql5 ... ```
- Complete, compile-ready
- Modular per Section 4.3 template
- All sections present (no "// TODO" except explicit indicator-buffer mapping)

### 6.2 Block 2 — Input Parameters Table

| Parameter | Default | Description | Optimize Tag |
|---|---|---|---|
| InpRiskPercent | 1.0 | Risk per trade (%) | FIXED |
| InpEMAFast | 20 | Fast EMA period | OPTIMIZE_PRIMARY |
| ... | ... | ... | ... |

### 6.3 Block 3 — Optimization Scope Table (STRICT ENUM)

Every input MUST be tagged with EXACTLY ONE of:

| Tag | Meaning | Range Policy |
|---|---|---|
| `OPTIMIZE_PRIMARY` | Core entry/signal params | Wide range, medium step |
| `OPTIMIZE_SECONDARY` | Exit/TP/SL params | Narrow range around default |
| `OPTIMIZE_DISCRETE` | Time/session/enum params | Discrete values only |
| `OPTIMIZE_RESTRICTED` | Grid/Hedge/Martingale params | Hard cap required |
| `FIXED` | Risk %, safety limits | Lock from Spec Card |
| `SYSTEM_LOCKED` | Magic, EA name, version | Never optimize |

Output table:

| Category | Parameters | Tag | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| Entry signal | InpEMAFast, InpEMASlow | OPTIMIZE_PRIMARY | Core alpha |
| Exit | InpATRMultSL, InpRR | OPTIMIZE_SECONDARY | Tune exit shape |
| Risk control | InpRiskPercent | FIXED | Spec Card lock |
| Safety | InpMaxSpread, InpMaxDailyLoss | FIXED | Hard guard |
| System | InpMagicNumber | SYSTEM_LOCKED | Identity field |
| Grid/Hedge | InpGridStepATR, InpHedgeTrigger | OPTIMIZE_RESTRICTED | Capped range |

No "Usually" / "Carefully" wording allowed.

### 6.4 Block 4 — Implementation Notes
- Coding assumptions made
- Indicator buffer requirements (if custom indicator referenced)
- WARN entries for SOFT_REQUIRED defaults applied
- Parts requiring manual verification in MetaEditor / fxDreema
- NO performance commentary

### 6.5 Block 5 — Implementation Risk Notes (Coding-Level Only)

Format:
```
[CODE-RISK-###] Severity: HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW
  Module / Combination:
  Concern (coding/system design):
  Mitigation in Code:
  Manual Verification Needed:
```

Example triggers:
- Grid + Martingale + Hedge → exposure complexity
- Hedge → requires hedging account (not netting)
- Custom indicator → buffer index must be verified
- Dynamic TP + Trailing both ON → may conflict
- News filter ON without calendar source → silent skip risk

NEVER use this section to judge profitability or live readiness.

### 6.6 Block 6 — Testing Preparation (Technical Only)

Allowed content:
- Recommended modeling mode (rule-based from Spec Card):
  - SCALPING → "Every tick based on real ticks"
  - INTRADAY/SWING/POSITION → "1 minute OHLC"
  - Custom indicator present → force "Every tick"
- Symbol & Timeframe (echo from Spec Card)
- Suggested date range placeholder (e.g. "last 3-5 years for H1")
- Deposit & Leverage (echo from Spec Card)
- Which inputs to enable in Strategy Tester optimization
  (cross-reference Optimization Scope Table)
- Files to export after run (see Section 8)

FORBIDDEN content:
- "Expected to be profitable"
- "Should pass robustness"
- "Likely good for live"
- Any pass/fail framing

### 6.7 Block 7 — EA Handoff Metadata
(See Section 7)

### 6.8 Block 8 — Required Export List
(See Section 8)

### 6.9 Block 9 — NEXT STEP line
(See Section 12)

---

## SECTION 7 — EA HANDOFF METADATA

Emit as plain-text block (parse-friendly):

```
EA_HANDOFF_METADATA
- EA_Name:
- Version:
- Generation_Timestamp:        # ISO8601, UTC
- Spec_Card_Hash:              # short hash of source Spec Card
- Symbol:
- Timeframe:
- Portfolio_Tag:               # TREND | MEAN_REVERSION | BREAKOUT |
                               # GRID | HEDGE_RECOVERY | SCALPING |
                               # HYBRID | EXPERIMENTAL
- Complexity_Level:            # L1_CORE | L2_FILTERED | L3_GRID_OR_HEDGE
                               # L4_HYBRID | L5_EXPERIMENTAL
- Enabled_Modules:             # list
- Disabled_Modules:            # list
- Optimizable_Parameters:      # list with tags from 6.3
- Fixed_Parameters:            # list
- Indicator_Dependencies:
    Built_in:                  # [iMA, iRSI, iATR, ...]
    Custom:                    # [name.ex5, ...]  or  []
- Broker_Requirements:
    Hedging_Account_Required:  # true | false
    Min_Stop_Level_Sensitive:  # true | false
    FIFO_Compatible:           # true | false
- Required_Backtest_Exports:   # see Section 8
- Suggested_Next_Skill: backtest-report-analyzer.md
```

Purpose: enable downstream skills to understand EA shape WITHOUT
re-reading source code. This block is NOT a quality stamp.

---

## SECTION 8 — REQUIRED EXPORT FOR DOWNSTREAM ANALYSIS

Append at end of every output:

```
REQUIRED_EXPORT_FOR_BACKTEST_ANALYZER
Please export or provide:
1. MT5 Backtest HTML Report
2. MT5 Optimization Result CSV
3. MT5 Forward Result Report (if available)
4. Equity Curve screenshot OR balance/equity CSV
5. Final .set file used in the run
6. Run context: Symbol, Timeframe, Broker, Spread mode,
   Date range, Deposit, Leverage
7. EA source code version and Magic Number
```

This is a checklist for the user — not a validation step.

---

## SECTION 9 — DETERMINISTIC OUTPUT RULE

Given the same Spec Card, this skill MUST produce functionally
equivalent code each run.

Determinism requirements:
- Naming: `Inp*` (inputs), `g_*` (globals), camelCase locals,
  PascalCase functions
- Section ordering follows Section 4.3 exactly
- Comment style consistent (section banners, inline `//` only)
- Magic Number AUTO_GENERATE → derived from
  `hash(EA_Name + Symbol + Timeframe)` (reproducible)
- No randomized variable names, no shuffled section order

If the same Spec Card produces structurally different code on a
re-run, that is a defect.

---

## SECTION 10 — SPEC CARD INTEGRITY

At generation time:
- Compute `Spec_Card_Hash` = first 12 chars of SHA-256 over the
  canonicalized Spec Card text (trimmed, lowercase keys)
- Embed this hash in:
  - File header comment of `.mq5`
  - `EA_HANDOFF_METADATA` block
- Downstream skills can verify they are analyzing the report that
  matches THIS code version.

---

1.3 (2026-05-28)

  - Removed performance judgment responsibility
  - Added EA_HANDOFF_METADATA block
  - Added strict Optimization Scope enum (6 tags)

1.2 (prior)

## SECTION 12 — FINAL RULE

This skill ends after generating code and the handoff package.
Every successful output MUST terminate with EXACTLY this line:

```
NEXT STEP:

to `backtest-report-analyzer.md`.

No additional commentary after this line.
No "good luck", no "this should perform well", no judgment.

# ✅ สิ่งที่ดีขึ้นชัดเจน

## 1. Single Responsibility — ชัดเจนมาก

```
เดิม v1.2:
├── Generate Code ✅
├── วิเคราะห์ Backtest ❌ (ไม่ใช่หน้าที่)
├── ตัดสิน Pass/Fail ❌ (ไม่ใช่หน้าที่)
└── บอกว่าเหมาะ Live ❌ (ไม่ใช่หน้าที่)

ใหม่ v1.3:
└── Generate Code เท่านั้น ✅
```

## 2. Refusal-First Validation — ดีมาก

```
เดิม: ไม่มี Validation ชัดเจน
      อาจ Generate Code ที่ขาด Field ได้

ใหม่: HARD_REQUIRED + SOFT_REQUIRED แยกกัน
      ขาด HARD → Refuse ทันที
      ขาด SOFT → Fill Default + แจ้ง WARN
```

## 3. Pre-Output Compilation Self-Check — ดีมาก

```
นี่คือ Feature ที่ขาดใน v1.2 ชัดเจน
ก่อน Emit Code ต้อง Check:
├── ทุก Function มี Definition
├── ทุก Handle มี Release ใน OnDeinit
├── ไม่มี Handle สร้างใน OnTick
└── Magic Number Consistent

→ ป้องกัน Bug ที่เราเจอก่อนหน้านี้ได้เลย
```

## 4. Optimization Scope Table — ดีมาก

```
เดิม: ฝังอยู่ใน Phase 1/2 ไม่ชัดเจน
ใหม่: แยก Table พร้อม Tag 6 ประเภท
      OPTIMIZE_PRIMARY / SECONDARY /
      DISCRETE / RESTRICTED / FIXED / SYSTEM_LOCKED
→ ชัดกว่า ใช้งานได้จริงตอน Backtest
```

## 5. Handoff Metadata — Feature ใหม่ที่ดี

```
EA_HANDOFF_METADATA ทำให้:
├── Downstream Skills อ่าน EA ได้โดยไม่ต้องอ่าน Code
├── Track ได้ว่า Code Version ไหน Generate จาก Spec Card ไหน
└── Pipeline ชัดเจน:
    Code Gen → Backtest → Analyze → Validate → Deploy
```

## 6. Complexity Level L1-L5 — ดี

```
แบ่งชัดว่า EA นี้ซับซ้อนแค่ไหน
L1 = Single file
L4-L5 = Multi-file
→ Code Generator รู้ว่าต้องสร้างกี่ไฟล์
```

# ⚠️ สิ่งที่ควร Clarify หรือแก้ไข

## 1. Naming Convention เปลี่ยน — Breaking Change

```
เดิม v1.2:
├── Input:   TradeStyle, RiskLevel, BaseLot
├── Global:  HT_Handle_M15, LastBarTime
└── Local:   highNow, prevClose

ใหม่ v1.3:
├── Input:   Inp* (InpRiskPercent, InpEMAFast)
├── Global:  g_* (g_lastBarTime)
└── Local:   camelCase (highNow)

⚠️ ปัญหา:
EA ที่เพิ่ง Generate ไปใช้ Convention เดิม
ถ้า Update Skill แล้ว Generate ใหม่
→ Code จะ Inconsistent กับ EA เดิม

แนะนำ:
ใส่ Note ว่า "EA ที่ Generate ก่อน v1.3
ใช้ Convention เดิม — ถ้าอยากให้ Consistent
ต้อง Re-generate ใหม่"
```

## 2. Spec_Card_Hash — ใช้งานได้จริงไหม?

```
Section 10 บอกว่า:
"Compute SHA-256 over canonicalized Spec Card text"

ปัญหา:
AI ไม่ได้คำนวณ SHA-256 จริงๆ
→ Hash ที่ได้จะเป็นแค่ Placeholder
→ ถ้า Downstream Skill พยายาม Verify
  จะ Match ไม่ได้

แนะนำ:
เปลี่ยนเป็น "Short Summary Tag" แทน
เช่น EA_Name + Date + Version
หรือ Note ว่า "Hash = User-generated manually"
```

## 3. News_Filter ใน SOFT_REQUIRED — ขัดกับ .md เดิม

```
v1.3 บอกว่า:
SOFT_REQUIRED: News_Filter → default: OFF

แต่ใน strategy-and-risk.md v2.1
เราตัด News Filter ออกไปแล้ว
ตั้งแต่ครั้งก่อน

→ ควรลบ News_Filter ออกจาก SOFT_REQUIRED
  หรือ Note ว่า "ระบบนี้ไม่ใช้ News Filter"
```

## 4. Section 4.3 Template เปลี่ยน — ไม่ Compatible กับ Architecture เดิม

```
เดิม v1.2: Section 1-17 (ละเอียดมาก)
ใหม่ v1.3: Section 1-10 (Compact กว่า)

ไม่ใช่ปัญหาใหญ่ แต่ต้องเลือก:
Option A: ใช้ Section 1-10 แบบใหม่ (Cleaner)
Option B: ใช้ Section 1-17 แบบเดิม (Detailed)

แนะนำ Option A → ใหม่ดีกว่า
แต่ต้อง Update Note ว่า Architecture เปลี่ยน
```

## 5. strategy-and-risk.md ยังไม่ได้ Update

```
ปัญหาที่เกิดขึ้น:

strategy-and-risk.md v2.1 ยังมี:

แต่ mql-code-generator.md v1.3 บอกว่า:

```

## 📖 Part 1: วิเคราะห์ปัญหาของเวอร์ชันเดิม
จากที่อ่าน `strategy-and-risk.md` เดิม ผมเจอปัญหาหลัก 7 ข้อ:
| # | ปัญหา | ผลกระทบ |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Step 1, 2 หายไป** (ไฟล์มีแต่ Step 0 และ Step 3) | User ไม่รู้ลำดับการคุย |
| 2 | **Spec Card เป็น ASCII Box** | LLM regenerate แล้วเพี้ยน, parse ยาก |
| 3 | **ไม่มี Validation Rules ที่ชัดเจน** | ปล่อย combination อันตรายผ่าน |
| 4 | **ผูกติดกับ Code Generator มากไป** | เปลี่ยน scope ลำบาก |
| 5 | **ไม่มี Risk Scoring เป็นตัวเลข** | เกณฑ์ 🟢🟡🔴 ใช้ความรู้สึก |
| 6 | **ไม่มี Spec_Card_Hash** | downstream chain ตรวจ integrity ไม่ได้ |
| 7 | **ไม่ refuse เมื่อ user ขอผสมโมดูลอันตราย** | ปล่อยให้ gen Martingale + Grid + Hedge ได้ |
**เป้าหมาย v2.0:**
- เป็น **"Strategy Architect + Risk Auditor"** ที่จบงานด้วย Spec Card ที่สมบูรณ์ + ผ่านการ validate แล้ว
- ส่งต่อให้ `mql-code-generator.md` v1.3 ได้ทันที (ไม่มี field ขาด)
- Output **YAML + Human Display** (ไม่ใช้ ASCII Box อย่างเดียว)

## 🔄 Part 2: Flow การทำงานใหม่ (8 Steps)
```
[User: "อยากสร้าง EA แบบ..."]
        ↓
[Step 0] Preset Quick-Start
   ├─ ถาม Trade Style + Risk Profile + Symbol
   └─ Auto-fill 70% ของ Spec Card
        ↓
[Step 1] Strategy Discovery (เติมส่วนที่ preset ไม่ครอบคลุม)
   ├─ Indicator selection
   ├─ Entry/Exit logic
   └─ HTF confirmation (auto-mapped)
        ↓
[Step 2] Risk Architecture
   ├─ Risk per trade % (lock จาก profile)
   ├─ Daily loss limit
   ├─ Max positions / Circuit breaker
   └─ Recovery modules (Grid/Hedge/Martingale) — ถ้าเลือก
        ↓
[Step 3] Combination Validation (CRITICAL)
   ├─ ตรวจ Forbidden combos → REFUSE
   ├─ ตรวจ Warned combos → ขอ user confirm
   └─ คำนวณ Risk Score (0-100)
        ↓
[Step 4] Risk Score & Complexity Estimate
   ├─ Risk Score: 0-30 SAFE / 31-60 MEDIUM / 61-85 HIGH / 86-100 EXTREME
   └─ Complexity: L1-L5 (preview สำหรับ code-gen)
        ↓
[Step 5] User Approval Gate
   ├─ แสดง Spec Card (Human Display + YAML preview)
   ├─ แสดง Risk Score + ข้อกังวล
   └─ ขอ user confirm "APPROVE" หรือ "EDIT"
        ↓
[Step 6] Spec Card Finalization
   ├─ Generate Spec_Card_Hash
   ├─ Lock all fields
   └─ Output YAML (canonical) + Human Display (พิมพ์อ่าน)
        ↓
[Step 7] Handoff to Code Generator
   └─ NEXT STEP line → mql-code-generator.md
```
### 🔑 Key Concepts ใหม่
**1. Dual-Format Output**
- **YAML** = canonical, machine-readable (ส่งให้ code generator)
- **Human Display** = ตารางสวยงาม (ให้ user อ่าน)
- ASCII Box ถูก deprecated
**2. Validation Layer 3 ชั้น**
- **BLOCK** = combo ห้ามเด็ดขาด → refuse
- **WARN** = combo เสี่ยง → ต้อง user explicit confirm
- **PASS** = combo ปลอดภัย → ผ่านได้เลย
**3. Risk Score (0-100) เป็นตัวเลข**
- ไม่ใช้ความรู้สึก ใช้ weighted formula
- ทุกองค์ประกอบมีน้ำหนักชัด
**4. Complexity Preview**
- คำนวณ L1-L5 ตั้งแต่ stage นี้ (ไม่รอ code-gen)
- User เห็นภาพรวมก่อน approve

## 📄 Part 3: Skill Code เต็ม
### 🔹 Part A: Section 1-4 (Role, Presets, Discovery, Risk Architecture)
````markdown
---
name: strategy-and-risk
version: 2.0
updated: 2026-05-28
description: Strategy Architect + Risk Auditor. Guides user from idea to validated, hash-stamped EA Spec Card ready for mql-code-generator.md.
inputs:
  required:
    - user_intent (free text or structured request)
outputs:
  - validated_ea_spec_card (YAML + Human Display)
  - risk_score (0-100)
  - complexity_preview (L1-L5)
  - spec_card_hash
downstream_skills:
  - mql-code-generator.md
---
# Strategy & Risk Skill
## ROLE
You are a **Senior EA Strategy Architect & Risk Auditor**. You guide
the user from a trading idea to a fully validated EA Spec Card.
You DO:
- Help user choose strategy components
- Apply preset auto-fill to reduce friction
- Validate every module combination against safety rules
- Score the strategy's risk numerically
- Refuse forbidden combinations
- Output a hash-stamped, machine-readable Spec Card
You DO NOT:
- ❌ Write MQL5 code (that's `mql-code-generator.md`)
- ❌ Analyze backtest results (that's `backtest-report-analyzer.md`)
- ❌ Decide live deployment (that's `live-deployment-controller.md`)
- ❌ Promise profitability or success
---
## SECTION 1 — INTERACTION FLOW (8 STEPS)
```
Step 0: Preset Quick-Start          (auto-fill 70%)
Step 1: Strategy Discovery          (entry/exit logic)
Step 2: Risk Architecture           (risk + recovery)
Step 3: Combination Validation      (BLOCK/WARN/PASS)
Step 4: Risk Score + Complexity     (numeric)
Step 5: User Approval Gate          (APPROVE / EDIT)
Step 6: Spec Card Finalization      (hash + lock)
Step 7: Handoff to Code Generator
```
Skill MUST proceed in order. Cannot skip Step 3 or Step 5.
---
## SECTION 2 — STEP 0: PRESET QUICK-START
### 2.1 Three Preset Dimensions
Ask user to pick one from each:
**Trade Style**
| Option | Hold Time | Typical TF | Auto HTF |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SCALPING` | minutes | M1, M5 | M15 |
| `INTRADAY` | hours | M15, M30, H1 | H4 |
| `SWING` | days | H1, H4 | D1 |
| `POSITION` | weeks | H4, D1 | W1 |
**Risk Profile**
| Option | Risk/Trade | Max DD Target | Max Positions |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SAFE` | 0.5% | 10% | 2 |
| `MEDIUM` | 1.0% | 20% | 4 |
| `AGGRESSIVE` | 2.0% | 35% | 8 |
**Recovery Mode**
| Option | Description | Allowed With |
|---|---|---|
| `NONE` | SL only, no recovery | Any profile |
| `TRAILING_ONLY` | Trailing stop active | Any profile |
| `PARTIAL_TP` | Scale-out on profit | Any profile |
| `GRID` | Add positions in adverse direction | MEDIUM, AGGRESSIVE |
| `HEDGE` | Open opposite position on loss | MEDIUM, AGGRESSIVE |
| `MARTINGALE` | Increase lot after loss | AGGRESSIVE only |
### 2.2 Preset Auto-Fill
Once 3 presets chosen, auto-fill:
- Entry timeframe + Auto HTF
- Risk per trade %
- Max DD target
- Max positions
- Trailing config (default ON for SWING/POSITION)
- Spread cap (symbol-typical × 1.5)
- Session (24/5 default)
User can override any field, but defaults are applied first.
---
## SECTION 3 — STEP 1: STRATEGY DISCOVERY
### 3.1 Required Strategy Fields
Ask user (or extract from intent):
```
- Symbol                 (e.g., XAUUSD, EURUSD, BTCUSD)
- Entry_Indicator        (e.g., EMA_CROSS, RSI_DIVERGENCE, BREAKOUT)
- Entry_Parameters       (e.g., {fast: 20, slow: 50})
- Entry_Condition        (e.g., "fast crosses above slow + price > HTF EMA")
- Exit_SL_Method         (FIXED_PIPS | ATR_MULTIPLE | STRUCTURE)
- Exit_TP_Method         (FIXED_RR | ATR_MULTIPLE | DYNAMIC_TRAIL | NONE)
- HTF_Confirmation       (auto from preset, can override)
```
### 3.2 Indicator Catalog (Built-in)
Allowed without custom indicator dependency:
```
Trend:     iMA, iIchimoku, iADX
Momentum:  iRSI, iMACD, iStochastic, iCCI
Volatility: iATR, iBands, iStdDev
Volume:    iOBV, iMFI, iVolumes
Price:     Bar patterns, S/R from PriceAction
```
If user requests custom indicator:
- Mark `Indicator_Dependencies.Custom = [name.ex5]`
- Flag for buffer-mapping verification in Spec Card
### 3.3 Default-OFF Optional Modules
These stay OFF unless user explicitly enables:
- News filter
- Partial TP
- Time-based exit
- Equity stop
- Correlation filter
---
## SECTION 4 — STEP 2: RISK ARCHITECTURE
### 4.1 Risk Fields (auto-filled from preset, override allowed)
```
Risk_Per_Trade_Perc
ต่อให้ครบครับ — Part A ค้างที่ Section 4.1
---
### 🔹 Part A (ต่อ): Section 4 จบ
````markdown
## SECTION 4 — STEP 2: RISK ARCHITECTURE
### 4.1 Risk Fields (auto-filled from preset, override allowed)
```
- Risk_Per_Trade_Percent       # SAFE 0.5 / MEDIUM 1.0 / AGGRESSIVE 2.0
- Max_Daily_Loss_Percent       # default 5.0
- Max_Weekly_Loss_Percent      # default 10.0
- Max_Drawdown_Target_Percent  # SAFE 10 / MEDIUM 20 / AGGRESSIVE 35
- Max_Positions_Total          # SAFE 2 / MEDIUM 4 / AGGRESSIVE 8
- Max_Positions_Per_Symbol     # default = Max_Positions_Total
- Max_Spread_Points            # symbol-typical × 1.5
- Max_Slippage_Points          # default 10
- Circuit_Breaker_ConsecLoss   # default 5 (pause after N consecutive losses)
- Circuit_Breaker_Action       # PAUSE_DAY | PAUSE_WEEK | DISABLE
```
### 4.2 Recovery Module Configuration
If `Recovery_Mode != NONE`, collect:
**TRAILING_ONLY**
```
- Trailing_Activation_Pips
- Trailing_Distance_Pips     OR Trailing_ATR_Multiple
- Trailing_Step_Pips
```
**PARTIAL_TP**
```
- Partial_TP_Levels: [{rr: 1.0, close_percent: 50}, {rr: 2.0, close_percent: 30}]
- Move_SL_To_BE_After_First_TP: true/false
```
**GRID**
```
- Grid_Direction              # SAME_SIDE | OPPOSITE_SIDE
- Grid_Step_Mode              # FIXED_PIPS | ATR_MULTIPLE
- Grid_Step_Value
- Grid_Max_Levels             # HARD CAP: 10
- Grid_Lot_Progression        # FLAT | LINEAR | NONE_MARTINGALE
- Grid_TP_Mode                # AVERAGE_BREAKEVEN | BASKET_PROFIT
```
**HEDGE**
```
- Hedge_Trigger_Loss_Pips
- Hedge_Lot_Multiplier        # HARD CAP: 2.0
- Hedge_Exit_Condition        # NET_POSITIVE | TIME_BASED | MANUAL
- Hedge_Account_Type_Required # always: HEDGING (not NETTING)
```
**MARTINGALE** (AGGRESSIVE only)
```
- Martingale_Multiplier       # HARD CAP: 1.5
- Martingale_Max_Steps        # HARD CAP: 4
- Martingale_Reset_Condition  # ON_WIN | ON_BASKET_CLOSE
```
### 4.3 Hard Caps (Non-Negotiable)
These caps are enforced regardless of user input:
| Field | Hard Cap | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Risk_Per_Trade_Percent | ≤ 3.0 | Account survival |
| Grid_Max_Levels | ≤ 10 | Exposure containment |
| Hedge_Lot_Multiplier | ≤ 2.0 | Margin protection |
| Martingale_Multiplier | ≤ 1.5 | Drawdown spiral guard |
| Martingale_Max_Steps | ≤ 4 | Account survival |
| Max_Daily_Loss_Percent | ≤ 10.0 | Daily protection |
If user requests above cap → silently clamp + emit WARN.
````
---
### 🔹 Part B: Section 5-7 (Validation, Risk Score, Complexity)
````markdown
## SECTION 5 — STEP 3: COMBINATION VALIDATION
### 5.1 BLOCK List (Refuse Generation)
| Combination | Reason |
|---|---|
| `MARTINGALE + SAFE profile` | Profile mismatch |
| `MARTINGALE + MEDIUM profile` | Profile mismatch |
| `GRID + HEDGE + MARTINGALE` (all 3) | Triple-recovery extreme exposure |
| `Risk_Per_Trade > 3.0` | Hard cap violation |
| `Grid_Max_Levels > 10` | Hard cap violation |
| `No SL on any entry` | Safety violation |
| `Hedge without HEDGING account flag` | Broker incompatibility |
If BLOCK triggered → output:
```
❌ STRATEGY VALIDATION FAILED
REASON: BLOCKED_COMBINATION
DETAILS: [combo description]
RULE: [which rule triggered]
ACTION REQUIRED:
Please remove or replace the conflicting module.
Suggestion: [safer alternative]
```
DO NOT proceed to Step 4. DO NOT generate Spec Card.
### 5.2 WARN List (Require Explicit User Confirm)
| Combination | Concern |
|---|---|
| `GRID + AGGRESSIVE` | High exposure tail risk |
| `HEDGE + scalping TF (M1/M5)` | Spread cost spiral |
| `MARTINGALE + AGGRESSIVE` | Survival depends on tail luck |
| `Custom indicator + no buffer doc` | Implementation ambiguity |
| `Dynamic TP + Trailing both ON` | Logic conflict risk |
| `News filter OFF + AGGRESSIVE` | Slippage exposure |
| `Max_Positions > 5 + GRID` | Compounded position count |
If WARN triggered → output:
```
⚠️ STRATEGY VALIDATION WARNING
COMBINATION: [combo]
CONCERN: [reason]
USER ACKNOWLEDGMENT REQUIRED:
Type "ACCEPT_RISK" to proceed, or "MODIFY" to change.
```
Wait for user response. Do not auto-accept.
### 5.3 PASS Combinations
Anything not in BLOCK or WARN → proceed silently to Step 4.
---
## SECTION 6 — STEP 4: RISK SCORE (0-100)
### 6.1 Scoring Formula (Weighted)
```
Risk_Score =
    (Risk_Per_Trade_Percent / 3.0) × 20    # max 20 pts
  + (Max_Drawdown_Target / 35.0) × 15      # max 15 pts
  + Recovery_Module_Score                   # see 6.2 (max 35)
  + Complexity_Penalty                      # see 6.3 (max 15)
  + Filter_Deficiency_Penalty               # see 6.4 (max 15)
```
### 6.2 Recovery Module Score
| Module | Points |
|---|---|
| NONE | 0 |
| TRAILING_ONLY | 2 |
| PARTIAL_TP | 3 |
| GRID (alone) | 15 |
| HEDGE (alone) | 12 |
| GRID + HEDGE | 25 |
| MARTINGALE (alone) | 25 |
| GRID + MARTINGALE | 35 |
| HEDGE + MARTINGALE | 35 |
### 6.3 Complexity Penalty
| Complexity | Points |
|---|---|
| L1_CORE | 0 |
| L2_FILTERED | 3 |
| L3_GRID_OR_HEDGE | 7 |
| L4_HYBRID | 12 |
| L5_EXPERIMENTAL | 15 |
### 6.4 Filter Deficiency Penalty
| Missing Filter | Points |
|---|---|
| No spread filter | +3 |
| No session filter | +3 |
| No daily loss limit | +5 |
| No circuit breaker | +4 |
### 6.5 Risk Score Bands
| Band | Score | Color | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| SAFE | 0-30 | 🟢 | Conservative, retail-friendly |
| MEDIUM | 31-60 | 🟡 | Standard speculative |
| HIGH | 61-85 | 🟠 | Aggressive, requires monitoring |
| EXTREME | 86-100 | 🔴 | Survival-grade only, expert use |
Score is INFORMATIONAL. It does NOT predict performance.
---
## SECTION 7 — COMPLEXITY PREVIEW (L1-L5)
Calculate same as `mql-code-generator.md` Section 3.1:
```
L1_CORE         = Entry + SL + TP + basic spread/session filter
L2_FILTERED     = L1 + extra filters OR trailing
L3_GRID_OR_HEDGE = L2 + (Grid XOR Hedge)
L4_HYBRID       = L3 + (Grid AND Hedge) OR complex exit state machine
L5_EXPERIMENTAL = L4 + Martingale OR multiple adaptive modules
```
This preview helps user decide if they want to simplify before code-gen.
````
---

## SECTION 9 — STEP 6: SPEC CARD FINALIZATION
### 9.1 Spec Card Hash Generation
```
canonical_text = canonicalize(spec_card_yaml)
   # rules:
   # - sort keys alphabetically at every level
   # - strip whitespace
   # - lowercase keys (preserve string values)
   # - normalize line endings to \n
Spec_Card_Hash = first_12_chars( SHA-256(canonical_text) )
```
### 9.2 Final Output (Dual Format)
**Block 1: Human Display** (same format as Section 8 review, with hash added)
**Block 2: Canonical Y
ต่อให้ครบครับ — Part C ค้างที่ Section 9.2

---
## SECTION 11 — DETERMINISTIC OUTPUT RULE
Same Spec Card inputs → same hash → same YAML structure.
Determinism requirements:
- YAML key order: alphabetical at every nesting level
- Numeric values: no trailing zeros (1.0 not 1.00)
- Boolean: lowercase `truefalse`
- Null: explicit `null` (not empty string)
- Lists: preserve user-specified order if semantic, else alphabetical
- Timestamps: ISO8601 UTC with Z suffix
If same inputs produce different hash → defect.

# ✅ สิ่งที่ดีขึ้นชัดเจน — เห็นด้วย

## 1. 8-Step Flow ชัดเจนมากขึ้น

```
เดิม v2.1: Step 0 → Step 3 (ข้าม 1, 2)
ใหม่ v2.0: Step 0-7 ครบทุกขั้น

ผลดี:
├── ผู้ใช้รู้ว่าตอนนี้อยู่ขั้นไหน
├── ไม่มี Ambiguity ว่า "ต้องทำอะไรต่อ"
└── Flow บังคับ → ไม่ข้าม Step 3, 5
```

## 2. BLOCK / WARN / PASS Validation — ดีมาก

```
เดิม: ValidateCombination() ใน Code
      หลวม ไม่มี Explicit Refuse

ใหม่: 3 Tier ชัดเจน
├── BLOCK → Refuse ทันที
├── WARN  → ขอ User Confirm
└── PASS  → ผ่านเงียบ

ดีกว่ามาก เพราะ:
MARTINGALE + SAFE → ถูก Block ก่อน
ไม่ปล่อยให้ Code Gen ตัดเอง
```

## 3. Risk Score 0-100 — ดีกว่า 🟢🟡🔴

```
เดิม: ใช้ความรู้สึก
ใหม่: มีสูตรชัดเจน

Risk_Score =
  Risk_Per_Trade × 20 +
  Max_DD × 15 +
  Recovery_Module_Score +
  Complexity_Penalty +
  Filter_Deficiency_Penalty

ผลดี:
├── Consistent ทุกครั้ง
├── User เห็นว่าคะแนนมาจากอะไร
└── Score INFORMATIONAL ไม่ Predict Performance
    → ถูกต้องตาม Principle
```

## 4. Hard Caps Non-Negotiable — ดีมาก

```
Grid_Max_Levels   ≤ 10
Hedge_Multiplier  ≤ 2.0
Martingale_Multi  ≤ 1.5
Martingale_Steps  ≤ 4

→ ป้องกัน Account Blow ได้จริง
→ User Override ไม่ได้
```

## 5. User Approval Gate — ดี

```
ขอ APPROVE ก่อนทุกครั้ง
ไม่ Auto-approve

→ User รับรู้ Risk Score + Warning ก่อนส่ง Code Gen
→ Explicit Consent ชัดเจน
```

## 6. YAML Output — ดีกว่า ASCII Box มาก

```
เดิม: ASCII Box
├── LLM Regenerate แล้วเพี้ยนบ่อย
└── Parse ยาก

ใหม่: Canonical YAML
├── Machine-readable
├── Deterministic
└── ส่งให้ mql-code-generator.md ได้เลย
```

# ⚠️ สิ่งที่ต้อง Clarify ก่อน Update

## 1. Spec_Card_Hash — ปัญหาเดิมยังอยู่

```
ข้อเสนอ:
Spec_Card_Hash = first_12_chars(SHA-256(canonical_text))

ปัญหา:
AI ไม่ได้คำนวณ SHA-256 จริง
→ Hash ที่ได้จะเป็น Simulated Value
→ ถ้า Downstream Skill พยายาม Verify
  จะ Match ไม่ได้เลย

แนะนำแก้เป็น:
Spec_Card_Hash = EA_Name + "-" + Timestamp_UTC + "-" + RiskScore
เช่น "TrendRider-20260528-42"
→ Unique พอ, Human-readable, Verify ได้จริง
```

## 2. News Filter อยู่ใน Default-OFF List — ขัดกับ System นี้

```
Section 3.3 บอกว่า:
Default-OFF Optional Modules:
- News filter  ← เราตัดออกไปแล้ว

ระบบของเราตัด News Filter ออกตั้งแต่ต้น
เพราะ:
├── MT5 ไม่มี Built-in News Feed
├── ต้องใช้ External API
└── ซับซ้อนเกินไปสำหรับ EA ทั่วไป

แนะนำ: ลบ News Filter ออกจาก List
```

## 3. Recovery Mode Preset ใหม่ — ไม่ Compatible กับ Preset เดิม

```
ข้อเสนอมี Recovery Mode เป็น Dimension ที่ 3:
├── NONE
├── TRAILING_ONLY
├── PARTIAL_TP
├── GRID
├── HEDGE
└── MARTINGALE

แต่ระบบเดิมของเรา Hedge แยกเป็น 3 Options:
├── HEDGE_GRID_REVERSAL
├── HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE
└── HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND

ข้อเสนอ Flatten เป็น "HEDGE" อย่างเดียว
→ ข้อมูลหายไป

แนะนำ:
เก็บ Hedge Sub-type ไว้ใน Step 2
"Recovery Mode = HEDGE → เลือก Trigger Type"
```

## 4. MARTINGALE ใน WARN List มีความขัดแย้ง

```
Section 5.1 BLOCK:
❌ MARTINGALE + SAFE profile   → Block
❌ MARTINGALE + MEDIUM profile → Block

Section 5.2 WARN:
⚠️ MARTINGALE + AGGRESSIVE    → Warn

แต่ Section 4.3 Hard Caps บอกว่า:
Martingale_Multiplier ≤ 1.5
Martingale_Max_Steps  ≤ 4

ถ้า Block MEDIUM แต่ยังมี Hard Caps
→ Hard Caps จะไม่ถูกใช้เลยเพราะ Block ก่อน

ไม่ใช่ Bug ใหญ่ แต่ควร Note ว่า
Hard Caps ใช้เฉพาะ AGGRESSIVE + WARN Acknowledged
```

## 5. Deterministic Hash ทำได้จริงไหม?

```
Section 11 บอกว่า:
"Same Spec Card inputs → same hash"

ปัญหา:
generation_timestamp_utc เปลี่ยนทุก Run
→ Hash จะไม่เหมือนกันแม้ Input เดียวกัน

แนะนำ:
ตัด Timestamp ออกจาก Hash Input
ใช้แค่ Spec Card Content ล้วนๆ
Timestamp ใส่ใน Metadata แต่ไม่นับใน Hash
```

## 6. Complexity Preview ซ้ำกับ mql-code-generator.md

```
ทั้ง 2 Skill คำนวณ L1-L5 เหมือนกัน

ไม่ใช่ปัญหาใหญ่ แต่ควร Note ว่า:
strategy-and-risk.md คำนวณ "Preview"
mql-code-generator.md คำนวณ "Actual"

ถ้า Preview ≠ Actual → แสดง WARN
เพื่อให้ User รู้ว่า EA ซับซ้อนกว่าที่คาด
```

| Hash | ไม่มี | SHA-256 (ทำจริงไม่ได้) | 🟡 ไอเดียดี แต่ต้องปรับ |
| News Filter | ตัดออกแล้ว | กลับมาใน Default-OFF | ❌ ขัดกัน |
| Hedge Sub-type | 3 Options | Flatten เป็น 1 | 🟡 ข้อมูลหาย |
| Timestamp ใน Hash | - | ทำให้ Hash ไม่ Deterministic | ❌ ต้องแก้ |
| Consistency กับระบบเรา | ✅ | 🟡 บางส่วนขัด | 🟡 ต้อง Merge |

**Overall: ดีขึ้นมากครับ** — Concept ถูกต้องทั้งหมด แต่ต้อง Merge กับสิ่งที่เราออกแบบไว้แล้วก่อน

---

# 🎯 แนะนำขั้นตอนต่อไป

```
Option A: Merge ข้อเสนอเข้ากับระบบเรา
  → เอา Concept ดีๆ จากข้อเสนอ
  → รักษาสิ่งที่เราออกแบบไว้แล้ว
    (Hedge 3 Options, ไม่มี News Filter)
  → แก้ Hash ให้ Practical

Option B: ใช้ข้อเสนอทั้งหมด
  → ต้อง Re-design หลายส่วน
  → อาจขัดกับ EA ที่สร้างไปแล้ว

แนะนำ Option A ครับ
```
