//--- Circuit Breaker
bool     g_cbActive  = false;
datetime g_cbUntil   = 0;

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 6: OnInit()                                              |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

int OnInit()
{
    //--- Apply Preset + Validate
    ApplyPreset();
    ValidateCombination();

    //--- Trade Object Setup
    Trade.SetExpertMagicNumber(InpMagicNumber);
    Trade.SetDeviationInPoints(50); // Wide deviation for Multi-Symbol
    Trade.SetTypeFilling(ORDER_FILLING_IOC);

    //--- Create ATR Handles (BUG-FREE: สร้างครั้งเดียว)
    h_atrFilter = iATR(_Symbol, InpEntryTF,   InpATR_Period);
    h_htATR_M15 = iATR(_Symbol, InpEntryTF,   InpHT_ATR_Period);
    h_htATR_H1  = iATR(_Symbol, InpConfirmTF, InpHT_ATR_Period);

    if(h_atrFilter == INVALID_HANDLE ||
       h_htATR_M15 == INVALID_HANDLE ||
       h_htATR_H1  == INVALID_HANDLE)
    {
        Print("ERROR: Cannot create ATR handles | Symbol: ", _Symbol);
        return INIT_FAILED;
    }

    //--- Init Balance & Date
    g_initBalance    = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
    g_dailyStartEq   = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);

    //--- BUG-FIX: ตั้ง LastResetDate = วันปัจจุบัน
    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);
    g_lastResetDate = StringToTime(StringFormat("%04d.%02d.%02d",
                                   dt.year, dt.mon, dt.day));

    //--- Symbol Check
    if(!SymbolSelect(_Symbol, true))
    {
        Print("ERROR: Cannot select symbol: ", _Symbol);
        return INIT_FAILED;
    }

    //--- Init HalfTrend State
    InitHalfTrend();

    //--- Log Init
    Print("=== HalfTrend MTF EA v3.0 ===");
    Print("Symbol: ", _Symbol,
          " | Entry: ",   EnumToString(InpEntryTF),
          " | Confirm: ", EnumToString(InpConfirmTF));
    Print("Style: ",  EnumToString(InpTradeStyle),
          " | Risk: ", EnumToString(InpRiskLevel),
          " | Balance: ", g_initBalance);
    Print("BaseLot: ", InpBaseLot,
          " | HalfLot: ", NormalizeDouble(InpBaseLot * InpHalfLotRatio, 2));

    return INIT_SUCCEEDED;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 7: OnDeinit()                                            |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

void OnDeinit(int reason)
{
    //--- BUG-FIX: Release ทุก Handle ป้องกัน Memory Leak
    if(h_atrFilter != INVALID_HANDLE)
    {
        IndicatorRelease(h_atrFilter);
        h_atrFilter = INVALID_HANDLE;
    }
    if(h_htATR_M15 != INVALID_HANDLE)
    {
        IndicatorRelease(h_htATR_M15);
        h_htATR_M15 = INVALID_HANDLE;
    }
    if(h_htATR_H1 != INVALID_HANDLE)
    {
        IndicatorRelease(h_htATR_H1);
        h_htATR_H1 = INVALID_HANDLE;
    }

    ObjectsDeleteAll(0, "HT_");
    Comment("");
    Print("EA Deinitialized | Reason: ", reason,
          " | Symbol: ", _Symbol);
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 8: OnTick() — Safety Check Order                        |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

void OnTick()
{
    // 1. Daily Reset
    ResetDailyStats();

    // 2. Emergency Exit
    if(!CheckEmergencyExit())   return;
    // 3. Drawdown Check
    if(!CheckDrawdownLimit())   return;
    // 4. Daily Loss Check
    if(!CheckDailyLossLimit())  return;
    // 5. Circuit Breaker
    if(!CheckCircuitBreaker())  return;
    // 6. Spread Hard Cap
    if(!CheckSpreadSpike())     return;
    // 7. Volatility Spike
    if(!CheckVolSpike())        return;
    // 8. Price Gap
    if(!CheckPriceGap())        return;
    // 9. ATR Baseline Filter
    if(!CheckATRFilter())       return;
    // 10. Session Filter
    if(!CheckSessionFilter())   return;

    //--- Update Confirm TF HalfTrend (New Bar)
    if(IsNewBar(InpConfirmTF, g_lastBarConfirm))
        UpdateHalfTrend_Confirm();

    //--- Entry Logic — New Entry TF Bar Only
    if(!IsNewBar(InpEntryTF, g_lastBarEntry))
    {
        // 15. Exit Logic (Every Tick)
        CheckExitLogic();
        // 16. Dashboard
        ShowDashboard();
        return;
    }

    //--- Update Entry TF HalfTrend → Signal
    UpdateHalfTrend_Entry();

    //--- Max Positions Check
    if(CountMyPositions() >= InpMaxPositions)
    {
        CheckExitLogic();
        ShowDashboard();
        return;
    }

    //--- Max Total Lot Check
    if(GetTotalLot() >= InpMaxTotalLot)
    {
        CheckExitLogic();
        ShowDashboard();
        return;
    }

    //--- Calculate Lots
    double lotFull = NormalizeDouble(InpBaseLot, 2);
    double lotHalf = NormalizeDouble(
                     MathMax(InpBaseLot * InpHalfLotRatio, 0.01), 2);

    //--- MTF Decision Table
    bool confirmUp   = (g_ht_trend_confirm == 0);
    bool confirmDown = (g_ht_trend_confirm == 1);

    // Case 1: Entry Buy  + Confirm Up   → Buy Full Lot
    if(g_ht_buySignal && confirmUp && InpAllowBuy)
        OpenOrder(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, lotFull, "HT_C1_BuyFull");

    // Case 2: Entry Buy  + Confirm Down → Buy Half Lot (Counter H1)
    else if(g_ht_buySignal && confirmDown && InpAllowBuy)
        OpenOrder(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, lotHalf, "HT_C2_BuyHalf");

    // Case 3: Entry Sell + Confirm Up   → Buy Half Lot (Follow H1)
    else if(g_ht_sellSignal && confirmUp && InpAllowBuy)
        OpenOrder(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, lotHalf, "HT_C3_ContraHalf");

    // Case 4: Entry Sell + Confirm Down → Sell Full Lot
    else if(g_ht_sellSignal && confirmDown && InpAllowSell)
        OpenOrder(ORDER_TYPE_SELL, lotFull, "HT_C4_SellFull");

    // 15. Exit Logic
    CheckExitLogic();
    // 16. Dashboard
    ShowDashboard();
}

//--- New Bar Detection (Multi-Symbol Safe)
bool IsNewBar(ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf, datetime &lastTime)
{
    datetime current = iTime(_Symbol, tf, 0);
    if(current != lastTime)
    {
        lastTime = current;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| HalfTrend Built-in Calculation                                   |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

//--- Init State จาก Bar ปัจจุบัน
void InitHalfTrend()
{
    g_ht_phigh_entry  = iHigh(_Symbol, InpEntryTF,   1);
    g_ht_plow_entry   = iLow (_Symbol, InpEntryTF,   1);
    g_ht_trend_entry  = 0;
    g_ht_buySignal    = false;
    g_ht_sellSignal   = false;

    g_ht_phigh_confirm = iHigh(_Symbol, InpConfirmTF, 1);
    g_ht_plow_confirm  = iLow (_Symbol, InpConfirmTF, 1);
    g_ht_trend_confirm = 0;
}

//--- Update Entry TF (เรียกทุก New Entry Bar)
void UpdateHalfTrend_Entry()
{
    g_ht_buySignal  = false;
    g_ht_sellSignal = false;

    double highNow = iHigh(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
    double lowNow  = iLow (_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);

    double halfATR = GetHalfATR(h_htATR_M15);

    if(g_ht_trend_entry == 0) // Uptrend
    {
        g_ht_phigh_entry = MathMax(g_ht_phigh_entry, highNow);
        double atrLine   = g_ht_phigh_entry - halfATR;

        if(lowNow < atrLine) // Reversal → Down
        {
            g_ht_trend_entry  = 1;
            g_ht_plow_entry   = lowNow;
            g_ht_sellSignal   = true;
        }
    }
    else // Downtrend
    {
        g_ht_plow_entry = MathMin(g_ht_plow_entry, lowNow);
        double atrLine  = g_ht_plow_entry + halfATR;

        if(highNow > atrLine) // Reversal → Up
        {
            g_ht_trend_entry  = 0;
            g_ht_phigh_entry  = highNow;
            g_ht_buySignal    = true;
        }
    }

    if(g_ht_buySignal)
        Print("HT Entry Buy | ", _Symbol,
              " | Bar: ", TimeToString(iTime(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1)));
    if(g_ht_sellSignal)
        Print("HT Entry Sell | ", _Symbol,
              " | Bar: ", TimeToString(iTime(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1)));
}

//--- Update Confirm TF (เรียกทุก New Confirm Bar)
void UpdateHalfTrend_Confirm()
{
    double highNow = iHigh(_Symbol, InpConfirmTF, 1);
    double lowNow  = iLow (_Symbol, InpConfirmTF, 1);

    double halfATR = GetHalfATR(h_htATR_H1);

    if(g_ht_trend_confirm == 0) // Uptrend
    {
        g_ht_phigh_confirm = MathMax(g_ht_phigh_confirm, highNow);
        double atrLine     = g_ht_phigh_confirm - halfATR;

        if(lowNow < atrLine)
        {
            g_ht_trend_confirm = 1;
            g_ht_plow_confirm  = lowNow;
            Print("HT Confirm → DOWN | ", _Symbol);
        }
    }
    else // Downtrend
    {
        g_ht_plow_confirm = MathMin(g_ht_plow_confirm, lowNow);
        double atrLine    = g_ht_plow_confirm + halfATR;

        if(highNow > atrLine)
        {
            g_ht_trend_confirm = 0;
            g_ht_phigh_confirm = highNow;
            Print("HT Confirm → UP | ", _Symbol);
        }
    }
}

//--- Get Half ATR Value
double GetHalfATR(int handle)
{
    double buf[];
    ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);
    if(CopyBuffer(handle, 0, 1, 1, buf) < 1) return 0;
    return buf[0] * InpHT_Amplitude / 2.0;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 9: Filter Functions                                      |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

//--- Spread Hard Cap (Real-time)
bool CheckSpreadSpike()
{
    long spread = SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD);
    if(spread > InpMaxSpreadHard)
    {
        Print("Spread Spike: ", spread, " pts → Block | ", _Symbol);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

//--- Volatility Spike (Current Bar TR)
bool CheckVolSpike()
{
    if(!InpVolSpikeON) return true;
    double high      = iHigh (_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 0);
    double low       = iLow  (_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 0);
    double prevClose = iClose(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
    double tr        = MathMax(high - low,
                       MathMax(MathAbs(high - prevClose),
                               MathAbs(low  - prevClose)));
    double atrNow    = GetATR(h_atrFilter);
    if(tr > atrNow * InpVolSpikeMulti)
    {
        Print("Vol Spike | TR:", tr, " ATR:", atrNow, " | ", _Symbol);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

//--- Price Gap (New Bar)
bool CheckPriceGap()
{
    if(!InpGapProtON) return true;
    double prevClose = iClose(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
    double currOpen  = iOpen (_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 0);
    double gap       = MathAbs(currOpen - prevClose);
    if(gap > InpMaxGapPips * _Point * 10)
    {
        Print("Price Gap: ", gap / (_Point * 10),
              " pips → CB | ", _Symbol);
        ActivateCB();
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

//--- ATR Baseline Filter
bool CheckATRFilter()
{
    double atr = GetATR(h_atrFilter);
    if(atr < InpATR_MinValue)
    {
        // ไม่ Print ทุก Tick — เงียบ
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

//--- Session Filter
bool CheckSessionFilter()
{
    if(!InpSessionON) return true; // false = 24/5

    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeGMT(), dt);
    int h = dt.hour;

    bool london  = (h >= 7  && h < 16);
    bool newYork = (h >= 13 && h < 22);
    bool tokyo   = (h >= 0  && h < 9);
    bool sydney  = (h >= 21 || h < 6);

    if(InpAllowLondon && london)  return true;
    if(InpAllowNY     && newYork) return true;
    if(InpAllowTokyo  && tokyo)   return true;
    if(InpAllowSydney && sydney)  return true;
    return false;
}

//--- Circuit Breaker
void ActivateCB()
{
    if(!InpCB_ON) return;
    g_cbActive = true;
    g_cbUntil  = TimeCurrent() + 1440 * 60; // 24hr Fixed
    if(InpNotifyON)
        SendNotification("CB ON | " + _Symbol + " | Resume: "
                         + TimeToString(g_cbUntil));
    Print("Circuit Breaker ON | Resume: ",
          TimeToString(g_cbUntil), " | ", _Symbol);
}

bool CheckCircuitBreaker()
{
    if(!InpCB_ON || !g_cbActive) return true;
    if(TimeCurrent() >= g_cbUntil)
    {
        g_cbActive = false;
        Print("Circuit Breaker OFF | ", _Symbol);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

//--- Spread Normal Filter
bool CheckSpreadNormal()
{
    long spread = SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD);
    return (spread <= InpMaxSpread);
}

//--- Get ATR Value from Pre-created Handle
double GetATR(int handle)
{
    double buf[];
    ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);
    if(CopyBuffer(handle, 0, 0, 1, buf) < 1) return 0;
    return buf[0];
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 10: Order Functions                                      |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

void OpenOrder(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type, double lot, string comment)
{
    //--- Spread Check ก่อน Open
    if(!CheckSpreadNormal()) return;

    //--- Margin Check
    if(!CheckMargin(lot)) return;

    double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
    double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);

    //--- Calculate SL
    double sl = CalcSL(type);
    if(sl == 0.0)
    {
        Print("ERROR: SL = 0 blocked | ", _Symbol);
        return;
    }

    //--- Adjust Lot if SL too wide
    double entry  = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? ask : bid;
    double slPips = MathAbs(entry - sl) / (_Point * 10);
    lot = AdjustLotForMaxSL(lot, slPips);

    //--- Calculate TP
    double tp = CalcTP(type, sl);

    //--- Place Order
    bool result = false;
    if(type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
        result = Trade.Buy(lot, _Symbol, ask, sl, tp, comment);
    else
        result = Trade.Sell(lot, _Symbol, bid, sl, tp, comment);

    if(result && Trade.ResultRetcode() == TRADE_RETCODE_DONE)
        Print("Order OK | ", EnumToString(type),
              " Lot:", lot,
              " SL:", sl, " TP:", tp,
              " | ", _Symbol, " | ", comment);
    else
        Print("Order FAIL | RC:", Trade.ResultRetcode(),
              " | ", Trade.ResultComment(),
              " | ", _Symbol);
}

void CloseAllOrders()
{
    for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;
        if(PositionGetSymbol(0)          != _Symbol) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != InpMagicNumber) continue;
        Trade.PositionClose(ticket);
    }
}

int CountMyPositions()
{
    int count = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < PositionsTotal(); i++)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;
        if(PositionGetSymbol(0)               != _Symbol) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) == InpMagicNumber)
            count++;
    }
    return count;
}

double GetTotalLot()
{
    double total = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < PositionsTotal(); i++)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;
        if(PositionGetSymbol(0)               != _Symbol) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) == InpMagicNumber)
            total += PositionGetDouble(POSITION_VOLUME);
    }
    return total;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 11: MM Functions                                         |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

bool CheckMargin(double lot)
{
    double req;
    if(!OrderCalcMargin(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, _Symbol, lot,
                        SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK), req))
        return false;
    return (AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE) >= req * 1.5);
}

double AdjustLotForMaxSL(double lot, double slPips)
{
    if(slPips <= InpMaxSL_Pips) return lot;
    double balance = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
    double maxRisk = balance * (InpRiskPercent / 100.0);
    double pipVal  = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE);
    if(pipVal <= 0) return lot;
    lot = maxRisk / (InpMaxSL_Pips * pipVal);
    Print("SL Wide → Lot adjusted: ", lot, " | ", _Symbol);
    return NormalizeDouble(MathMax(lot, 0.01), 2);
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 13: TP/SL/Exit Functions                                 |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

double CalcSL(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type)
{
    double sl = 0;
    int    digits = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);

    if(InpSLMode == SL_STRUCTURE)
    {
        if(type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
        {
            double low = iLow(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
            for(int i = 2; i <= InpSLLookback; i++)
                low = MathMin(low, iLow(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, i));
            sl = low - 10 * _Point;
        }
        else
        {
            double high = iHigh(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
            for(int i = 2; i <= InpSLLookback; i++)
                high = MathMax(high, iHigh(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, i));
            sl = high + 10 * _Point;
        }
    }
    else // SL_ATR
    {
        double atr   = GetATR(h_atrFilter);
        double ask   = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
        double bid   = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
        double entry = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? ask : bid;
        sl = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
           ? entry - atr * InpSL_ATR_Multi
           : entry + atr * InpSL_ATR_Multi;
    }

    return NormalizeDouble(sl, digits);
}

double CalcTP(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type, double sl)
{
    double ask    = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
    double bid    = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
    double entry  = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? ask : bid;
    double slDist = MathAbs(entry - sl);
    int    digits = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);
    double tp     = 0;

    if(InpTPMode == TP_RR)
        tp = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
           ? entry + slDist * InpRRRatio
           : entry - slDist * InpRRRatio;
    else
    {
        double dist = InpTPFixedPips * _Point * 10;
        tp = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? entry + dist : entry - dist;
    }

    return NormalizeDouble(tp, digits);
}

//--- ATR Trailing Stop (Adaptive)
void ManageATRTrail()
{
    if(!InpTrailON) return;

    double atr        = GetATR(h_atrFilter);
    double trailDist  = atr * InpTrailATR_Multi;
    double trailStart = InpTrailStart_Pips * _Point * 10;
    int    digits     = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);

    for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;
        if(PositionGetSymbol(0)               != _Symbol) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != InpMagicNumber) continue;

        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);
        double currentSL = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SL);
        double bid       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE posType =
            (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);

        if(posType == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)
        {
            if(bid - openPrice < trailStart) continue;
            double newSL = NormalizeDouble(bid - trailDist, digits);
            if(newSL > currentSL)
                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);
        }
        else
        {
            double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
            if(openPrice - ask < trailStart) continue;
            double newSL = NormalizeDouble(ask + trailDist, digits);
            if(newSL < currentSL || currentSL == 0)
                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);
        }
    }
}

void CheckExitLogic()
{
    ManageATRTrail(); // Trailing Stop
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 14: Risk Functions                                       |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

void ApplyPreset()
{
    //--- Style Presets (ปรับ Symbol-Agnostic ไม่ Hardcode ATR_Min)
    switch(InpTradeStyle)
    {
        case STYLE_SCALPING:
            InpMaxSpread = 10; InpSLLookback = 5;
            InpTrailStart_Pips = 10; InpTrailATR_Multi = 0.5;
            break;
        case STYLE_INTRADAY:
            InpMaxSpread = 20; InpSLLookback = 10;
            InpTrailStart_Pips = 20; InpTrailATR_Multi = 1.0;
            break;
        case STYLE_SWING:
            InpMaxSpread = 30; InpSLLookback = 20;
            InpTrailStart_Pips = 50; InpTrailATR_Multi = 1.5;
            break;
        case STYLE_TREND:
            InpMaxSpread = 30; InpSLLookback = 20;
            InpTrailStart_Pips = 80; InpTrailATR_Multi = 2.0;
            break;
    }
    //--- Risk Presets
    switch(InpRiskLevel)
    {
        case RISK_SAFE:
            InpRiskPercent = 0.5; InpMaxDD_Pct = 10.0;
            InpDailyLoss_Pct = 3.0; InpMaxPositions = 3;
            InpMaxTotalLot = 0.1; InpCB_DD_Trigger = 8.0;
            break;
        case RISK_MEDIUM:
            InpRiskPercent = 1.0; InpMaxDD_Pct = 20.0;
            InpDailyLoss_Pct = 5.0; InpMaxPositions = 5;
            InpMaxTotalLot = 0.5; InpCB_DD_Trigger = 15.0;
            break;
        case RISK_AGGRESSIVE:
            InpRiskPercent = 2.0; InpMaxDD_Pct = 35.0;
            InpDailyLoss_Pct = 10.0; InpMaxPositions = 10;
            InpMaxTotalLot = 1.0; InpCB_DD_Trigger = 25.0;
            break;
    }
}

void ValidateCombination()
{
    Print("ValidateCombination OK | ",
          EnumToString(InpTradeStyle), " + ",
          EnumToString(InpRiskLevel));
}

double GetCurrentDD()
{
    double eq  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
    double bal = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
    if(bal <= 0) return 0;
    return ((bal - eq) / bal) * 100.0;
}

bool CheckDrawdownLimit()
{
    if(GetCurrentDD() >= InpMaxDD_Pct)
    {
        Print("DD LIMIT: ", GetCurrentDD(), "% | ", _Symbol);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool CheckDailyLossLimit()
{
    double eq        = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
    double dailyLoss = ((g_dailyStartEq - eq) / g_dailyStartEq) * 100.0;
    if(dailyLoss >= InpDailyLoss_Pct)
    {
        Print("DAILY LOSS: ", dailyLoss, "% | ", _Symbol);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

//--- BUG-FIX: Date Compare แทน hour==0
void ResetDailyStats()
{
    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);
    datetime today = StringToTime(StringFormat("%04d.%02d.%02d",
                                  dt.year, dt.mon, dt.day));
    if(today > g_lastResetDate)
    {
        g_dailyStartEq  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
        g_lastResetDate = today;
        Print("Daily Reset | Equity: ", g_dailyStartEq,
              " | ", _Symbol);
    }
}

bool CheckEmergencyExit()
{
    if(GetCurrentDD() >= InpEmergencyDD)
    {
        CloseAllOrders();
        if(InpNotifyEmergency && InpNotifyON)
            SendNotification("EMERGENCY EXIT | " + _Symbol
                + " | DD: " + DoubleToString(GetCurrentDD(), 1) + "%");
        Print("EMERGENCY EXIT | DD: ", GetCurrentDD(),
              "% | ", _Symbol);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 18: Dashboard                                            |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

void ShowDashboard()
{
    string entryDir  = g_ht_buySignal  ? "↑ BUY"
                     : g_ht_sellSignal ? "↓ SELL" : "─";
    string confirmDir = (g_ht_trend_confirm == 0) ? "↑ UP" : "↓ DOWN";

    Comment(StringFormat(
        "══ HalfTrend MTF v3.0 ══ %s\n"
        "Balance: %.2f | Equity: %.2f | DD: %.1f%%\n"
        "Spread : %d pts | ATR: %.5f\n"
        "Entry(%s): %s | Confirm(%s): %s\n"
        "Pos    : %d/%d | TotalLot: %.2f/%.2f\n"
        "Style  : %s | Risk: %s\n"
        "Session: %s | CB: %s",
        _Symbol,
        AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE),
        AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY),
        GetCurrentDD(),
        (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD),
        GetATR(h_atrFilter),
        EnumToString(InpEntryTF),   entryDir,
        EnumToString(InpConfirmTF), confirmDir,
        CountMyPositions(), InpMaxPositions,
        GetTotalLot(), InpMaxTotalLot,
        EnumToString(InpTradeStyle),
        EnumToString(InpRiskLevel),
        InpSessionON ? "ON" : "OFF (24/5)",
        g_cbActive   ? "ON"  : "OFF"
    ));
}

# 📋 Block 4 — Implementation Notes

```
1. Multi-Symbol Design:
   - ใช้ _Symbol ทุกที่ ไม่ Hardcode
   - InpATR_MinValue ต้องปรับตาม Symbol:
     XAUUSD → 0.5, EURUSD → 0.0005,
     USDJPY → 0.05, BTCUSD → 5.0
   - InpMaxSpread ปรับตาม Broker:
     Gold → 20-30 pts, FX Major → 5-15 pts

2. Session Default = false:
   - 24/5 Backtest ได้ทันที
   - ถ้าต้องการ Session Filter → InpSessionON = true

3. HalfTrend Built-in:
   - ไม่ต้องติดตั้ง .ex5 ภายนอก
   - State Machine สะสม phigh/plow ข้าม Bar
   - ต้องรอ HT_ATR_Period bars แรก
     ก่อน Signal เสถียร

4. ATR MinValue Warning:
   - ถ้า ATR_MinValue ตั้งสูงเกิน
     EA จะไม่เทรดเลยในช่วง Low Volatility
   - เริ่มต้นด้วย 0.5 สำหรับ Gold
     แล้วปรับหลัง Backtest

5. SOFT_REQUIRED Defaults Applied:
   - Trading_Session → false (24/5)
   - Trailing_Config → false (OFF)
   - Black Swan → false (OFF)
   - Circuit Breaker → false (OFF)
```

# ⚠️ Block 5 — Implementation Risk Notes

```
[CODE-RISK-001] Severity: LOW
  Module: HalfTrend State Machine
  Concern: phigh/plow เริ่มจาก Bar แรก
           อาจให้ Signal ผิดใน 10-20 Bar แรก
  Mitigation: InitHalfTrend() ใช้ Bar[1] เป็นจุดตั้งต้น
  Manual Verification: ดู Log "HT Entry Buy/Sell"
                       ช่วง Warmup ~100 Bars แรก

[CODE-RISK-002] Severity: LOW
  Module: Multi-Symbol Position Filter
  Concern: CountMyPositions() นับเฉพาะ _Symbol + Magic
           ถ้าใช้หลาย EA บน Symbol เดียวกัน
           Magic ต้องไม่ซ้ำกัน
  Mitigation: InpMagicNumber ใช้ค่าเฉพาะต่อ EA
  Manual Verification: ตรวจ Magic ไม่ซ้ำก่อน Deploy

[CODE-RISK-003] Severity: MEDIUM
  Module: Case 3 — Counter Entry
  Concern: M15 Sell + H1 Up → Buy Half Lot
           เป็น Counter-trend Trade
           อาจให้ผล Backtest ต่างจาก Case 1+4
  Mitigation: แยก Comment "HT_C3" ไว้
  Manual Verification: ใน Backtest Report กรอง
                       Comment ดูว่า Case 3 กำไรหรือขาดทุน
```

# 🧪 Block 6 — Testing Preparation

```
Symbol   : ใส่ Symbol ที่ต้องการ (EA รันได้ทุก Symbol)
Model    : Every Tick (Built-in HalfTrend ต้องการ Tick Data)
Period   : 2020–2024 (5 ปี In-Sample)
Deposit  : ตาม Account จริง (Cent=10,000 / Standard=1,000)
Leverage : 1:100
Spread   : Current (Spread จริงของ Broker)

ขั้นตอน:
1. เปิด MT5 Strategy Tester

# 1️⃣ กดแล้วเปลี่ยนตัวเลขได้ไหม?

```

Flow จริง:
1. ผู้ใช้เลือก InpRiskLevel = AGGRESSIVE
2. กด Start / OK
3. MT5 เรียก OnInit()
4. ApplyPreset() รัน → เปลี่ยนค่าทุกตัวอัตโนมัติ

⚠️ ข้อจำกัดของ MQL5:
Input ที่ถูก Override โดย ApplyPreset()
จะเห็นค่า Default ใน UI เสมอ
แต่ EA ใช้ค่าจาก ApplyPreset() จริง

วิธีแก้ → เพิ่ม Comment อธิบาย
ในบรรทัด Input ทุกตัวที่ถูก Override

# 2️⃣ Safe / Medium / Aggressive ต่างกันยังไง

## ตารางเปรียบเทียบครบ

| Parameter | SAFE 🟢 | MEDIUM 🟡 | AGGRESSIVE 🔴 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Risk/Trade** | 0.5% | 1.0% | 2.0% |
| **Max DD%** | 10% | 20% | 35% |
| **Daily Loss%** | 3% | 5% | 10% |
| **Max Positions** | 3 | 5 | 10 |
| **Max Total Lot** | 0.1 | 0.5 | 1.0 |
| **CB DD Trigger** | 8% | 15% | 25% |

## ความหมายในชีวิตจริง

```
SAFE 🟢
├── แพ้ 20 Trade ติดกัน → ยังเหลือ Balance ~90%
├── ต่อวัน เสียได้ไม่เกิน 3%
└── เหมาะ: ทดสอบ EA ใหม่, Account จริง

MEDIUM 🟡
├── แพ้ 20 Trade ติดกัน → เหลือ Balance ~80%
├── Balance ลด 20% → EA หยุดอัตโนมัติ
└── เหมาะ: EA ที่ผ่าน Backtest แล้ว

AGGRESSIVE 🔴
├── แพ้ 20 Trade ติดกัน → เหลือ Balance ~65%
├── Lot ใหญ่ขึ้น 4× เทียบ SAFE
└── เหมาะ: EA ที่ Proven แล้วเท่านั้น
```

---

# 3️⃣ เลือก AGGRESSIVE แล้ว Optimize อะไรต่อ?

```
AGGRESSIVE เปลี่ยนแค่ Risk Parameters
ไม่เปลี่ยน Strategy Parameters

ดังนั้น Optimize ตามปกติได้เลย:
```

## Phase 1 — หา Best Style+Strategy

```
Fix  : InpRiskLevel = AGGRESSIVE (ล็อคไว้ก่อน)
Vary :
  ✅ InpTradeStyle     (4 options)
  ✅ InpEntryTF        (M5/M15/H1)
  ✅ InpConfirmTF      (M30/H1/H4)
  ✅ InpTPMode         (RR/Fixed)
  ✅ InpSLMode         (Structure/ATR)

Goal: หา Combination ที่ Profit Factor สูงสุด
```

## Phase 2 — Fine-tune ตัวเลข

```
Fix  : Best Combination จาก Phase 1
Vary :
  ✅ InpHT_Amplitude   (1–5)
  ✅ InpHT_ATR_Period  (50/100/200)
  ✅ InpRRRatio        (1.0–3.0)
  ✅ InpSLLookback     (5–20)
```

## Phase 3 — Compare Risk Level

```
เอา Best Parameter จาก Phase 2
แล้ว Run แยกทั้ง 3 Risk Level:
  SAFE → ดู Return vs DD
  MEDIUM → ดู Return vs DD
  AGGRESSIVE → ดู Return vs DD

เลือกตาม Risk Tolerance ของตัวเอง
```

InpTrailATR_Multi=1.5;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_TREND:\\n            InpTPFixedPips=200; InpStructureLookback=20;\\n            InpMaxSpreadPoints=30; InpATR_MinValue=0.0010;\\n            InpTrailStart_Pips=80; InpTrailATR_Multi=2.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n    // Risk Profile → Lot/DD/Position/CB defaults\\n    switch(InpRiskLevel)\\n    {\\n        case RISK_SAFE:\\n            InpRiskPercent=0.5; InpMaxDrawdownPct=10.0;\\n            InpDailyLossPct=3.0; InpMaxOpenPositions=3;\\n            InpMaxTotalLot=0.1; InpCB_DD_Trigger=8.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_MEDIUM:\\n            InpRiskPercent=1.0; InpMaxDrawdownPct=20.0;\\n            InpDailyLossPct=5.0; InpMaxOpenPositions=5;\\n            InpMaxTotalLot=0.5; InpCB_DD_Trigger=15.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_AGGRESSIVE:\\n            InpRiskPercent=2.0; InpMaxDrawdownPct=35.0;\\n            InpDailyLossPct=10.0; InpMaxOpenPositions=10;\\n            InpMaxTotalLot=1.0; InpCB_DD_Trigger=25.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n### 6.2 ValidateCombination()\\n\\n```mql5\\nvoid ValidateCombination()\\n{\\n    // SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND = Signal too slow\\n    if(InpTradeStyle == STYLE_SCALPING &amp;&amp;\\n       InpHedgeMode  == HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND)\\n    {\\n        InpHedgeMode = HEDGE_OFF;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: SCALPING+FOLLOW_TREND → Hedge forced OFF\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n    // TREND + FOLLOW_CANDLE = High false signal\\n    if(InpTradeStyle == STYLE_TREND &amp;&amp;\\n       InpHedgeMode  == HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE)\\n    {\\n        InpHedgeMode = HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: TREND+FOLLOW_CANDLE → Hedge forced FOLLOW_TREND\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n    // GRID_NONE + MARTINGALE = No grid to scale on\\n    if(InpGridMode == GRID_NONE &amp;&amp;\\n       InpMMMode   == MM_MARTINGALE)\\n    {\\n        InpMMMode = MM_FIXED;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: No Grid+MARTINGALE → MM forced FIXED\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n    // TP_DYNAMIC + Trail ON = Duplicate exit\\n    if(InpTPMode          == TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE &amp;&amp;\\n       InpTrailingStop_ON == true)\\n    {\\n        InpTrailingStop_ON = false;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: DYNAMIC_TP+Trail → Trail forced OFF\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n    // SCALPING + RANGE_TREND SL = SL too wide\\n    if(InpTradeStyle == STYLE_SCALPING &amp;&amp;\\n       InpSLMode     == SL_RANGE_TREND)\\n    {\\n        InpSLMode = SL_STRUCTURE;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: SCALPING+RANGE_TREND SL → SL forced STRUCTURE\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 7 — ENTRY CODE TEMPLATES\\n\\nReference when generating Entry Logic from Spec Card.\\n\\n### Template 1: Custom Indicator (iCustom)\\n\\n```mql5\\n// For HalfTrend, SuperTrend, or any custom indicator\\n// Spec Card must specify: filename.ex5 + Buffer Index + Signal Condition\\n\\nint      h_custom;\\ndouble   g_bufUp[], g_bufDown[];\\n\\n// OnInit()\\nh_custom = iCustom(_Symbol, InpEntryTimeframe,\\n                   \\\&quot;IndicatorName\\\&quot;,  // .ex5 filename\\n                   Param1, Param2);\\nif(h_custom == INVALID_HANDLE)\\n{\\n    Print(\\\&quot;ERROR: Failed to create custom handle\\\&quot;);\\n    return INIT_FAILED;\\n}\\nArraySetAsSeries(g_bufUp,   true);\\nArraySetAsSeries(g_bufDown, true);\\n\\n// OnDeinit()\\n// if(h_custom != INVALID_HANDLE) IndicatorRelease(h_custom);\\n\\n// Entry Check (New Bar Only)\\nCopyBuffer(h_custom, 0, 0, 3, g_bufUp);\\nCopyBuffer(h_custom, 1, 0, 3, g_bufDown);\\n\\nbool buySignal  = (g_bufUp[1]   != EMPTY_VALUE &amp;&amp;\\n                   g_bufUp[2]   == EMPTY_VALUE);\\nbool sellSignal = (g_bufDown[1] != EMPTY_VALUE &amp;&amp;\\n                   g_bufDown[2] == EMPTY_VALUE);\\n```\\n\\n### Template 2: g_emaSlow);\\n\\nbool buySignal  = (g_emaFast[1] &gt; g_emaSlow[1]) &amp;&amp;\\n                  (g_emaFast[2] &lt;= g_emaSlow[2]);\\nbool sellSignal = (g_emaFast[1] &lt; g_emaSlow[1]) &amp;&amp;\\n                  (g_emaFast[2] &gt;= g_emaSlow[2]);\\n```\\n\\n### Template 3: RSI\\n\\n```mql5\\nint    h_rsi;\\ndouble g_rsiBuf[];\\n\\n// OnInit()\\nh_rsi = iRSI(_Symbol, InpEntryTimeframe, g_rsiBuf[2] &lt;= InpRSI_Overbought);\\n```\\n\\n### Template 4: Bollinger Bands\\n\\n```mql5\\nint    h_bb;\\ndouble g_bbUpper[], g_bbLower[];\\n\\n// OnInit()\\nh_bb = iBands(_Symbol, Code Patterns (BUG-FREE Standards)\\n\\n**ATR Handle \\u2014 \\u0e2a\\u0e23\\u0e49\\u0e32\\u0e07\\u0e04\\u0e23\\u0e31\\u0e49\\u0e07\\u0e40\\u0e14\\u0e35\\u0e22\\u0e27\\u0e43\\u0e19 OnInit()**\\n```mql5\\n// CORRECT \\u2705\\nint h_atrFilter = INVALID_HANDLE;\\nint h_atrGrid   = INVALID_HANDLE;\\n\\nint OnInit()\\n{\\n    h_atrFilter = iATR(_Symbol, InpATR_TF_Filter, InpATR_Period);\\n    h_atrGrid   = iATR(_Symbol, InpATR_TF_Grid,   InpATR_Period);\\n    if(h_atrFilter == INVALID_HANDLE || h_atrGrid == INVALID_HANDLE)\\n        return INIT_FAILED;\\n}\\n\\n// WRONG \\u274c \\u2014 Memory Leak\\ndouble GetATR() { int h = iATR(_Symbol, ...); ... }\\n```\\n\\n**Daily Reset \\u2014 Date Compare (\\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48\\u0e43\\u0e0a\\u0e49 hour==0)**\\n```mql5\\n// CORRECT \\u2705\\ndatetime g_lastResetDate = 0;\\n\\nvoid ResetDailyStats()\\n{\\n    MqlDateTime dt;\\n    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);\\n    datetime today = StringToTime(StringFormat(\\\&quot;%04d.%02d.%02d\\\&quot;,\\n                                  dt.year, dt.mon, dt.day));\\n    if(today &gt; g_lastResetDate)\\n    {\\n        g_dailyStartEquity = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n        g_lastResetDate    = today;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n// WRONG \\u274c \\u2014 May miss reset\\nvoid ResetDailyStats()\\n{\\n    MqlDateTime dt;\\n    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);\\n    if(dt.hour == 0 &amp;&amp; dt.min == 0) { ... }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n**OnDeinit \\u2014 Release \\u0e17\\u0e38\\u0e01 Handle**\\n```mql5\\nvoid OnDeinit(int reason)\\n{\\n    if(h_atrFilter != INVALID_HANDLE) IndicatorRelease(h_atrFilter);\\n    if(h_atrGrid   != INVALID_HANDLE) IndicatorRelease(h_atrGrid);\\n    // Release Entry Indicator Handles\\n    // Release Custom Handles\\n    ObjectsDeleteAll(0, \\\&quot;EA_\\\&quot;);\\n    Comment(\\\&quot;\\\&quot;);\\n    Print(\\\&quot;EA Deinitialized | Reason: \\\&quot;, reason);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n### convention consistent (Inp/g_/PascalCase)\\n- [ ] SL != 0 on every Order path\\n- [ ] `ApplyPreset()` called first in `OnInit()`\\n- [ ] `ValidateCombination()` called after `ApplyPreset()`\\n- [ ] \\u0e17\\u0e38\\u0e01 Input \\u0e21\\u0e35 Comment \\u0e2d\\u0e18\\u0e34\\u0e1a\\u0e32\\u0e22\\u0e15\\u0e32\\u0e21 4.7 Standard\\n- [ ] PRESET Section \\u0e21\\u0e35\\u0e15\\u0e32\\u0e23\\u0e32\\u0e07 that fails self-check.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 6 \\u2014 ApplyPreset() + ValidateCombination() Templates\\n\\n### 6.1 ApplyPreset()\\n\\n```mql5\\nvoid ApplyPreset()\\n{\\n    // Trade Style \\u2192 TP/SL/Grid/Filter defaults\\n    switch(InpTradeStyle)\\n    {\\n        case STYLE_SCALPING:\\n            InpTPFixedPips=15; InpStructureLookback=5;\\n            InpMaxSpreadPoints=10; InpATR_MinValue=0.0003;\\n            InpTrailStart_Pips=10; InpTrailATR_Multi=0;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_INTRADAY:\\n            InpTPFixedPips=40; InpStructureLookback=10;\\n            InpMaxSpreadPoints=20; InpATR_MinValue=0.0005;\\n            InpTrailStart_Pips=20; InpTrailATR_Multi=1.0;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_SWING:\\n            InpTPFixedPips=100; InpStructureLookback=20;\\n            InpMaxSpreadPoints=30; InpATR_MinValue=0.0008;\\n            InpTrailStart_Pips=50; InpTrailATR_Multi=1.5;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_TREND:\\n            InpTPFixedPips=200; InpStructureLookback=20;\\n            InpMaxSpreadPoints=30; InpATR_MinValue=0.0010;\\n            InpTrailStart_Pips=80; InpTrailATR_Multi=2.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n    // Risk Profile \\u2192 Lot/DD/Position/CB defaults\\n    switch(InpRiskLevel)\\n    {\\n        case RISK_SAFE:\\n            InpRiskPercent=0.5; InpMaxDrawdownPct=10.0;\\n            InpDailyLossPct=3.0; InpMaxOpenPositions=3;\\n            InpMaxTotalLot=0.1; InpCB_DD_Trigger=8.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_MEDIUM:\\n            InpRiskPercent=1.0; InpMaxDrawdownPct=20.0;\\n            InpDailyLossPct=5.0; InpMaxOpenPositions=5;\\n            InpMaxTotalLot=0.5; InpCB_DD_Trigger=15.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_AGGRESSIVE:\\n            InpRiskPercent=2.0; InpMaxDrawdownPct=35.0;\\n            InpDailyLossPct=10.0; InpMaxOpenPositions=10;\\n            InpMaxTotalLot=1.0; InpCB_DD_Trigger=25.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n### 6.2 ValidateCombination()\\n\\n```mql5\\nvoid ValidateCombination()\\n{\\n    // SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND = Signal too slow\\n    if(InpTradeStyle == STYLE_SCALPING &amp;&amp;\\n       InpHedgeMode  == HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND)\\n    {\\n        InpHedgeMode = HEDGE_OFF;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: SCALPING+FOLLOW_TREND \\u2192 Hedge forced OFF\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n    // TREND +   ✅ InpTPMode + InpSLMode

Phase 2 — Fine-tune Signal
  ✅ InpHT_Amplitude   (1–5)
  ✅ InpHT_ATR_Period  (50/100/200)
  ✅ InpRRRatio        (1.0–3.0)
  ✅ InpSLLookback     (5–20)

Phase 3 — Compare Risk Levels
  Run Best Params กับ SAFE / MEDIUM / AGGRESSIVE
  เลือกตาม Risk Tolerance
```
