int OnInit()
{
    //--- Step 1: Apply Preset (ก่อนทุกอย่าง)
    ApplyPreset();

    //--- Step 2: Validate Combination
    ValidateCombination();

    //--- Step 3: Trade Object
    Trade.SetExpertMagicNumber(InpMagicNumber);
    Trade.SetDeviationInPoints(50);
    Trade.SetTypeFilling(ORDER_FILLING_IOC);

    //--- Step 4: Create ATR Handles (BUG-FIX: สร้างครั้งเดียว)
    h_atrFilter = iATR(_Symbol, InpEntryTF,    InpATR_Period);
    h_htATR_M15 = iATR(_Symbol, InpEntryTF,    InpHT_ATR_Period);
    h_htATR_H1  = iATR(_Symbol, InpConfirmTF,  InpHT_ATR_Period);

    if(h_atrFilter == INVALID_HANDLE ||
       h_htATR_M15 == INVALID_HANDLE ||
       h_htATR_H1  == INVALID_HANDLE)
    {
        Print("ERROR: Cannot create ATR handles | Symbol: ", _Symbol);
        return INIT_FAILED;
    }

    //--- Step 5: Init Balance
    g_initBalance  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
    g_dailyStartEq = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);

    //--- Step 6: Init Daily Reset Date (BUG-FIX)
    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);
    g_lastResetDate = StringToTime(StringFormat("%04d.%02d.%02d",
                                   dt.year, dt.mon, dt.day));

    //--- Step 7: Symbol Check
    if(!SymbolSelect(_Symbol, true))
    {
        Print("ERROR: Cannot select symbol: ", _Symbol);
        return INIT_FAILED;
    }

    //--- Step 8: Init HalfTrend State
    InitHalfTrend();

    //--- Log
    Print("=== HalfTrend MTF EA v3.0 | mql-code-generator v1.3 ===");
    Print("Symbol: ",    _Symbol,
          " | EntryTF: ",   EnumToString(InpEntryTF),
          " | ConfirmTF: ", EnumToString(InpConfirmTF));
    Print("Style: ",  EnumToString(InpTradeStyle),
          " | Risk: ",  EnumToString(InpRiskLevel),
          " | Balance: ", g_initBalance);
    Print("BaseLot: ", InpBaseLot,
          " | HalfLot: ",
          NormalizeDouble(InpBaseLot * InpHalfLotRatio, 2));
    Print("Risk%: ", InpRiskPercent,
          " | MaxDD: ", InpMaxDD_Pct,
          "% | DailyLoss: ", InpDailyLoss_Pct, "%");

    return INIT_SUCCEEDED;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 7: OnDeinit()                                            |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

void OnDeinit(int reason)
{
    //--- BUG-FIX: Release ทุก Handle ป้องกัน Memory Leak
    if(h_atrFilter != INVALID_HANDLE)
    {
        IndicatorRelease(h_atrFilter);
        h_atrFilter = INVALID_HANDLE;
    }
    if(h_htATR_M15 != INVALID_HANDLE)
    {
        IndicatorRelease(h_htATR_M15);
        h_htATR_M15 = INVALID_HANDLE;
    }
    if(h_htATR_H1 != INVALID_HANDLE)
    {
        IndicatorRelease(h_htATR_H1);
        h_htATR_H1 = INVALID_HANDLE;
    }

    ObjectsDeleteAll(0, "HT_");
    Comment("");
    Print("EA Deinitialized | Reason: ", reason, " | ", _Symbol);
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 8: OnTick() — Safety Check Order (Fixed Sequence)        |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

void OnTick()
{
    // 1. Daily Reset (BUG-FIX: Date Compare)
    ResetDailyStats();

    // 2. Emergency Exit
    if(!CheckEmergencyExit())   return;
    // 3. Drawdown Limit
    if(!CheckDrawdownLimit())   return;
    // 4. Daily Loss Limit
    if(!CheckDailyLossLimit())  return;
    // 5. Circuit Breaker
    if(!CheckCircuitBreaker())  return;
    // 6. Spread Hard Cap (Real-time)
    if(!CheckSpreadSpike())     return;
    // 7. Volatility Spike (Current Bar TR)
    if(!CheckVolSpike())        return;
    // 8. Price Gap
    if(!CheckPriceGap())        return;
    // 9. ATR Baseline Filter
    if(!CheckATRFilter())       return;
    // 10. Session Filter
    if(!CheckSessionFilter())   return;

    //--- Update Confirm TF HalfTrend (New H1 Bar only)
    if(IsNewBar(InpConfirmTF, g_lastBar_Confirm))
        UpdateHalfTrend_Confirm();

    //--- 15. Exit Logic (Every Tick)
    CheckExitLogic();

    //--- 13. Entry Logic (New Entry TF Bar only)
    if(!IsNewBar(InpEntryTF, g_lastBar_Entry))
    {
        ShowDashboard();
        return;
    }

    //--- Update Entry TF HalfTrend → Get Signal
    UpdateHalfTrend_Entry();

    //--- Max Positions / Lot Guards
    if(CountMyPositions() >= InpMaxPositions)
    {
        ShowDashboard();
        return;
    }
    if(GetTotalLot() >= InpMaxTotalLot)
    {
        ShowDashboard();
        return;
    }

    //--- Lot Calculation
    double lotFull = NormalizeDouble(InpBaseLot, 2);
    double lotHalf = NormalizeDouble(
                     MathMax(InpBaseLot * InpHalfLotRatio, 0.01), 2);

    //--- MTF Decision Table
    bool h1Up   = (g_ht_trend_confirm == 0);
    bool h1Down = (g_ht_trend_confirm == 1);

    // Case 1: Entry Buy  + Confirm Up   → Buy Full Lot
    if(g_ht_buySignal  && h1Up   && InpAllowBuy)
        OpenOrder(ORDER_TYPE_BUY,  lotFull, "HT_C1_BuyFull");

    // Case 2: Entry Buy  + Confirm Down → Buy Half Lot
    else if(g_ht_buySignal  && h1Down && InpAllowBuy)
        OpenOrder(ORDER_TYPE_BUY,  lotHalf, "HT_C2_BuyHalf");

    // Case 3: Entry Sell + Confirm Up   → Buy Half Lot (Follow HTF)
    else if(g_ht_sellSignal && h1Up   && InpAllowBuy)
        OpenOrder(ORDER_TYPE_BUY,  lotHalf, "HT_C3_ContraHalf");

    // Case 4: Entry Sell + Confirm Down → Sell Full Lot
    else if(g_ht_sellSignal && h1Down && InpAllowSell)
        OpenOrder(ORDER_TYPE_SELL, lotFull, "HT_C4_SellFull");

    // 16. Dashboard
    ShowDashboard();
}

//--- New Bar Detection (Multi-Symbol, Multi-TF Safe)
bool IsNewBar(ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf, datetime &lastTime)
{
    datetime current = iTime(_Symbol, tf, 0);
    if(current != lastTime)
    {
        lastTime = current;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| HalfTrend Built-in Algorithm                                     |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

//--- Init from first available bar
void InitHalfTrend()
{
    g_ht_phigh_entry   = iHigh(_Symbol, InpEntryTF,   1);
    g_ht_plow_entry    = iLow (_Symbol, InpEntryTF,   1);
    g_ht_trend_entry   = 0;
    g_ht_buySignal     = false;
    g_ht_sellSignal    = false;

    g_ht_phigh_confirm = iHigh(_Symbol, InpConfirmTF, 1);
    g_ht_plow_confirm  = iLow (_Symbol, InpConfirmTF, 1);
    g_ht_trend_confirm = 0;

    Print("HalfTrend Init | Entry phigh=", g_ht_phigh_entry,
          " plow=", g_ht_plow_entry);
}

//--- Update Entry TF (called every New Entry Bar)
void UpdateHalfTrend_Entry()
{
    g_ht_buySignal  = false;
    g_ht_sellSignal = false;

    double highNow = iHigh(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
    double lowNow  = iLow (_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
    double halfATR = GetHalfATR(h_htATR_M15);
    if(halfATR <= 0) return;

    if(g_ht_trend_entry == 0) // Currently Up
    {
        g_ht_phigh_entry = MathMax(g_ht_phigh_entry, highNow);
        double atrLine   = g_ht_phigh_entry - halfATR;
        if(lowNow < atrLine)
        {
            g_ht_trend_entry = 1;
            g_ht_plow_entry  = lowNow;
            g_ht_sellSignal  = true;
            Print("HT Signal: SELL | ", _Symbol, " | ",
                  TimeToString(iTime(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1)));
        }
    }
    else // Currently Down
    {
        g_ht_plow_entry = MathMin(g_ht_plow_entry, lowNow);
        double atrLine  = g_ht_plow_entry + halfATR;
        if(highNow > atrLine)
        {
            g_ht_trend_entry = 0;
            g_ht_phigh_entry = highNow;
            g_ht_buySignal   = true;
            Print("HT Signal: BUY | ", _Symbol, " | ",
                  TimeToString(iTime(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1)));
        }
    }
}

//--- Update Confirm TF (called every New Confirm Bar)
void UpdateHalfTrend_Confirm()
{
    double highNow = iHigh(_Symbol, InpConfirmTF, 1);
    double lowNow  = iLow (_Symbol, InpConfirmTF, 1);
    double halfATR = GetHalfATR(h_htATR_H1);
    if(halfATR <= 0) return;

    if(g_ht_trend_confirm == 0)
    {
        g_ht_phigh_confirm = MathMax(g_ht_phigh_confirm, highNow);
        double atrLine     = g_ht_phigh_confirm - halfATR;
        if(lowNow < atrLine)
        {
            g_ht_trend_confirm = 1;
            g_ht_plow_confirm  = lowNow;
            Print("HT Confirm: DOWN | ", _Symbol);
        }
    }
    else
    {
        g_ht_plow_confirm = MathMin(g_ht_plow_confirm, lowNow);
        double atrLine    = g_ht_plow_confirm + halfATR;
        if(highNow > atrLine)
        {
            g_ht_trend_confirm = 0;
            g_ht_phigh_confirm = highNow;
            Print("HT Confirm: UP | ", _Symbol);
        }
    }
}

//--- Get Half ATR: ATR × Amplitude / 2
double GetHalfATR(int handle)
{
    double buf[];
    ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);
    if(CopyBuffer(handle, 0, 1, 1, buf) < 1) return 0;
    return buf[0] * InpHT_Amplitude / 2.0;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 9: Filter Functions                                      |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

//--- Hard Cap Spread (Real-time every Tick)
bool CheckSpreadSpike()
{
    long spread = SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD);
    if(spread > InpMaxSpreadHard)
    {
        Print("SpreadSpike: ", spread, " pts blocked | ", _Symbol);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

//--- Volatility Spike (Current Bar TR vs ATR)
bool CheckVolSpike()
{
    if(!InpVolSpikeON) return true;
    double high  = iHigh (_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 0);
    double low   = iLow  (_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 0);
    double prev  = iClose(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
    double tr    = MathMax(high - low,
                   MathMax(MathAbs(high - prev),
                           MathAbs(low  - prev)));
    double atr   = GetATR(h_atrFilter);
    if(tr > atr * InpVolSpikeMulti)
    {
        Print("VolSpike: TR=", tr, " ATR=", atr, " | ", _Symbol);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

//--- Price Gap (New Bar check)
bool CheckPriceGap()
{
    if(!InpGapProtON) return true;
    double prev = iClose(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
    double curr = iOpen (_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 0);
    double gap  = MathAbs(curr - prev);
    if(gap > InpMaxGapPips * _Point * 10)
    {
        Print("PriceGap: ", gap / (_Point * 10), " pips → CB | ", _Symbol);
        ActivateCB();
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

//--- ATR Baseline Filter
bool CheckATRFilter()
{
    return (GetATR(h_atrFilter) >= InpATR_MinValue);
}

//--- Session Filter
bool CheckSessionFilter()
{
    if(!InpSessionON) return true;
    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeGMT(), dt);
    int h = dt.hour;
    if(InpAllowLondon && (h >= 7  && h < 16)) return true;
    if(InpAllowNY     && (h >= 13 && h < 22)) return true;
    if(InpAllowTokyo  && (h >= 0  && h < 9))  return true;
    if(InpAllowSydney && (h >= 21 || h < 6))  return true;
    return false;
}

//--- Circuit Breaker: Activate (24hr Fixed)
void ActivateCB()
{
    if(!InpCB_ON) return;
    g_cbActive = true;
    g_cbUntil  = TimeCurrent() + 1440 * 60;
    if(InpNotifyON)
        SendNotification("CB ON | " + _Symbol + " | Resume: "
                         + TimeToString(g_cbUntil));
    Print("CircuitBreaker ON | Resume: ", TimeToString(g_cbUntil),
          " | ", _Symbol);
}

bool CheckCircuitBreaker()
{
    if(!InpCB_ON || !g_cbActive) return true;
    if(TimeCurrent() >= g_cbUntil)
    {
        g_cbActive = false;
        Print("CircuitBreaker OFF | ", _Symbol);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

//--- Spread Normal (before entry)
bool CheckSpreadNormal()
{
    return (SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD) <= InpMaxSpread);
}

//--- Get ATR from Pre-created Handle (BUG-FIX: ไม่สร้างใหม่)
double GetATR(int handle)
{
    double buf[];
    ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);
    if(CopyBuffer(handle, 0, 0, 1, buf) < 1) return 0;
    return buf[0];
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 10: Order Functions                                      |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

//--- Open Order with full safety checks
void OpenOrder(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type, double lot, string comment)
{
    if(!CheckSpreadNormal()) return;
    if(!CheckMargin(lot))    return;

    int    digits = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);
    double ask    = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
    double bid    = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
    double entry  = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? ask : bid;

    double sl = CalcSL(type);
    if(sl == 0.0) { Print("SL=0 blocked | ", _Symbol); return; }

    double slPips = MathAbs(entry - sl) / (_Point * 10);
    lot = AdjustLotForMaxSL(lot, slPips);

    double tp = CalcTP(type, sl);

    bool ok = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
            ? Trade.Buy (lot, _Symbol, ask, sl, tp, comment)
            : Trade.Sell(lot, _Symbol, bid, sl, tp, comment);

    if(ok && Trade.ResultRetcode() == TRADE_RETCODE_DONE)
        Print("Order OK | ", EnumToString(type),
              " Lot=", lot, " SL=", sl, " TP=", tp,
              " | ", comment, " | ", _Symbol);
    else
        Print("Order FAIL | RC=", Trade.ResultRetcode(),
              " ", Trade.ResultComment(), " | ", _Symbol);
}

//--- Close all EA positions on this symbol
void CloseAllOrders()
{
    for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket))          continue;
        if(PositionGetString(POSITION_SYMBOL) != _Symbol) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != InpMagicNumber) continue;
        Trade.PositionClose(ticket);
    }
}

//--- Count EA positions on this symbol
int CountMyPositions()
{
    int count = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < PositionsTotal(); i++)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket))          continue;
        if(PositionGetString(POSITION_SYMBOL) != _Symbol) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) == InpMagicNumber)
            count++;
    }
    return count;
}

//--- Total lot of EA positions
double GetTotalLot()
{
    double total = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < PositionsTotal(); i++)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket))          continue;
        if(PositionGetString(POSITION_SYMBOL) != _Symbol) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) == InpMagicNumber)
            total += PositionGetDouble(POSITION_VOLUME);
    }
    return total;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 11: MM Functions                                         |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

//--- Margin check with 150% safety buffer
bool CheckMargin(double lot)
{
    double req = 0;
    if(!OrderCalcMargin(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, _Symbol, lot,
                        SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK), req))
        return false;
    return (AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE) >= req * 1.5);
}

//--- Reduce lot if SL is too wide
double AdjustLotForMaxSL(double lot, double slPips)
{
    if(slPips <= InpMaxSL_Pips) return lot;
    double balance = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
    double maxRisk = balance * (InpRiskPercent / 100.0);
    double pipVal  = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE);
    if(pipVal <= 0) return lot;
    lot = maxRisk / (InpMaxSL_Pips * pipVal);
    Print("SL wide → Lot adjusted: ", lot, " | ", _Symbol);
    return NormalizeDouble(MathMax(lot, 0.01), 2);
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 13: TP/SL/Exit Functions                                 |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

//--- Calculate Stop Loss
double CalcSL(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type)
{
    int    digits = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);
    double sl     = 0;

    if(InpSLMode == SL_STRUCTURE)
    {
        if(type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
        {
            double low = iLow(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
            for(int i = 2; i <= InpSLLookback; i++)
                low = MathMin(low, iLow(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, i));
            sl = low - 10 * _Point;
        }
        else
        {
            double high = iHigh(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
            for(int i = 2; i <= InpSLLookback; i++)
                high = MathMax(high, iHigh(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, i));
            sl = high + 10 * _Point;
        }
    }
    else // SL_ATR
    {
        double atr   = GetATR(h_atrFilter);
        double ask   = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
        double bid   = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
        double entry = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? ask : bid;
        sl = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
           ? entry - atr * InpSL_ATR_Multi
           : entry + atr * InpSL_ATR_Multi;
    }
    return NormalizeDouble(sl, digits);
}

//--- Calculate Take Profit
double CalcTP(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type, double sl)
{
    int    digits = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);
    double ask    = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
    double bid    = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
    double entry  = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? ask : bid;
    double slDist = MathAbs(entry - sl);
    double tp     = 0;

    if(InpTPMode == TP_RR)
        tp = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
           ? entry + slDist * InpRRRatio
           : entry - slDist * InpRRRatio;
    else
    {
        double dist = InpTPFixedPips * _Point * 10;
        tp = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? entry + dist : entry - dist;
    }
    return NormalizeDouble(tp, digits);
}

//--- ATR Trailing Stop (Adaptive)
void ManageATRTrail()
{
    if(!InpTrailON) return;

    int    digits     = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);
    double atr        = GetATR(h_atrFilter);
    double trailDist  = atr * InpTrailATR_Multi;
    double trailStart = InpTrailStart * _Point * 10;

    for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket))              continue;
        if(PositionGetString(POSITION_SYMBOL) != _Symbol) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != InpMagicNumber) continue;

        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);
        double currentSL = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SL);
        double bid       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE posType =
            (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);

        if(posType == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)
        {
            if(bid - openPrice < trailStart) continue;
            double newSL = NormalizeDouble(bid - trailDist, digits);
            if(newSL > currentSL)
                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);
        }
        else
        {
            double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
            if(openPrice - ask < trailStart) continue;
            double newSL = NormalizeDouble(ask + trailDist, digits);
            if(newSL < currentSL || currentSL == 0)
                Trade.PositionModify(ticket, newSL, 0);
        }
    }
}

//--- Master Exit Logic
void CheckExitLogic()
{
    ManageATRTrail();
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 14: Risk Functions                                       |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

//--- Apply Preset values (called first in OnInit)
void ApplyPreset()
{
    // Trade Style → Spread / SL / Trail defaults
    switch(InpTradeStyle)
    {
        case STYLE_SCALPING:
            InpMaxSpread  = 10;  InpSLLookback   = 5;
            InpTrailStart = 10;  InpTrailATR_Multi = 0.5;
            break;
        case STYLE_INTRADAY:
            InpMaxSpread  = 20;  InpSLLookback   = 10;
            InpTrailStart = 20;  InpTrailATR_Multi = 1.0;
            break;
        case STYLE_SWING:
            InpMaxSpread  = 30;  InpSLLookback   = 20;
            InpTrailStart = 50;  InpTrailATR_Multi = 1.5;
            break;
        case STYLE_TREND:
            InpMaxSpread  = 30;  InpSLLookback   = 20;
            InpTrailStart = 80;  InpTrailATR_Multi = 2.0;
            break;
    }
    // Risk Profile → Lot / DD / Position / CB
    switch(InpRiskLevel)
    {
        case RISK_SAFE:
            InpRiskPercent   = 0.5;  InpMaxDD_Pct     = 10.0;
            InpDailyLoss_Pct = 3.0;  InpMaxPositions  = 3;
            InpMaxTotalLot   = 0.1;  InpCB_DD_Trigger = 8.0;
            break;
        case RISK_MEDIUM:
            InpRiskPercent   = 1.0;  InpMaxDD_Pct     = 20.0;
            InpDailyLoss_Pct = 5.0;  InpMaxPositions  = 5;
            InpMaxTotalLot   = 0.5;  InpCB_DD_Trigger = 15.0;
            break;
        case RISK_AGGRESSIVE:
            InpRiskPercent   = 2.0;  InpMaxDD_Pct     = 35.0;
            InpDailyLoss_Pct = 10.0; InpMaxPositions  = 10;
            InpMaxTotalLot   = 1.0;  InpCB_DD_Trigger = 25.0;
            break;
    }
}

//--- Validate Combination (auto-fix invalid combos)
void ValidateCombination()
{
    // TP_FIXED + InpTrailON → Trail อาจขัดกัน (เตือนเท่านั้น)
    if(InpTPMode == TP_FIXED && InpTrailON)
        Print("WARN: TP_FIXED + Trail ON — Trail may override TP | ",
              _Symbol);

    Print("ValidateCombination OK | ",
          EnumToString(InpTradeStyle), " + ",
          EnumToString(InpRiskLevel),  " | ", _Symbol);
}

//--- Current Drawdown %
double GetCurrentDD()
{
    double eq  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
    double bal = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
    if(bal <= 0) return 0;
    return ((bal - eq) / bal) * 100.0;
}

//--- Drawdown limit check
bool CheckDrawdownLimit()
{
    if(GetCurrentDD() >= InpMaxDD_Pct)
    {
        Print("DD Limit: ", GetCurrentDD(), "% | ", _Symbol);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

//--- Daily loss limit check
bool CheckDailyLossLimit()
{
    double eq    = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
    double loss  = ((g_dailyStartEq - eq) / g_dailyStartEq) * 100.0;
    if(loss >= InpDailyLoss_Pct)
    {
        Print("DailyLoss: ", loss, "% | ", _Symbol);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

//--- BUG-FIX: Date Compare — ไม่ใช้ hour==0
void ResetDailyStats()
{
    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);
    datetime today = StringToTime(StringFormat("%04d.%02d.%02d",
                                  dt.year, dt.mon, dt.day));
    if(today > g_lastResetDate)
    {
        g_dailyStartEq  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
        g_lastResetDate = today;
        Print("Daily Reset | Equity=", g_dailyStartEq, " | ", _Symbol);
    }
}

//--- Emergency Exit: close all, notify
bool CheckEmergencyExit()
{
    if(GetCurrentDD() >= InpEmergencyDD)
    {
        CloseAllOrders();
        if(InpNotifyON && InpNotifyEmg)
            SendNotification("EMERGENCY EXIT | " + _Symbol +
                " | DD=" + DoubleToString(GetCurrentDD(), 1) + "%");
        Print("EMERGENCY EXIT | DD=", GetCurrentDD(), "% | ", _Symbol);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 17: Notifications                                        |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

void SendAlert(string message)
{
    if(!InpNotifyON) return;
    SendNotification(message);
    Print("[ALERT] ", message);
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| Section 18: Dashboard                                            |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

void ShowDashboard()
{
    string entryDir  = g_ht_buySignal  ? "BUY Signal"
                     : g_ht_sellSignal ? "SELL Signal" : "Holding";
    string confirmDir = (g_ht_trend_confirm == 0) ? "UP" : "DOWN";
    string cbStatus   = g_cbActive
                      ? "ON (Resume " + TimeToString(g_cbUntil,
                          TIME_DATE|TIME_MINUTES) + ")"
                      : "OFF";

    Comment(StringFormat(
        "=== HalfTrend MTF EA v3.0 ===\n"
        "Symbol : %s  |  %s\n"
        "Balance: %.2f  Equity: %.2f  DD: %.1f%%\n"
        "Spread : %d pts  ATR: %.5f\n"
        "EntryTF(%s): %s  |  ConfirmTF(%s): %s\n"
        "Positions: %d/%d  TotalLot: %.2f/%.2f\n"
        "Style: %s  Risk: %s\n"
        "Session: %s  CircuitBreaker: %s",
        _Symbol,
        TimeToString(TimeCurrent(), TIME_DATE|TIME_MINUTES),
        AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE),
        AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY),
        GetCurrentDD(),
        (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD),
        GetATR(h_atrFilter),
        EnumToString(InpEntryTF),    entryDir,
        EnumToString(InpConfirmTF),  confirmDir,
        CountMyPositions(), InpMaxPositions,
        GetTotalLot(),      InpMaxTotalLot,
        EnumToString(InpTradeStyle),
        EnumToString(InpRiskLevel),
        InpSessionON ? "ON" : "OFF (24/5)",
        cbStatus
    ));
}

# 📊 Block 2 — Input Parameters Table

| Parameter | Default | คำอธิบาย | Optimize Tag |
|---|---|---|---|
| **InpRiskLevel** | MEDIUM | Risk Profile: กำหนด DD/Pos/Lot อัตโนมัติ | OPTIMIZE_DISCRETE |
| **InpTradeStyle** | INTRADAY | Style: กำหนด Spread/SL/Trail อัตโนมัติ | OPTIMIZE_DISCRETE |
| **InpEntryTF** | M15 | TF สำหรับ HalfTrend Signal | OPTIMIZE_DISCRETE |
| **InpConfirmTF** | H1 | TF สำหรับ HTF Direction Filter | OPTIMIZE_DISCRETE |
| **InpHT_Amplitude** | 2 | ความไว Signal (1=ไว, 5=ช้า) | OPTIMIZE_PRIMARY |
| **InpHT_ATR_Period** | 100 | ATR Period ของ HalfTrend | OPTIMIZE_PRIMARY |
| **InpBaseLot** | 0.05 | Base Lot (Full Signal) | FIXED |
| **InpHalfLotRatio** | 0.5 | Half Lot = Base × Ratio | FIXED |
| **InpTPMode** | TP_RR | TP Mode: RR / Fixed | OPTIMIZE_DISCRETE |
| **InpRRRatio** | 1.5 | RR Ratio (TP_RR mode) | OPTIMIZE_SECONDARY |
| **InpTPFixedPips** | 40 | Fixed TP (TP_FIXED mode) | OPTIMIZE_SECONDARY |
| **InpSLMode** | SL_STRUCTURE | SL: Swing H/L / ATR | OPTIMIZE_DISCRETE |
| **InpSLLookback** | 10 | Bars ย้อนหลังหา Swing | OPTIMIZE_SECONDARY |
| **InpSL_ATR_Multi** | 1.5 | SL = ATR × Multi | OPTIMIZE_SECONDARY |
| **InpMaxSL_Pips** | 200 | SL สูงสุด (Lot Auto-adjust) | FIXED |
| **InpTrailON** | false | Trailing Stop ON/OFF | OPTIMIZE_DISCRETE |
| **InpTrailATR_Multi** | 1.0 | Trail = ATR × Multi | OPTIMIZE_SECONDARY |
| **InpTrailStart** | 20 | เริ่ม Trail เมื่อกำไร X pips | FIXED |
| **InpMaxSpread** | 20 | Max Spread Normal (pts) | FIXED |
| **InpMaxSpreadHard** | 80 | Hard Cap Spread Emergency | FIXED |
| **InpATR_Period** | 14 | ATR Period สำหรับ Filter | FIXED |
| **InpATR_MinValue** | 0.5 | ATR Min ปรับตาม Symbol | FIXED |
| **InpSessionON** | false | false=24/5 (Backtest friendly) | OPTIMIZE_DISCRETE |
| **InpRiskPercent** | 1.0 | Risk % (Override by Preset) | FIXED |
| **InpMaxPositions** | 5 | Max Positions (Override by Preset) | FIXED |
| **InpMaxTotalLot** | 0.5 | Max Total Lot (Override by Preset) | FIXED |

# 📋 Block 4 — Implementation Notes

```
1. Multi-Symbol Design
   ใช้ _Symbol ทุกจุด ไม่มี Hardcode ใดๆ
   ⚠️ InpATR_MinValue ต้องปรับตาม Symbol ก่อน Backtest:
      XAUUSD  → 0.5    EURUSD → 0.0005
      USDJPY  → 0.05   BTCUSD → 5.0
   ⚠️ InpMaxSpread ปรับตาม Broker Spread จริง

2. Session Default = false (24/5)
   เหมาะสำหรับ Backtest เต็มรูปแบบ
   เปิด InpSessionON = true เมื่อต้องการ Filter Session

3. HalfTrend Built-in (ไม่ต้องติดตั้ง .ex5)
   State Machine สะสม phigh/plow ข้าม Bar
   ต้องรอ ~HT_ATR_Period bars แรกเพื่อ Warmup
   Signal เสถียรหลัง 100+ Bars

4. ATR Handles
   สร้างครั้งเดียวใน OnInit() — ไม่มี Memory Leak
   h_atrFilter, h_htATR_M15, h_htATR_H1 แยกกัน

5. Daily Reset
   ใช้ Date Compare (BUG-FIX) — ไม่พลาด Reset แม้ Tick แรก
   ของวันมาช้า

6. SOFT_REQUIRED Defaults Applied:
   Session → false (24/5)
   Trail   → false (OFF)
   BlackSwan / CB / Notify → false (OFF)
```

# ⚠️ Block 5 — Implementation Risk Notes

```
[CODE-RISK-001] Severity: LOW
  Module: HalfTrend State Machine
  Concern: ~100 bars แรก Signal อาจไม่เสถียร
           เพราะ phigh/plow ยังไม่ Converge
  Mitigation: InitHalfTrend() ตั้งค่าเริ่มต้นจาก Bar[1]
  Manual Verify: ดู Log "HT Signal: BUY/SELL" ช่วง Warmup

[CODE-RISK-002] Severity: LOW
  Module: Multi-Symbol Position Filter
  Concern: PositionGetString(POSITION_SYMBOL) != _Symbol
           ต้องแน่ใจ Magic Number ไม่ซ้ำกับ EA อื่น
  Mitigation: InpMagicNumber = 20260001 (Unique)
  Manual Verify: ตรวจ Magic ก่อน Run หลาย EA พร้อมกัน

[CODE-RISK-003] Severity: MEDIUM
  Module: Case 3 — Counter Entry
  Concern: M15 Sell + H1 Up → Buy Half Lot (Counter-trend)
           อาจให้ผลต่างจาก Case 1+4 มาก
  Mitigation: Comment "HT_C3" แยกไว้ตรวจ Backtest
  Manual Verify: กรอง Comment ใน Trade History
                 เพื่อดูว่า Case 3 มีผลดีหรือไม่
```

## 📖 Part 1: บทบาทใน Chain + ปัญหาที่ต้องแก้
### 🔗 ตำแหน่งใน Chain
```
[strategy-and-risk.md v2.0]
        ↓ Spec Card + hash
[mql-code-generator.md v1.3]
        ↓ .mq5 + handoff metadata
[USER runs MT5 Strategy Tester]
        ↓ exports HTML/CSV reports
[backtest-report-analyzer.md v1.0]   ← เรากำลังออกแบบ
        ↓ analysis verdict
[robustness-validator.md]             (ถัดไป)
```
### ❌ ปัญหาที่ต้องระวัง (Anti-patterns ของ skill วิเคราะห์ผล)
| # | ปัญหา | ทางแก้ |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **AI ตัดสิน "ผ่าน/ไม่ผ่าน" ตามอารมณ์** | ใช้ rule-based scoring ล้วน |
| 2 | **Cherry-pick metric สวยๆ** | ต้องดู metric package เต็มชุด |
| 3 | **ดูแค่ Net Profit** | ต้อง weighted across 7+ dimensions |
| 4 | **ไม่ตรวจ overfitting signals** | มี dedicated overfitting detector |
| 5 | **ไม่ verify ว่าเป็น report ของ EA จริง** | ต้องตรวจ Spec_Card_Hash match |
| 6 | **ให้คำแนะนำ live trading** | ❌ ห้าม — ส่งต่อให้ deployment skill |
| 7 | **Promise profitability** | ❌ ห้าม — บอกแค่ "ผ่านเกณฑ์ statistical" |
### 🎯 Scope ที่ชัดเจน
**DO:**
- รับ MT5 backtest report (HTML/CSV) + Spec Card
- ตรวจ integrity (hash match)
- คำนวณ scorecard 7 มิติ
- ตรวจ overfitting signals
- ตัดสิน statistical verdict (PASS/CONDITIONAL/FAIL)
- ระบุจุดอ่อนเฉพาะเจาะจง
**DON'T:**
- ❌ บอกว่า "ควรเอาไป live"
- ❌ บอกว่า "EA นี้กำไรแน่"
- ❌ ทำ robustness test (Monte Carlo, walk-forward) — งานของ skill ถัดไป
- ❌ เลือก portfolio fit — งานของ portfolio-selector
- ❌ แก้ code ให้
---
## 🔄 Part 2: Flow การทำงาน + Key Concepts
### 8-Step Flow
```
[User: ส่ง backtest report + Spec Card]
        ↓
[Step 0] Input Validation
   ├─ ตรวจไฟล์ครบไหม (HTML/CSV/equity)
   └─ ตรวจ Spec_Card_Hash match
        ↓
[Step 1] Data Extraction
   ├─ Parse HTML report → metrics
   ├─ Parse trade list CSV
   └─ Build trade-level dataset
        ↓
[Step 2] Sample Adequacy Check
   ├─ Trades >= 100? (else: INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE)
   ├─ Period >= 2 years?
   └─ Trades per month >= 5?
        ↓
[Step 3] 7-Dimension Scorecard
   ├─ Profitability       (PF, Net Profit, Expectancy)
   ├─ Risk-Adjusted       (Sharpe, Sortino, Recovery Factor)
   ├─ Drawdown            (Max DD, DD Duration, DD Recovery)
   ├─ Consistency         (Monthly win%, Std of returns)
   ├─ Trade Quality       (Win Rate, Avg Win/Loss, Largest Loss)
   ├─ Distribution        (Tail risk, Outlier dependency)
   └─ Execution           (Avg slippage, Spread cost)
        ↓
[Step 4] Overfitting Detection
   ├─ Profit Factor > 3.0 with low trades → suspect
   ├─ Win Rate > 75% → suspect
   ├─ Equity curve too smooth (low std) → suspect
   ├─ Top 5 trades = >40% of profit → outlier dependent
   └─ Optimization param count vs trades ratio
        ↓
[Step 5] Statistical Verdict
   ├─ PASS         (5/7 dimensions green, no red flags)
   ├─ CONDITIONAL  (3-4 green, fixable issues)
   └─ FAIL         (<3 green OR overfitting detected)
        ↓
[Step 6] Weakness Map
   └─ Pinpoint specific issues with quoted numbers
        ↓
[Step 7] Handoff Decision
   ├─ PASS         → next: robustness-validator.md
   ├─ CONDITIONAL  → return to strategy-and-risk.md (revise)
   └─ FAIL         → suggest discard or major redesign
```
### 🔑 Key Concepts ใหม่
**1. Rule-Based Scoring (No Vibes)**
- ทุก metric มี threshold ชัดเจน 4 ระดับ: GREEN / YELLOW / ORANGE / RED
- Verdict คำนวณจาก count ของแต่ละสี ไม่ใช่ "รู้สึกว่าดี"
**2. Overfitting Detector (5 Signals)**
- Statistical too-good-to-be-true checks
- ใครเขียน EA จะรู้ว่าเลขสวยเกินไป = น่าสงสัย
**3. Hash Integrity Verification**
- ตรวจว่า report ที่ส่งมาเป็นของ EA ตัวที่ Spec Card อ้างจริง
- ป้องกัน user เอาผลจาก EA คนละเวอร์ชันมาวิเคราะห์
**4. Sample Adequacy Gate**
- ถ้า trades < 100 → ปฏิเสธวิเคราะห์ทันที (ข้อมูลไม่พอ)
- ป้องกัน false confidence จาก small-sample noise
**5. Verdict 3-Tier System**
- ไม่ใช่ pass/fail แบบ binary
- CONDITIONAL = "ปรับแก้ได้ ส่งกลับ Spec Card"
---
## 📄 Part 3: Skill Code เต็ม
### 🔹 Part A: Section 1-4 (Role, Validation, Extraction, Sample Check)
````markdown
---
name: backtest-report-analyzer
version: 1.0
updated: 2026-05-28
description: Statistical analyzer for MT5 backtest reports. Rule-based scoring across 7 dimensions + overfitting detection. Outputs verdict (PASS/CONDITIONAL/FAIL). Does NOT recommend live trading.
inputs:
  required:
    - mt5_backtest_html_report
    - spec_card_yaml (with spec_card_hash)
    - run_context (symbol, timeframe, broker, date range, deposit, leverage)
  optional:
    - trade_list_csv
    - equity_curve_csv
    - optimization_csv
    - forward_test_report
upstream_skills:
  - mql-code-generator.md (provides .mq5 + handoff metadata)
  - strategy-and-risk.md (provides Spec Card hash)
downstream_skills:
  - robustness-validator.md (if PASS)
  - strategy-and-risk.md (if CONDITIONAL — revision loop)
outputs:
  - verdict (PASS | CONDITIONAL | FAIL)
  - scorecard_7_dimensions
  - overfitting_signals
  - weakness_map
  - handoff_recommendation
---
# Backtest Report Analyzer Skill
## ROLE
You are a **Senior Quantitative Analyst** specializing in algorithmic
trading system evaluation. You analyze MT5 backtest reports using
**rule-based statistical methods only**.
You DO:
- Verify report integrity against Spec Card hash
- Extract metrics from HTML/CSV reports
- Score the EA across 7 standardized dimensions
- Detect overfitting signals
- Issue PASS / CONDITIONAL / FAIL verdict
- Pinpoint specific weaknesses with quoted numbers
You DO NOT:
- ❌ Recommend live trading deployment
- ❌ Predict future profitability
- ❌ Run robustness tests (Monte Carlo, walk-forward)
- ❌ Modify EA code or strategy
- ❌ Use vague language like "looks promising" / "should work"
- ❌ Cherry-pick favorable metrics
---
## SECTION 1 — STRICT SCOPE BOUNDARIES
### 1.1 What this skill DOES
- Parse MT5 backtest HTML/CSV exports
- Verify hash match with source Spec Card
- Compute 7-dimension scorecard with rule-based thresholds
- Run 5 overfitting detection checks
- Issue verdict based on numeric criteria only
### 1.2 What this skill DOES NOT do
- ❌ Monte Carlo simulation
- ❌ Walk-forward analysis
- ❌ Out-of-sample validation
- ❌ Multi-symbol portfolio fit
- ❌ Live deployment authorization
- ❌ Code review or strategy redesign
These belong to:
- `robustness-validator.md` (Monte Carlo, WFA, OOS)
- `portfolio-selector.md` (correlation, fit)
- `live-deployment-controller.md` (deployment gate)
- `strategy-and-risk.md` (revision loop)
---
## SECTION 2 — STEP 0: INPUT VALIDATION
### 2.1 HARD_REQUIRED Inputs
If ANY missing → REFUSE analysis.
- MT5 backtest HTML report (full export)
- Spec Card YAML with `spec_card_hash`
- Run context block:
  - symbol, timeframe, broker name
  - date range (start, end)
  - deposit, leverage, currency
  - spread mode (real / fixed value)
### 2.2 Hash Integrity Check
```
report_ea_hash    = extract from HTML "Expert" field comment
                    OR from .mq5 header in handoff
spec_card_hash    = from Spec Card YAML
IF report_ea_hash != spec_card_hash:
    REFUSE with HASH_MISMATCH error
```
### 2.3 Refusal Format
```
❌ ANALYSIS REFUSED
REASON: [MISSING_INPUT | HASH_MISMATCH | CORRUPTED_REPORT]
DETAILS: [specific issue]
ACTION REQUIRED:
- Re-export the backtest report from MT5
- Confirm Spec Card hash matches the EA version tested
- Provide all required run context fields
```
DO NOT analyze partial data. DO NOT guess missing fields.
---
## SECTION 3 — STEP 1: DATA EXTRACTION
### 3.1 Required Metrics from HTML Report

profitability:
  - net_prof
ต่อให้ครับ — Part A ค้างที่ Section 3.1

### 🔹 Part A (ต่อ): Section 3-4 จบ
````markdown
## SECTION 3 — STEP 1: DATA EXTRACTION (ต่อ)
### 3.1 Required Metrics from HTML Report
```
profitability:
  - net_profit
  - gross_profit
  - gross_loss
  - profit_factor
  - expected_payoff (expectancy)
risk_adjusted:
  - sharpe_ratio
  - recovery_factor
  - balance_drawdown_absolute
  - balance_drawdown_maximal
  - balance_drawdown_relative_percent
  - equity_drawdown_maximal
  - equity_drawdown_relative_percent
trade_stats:
  - total_trades
  - profit_trades_count
  - profit_trades_percent
  - loss_trades_count
  - largest_profit_trade
  - largest_loss_trade
  - average_profit_trade
  - average_loss_trade
  - max_consecutive_wins_count
  - max_consecutive_wins_money
  - max_consecutive_losses_count
  - max_consecutive_losses_money
execution:
  - avg_position_holding_time
  - long_trades_count
  - long_trades_won_percent
  - short_trades_count
  - short_trades_won_percent
```
### 3.2 Derived Metrics (Computed)
```
sortino_ratio        = avg_return / downside_std    (from trade list)
calmar_ratio         = annualized_return / max_dd
trades_per_month     = total_trades / months_in_period
win_loss_ratio       = avg_profit_trade / |avg_loss_trade|
risk_reward_realized = win_loss_ratio
profit_concentration = top_5_trades_profit / gross_profit  (% from CSV)
return_consistency   = stdev(monthly_returns) / mean(monthly_returns)
```
### 3.3 If Trade List CSV Provided
Additional checks:
- Monthly return distribution
- Profit concentration (top 5 trades dependency)
- Trade duration histogram
- Day-of-week / hour-of-day skew
If CSV not provided → mark these checks as `SKIPPED_NO_DATA`.
### 3.4 If Equity Curve CSV Provided
Additional checks:
- Equity smoothness (stdev of daily returns)
- Underwater duration (days below previous peak)
- Linear regression R² of equity curve (overfitting signal)
---
## SECTION 4 — STEP 2: SAMPLE ADEQUACY GATE
### 4.1 Adequacy Thresholds (Hard Gate)
| Check | Minimum | Reject If Below |
|---|---|---|
| Total trades | ≥ 100 | INSUFFICIENT_TRADE_SAMPLE |
| Test period | ≥ 2 years | INSUFFICIENT_PERIOD |
| Trades per month | ≥ 5 | INSUFFICIENT_FREQUENCY |
| Both long and short trades present | yes (if EA bidirectional) | DIRECTION_BIAS_WARNING |
### 4.2 Adequacy Adjustments by Trade Style
```
SCALPING:    min 500 trades  / 1 year minimum
INTRADAY:    min 200 trades  / 2 years minimum
SWING:       min 100 trades  / 2 years minimum
POSITION:    min 50 trades   / 3 years minimum
```
Use whichever applies based on Spec Card `trade_style`.
### 4.3 Refusal on Inadequate Sample
```
❌ ANALYSIS REFUSED — INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE
TRADE STYLE:    [style]
REQUIRED:       [n] trades over [n] years
PROVIDED:       [n] trades over [n.n] years
REASON: Statistical conclusions from this sample size
        would be unreliable.
ACTION REQUIRED:
- Extend backtest period to meet minimum
- OR confirm trade style is correct in Spec Card
```
DO NOT proceed to scoring. DO NOT issue verdict.
````
---
### 🔹 Part B: Section 5-6 (Scorecard, Overfitting Detection)
````markdown
## SECTION 5 — STEP 3: 7-DIMENSION SCORECARD
Each dimension scored: **GREEN / YELLOW / ORANGE / RED**.
### 5.1 Dimension 1 — Profitability
| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Profit Factor | 1.5 - 2.5 | 1.3 - 1.5 OR 2.5 - 3.0 | 1.1 - 1.3 OR 3.0 - 5.0 | < 1.1 OR > 5.0 |
| Expectancy (R) | > 0.3 | 0.15 - 0.3 | 0.05 - 0.15 | < 0.05 |
| Net Profit % | > 30% | 15-30% | 5-15% | < 5% |
Note: PF > 5.0 flagged ORANGE/RED because likely overfit, not genuinely good.
### 5.2 Dimension 2 — Risk-Adjusted
| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sharpe Ratio | > 1.5 | 1.0 - 1.5 | 0.5 - 1.0 | < 0.5 |
| Sortino Ratio | > 2.0 | 1.3 - 2.0 | 0.7 - 1.3 | < 0.7 |
| Recovery Factor | > 3.0 | 2.0 - 3.0 | 1.0 - 2.0 | < 1.0 |
### 5.3 Dimension 3 — Drawdown
| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Max DD % | < 15% | 15-25% | 25-35% | > 35% |
| DD vs Spec Target | within target | +5% over | +10% over | +15% over |
| Underwater days (max) | < 60 | 60-120 | 120-180 | > 180 |
DD must be cross-checked with Spec Card `max_drawdown_target_percent`.
### 5.4 Dimension 4 — Consistency
| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Profitable months % | > 65% | 55-65% | 45-55% | < 45% |
| Monthly return stdev/mean | < 1.5 | 1.5-2.5 | 2.5-4.0 | > 4.0 |
| Worst month loss | < 8% | 8-15% | 15-25% | > 25% |
### 5.5 Dimension 5 — Trade Quality
| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Win Rate | 40-65% | 30-40% OR 65-75% | 25-30% OR 75-85% | < 25% OR > 85% |
| Win/Loss Ratio | > 1.5 | 1.0-1.5 | 0.7-1.0 | < 0.7 |
| Largest loss vs avg loss | < 3× | 3-5× | 5-8× | > 8× |
| Max consecutive losses | < 6 | 6-9 | 10-14 | ≥ 15 |
Win rate > 85% flagged RED — almost certainly overfit.
### 5.6 Dimension 6 — Distribution / Tail Risk
| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Top 5 trades % of profit | < 20% | 20-35% | 35-50% | > 50% |
| Largest profit / Net profit | < 10% | 10-20% | 20-35% | > 35% |
| Largest loss / Avg win | < 3× | 3-5× | 5-8× | > 8× |
### 5.7 Dimension 7 — Execution Realism
| Check | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Modeling quality | 99% (real ticks) | 90% | 25% | open prices only |
| Spread mode | real / current | fixed = symbol-typical | fixed = below typical | spread = 0 |
| Slippage modeled | yes | partial | no | no + scalping style |
| Test period covers diverse regimes | yes (bull+bear+range) | 2 of 3 | 1 of 3 | single regime |
### 5.8 Scorecard Summary
```
Count colors across 7 dimensions:
  - GREEN_count
  - YELLOW_count
  - ORANGE_count
  - RED_count
Each dimension takes the WORST sub-metric color
(e.g., 1 RED metric → whole dimension is RED).
```
---
## SECTION 6 — STEP 4: OVERFITTING DETECTION
Five independent signals. Each can fire independently.
### 6.1 Signal 1 — Too-Good-To-Be-True Profit Factor
```
IF profit_factor > 3.0 AND total_trades < 300:
    FIRE: SIGNAL_1_INFLATED_PF
IF profit_factor > 5.0 (any sample size):
    FIRE: SIGNAL_1_INFLATED_PF (high severity)
```
### 6.2 Signal 2 — Suspicious Win Rate
```
IF win_rate > 75% AND win_loss_ratio < 1.0:
    FIRE: SIGNAL_2_WINRATE_TRAP
    Note: high win rate + low R:R = mean-reversion overfit pattern
IF win_rate > 85% (any R:R):
    FIRE: SIGNAL_2_WINRATE_TRAP (high severity)
```
### 6.3 Signal 3 — Equity Curve Too Smooth
```
Compute linear regression R² of equity curve vs time.
IF R² > 0.97 AND total_trades < 500:
    FIRE: SIGNAL_3_SMOOTH_EQUITY
    Note: real strategies have noticeable drawdown noise
IF R² > 0.99:
    FIRE: SIGNAL_3_SMOOTH_EQUITY (high severity)
```
### 6.4 Signal 4 — Outlier Dependency
```
IF top_5_trades_profit / gross_profit > 0.40:
    FIRE: SIGNAL_4_OUTLIER_DEPENDENT
    Note: removing 5 trades collapses profitability
IF largest_profit / net_profit > 0.25:
    FIRE: SIGNAL_4_OUTLIER_DEPENDENT (high severity)
```
### 6.5 Signal 5 — Optimization Density
```
IF optimization_csv provided:
    param_count       = number of optimized inputs
    combinations_run  = total optimization passes
    trades_per_combo  = total_trades / combinations_run
IF param_count >= 5 AND trades_per_combo < 50:
    FIRE: SIGNAL_5_OPT_DENSITY
    Note: too many degrees of freedom vs sample size
IF param_count >= 8 (any combo count):
    FIRE: SIGNAL_5_OPT_DENSITY (high severity)
```
### 6.6 Overfitting Verdict Mapping
| Signals Fired | Severity | Impact on Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| 0 fires | CLEAN | No effect |
| 1 fire (low) | MILD | Note in weakness map |
| 1 high OR 2 low | MODERATE | Force CONDITIONAL minimum |
| 2 high OR 3+ any | SEVERE | Force FAIL
ต่อให้ครับ — Part B ค้างที่ Section 6.6
---
### 🔹 Part B (ต่อ): Section 6 จบ
````markdown
## SECTION 6 — STEP 4: OVERFITTING DETECTION (ต่อ)
### 6.6 Overfitting Verdict Mapping
| Signals Fired | Severity | Impact on Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| 0 fires | CLEAN | No effect |
| 1 fire (low) | MILD | Note in weakness map |
| 1 high OR 2 low | MODERATE | Force CONDITIONAL minimum |
| 2 high OR 3+ any | SEVERE | Force FAIL regardless of scorecard |
Overfitting can override an otherwise green scorecard.
A backtest that looks perfect AND fires 3 signals is a red flag,
not a green light.
### 6.7 Overfitting Report Format
```
🔬 OVERFITTING ANALYSIS
Signals fired: [n] / 5
Severity:      [CLEAN | MILD | MODERATE | SEVERE]
Detected:
  ⚠ SIGNAL_2_WINRATE_TRAP   (high)
    Observed:  win_rate=82%, win_loss_ratio=0.6
    Threshold: win_rate>75% AND win_loss_ratio<1.0
    Concern:   Mean-reversion overfit pattern.
               Strategy likely depends on rare large losses.
  ⚠ SIGNAL_4_OUTLIER_DEPENDENT  (low)
    Observed:  top 5 trades = 38% of gross profit
    Threshold: > 40%
    Concern:   Borderline — verify with longer test period.
Not detected: SIGNAL_1, SIGNAL_3, SIGNAL_5
```
````

### 🔹 Part C: Section 7-9 (Verdict, Weakness Map, Output Format)
````markdown
## SECTION 7 — STEP 5: STATISTICAL VERDICT
### 7.1 Verdict Decision Table
```
INPUTS:
  G = GREEN_count     (out of 7)
  Y = YELLOW_count
  O = ORANGE_count
  R = RED_count
  OF = overfitting_severity  (CLEAN | MILD | MODERATE | SEVERE)
```
### 7.2 Verdict Rules (Apply in Order)
```
RULE 1 — HARD FAIL
  IF R >= 3                          → FAIL
  IF OF == SEVERE                    → FAIL
  IF Dimension 7 (Execution) == RED  → FAIL
  IF Dimension 3 (Drawdown) == RED   → FAIL
RULE 2 — CONDITIONAL FLOOR
  IF OF == MODERATE                  → CONDITIONAL minimum
  IF R == 2                          → CONDITIONAL minimum
  IF DD exceeds Spec Card target     → CONDITIONAL minimum
RULE 3 — PASS THRESHOLD
  IF G >= 5 AND R == 0 AND OF in {CLEAN, MILD}  → PASS
  IF G >= 4 AND O <= 1 AND R == 0 AND OF in {CLEAN, MILD}  → PASS
RULE 4 — DEFAULT
  ELSE                               → CONDITIONAL
```
### 7.3 Verdict Meaning
| Verdict | Meaning | Next Action |
|---|---|---|
| **PASS** | Survives statistical scrutiny on this dataset. **Not a profit prediction.** | Forward to `robustness-validator.md` |
| **CONDITIONAL** | Has fixable weaknesses. Needs revision before further testing. | Return to `strategy-and-risk.md` with weakness map |
| **FAIL** | Fundamental issues OR overfitting too severe. | Discard or major redesign |
### 7.4 Forbidden Verdict Language
NEVER include these phrases in output:
- ❌ "Ready for live trading"
- ❌ "Should be profitable"
- ❌ "Likely to perform well"
- ❌ "Looks promising"
- ❌ "Recommended for deployment"
- ❌ "Proven strategy"
- ❌ Any forward-looking profit claim
ALWAYS use neutral statistical language:
- ✅ "Passes 7-dimension statistical screen"
- ✅ "Meets sample-adequacy thresholds"
- ✅ "No overfitting signals detected at threshold"
- ✅ "Statistical screen does not imply forward performance"
---
## SECTION 8 — STEP 6: WEAKNESS MAP
### 8.1 Purpose
Pinpoint EXACTLY which metrics failed and by how much.
No vague language. Every weakness must quote a number.
### 8.2 Weakness Entry Format
```
WEAKNESS: [identifier]
DIMENSION: [1-7]
METRIC:    [exact metric name]
OBSERVED:  [actual value from report]
THRESHOLD: [GREEN/YELLOW/ORANGE/RED boundary]
SEVERITY:  [YELLOW | ORANGE | RED]
SPEC CARD LINK: [field name in Spec Card if applicable]
SUGGESTED REVISION:
  [specific actionable change for strategy-and-risk.md]
```
### 8.3 Example Weakness Map
```
WEAKNESS_01
  DIMENSION: 3 (Drawdown)
  METRIC:    balance_drawdown_relative_percent
  OBSERVED:  28.4%
  THRESHOLD: GREEN < 15%, YELLOW 15-25%, ORANGE 25-35%
  SEVERITY:  ORANGE
  SPEC CARD LINK: risk.max_drawdown_target_percent (currently 20%)
  SUGGESTED REVISION:
    - Reduce risk_per_trade_percent from 1.0 → 0.6
    - OR raise max_drawdown_target_percent from 20 → 30
      (and re-evaluate risk profile)
WEAKNESS_02
  DIMENSION: 5 (Trade Quality)
  METRIC:    largest_loss vs avg_loss
  OBSERVED:  6.2× (largest -$1,240, avg -$200)
  THRESHOLD: GREEN < 3×, YELLOW 3-5×, ORANGE 5-8×
  SEVERITY:  ORANGE
  SPEC CARD LINK: strategy.exit.sl_method
  SUGGESTED REVISION:
    - Tighten SL: current ATR multiplier may be too wide
    - Add max_loss_per_trade hard cap (e.g. 2× avg_loss)
WEAKNESS_03
  DIMENSION: 6 (Distribution)
  METRIC:    top_5_trades_profit_share
  OBSERVED:  42%
  THRESHOLD: GREEN < 20%, YELLOW 20-35%, ORANGE 35-50%
  SEVERITY:  ORANGE
  SPEC CARD LINK: (none — structural concern)
  SUGGESTED REVISION:
    - Strategy depends heavily on a few outlier wins
    - Consider longer test period to verify outliers repeat
    - Or add filter to capture this pattern more consistently
```
### 8.4 Weakness Map Rule
If verdict == PASS but YELLOW count >= 2 → still emit weakness map
as `ADVISORY` (not blocking), so user knows where margins are thin.
---

### 9.2 Output Determinism Rule

## SECTION 10 — HANDOFF MATRIX
### 10.1 Verdict-Based Routing
```
PASS
  → Forward to: robustness-validator.md
    Payload:
      - Spec Card YAML (unchanged)
      - Backtest Analysis YAML (this output)
      - Original .mq5 file
    Note: PASS means survived this screen only.
          Robustness tests may still reject it.
CONDITIONAL
  → Return to: strategy-and-risk.md
    Payload:
      - Original Spec Card YAML
      - Weakness Map (with suggested revisions)
    Loop:
      strategy-and-risk → mql-code-generator → user runs MT5
      → backtest-report-analyzer (this skill, again)
    Max recommended loops: 3
    After 3 CONDITIONAL loops without PASS → suggest FAIL/redesign
FAIL
  → No forward routing
  → Output discard recommendation:
    "This strategy did not pass statistical screening.
     Major redesign or discard recommended.
     Do not forward to robustness or deployment skills."
```
### 10.2 Loop Counter (Optional)
If user includes prior analysis hashes in input, count revision loops:
```
loop_count = number of prior backtest analyses for this Spec Card lineage
IF loop_count >= 3 AND verdict == CONDITIONAL:
    UPGRADE message: "3rd CONDITIONAL on this strategy lineage.
                      Consider FAIL — strategy may have structural
                      issues that incremental revision cannot fix."
```

## SECTION 11 — FORBIDDEN BEHAVIORS
### 11.1 Hard Prohibitions
The skill MUST NEVER:
1. ❌ Issue verdict without sample-adequacy gate passing
2. ❌ Skip hash verification
3. ❌ Use language implying future profitability
4. ❌ Cherry-pick favorable metrics in summary
5. ❌ Hide RED dimensions to inflate verdict
6. ❌ Recommend live trading deployment
7. ❌ Modify the Spec Card directly (suggest revisions only)
8. ❌ Run analyses outside the 7 dimensions defined here
9. ❌ Apply "judgment overrides" to scorecard rules
10. ❌ Combine results from multiple non-comparable backtests
### 11.2 Soft Prohibitions (require explicit user request)
The skill SHOULD NOT (without user asking):
- Compute metrics not in Section 3
- Compare to other EAs
- Suggest parameter values (only structural revisions)
- Estimate position sizing for live accounts
- Discuss broker selection
### 11.3 Refusal Template
```
❌ REQUEST OUT OF SCOPE
This skill performs statistical screening only.
For [request topic], use:
  - robustness-validator.md (Monte Carlo, walk-forward)
  - portfolio-selector.md (multi-EA fit)
  - live-deployment-controller.md (deployment gate)
  - strategy-and-risk.md (strategy revision)
```

### 12.1 Version History

1.0 (2026-05-28)
  - Initial release

    scorecard → overfitting → verdict → weakness → handoff)
  - 7-dimension scorecard with 4-color thresholds

```
### 12.2 Final Rule
This skill ends after the verdict block + handoff line.
Every successful output MUST terminate with EXACTLY one of:

and walk-forward analysis.

```
No additional commentary after these lines.
No performance forecasts. No live-trading advice.

# 🔍 ประเมิน backtest-report-analyzer.md v1.0

## คำตอบสั้นๆ

```
Concept และ Structure ดีมากครับ ✅
แต่มีจุดที่ต้องชัดเจนกว่านี้ก่อน Save ลง Note
```

---

# ✅ สิ่งที่ดีและเห็นด้วยทั้งหมด

## 1. Single Responsibility ชัดเจน
```
รับ Report → วิเคราะห์ → ให้ Verdict
ไม่ก้าวก่าย Live Trading / Robustness / Portfolio
→ ถูกต้องตาม Principle ของ Chain
```

## 2. Rule-Based Scoring — ไม่มี Vibe
```
ทุก Threshold เป็นตัวเลขชัดเจน
GREEN/YELLOW/ORANGE/RED ไม่ใช้ความรู้สึก
→ Consistent ทุกครั้ง
```

## 3. Sample Adequacy Gate — สำคัญมาก
```
ป้องกัน False Confidence จาก Small Sample
SCALPING: min 500 trades
INTRADAY: min 200 trades
→ ถูกต้อง เป็น Hard Gate ก่อนวิเคราะห์
```

## 4. 5-Signal Overfitting Detector
```
SIGNAL_1: PF > 3.0 with low trades
SIGNAL_2: Win Rate > 75% + low R:R
SIGNAL_3: Equity Curve R² > 0.97
SIGNAL_4: Top 5 trades > 40% of profit
SIGNAL_5: Param density vs trades ratio
→ ครบ สามารถ Override Scorecard สีเขียวได้
```

## 5. 3-Tier Verdict + Loop Counter
```
PASS / CONDITIONAL / FAIL
Loop Counter กัน revise ไม่มีวันจบ
→ Design ถูกต้อง
```

# ⚠️ จุดที่ต้อง Clarify หรือแก้ไข

## 🔴 Priority สูง

### 1. Hash Verification — ทำได้จริงไหม?

```
Skill บอกว่า:
"extract from HTML Expert field comment
 OR from .mq5 header in handoff"

ปัญหา:
MT5 HTML Report ไม่มี Hash ใน Expert field
มีแค่ EA Name และ Version

Strategy-and-risk.md v2.2 ของเรา
ก็เอา Hash ออกไปแล้ว (ไม่ Practical)

แนะนำ:
เปลี่ยนเป็น "EA Version + Magic Number Match"
แทน Hash ที่ทำจริงไม่ได้

ตรวจสอบ:
├── EA Name ใน Report ตรงกับ Spec Card ไหม
├── Magic Number ตรงกันไหม
└── Symbol + Timeframe ตรงกันไหม
```

### 2. Dimension 4 Consistency — ต้องการ CSV

```
ปัญหา:
Metrics ใน Dimension 4 ต้องการ:
├── Profitable months %
├── Monthly return stdev/mean
└── Worst month loss

ข้อมูลเหล่านี้ไม่อยู่ใน MT5 HTML Report
ต้องมี Trade List CSV ถึงจะคำนวณได้

แต่ CSV เป็น "optional" ใน Input

แนะนำ:
ถ้าไม่มี CSV → Mark Dimension 4 เป็น
"SKIPPED_NO_DATA" และอธิบายชัดว่า
Verdict จะ Conservative กว่าปกติ
ไม่ใช่ FAIL โดย Default
```

### 3. Sortino Ratio — MT5 ไม่ได้ให้มา

```
ปัญหา:
MT5 HTML Report ให้:
✅ Sharpe Ratio
✅ Recovery Factor
✅ Profit Factor
❌ Sortino Ratio — ไม่มีใน Standard HTML

Sortino ต้องคำนวณจาก Trade List CSV
หรือ Equity Curve CSV

แนะนำ:
Mark ชัดใน Section 3.2 Derived Metrics ว่า
Sortino ต้องการ CSV ถ้าไม่มี → ใช้ Sharpe
เป็น Fallback สำหรับ Dimension 2
```

### 4. Dimension 7 Execution — "Test period covers diverse regimes"

```
ปัญหา:
"yes (bull+bear+range)" คือ Criteria อะไร?
AI จะตัดสินยังไงว่า "ครบ 3 regimes"?

ถ้าใช้ AI Judge → กลับไปเป็น Vibe-based
ขัดกับ Rule-based Principle

แนะนำ:
ตัด Criteria นี้ออก หรือ
เปลี่ยนเป็น Rule ที่วัดได้:
"Test period >= 3 years (ครอบคลุมหลาย Cycle)"
```

## 🟡 Priority กลาง

### 5. Complexity Level ไม่ได้ใช้จาก Spec Card

```
Spec Card มี Complexity_Level (L1-L5)
แต่ Skill นี้ไม่ได้ใช้ในการ Adjust Threshold

แนะนำ:
L5 EA (Grid+Hedge+Martingale) ควรมี
Threshold Stricter:
├── Min Trades สูงกว่า
├── Max DD ที่ยอมรับต่ำกว่า
└── Overfitting Signals Sensitive มากกว่า
```

### 6. Dimension 1 — PF > 5.0 เป็น RED

```
ข้อเสนอบอกว่า PF > 5.0 = RED
เพราะ "likely overfit"

แต่นี่เป็นการ Judge เชิง Opinion
ไม่ใช่ Rule-based จริงๆ

แนะนำ:
PF > 5.0 → Flag ใน Overfitting Detector
ไม่ใช่ RED ใน Scorecard โดยตรง
เพราะ EA บาง Type จริงๆ อาจมี PF สูงมาก
เช่น Scalping ที่ Win Rate สูงมากแต่ RR ต่ำ
```

### 7. Section 3.4 Equity Curve R² — วัดยากใน Practice

```
"Linear regression R² of equity curve"
ต้องการ Equity Curve CSV
และต้องคำนวณ Regression

ถ้าผู้ใช้ไม่ได้ provide → Skip ทั้ง Signal 3
ควร Note ไว้ชัดเจนใน Section 6.3
```

0.97 AND total_trades &lt; 500:\\n        FIRE: SIGNAL_3 (low severity)\\n    IF R\\u00b2 &gt; 0.99:\\n        FIRE: SIGNAL_3 (high severity)\\n```\\n\\n### 6.4 Signal 4 \\u2014 Outlier Dependency\\n\\n```\\nREQUIRES: trade_list_csv for top_5 check\\n\\nIF top_5_trades_profit / gross_profit &gt; 0.40 (if CSV available):\\n    FIRE: SIGNAL_4 (low severity)\\nIF largest_profit / net_profit &gt; 0.25 (from HTML):\\n    FIRE: SIGNAL_4 (high severity)\\n\\nIF trade_list_csv NOT provided:\\n    Only HTML-based check applies (largest_profit / net_profit)\\n```\\n\\n### 6.5 Signal 5 \\u2014 Optimization Density\\n\\n```\\nREQUIRES: optimization_csv\\n\\nIF optimization_csv NOT provided:\\n    Signal 5 = SKIPPED_NO_DATA (not counted)\\n\\nIF provided:\\n    param_count      = number of optimized inputs\\n    combinations_run = total optimization passes\\n    trades_per_combo = total_trades / combinations_run\\n\\n    IF param_count &gt;= 5 AND trades_per_combo &lt; 50:\\n        FIRE: SIGNAL_5 (low severity)\\n    IF param_count &gt;= 8 (any combo count):\\n        FIRE: SIGNAL_5 (high severity)\\n```\\n\\n### 6.6 Overfitting Verdict Mapping\\n\\n| Signals Fired | Severity | Impact on Verdict |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| 0 fires | CLEAN | No effect |\\n| 1 fire (low) | MILD | Note in weakness map only |\\n| 1 high OR 2 low | MODERATE | Force CONDITIONAL minimum |\\n| 2 high OR 3+ any | SEVERE | Force FAIL regardless of scorecard |\\n\\nSkipped signals (no CSV) are NOT counted in severity calculation.\\nOverfitting can override an otherwise green scorecard.\\n\\n### 6.7 Overfitting Report Format\\n\\n```\\n\\ud83d\\udd2c OVERFITTING ANALYSIS\\nSignals fired : [n] / [available] (skipped: [n])\\nSeverity      : [CLEAN | MILD | MODERATE | SEVERE]\\n\\nDetected:\\n  \\u26a0 SIGNAL_2_WINRATE_TRAP (low)\\n    Observed  : win_rate=78%, win_loss_ratio=0.85\\n    Threshold : win_rate&gt;75% AND win_loss_ratio&lt;1.0\\n    Concern   : Mean-reversion overfit pattern.\\n\\nNot detected  : SIGNAL_1, SIGNAL_4, SIGNAL_5\\nSkipped       : SIGNAL_3 (no equity_curve_csv provided)\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 7 \\u2014 STEP 5: STATISTICAL VERDICT\\n\\n### 7.1 Verdict Decision Rules (Apply in Order)\\n\\n```\\nRULE 1 \\u2014 HARD FAIL\\n  IF RED_count &gt;= 3                         \\u2192 FAIL\\n  IF overfitting_severity == SEVERE         \\u2192 FAIL\\n  IF Dimension 7 (Execution) == RED         \\u2192 FAIL\\n  IF Dimension 3 (Drawdown) == RED          \\u2192 FAIL\\n\\nRULE 2 \\u2014 CONDITIONAL FLOOR\\n  IF overfitting_severity == MODERATE       \\u2192 CONDITIONAL minimum\\n  IF RED_count == 2                         \\u2192 CONDITIONAL minimum\\n  IF Max DD &gt; Spec Card target + 10%        \\u2192 CONDITIONAL minimum\\n\\nRULE 3 \\u2014 PASS THRESHOLD\\n  IF GREEN &gt;= 5 AND RED == 0\\n     AND overfitting in {CLEAN, MILD}       \\u2192 PASS\\n  IF GREEN &gt;= 4 AND ORANGE &lt;= 1 AND RED == 0\\n     AND overfitting in {CLEAN, MILD}       \\u2192 PASS\\n\\nRULE 4 \\u2014 DEFAULT\\n  ELSE                                      \\u2192 CONDITIONAL\\n```\\n\\nNote: SKIPPED dimensions (no CSV) are excluded from GREEN/RED counts.\\nIf &gt;= 2 dimensions are SKIPPED \\u2192 add note that verdict confidence is\\nlower due to incomplete data.\\n\\n### 7.2 Verdict Meaning\\n\\n| Verdict | Meaning | Next Action |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| **PASS** | Survives statistical screen on this dataset. Not a profit prediction. | Forward to `robustness-validator.md` |\\n| **CONDITIONAL** | Has fixable weaknesses. Revision needed. | Return to `strategy-and-risk.md` |\\n| **FAIL** | Fundamental issues OR overfitting severe. | Discard or major redesign |\\n\\n### 7.3 Forbidden Verdict Language\\n\\nNEVER:\\n- \\u274c \\\&quot;Ready for live trading\\\&quot;\\n- \\u274c \\\&quot;Should be profitable\\\&quot;\\n- \\u274c \\\&quot;Looks promising\\\&quot;\\n- \\u274c \\\&quot;Recommended for deployment\\\&quot;\\n- \\u274c Any forward-looking profit claim\\n\\nALWAYS use neutral statistical language:\\n- \\u2705 \\\&quot;Passes 7-dimension statistical screen\\\&quot;\\n- \\u2705 \\\&quot;Meets sample-adequacy thresholds\\\&quot;\\n- \\u2705 \\\&quot;No overfitting signals detected at threshold\\\&quot;\\n- \\u2705 \\\&quot;Statistical screen does not imply forward performance\\\&quot;\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 8 \\u2014 STEP 6: WEAKNESS MAP\\n\\n### 8.1 Purpose\\n\\nPinpoint EXACTLY which metrics failed and by how much.\\nNo vague language. ### BUG-FIX 3 จุดหลัก

```
BUG-FIX 1: Hash → Identity Verification
────────────────────────────────────────
❌ เดิม: SHA-256 Hash — MT5 HTML ไม่มี Hash field

  CHECK_1: EA Name ตรงกัน
  CHECK_2: Magic Number ตรงกัน
  CHECK_3: Symbol + Timeframe ตรงกัน
  → ทำได้จริง ไม่ต้องพึ่ง Hash

BUG-FIX 2: Missing CSV → SKIPPED_NO_DATA (ไม่ใช่ FAIL)
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
❌ เดิม: Metrics ที่ต้อง CSV แต่ไม่มี → อาจ Score ผิด
✅ ใหม่: Mark ชัดว่า SKIPPED_NO_DATA:
  - Sortino Ratio        → Dim 2
  - Monthly Consistency  → Dim 4 (ทั้ง Dimension)
  - Top 5 Profit Share   → Dim 6
  - Signal 3 (R²)        → Overfitting
  - Signal 5 (Opt Density) → Overfitting
  Skipped dimensions ไม่นับใน Color Count
  Verdict ปรับ Conservative แทน

BUG-FIX 3: Diverse Regimes → Test Period Years
───────────────────────────────────────────────
❌ เดิม: "covers bull+bear+range" — AI ตัดสินแบบ Subjective
✅ ใหม่: Test Period Length (Rule วัดได้):
  ≥ 3 years = GREEN
  2-3 years = YELLOW
  1-2 years = ORANGE
  < 1 year  = RED
```

# 🔗 รวมกันได้ไหม?

## วิเคราะห์แต่ละคู่

```
robustness + backtest-analyzer รวมได้ไหม?
→ ❌ ไม่ควร
  Backtest = วิเคราะห์ผล 1 Run
  Robustness = ทดสอบว่า "ผลนั้น Stable ไหม"
  Input ต่างกัน Logic ต่างกัน

robustness + portfolio รวมได้ไหม?
→ ❌ ไม่ควร
  Robustness = ทดสอบ EA เดี่ยว
  Portfolio = ประเมิน EA หลายตัวร่วมกัน
  Concern ต่างกันสิ้นเชิง

portfolio + live-deployment รวมได้ไหม?
→ 🟡 รวมได้ถ้าเทรดแบบ Single EA เท่านั้น
  ถ้า Multi-EA ต้องแยกเพราะ Portfolio Selection
  เป็น Input ของ Deployment ไม่ใช่ส่วนเดียวกัน
```

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Skill 4: robustness-validator.md                   │
│  Input : Spec Card + Backtest Analysis YAML         │
│  Do    : Monte Carlo + Walk-Forward + OOS           │
│  Output: Robustness Score + PASS/FAIL               │
│  Scope : EA เดี่ยว เท่านั้น                         │
└──────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘
                       ↓ PASS
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Skill 5: portfolio-selector.md                     │
│  Input : EA Collection + Robustness Scores          │
│  Do    : Correlation Analysis + Weight Allocation   │
│  Output: Portfolio Composition + Max Lot per EA     │
│  Scope : Multi-EA เท่านั้น (Single EA → Skip)       │
└──────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘
                       ↓
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Skill 6: live-deployment-controller.md             │
│  Input : Robustness Score + Portfolio (if any)      │
│  Do    : Gate Check + Kill-Switch Rules             │
│  Output: DEPLOY_APPROVED / HOLD / REJECT            │
│  Scope : Final Gate เท่านั้น                        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Option B — ยุบ Portfolio + Live เป็น 1 Skill

```
ทำได้ถ้า:
├── ใช้ Single EA เป็นหลัก
├── Portfolio Selection ไม่ซับซ้อน
└── Live Gate ไม่ต้องการ Portfolio Weight

ชื่อ: deployment-controller.md
Input: Robustness Score + (Optional: EA List)
```

---

# 🔍 วิเคราะห์แต่ละ Skill ลึกขึ้น

## Skill 4: robustness-validator.md

```
หน้าที่: ทดสอบว่า Backtest Result "Stable" หรือ "Lucky"

3 Tests:
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Test 1: Monte Carlo Simulation              │
│  → สุ่ม Trade Order 1,000 ครั้ง            │
│  → ดูว่า DD / PF ยังอยู่ใน Range ไหม      │
│  → Output: DD Percentile 95 / PF Range      │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Test 2: Walk-Forward Analysis (WFA)         │
│  → แบ่ง Data เป็น Window เดิน Forward      │
│  → In-Sample Optimize → Out-of-Sample Test │
│  → Efficiency Ratio = OOS PF / IS PF       │
│  → Output: WFA Efficiency Ratio            │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Test 3: Out-of-Sample (OOS) Test            │
│  → ข้อมูลที่ไม่ได้ใช้ Optimize             │
│  → Run EA บน Period ใหม่                    │
│  → Compare: OOS PF vs IS PF                │
│  → Output: OOS Degradation %               │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Verdict: ROBUST / MARGINAL / NOT_ROBUST
```

## Skill 5: portfolio-selector.md

```
หน้าที่: เลือก EA หลายตัวให้ Correlation ต่ำ

Core Logic:
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Step 1: Correlation Matrix                  │
│  → คำนวณ Correlation ระหว่าง EA pairs       │
│  → Corr < 0.3 = Good / > 0.7 = Avoid       │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Step 2: Portfolio Optimization              │
│  → Max Sharpe / Min DD / Equal Risk        │
│  → Output: Weight per EA                   │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Step 3: Combined Risk Check                 │
│  → Total DD ถ้า EA ทุกตัว DD พร้อมกัน      │
│  → Max Lot per EA = f(Weight × TotalLot)    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Verdict: PORTFOLIO_APPROVED / REBALANCE / REJECT
```

## Skill 6: live-deployment-controller.md

```
หน้าที่: Gate สุดท้าย + Kill-Switch Rules

Structure:
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Pre-Deploy Checklist (Static)               │
│  → Robustness Score ผ่าน threshold          │
│  → Account สามารถรับ Max DD ได้             │
│  → Broker Requirements ครบ                  │
│  → Forward Test ผ่านหรือไม่                 │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Monitoring Criteria (Dynamic)               │
│  → Live DD > X% → Alert                    │
│  → Live PF ต่ำกว่า Backtest PF × Y → Alert │
│  → Consecutive Loss > N → Pause            │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Kill-Switch Rules                           │
│  → Live DD > Emergency DD → STOP           │
│  → Anomaly Trade (Lot × 5) → STOP         │
│  → Broker Error Streak → STOP             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Output: DEPLOY_APPROVED / HOLD / REJECT + Monitoring Config
```

---

# 📊 เปรียบเทียบ Option

| | Option A (3 Skills) | Option B (2 Skills) |
|---|---|---|
| **ความชัดเจน** | สูง แต่ละ Skill ทำอย่างเดียว | กลาง บาง Logic ปนกัน |
| **ใช้งานง่าย** | ต้อง Run 3 ขั้น | Run 2 ขั้น ถ้า Single EA |
| **ขยายได้ในอนาคต** | ง่าย เพิ่ม Skill ใหม่ได้ | ยาก ต้องแก้ Skill ที่มี |
| **เหมาะกับคุณ** | ถ้า Plan จะเทรด Multi-EA | ถ้าใช้ Single EA ตลอด |

---

# 🎯 คำแนะนำตรงๆ

```
แนะนำ Option A ครับ แต่ปรับลำดับ Priority:

Priority 1: robustness-validator.md
→ จำเป็นมากที่สุด ใช้กับ EA เดี่ยวทันที
→ ทำก่อน

Priority 2: live-deployment-controller.md
→ จำเป็น เป็น Gate สุดท้าย
→ ทำเป็นอันดับ 2

Priority 3: portfolio-selector.md
→ ทำเมื่อมี EA หลายตัวแล้ว
→ สามารถข้ามไปก่อนได้
→ ทำทีหลังก็ได้
```

# 📋 โครงสร้าง Skills ที่แนะนำ

## robustness-validator.md v1.0

```yaml
name: robustness-validator
role: Monte Carlo + WFA + OOS Analyst
inputs:
  required:
    - backtest_analysis_yaml (from backtest-report-analyzer)
    - spec_card_yaml
    - trade_list_csv (REQUIRED — ต่างจาก Skill 3)
  optional:
    - optimization_csv (for WFA window config)
outputs:
  - robustness_score (0-100)
  - monte_carlo_result
  - wfa_efficiency_ratio
  - oos_degradation_percent
  - verdict: ROBUST / MARGINAL / NOT_ROBUST

sections:
  1. Input Validation + Upstream Check (Skill 3 PASS required)
  2. Monte Carlo Simulation (1,000 runs)
     - Shuffle trade order → DD Distribution
     - Worst-case DD at 95th percentile
     - PF stability range
  3. Walk-Forward Analysis
     - Window: IS 70% / OOS 30% (3 windows minimum)
     - Efficiency Ratio = avg(OOS PF) / IS PF
     - Threshold: ER > 0.7 = Pass
  4. OOS Degradation Check
     - IS PF vs OOS PF comparison
     - Degradation < 25% = Pass
  5. Robustness Score (0-100)
     - Weighted: MC 40% + WFA 40% + OOS 20%
  6. Verdict + Handoff
     - ROBUST → live-deployment-controller.md
     - MARGINAL → return to strategy-and-risk.md
     - NOT_ROBUST → discard

key_rules:
  - Trade List CSV REQUIRED (ไม่ใช่ Optional)
  - ไม่ทำ Backtest ซ้ำ — ใช้ Trade Data จาก Skill 3
  - ไม่ตัดสิน Live Deployment — งานของ Skill 6
  - Monte Carlo ใช้ Simulation ไม่ใช่ Re-run MT5
```

## live-deployment-controller.md v1.0

```yaml
name: live-deployment-controller
role: Final Deployment Gate + Kill-Switch Design
inputs:
  required:
    - robustness_analysis_yaml (from robustness-validator)
    - spec_card_yaml
    - account_context:
        balance, broker, account_type (hedge/netting)
        max_risk_budget_percent
  optional:
    - portfolio_yaml (from portfolio-selector if Multi-EA)
outputs:
  - deployment_verdict: APPROVED / HOLD / REJECT
  - monitoring_config
  - kill_switch_rules
  - position_sizing_for_live

sections:
  1. Pre-Deploy Checklist (Static Gate)
     - Robustness Score >= threshold
     - Account Balance >= Minimum for EA's Risk%
     - Broker supports Hedging (if EA requires)
     - Forward Test Present? (Optional but noted)
  2. Live Monitoring Criteria
     - DD Alert Level: Backtest MaxDD × 1.2
     - PF Degradation Alert: PF < Backtest PF × 0.7
     - Consecutive Loss Alert: > MaxConsecLoss in Backtest
  3. Kill-Switch Rules
     - Hard Stop: Live DD >= EmergencyDD in Spec Card
     - Anomaly: Single Trade Lot > BaseLot × 3
     - Error Streak: 3 consecutive TRADE_RETCODE errors
     - Circuit Breaker: Carry over from EA config
  4. Position Sizing for Live
     - Adjust BaseLot if Live Balance ≠ Backtest Deposit
     - Scale: LiveLot = BacktestLot × (LiveBalance/TestDeposit)
  5. Deployment Verdict + Config Output

key_rules:
  - ไม่ Deploy ถ้า Robustness = NOT_ROBUST
  - ให้ Monitoring Config ที่ชัดเจน ไม่ใช่แค่ "คอยดู"
  - Kill-Switch เป็น Rule-based ไม่ใช่ Opinion
  - ไม่รับประกันผลกำไร Live
```

## portfolio-selector.md v1.0

```yaml
name: portfolio-selector
role: Multi-EA Portfolio Composition
inputs:
  required:
    - ea_collection: list of robustness_analysis_yaml
      (min 2 EAs, all with ROBUST or MARGINAL verdict)
    - portfolio_context:
        total_risk_budget_percent
        max_drawdown_portfolio
        target_sharpe
outputs:
  - portfolio_composition (EA + weight + max_lot)
  - correlation_matrix
  - combined_risk_estimate
  - verdict: APPROVED / REBALANCE / INSUFFICIENT_EAs

sections:
  1. Input Validation (ต้องมี >= 2 EAs ที่ผ่าน Robustness)
  2. Correlation Analysis
     - ใช้ Monthly Return ของแต่ละ EA (จาก Trade CSV)
     - Correlation Matrix
     - Pairs ที่ Corr > 0.7 = ไม่แนะนำใช้ร่วมกัน
  3. Portfolio Optimization
     - Method: Max Sharpe / Equal Risk / Min DD
     - Output: Weight per EA (สัดส่วน Lot)
  4. Combined Risk Check
     - Worst-case: ทุก EA DD พร้อมกัน 100%
     - Combined DD ≤ Portfolio Max DD Target
  5. Final Composition + Handoff to Deployment

key_rules:
  - ต้องมี >= 2 EAs ผ่าน Robustness ก่อน
  - Single EA → Skip Skill นี้ → ไป Deployment ตรง
  - ไม่รับประกัน Portfolio Performance
  - Correlation คำนวณจาก Monthly Return ไม่ใช่ Correlation ของ Symbol
```

# 🚀 แนะนำขั้นตอนต่อไป

```
Option 1: เขียน robustness-validator.md ก่อน
          → ใช้กับ HalfTrend EA ได้ทันที
          → Chain จะสมบูรณ์ 4 Skills

Option 2: เขียน robustness + live-deployment พร้อมกัน
          → ได้ Full Usable Chain
          → Skip portfolio ไปก่อน

Option 3: เขียนทั้ง 3 พร้อมกัน
          → ครบ Chain ทันที
          → ใช้เวลามากขึ้นนิดหน่อย
```

You receive a trade list from a\\nPASSED backtest and apply three independent statistical tests\\nto determine whether the backtest result is **stable and\\nrepeatable** \\u2014 or **an artifact of overfitting / luck**.\\n\\nYou DO:\\n- Verify upstream PASS verdict exists before proceeding\\n- Run Monte Carlo simulation on trade order\\n- Compute Walk-Forward Analysis efficiency ratio\\n- Compute OOS degradation percentage\\n- Issue ROBUST / MARGINAL / NOT_ROBUST verdict\\n\\nYou DO NOT:\\n- \\u274c Re-run MT5 backtests\\n- \\u274c Recommend live trading\\n- \\u274c Modify EA code or parameters\\n- \\u274c Perform portfolio analysis (that is portfolio-selector.md)\\n- \\u274c Use vague language like \\\&quot;looks stable\\\&quot;\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 1 \\u2014 STRICT SCOPE BOUNDARIES\\n\\n### 1.1 What this skill DOES\\n- Validate upstream PASS verdict\\n- Monte Carlo: simulate 1,000 trade-order permutations\\n- WFA: compute IS/OOS efficiency across rolling windows\\n- OOS: measure PF degradation on held-out period\\n- Combine into Robustness Score (0\\u2013100)\\n\\n### 1.2 What this skill DOES NOT do\\n- \\u274c Backtest analysis (backtest-report-analyzer.md)\\n- \\u274c Portfolio correlation (portfolio-selector.md)\\n- \\u274c Live deployment gate (live-deployment-controller.md)\\n- \\u274c Code review or strategy redesign\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 2 \\u2014 INPUT VALIDATION (REFUSAL-FIRST)\\n\\n### 2.1 HARD_REQUIRED Inputs\\n\\n```\\nIF backtest_analysis_yaml.verdict != \\\&quot;PASS\\\&quot;:\\n    REFUSE with UPSTREAM_NOT_PASSED\\n\\nIF trade_list_csv NOT provided:\\n    REFUSE with MISSING_TRADE_CSV\\n    Note: Monte Carlo and WFA require trade-level data.\\n          HTML report alone is insufficient.\\n```\\n\\n### 2.2 Upstream Gate Check\\n\\n```\\nRequired from backtest_analysis_yaml:\\n  - Ensure backtest-report-analyzer.md issued PASS verdict\\n  - Provide trade_list_csv export from MT5\\n  - Minimum [n] trades required for this trade style\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 3 \\u2014 TEST 1: MONTE CARLO SIMULATION\\n\\n### 3.1 Method\\n\\n```\\nPurpose: Test if PF and DD are stable regardless of\\n         trade execution order (removes path dependency)\\n\\nProcess:\\n  1. Build distribution of 1,000 results\\n  4. Extract:\\n     - PF_median, PF_5th_percentile, PF_95th_percentile\\n     - DD_median, DD_95th_percentile (worst-case)\\n     - Probability of Ruin (DD &gt; EmergencyDD from Spec Card)\\n```\\n\\n### 3.2 Monte Carlo Scoring\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| PF 5th Percentile | &gt; 1.2 | 1.0\\u20131.2 | 0.8\\u20131.0 | &lt; 0.8 |\\n| DD 95th Percentile | &lt; MaxDD + 5% | +5\\u201310% | +10\\u201320% | &gt; +20% |\\n| Probability of Ruin | &lt; 2% | 2\\u20135% | 5\\u201310% | &gt; 10% |\\n| PF Range (95th\\u20135th) | &lt; 0.5 | 0.5\\u20131.0 | 1.0\\u20131.5 | &gt; 1.5 |\\n\\n```\\nMC_Score =\\n  PF_5th        \\u2192 35 pts max\\n  DD_95th       \\u2192 35 pts max\\n  Ruin_Prob     \\u2192 20 pts max\\n  PF_Stability  \\u2192 10 pts max\\n```\\n\\n### 3.3 Monte Carlo Output Format\\n\\n```\\n\\ud83d\\udcca MONTE CARLO (1,000 simulations)\\nPF Distribution  : median=1.74 | 5th=1.31 | 95th=2.28\\nDD Distribution  : median=18.2% | 95th=26.8%\\nProbability Ruin : 1.4%  (DD &gt; EmergencyDD 70%)\\nPF Stability     : range 0.97 (95th\\u20135th)\\nMC Score         : 72 / 100\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 4 \\u2014 TEST 2: WALK-FORWARD ANALYSIS (WFA)\\n\\n### 4.1 Method\\n\\n```\\nPurpose: Test if optimized parameters generalize to\\n         unseen data (detects curve-fitting)\\n\\nProcess:\\n  1. Split total test period into rolling windows\\n     Default split: IS 70% / OOS 30%\\n     Minimum 3 windows required\\n\\n  2. For each window:\\n     - IS period: identify best parameters\\n       (from optimization_csv if available,\\n        else use original Spec Card params)\\n     - OOS period: apply those params to unseen data\\n     - Record: IS_PF and OOS_PF per window\\n\\n  3. Compute:\\n     WFA_Efficiency_Ratio = mean(OOS_PF) / mean(IS_PF)\\n     WFA_Consistency = % of windows where OOS_PF &gt; 1.0\\n```\\n\\n### 4.2 WFA Window Sizing by Trade Style\\n\\n```\\nSCALPING  : 3-month IS / 1-month OOS  (min 6 windows)\\nINTRADAY  : 6-month IS / 2-month OOS  (min 4 windows)\\nSWING     : 12-month IS / 4-month OOS (min 3 windows)\\nPOSITION  : 18-month IS / 6-month OOS (min 3 windows)\\n```\\n\\n### 4.3 WFA Scoring\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| Efficiency Ratio (ER) | &gt; 0.80 | 0.65\\u20130.80 | 0.50\\u20130.65 | &lt; 0.50 |\\n| OOS Windows Profitable | &gt; 70% | 55\\u201370% | 40\\u201355% | &lt; 40% |\\n| OOS vs IS PF Degradation | &lt; 15% | 15\\u201330% | 30\\u201350% | &gt; 50% |\\n\\n```\\nWFA_Score =\\n  ER               \\u2192 50 pts max\\n  OOS_Profitable%  \\u2192 30 pts max\\n  Degradation      \\u2192 20 pts max\\n```\\n\\n### 4.4 WFA Output Format\\n\\n```\\n\\ud83d\\udcca WALK-FORWARD ANALYSIS (4 windows)\\nIS/OOS Split     : 70% / 30%  (6-month / 2-month)\\nEfficiency Ratio : 0.76\\nOOS Windows Prof : 3/4  (75%)\\nAvg IS PF        : 1.94  \\u2192  Avg OOS PF: 1.47\\nDegradation      : 24.2%\\nWFA Score        : 65 / 100\\n\\nWindow Detail:\\n  W1: IS PF=2.1 | OOS PF=1.6 | \\u2705\\n  W2: IS PF=1.8 | OOS PF=1.4 | \\u2705\\n  W3: IS PF=2.2 | OOS PF=1.7 | \\u2705\\n  W4: IS PF=1.7 | OOS PF=0.9 | \\u274c\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 5 \\u2014 TEST 3: OUT-OF-SAMPLE (OOS) TEST\\n\\n### 5.1 Method\\n\\n```\\nPurpose: Validate on data completely excluded\\n         from optimization process\\n\\nProcess:\\n  1. Identify OOS period:\\n     - User specifies a held-out date range\\n     - OR: use last 20% of available data (not in backtest)\\n\\n  2. Compare:\\n     - In-Sample (IS) metrics from backtest\\n     - OOS metrics from OOS run\\n\\n  3. Compute:\\n     OOS_Degradation = (IS_PF - OOS_PF) / IS_PF \\u00d7 100%\\n     OOS_DD_Expansion = (OOS_MaxDD - IS_MaxDD) / IS_MaxDD \\u00d7 100%\\n     OOS_Trade_Frequency = OOS trades/month vs IS Expansion | &lt; 20% | 20\\u201340% | 40\\u201370% | &gt; 70% |\\n| Trade Frequency Change | &lt; 20% | 20\\u201335% | 35\\u201350% | &gt; 50% |\\n| OOS PF &gt; 1.0 | yes | \\u2014 | \\u2014 | no |\\n\\n```\\nOOS_Score =\\n  PF_Degradation     \\u2192 40 pts max\\n  DD_Expansion       \\u2192 30 pts max\\n  Trade_Freq_Change  \\u2192 15 pts max\\n  OOS_PF_Positive    \\u2192 15 pts max\\n```\\n\\n### 5.3 OOS Output Format\\n\\n```\\n\\ud83d\\udcca OUT-OF-SAMPLE TEST\\nIS Period  : 2020-01-01 \\u2192 2023-12-31  (4 years)\\nOOS Period : 2024-01-01 \\u2192 2024-12-31  (1 year)\\n\\nIS   PF: 1.82  \\u2192  OOS PF: 1.41  (Degradation: 22.5%)\\nIS  MaxDD: 18.4%  \\u2192  OOS MaxDD: 21.2%  (Expansion: 15.2%)\\nIS  Trades/Mo: 10.1  \\u2192  OOS: 9.4  (Change: -6.9%)\\nOOS Score : 74 / 100\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 6 \\u2014 ROBUSTNESS SCORE\\n\\n### 6.1 Weighted Formula\\n\\n```\\nRobustness_Score =\\n    MC_Score  \\u00d7 0.40   (Monte Carlo)\\n  + WFA_Score \\u00d7 0.40   (Walk-Forward)\\n  + OOS_Score \\u00d7 0.20   (Out-of-Sample)\\n\\nRange: 0\\u2013100\\n```\\n\\n### 6.2 Score Bands\\n\\n| Score | Band | Meaning |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| 75\\u2013100 | \\ud83d\\udfe2 ROBUST | High confidence in stability |\\n| 55\\u201374 | \\ud83d\\udfe1 MARGINAL | Conditionally stable \\u2014 monitor closely |\\n| 0\\u201354 | \\ud83d\\udd34 NOT_ROBUST | Unstable \\u2014 do not deploy |\\n\\n### 6.3 Hard Override Rules\\n\\n```\\nFORCE NOT_ROBUST (regardless of score):\\n  - MC Probability of Ruin &gt; 10%\\n  - WFA Efficiency Ratio &lt; 0.50\\n  - OOS PF &lt;
