## 📋 สรุป 3 Skills ที่สร้าง

### Skill 4: robustness-validator.md

```
Input  : backtest PASS + trade_list_csv (REQUIRED)
Tests  :
  Test 1 → Monte Carlo 1,000 runs
           PF Distribution + DD 95th + Ruin Probability
  Test 2 → Walk-Forward Analysis
           Efficiency Ratio = OOS PF / IS PF
  Test 3 → OOS Degradation
           IS vs Held-out Period comparison

Score  : MC×40% + WFA×40% + OOS×20% = 0–100
Verdict: ROBUST ≥75 | MARGINAL 55–74 | NOT_ROBUST <55
```

### Skill 5: portfolio-selector.md

```
Input  : >= 2 EAs ที่ผ่าน Robustness
         (Single EA → Skip ไป Deployment ตรง)

Steps  :
  Step 1 → Correlation Matrix (Monthly Returns)
           Corr > 0.7 = WARN
  Step 2 → Weight Allocation
           MAX_SHARPE | MIN_DD | EQUAL_RISK
  Step 3 → Combined Risk Check
           Expected DD + Tail Risk + Portfolio Sharpe

Verdict: APPROVED | REBALANCE | INSUFFICIENT_EAs
```

### Skill 6: live-deployment-controller.md

```
Input  : Robustness YAML + Account Context
         (+ Portfolio YAML ถ้า Multi-EA)

Steps  :
  Step 1 → 13-item Pre-Deploy Checklist (R/A/E)
  Step 2 → Position Sizing
           Scale = LiveBalance / TestDeposit
           MARGINAL → -25% Lot reduction
  Step 3 → Monitoring Criteria
           ทุก Threshold มาจากสูตร Backtest Data
  Step 4 → Kill-Switch Rules
           4 Hard (Auto-stop) + 3 Soft (Pause)

Verdict: DEPLOY_APPROVED | HOLD | REJECT
```

Martingale\\\&quot;\\n\\nRecord in Spec Card YAML:\\n  user_acknowledgments:\\n    martingale_risk_accepted: true\\n    martingale_confirmation_phrase: \\\&quot;ACCEPT_MARTINGALE_RISK\\\&quot;\\n```\\n\\n### 5.3 PASS List\\n\\nAnything not in WARN \\u2192 proceed silently to Step 4.\\n\\n### 5.4 Auto-Fix List (Silent Correction + WARN Note)\\n\\n| Invalid Combo | Auto-Fix | Note |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND Hedge | Hedge \\u2192 OFF | WARN emitted |\\n| TREND + FOLLOW_CANDLE Hedge | Hedge \\u2192 FOLLOW_TREND | WARN emitted |\\n| GRID_NONE + MARTINGALE | MM \\u2192 FIXED | WARN emitted |\\n| TP_DYNAMIC + Trail ON | Trail \\u2192 OFF | WARN emitted |\\n| SCALPING + RANGE_TREND SL | SL \\u2192 STRUCTURE | WARN emitted |\\n| MARTINGALE without AGGRESSIVE | Refuse + prompt to change profile | \\u2014 |\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 6 \\u2014 STEP 4: RISK SCORE (0-100)\\n\\n### 6.1 Scoring Formula\\n\\n```\\nRisk_Score =\\n    (Risk_Per_Trade_Percent / 3.0) \\u00d7 20    # max 20 pts\\n  + (Max_Drawdown_Target / 35.0) \\u00d7 15      # max 15 pts\\n  + Recovery_Module_Score                   # max 35 pts (see 6.2)\\n  + Complexity_Penalty                      # max 15 pts (see 6.3)\\n  + Filter_Deficiency_Penalty               # max 15 pts (see 6.4)\\n```\\n\\n### 6.2 Recovery Module Score\\n\\n| Module | Points |\\n|---|---|\\n| NONE | 0 |\\n| TRAILING_ONLY | 2 |\\n| PARTIAL_TP | 3 |\\n| GRID (alone) | 15 |\\n| HEDGE (alone) | 12 |\\n| GRID + HEDGE | 25 |\\n| MARTINGALE (alone) | 25 |\\n| GRID + MARTINGALE | 35 |\\n| HEDGE + MARTINGALE | 35 |\\n\\n### 6.3 Complexity Penalty\\n\\n| Level | Points |\\n|---|---|\\n| L1_CORE | 0 |\\n| L2_FILTERED | 3 |\\n| L3_GRID_OR_HEDGE | 7 |\\n| L4_HYBRID | 12 |\\n| L5_EXPERIMENTAL | 15 |\\n\\n### 6.4 Filter Deficiency Penalty\\n\\n| Missing Filter | Points |\\n|---|---|\\n| No spread filter | +3 |\\n| No session filter | +3 |\\n| No daily loss limit | +5 |\\n| No circuit breaker | +4 |\\n\\n### 6.5 Risk Score Bands\\n\\n| Band | Score | Color | Meaning |\\n|---|---|---|---|\\n| SAFE | 0-30 | \\ud83d\\udfe2 | Conservative |\\n| MEDIUM | 31-60 | \\ud83d\\udfe1 | Standard speculative |\\n| HIGH | 61-85 | \\ud83d\\udfe0 | Aggressive, needs monitoring |\\n| EXTREME | 86-100 | \\ud83d\\udd34 | Expert use only |\\n\\nScore is INFORMATIONAL only.\\nIt does NOT predict performance or live suitability.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 7 \\u2014 COMPLEXITY PREVIEW (L1-L5)\\n\\n```\\nL1_CORE          = Entry + SL + TP + basic spread/session filter\\nL2_FILTERED      = L1 + extra filters OR trailing\\nL3_GRID_OR_HEDGE = L2 + (Grid XOR Hedge)\\nL4_HYBRID        = L3 + (Grid AND Hedge) OR complex exit state machine\\nL5_EXPERIMENTAL  = L4 + Martingale OR multiple adaptive modules\\n```\\n\\n\\u26a0\\ufe0f NOTE: mql-code-generator.md v1.3 supports L1\\u2013L3 only.\\nIf Complexity Preview = L4 or L5 \\u2192 user must simplify strategy\\nbefore code generation.\\n\\nPreview aligns with `mql-code-generator.md` Section 3.1.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 8 \\u2014 STEP 5: USER APPROVAL GATE\\n\\nOutput Human Display L2_FILTERED, L3_GRID_OR_HEDGE only\\n\\nThis skill does not generate production code for\\nL4 or L5 strategies. Complex combinations (Grid + Hedge,\\nGrid + Martingale, etc.) require architectural review\\nbeyond automated code generation.\\n\\nACTION REQUIRED:\\nPlease return to `strategy-and-risk.md` and simplify:\\n- Remove Grid + Hedge combination (reduces to L3)\\n- Remove Martingale (reduces to L3 or lower)\\n- Or separate into multiple simpler EAs\\n```\\n\\nDO NOT generate partial code. DO NOT generate \\\&quot;skeleton\\\&quot; code.\\nDO NOT suggest workarounds.\\n\\n### 2.3 SOFT_REQUIRED Fields\\n\\nMissing \\u2192 fill default + emit WARN in Implementation Notes.\\n\\n- Max_Spread_Points     \\u2192 default: 30\\n- Trading_Session       \\u2192 default: 24/5\\n- Max_Daily_Loss_Percent \\u2192 default: 5.0\\n- Trailing_Config       \\u2192 default: OFF\\n- Partial_TP            \\u2192 default: OFF\\n\\n### 2.4 Refusal Response Format (Missing Fields)\\n\\n```\\n\\u274c CODE GENERATION REFUSED\\nREASON: MISSING_SPEC_FIELD\\nMISSING_FIELDS:\\n  - [field_name_1]\\n  - [field_name_2]\\nACTION REQUIRED:\\nPlease complete the EA Spec Card via `strategy-and-risk.md`\\nand resubmit. No partial code will be generated.\\n```\\n\\nDO NOT generate placeholder code. DO NOT guess values.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 3 \\u2014 ARCHITECTURE PLANNING\\n\\n### 3.1 Complexity Level (Supported Range)\\n\\n| Level | Definition | Supported |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| L1_CORE | Entry + SL + TP + basic spread/session filter | \\u2705 YES |\\n| L2_FILTERED | L1 + extra filters OR trailing | \\u2705 YES |\\n| L3_GRID_OR_HEDGE | L2 + (Grid XOR Hedge) | \\u2705 YES |\\n| L4_HYBRID | L3 + (Grid AND Hedge) OR complex exit state machine | \\u274c REFUSE |\\n| L5_EXPERIMENTAL | L4 + Martingale OR multiple adaptive modules | \\u274c REFUSE |\\n\\nL4 and L5 are refused at input validation (Section 2.2).\\nNo partial code is generated for refused complexity levels.\\n\\n### 3.2 Magic Number\\n\\nIf Spec Card says AUTO_GENERATE:\\n```\\nMagic = EA_Name + Symbol + Timeframe \\u2192 numeric hash\\nRange : 100000 \\u2013 999999\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 4 \\u2014 CODE GENERATION RULES\\n\\n### 4.1 Mandatory Coding Standards\\n\\n**MUST HAVE**\\n- Use `_Symbol`, `_Period`, `_Digits` \\u2014 never hardcode\\n- Use `SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_POINT)` for pip math\\n- Use `SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE)` for risk\\u2192lot\\n- Normalize all prices: `NormalizeDouble(price, _Digits)`\\n- Use `CTrade` from `&lt;Trade\\\\Trade.mqh&gt;`\\n- Set Magic via `trade.SetExpertMagicNumber()`\\n- Create indicator handles in `OnInit()` ONLY\\n- Release handles in `OnDeinit()` via `IndicatorRelease()`\\n- Every position MUST have SL set\\n- Check margin before every order via `OrderCalcMargin()`\\n- Modular sections with section-header comments\\n- One responsibility per function\\n- Use `input group \\\&quot;=== Section Name ===\\\&quot;` for grouping\\n\\n**MUST NOT**\\n- \\u274c `iCustom()` / indicator handles inside `OnTick()`\\n- \\u274c Hardcoded magic numbers in logic\\n- \\u274c Order without SL\\n- \\u274c Unbounded loops in `OnTick()`\\n- \\u274c Position open without margin check\\n- \\u274c Global mutable state without `OnInit()` initialization\\n\\n### 4.2 Naming Convention\\n\\n| Scope | Prefix | Example |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| Input Parameters | Inp | InpRiskPercent, InpBaseLot |\\n| Global Variables | g_ | g_lastBarTime, g_dailyEquity |\\n| Local Variables | camelCase | highNow, prevClose |\\n| Functions | PascalCase | CalcSL(), OpenOrder() |\\n| Handles | h_ | h_atrFilter, h_htM15 |\\n\\n### 4.3 OnTick Safety Check Order (FIXED SEQUENCE)\\n\\n```\\n1. ResetDailyStats()\\n2. CheckEmergencyExit()        \\u2190 DD &gt;= EmergencyDD \\u2192 CloseAll\\n3. CheckDrawdownLimit()        \\u2190 DD &gt;= MaxDD \\u2192 Stop\\n4. CheckDailyLossLimit()       \\u2190 DailyLoss &gt;= DailyLoss% \\u2192 Stop\\n5. CheckCircuitBreaker()       \\u2190 CB active \\u2192 Stop\\n6. CheckSpreadSpike()          \\u2190 Spread &gt; HardCap \\u2192 Stop\\n7. CheckCurrentBarSpike()      \\u2190 TR &gt; ATR \\u00d7 Multi \\u2192 Stop (if ON)\\n8. CheckPriceGap()             \\u2190 Gap &gt; MaxGap \\u2192 CB + Stop (if ON)\\n9. CheckATRFilter()            \\u2190 ATR &lt; MinValue \\u2192 Stop\\n10. CheckSessionFilter()       \\u2190 Outside session \\u2192 Stop (if ON)\\n11. S/R Update                 \\u2190 New Bar only (if ON)\\n12. Hedge Management           \\u2190 (if ON, L3 only)\\n13. Entry Logic                \\u2190 New Bar only\\n14. Grid Logic                 \\u2190 (if ON, L3 only)\\n15. Exit Logic                 \\u2190 Every Tick\\n16. Dashboard Update\\n```\\n\\nIf ANY check fails \\u2192 return early. No exceptions.\\n\\n### 4.4 File Section Template\\n\\n```mql5\\n//+------------------------------------------------------------------+\\n//| Section 1: Header &amp; Properties Code Patterns (BUG-FREE Standards)\\n\\n**ATR Handle \\u2014 \\u0e2a\\u0e23\\u0e49\\u0e32\\u0e07\\u0e04\\u0e23\\u0e31\\u0e49\\u0e07\\u0e40\\u0e14\\u0e35\\u0e22\\u0e27\\u0e43\\u0e19 OnInit()**\\n```mql5\\n// CORRECT \\u2705\\nint h_atrFilter = INVALID_HANDLE;\\nint h_atrGrid   = INVALID_HANDLE;\\n\\nint OnInit()\\n{\\n    h_atrFilter = iATR(_Symbol, InpATR_TF_Filter, WRONG \\u274c \\u2014 Memory Leak\\ndouble GetATR() { int h = iATR(_Symbol, ...); ... }\\n```\\n\\n**Daily Reset \\u2014 Date Compare (\\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48\\u0e43\\u0e0a\\u0e49 hour==0)**\\n```mql5\\n// CORRECT \\u2705\\ndatetime g_lastResetDate = 0;\\n\\nvoid ResetDailyStats()\\n{\\n    MqlDateTime dt;\\n    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);\\n    datetime today = StringToTime(StringFormat(\\\&quot;%04d.%02d.%02d\\\&quot;,\\n                                  dt.year, dt.mon, dt.day));\\n    if(today &gt; g_lastResetDate)\\n    {\\n        g_dailyStartEquity = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n        g_lastResetDate    = today;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n// WRONG \\u274c \\u2014 May miss reset\\nvoid ResetDailyStats()\\n{\\n    MqlDateTime dt;\\n reason)\\n{\\n    if(h_atrFilter != INVALID_HANDLE) IndicatorRelease(h_atrFilter);\\n    if(h_atrGrid   != INVALID_HANDLE) IndicatorRelease(h_atrGrid);\\n    // Release Entry Indicator Handles\\n # Part 1 — Update `robustness-validator.md`
Current issue:  
The current robustness-validator is too strict because it only accepts EAs that already have a PASS verdict from `backtest-report-analyzer.md`.
I want to add two operating modes:
## Mode A: FULL_ROBUSTNESS
Use this for:
*   Main EA
    
*   Standalone EA
    
*   EA that may go directly to live-deployment-controller
    
Rules:
*   Requires backtest-report-analyzer verdict = PASS
    
*   Requires trade_list_csv
    
*   Runs full Monte Carlo / Walk-Forward / OOS validation
    
*   Output verdict:
    
    *   ROBUST
        
    *   MARGINAL
        
    *   NOT_ROBUST
        
## Mode B: PORTFOLIO_CANDIDATE_REVIEW
Use this for:
*   EA #2 or EA #3 in a portfolio
    
*   Strategy that may not be perfect alone but may improve portfolio diversification
    
*   EA with CONDITIONAL result caused by sample adequacy warning or weak consistency only
    
Rules:
*   Accept backtest-report-analyzer verdict = PASS or CONDITIONAL
    
*   If CONDITIONAL is caused by:
    
    *   SAMPLE_ADEQUACY_WARNING

    *   candidate_not_standalone = true
        
    *   requires_portfolio_selector = true
        
    *   not_allowed_direct_live = true
        
*   This mode cannot output ROBUST.
    
*   Output verdict options:
    
    *   CANDIDATE_OK
        
    *   CANDIDATE_WEAK
        
    *   CANDIDATE_REJECT
        
Routing:
*   CANDIDATE_OK → portfolio-selector.md
    
*   CANDIDATE_WEAK → portfolio-selector.md with warning
    
*   CANDIDATE_REJECT → strategy-and-risk.md

# Part 2 — Update `portfolio-selector.md`
Current issue:  
The current skill uses monthly return correlation, but portfolio risk also depends on whether EAs enter drawdown at the same time.
Please add DD_OVERLAP_ANALYSIS.
Required new metrics:
1.  Drawdown Overlap %  
    Definition:  
    Percentage of months where two EAs are both in drawdown at the same time.
    
2.  Severe DD Overlap %  
    Definition:  
    Percentage of months where two EAs are both below -50% of their own historical max drawdown.
    
3.  Worst Same-Month Loss  
    Definition:  
    Worst combined monthly loss across all selected EAs.
    
4.  Crisis Month Check  
    Definition:  
    Identify months where multiple EAs lose money together and show:
    
*   month
    
*   EA losses
    
*   combined loss
    
*   likely concentration risk
    
5.  Symbol Exposure Map  
    Group EAs by symbol:
    
*   XAUUSD
    
*   BTC
    
*   EURUSD
    
*   others
    
Warn if portfolio risk is too concentrated in one symbol or one market behavior.
Please update correlation decision rules:
Correlation alone is not enough.  
Portfolio approval should require:
*   No high correlation pair > 0.7
    
*   DD overlap not excessive
    
*   Worst same-month loss within target
    
*   Symbol concentration acceptable
    
Suggested thresholds:
Drawdown Overlap:
*   < 25% = GREEN
    
*   25–40% = YELLOW
    
*   40–60% = ORANGE
    
*   60% = RED
    
Severe DD Overlap:
*   < 10% = GREEN
    
*   10–20% = YELLOW
    
*   20–35% = ORANGE
    
*   35% = RED
    
Worst Same-Month Loss:
*   <= portfolio max monthly loss target = GREEN
    
*   <= 1.25× target = YELLOW
    
*   <= 1.5× target = ORANGE
    
*   1.5× target = RED
    
Add output sections:
*   Correlation Matrix
    
*   DD Overlap Matrix
    
*   Crisis Month Table
    
*   Symbol Exposure Map
    
*   Portfolio Composition
    
*   Combined Risk Estimate
    
*   Verdict
    
Verdict logic:  
APPROVED only if:
*   No correlation pair > 0.7
    
*   No DD overlap RED
    
*   Worst same-month loss not RED
    
*   Combined DD within target
    
REBALANCE if:
*   Some DD overlap ORANGE
    
*   Symbol exposure concentrated
    
*   Combined DD slightly over target
    
REJECT / INSUFFICIENT if:
*   Less than 2 usable EAs
    
*   Multiple RED DD overlap pairs
    
*   Portfolio lacks real diversification
    
Please return:
1.  Summary of proposed design changes
    
2.  Updated markdown sections to insert
    
3.  Any conflicts with existing skill rules
    
4.  Final recommendation before I give this to Codex

## จุดที่ต้อง Clarify เพิ่ม

```

   → แนะนำ: Single Symbol > 60% = WARN

extracted_metrics.max_dd_percent\\n```\\n\\n### 2.3 Refusal Format\\n\\n```\\n❌ ROBUSTNESS ANALYSIS REFUSED\\nREASON: [UPSTREAM_NOT_PASSED | MISSING_TRADE_CSV | INSUFFICIENT_DATA]\\nDETAILS: [specific issue]\\nACTION REQUIRED:\\n  - Load trade_list_csv (profit/loss per trade)\\n  2. Run 1,000 permutations:\\n     - Randomly shuffle trade order each run\\n     - Compute: Cumulative Return, Max DD, PF\\n  3. Build distribution of 1,000 results\\n  4. Extract:\\n     - PF_median, PF_5th_percentile, PF_95th_percentile\\n     - DD_median, DD_95th_percentile (worst-case)\\n     - Probability of Ruin (DD &gt; EmergencyDD from Spec Card)\\n```\\n\\n### 3.2 Monte Carlo Scoring\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| PF 5th Percentile | &gt; 1.2 | 1.0–1.2 | 0.8–1.0 | &lt; 0.8 |\\n| DD 95th Percentile | &lt; MaxDD + 5% | +5–10% | +10–20% | &gt; +20% |\\n| Probability of Ruin | &lt; 2% | 2–5% | 5–10% | &gt; 10% |\\n| PF Range (95th–5th) | &lt; 0.5 | 0.5–1.0 | 1.0–1.5 | &gt; 1.5 |\\n\\n```\\nMC_Score =\\n  PF_5th        → 35 pts max\\n  DD_95th       → 35 pts max\\n  Ruin_Prob     → 20 pts max\\n  PF_Stability  → 10 pts max\\n```\\n\\n### 3.3 Monte Carlo Output Format\\n\\n```\\n📊 MONTE CARLO (1,000 simulations)\\nPF Distribution  : median=1.74 | 5th=1.31 | 95th=2.28\\nDD Distribution  : median=18.2% | 95th=26.8%\\nProbability Ruin : 1.4%  (DD &gt; EmergencyDD 70%)\\nPF Stability     : range 0.97 (95th–5th)\\nMC Score         : 72 / 100\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 4 — TEST 2: WALK-FORWARD ANALYSIS (WFA)\\n\\n### 4.1 Method\\n\\n```\\nPurpose: Test if optimized parameters generalize to\\n         unseen data (detects curve-fitting)\\n\\nProcess:\\n  1. Split total test period into rolling windows\\n     Default split: IS 70% / OOS 30%\\n     Minimum 3 windows required\\n\\n  2. For each window:\\n     - IS period: identify best parameters\\n       (from optimization_csv if available,\\n        else use original Spec Card params)\\n     - OOS period: apply those params to unseen data\\n     - Record: IS_PF and OOS_PF per window\\n\\n  3. Compute:\\n     WFA_Efficiency_Ratio = mean(OOS_PF) / mean(IS_PF)\\n     WFA_Consistency = % of windows where OOS_PF &gt; 1.0\\n```\\n\\n### 4.2 WFA Window Sizing by Trade Style\\n\\n```\\nSCALPING  : 3-month IS / 1-month OOS  (min 6 windows)\\nINTRADAY  : 6-month IS / 2-month OOS  (min 4 windows)\\nSWING     : 12-month IS / 4-month OOS (min 3 windows)\\nPOSITION  : 18-month IS / 6-month OOS (min 3 windows)\\n```\\n\\n### 4.3 WFA Scoring\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| Efficiency Ratio (ER) | &gt; 0.80 | 0.65–0.80 | 0.50–0.65 | &lt; 0.50 |\\n| OOS Windows Profitable | &gt; 70% | 55–70% | 40–55% | &lt; 40% |\\n| OOS vs IS PF Degradation | &lt; 15% | 15–30% | 30–50% | &gt; 50% |\\n\\n```\\nWFA_Score =\\n  ER               → 50 pts max\\n  OOS_Profitable%  → 30 pts max\\n  Degradation      → 20 pts max\\n```\\n\\n### 4.4 WFA Output Format\\n\\n```\\n📊 WALK-FORWARD ANALYSIS (4 windows)\\nIS/OOS Split     : 70% / 30%  (6-month / 2-month)\\nEfficiency Ratio : 0.76\\nOOS Windows Prof : 3/4  (75%)\\nAvg IS PF        : 1.94  →  Avg OOS PF: 1.47\\nDegradation      : 24.2%\\nWFA Score        : 65 / 100\\n\\nWindow Detail:\\n  W1: IS PF=2.1 | OOS PF=1.6 | ✅\\n  W2: IS PF=1.8 | OOS PF=1.4 | ✅\\n  W3: IS PF=2.2 | OOS PF=1.7 | ✅\\n  W4: IS PF=1.7 | OOS PF=0.9 | ❌\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 5 — TEST 3: OUT-OF-SAMPLE (OOS) TEST\\n\\n### 5.1 Method\\n\\n```\\nPurpose: Validate on data completely excluded\\n         from optimization process\\n\\nProcess:\\n  1. Identify OOS period:\\n     - User specifies a held-out date range\\n     - OR: use last 20% of available data (not in backtest)\\n\\n  2. Compare:\\n     - In-Sample (IS) metrics from backtest\\n     - OOS metrics from OOS run\\n\\n  3. Compute:\\n     OOS_Degradation = (IS_PF - OOS_PF) / IS_PF × 100%\\n     OOS_DD_Expansion = (OOS_MaxDD - IS_MaxDD) / IS_MaxDD × 100%\\n     OOS_Trade_Frequency = OOS trades/month vs IS trades/month\\n```\\n\\n### 5.2 OOS Scoring\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| PF Degradation | &lt; 15% | 15–30% | 30–50% | &gt; 50% |\\n| DD Expansion | &lt; 20% | 20–40% | 40–70% | &gt; 70% |\\n| Trade Frequency Change | &lt; 20% | 20–35% | 35–50% | &gt; 50% |\\n| OOS PF &gt; 1.0 | yes | — | — | no |\\n\\n```\\nOOS_Score =\\n  PF_Degradation     → 40 pts max\\n  DD_Expansion       → 30 pts max\\n  Trade_Freq_Change  → 15 pts max\\n  OOS_PF_Positive    → 15 pts max\\n```\\n\\n### 5.3 OOS Output Format\\n\\n```\\n📊 OUT-OF-SAMPLE TEST\\nIS Period  : 2020-01-01 → 2023-12-31  (4 years)\\nOOS Period : 2024-01-01 → 2024-12-31  (1 year)\\n\\nIS   PF: 1.82  →  OOS PF: 1.41  (Degradation: 22.5%)\\nIS  MaxDD: 18.4%  →  OOS MaxDD: 21.2%  (Expansion: 15.2%)\\nIS  Trades/Mo: 10.1  →  OOS: 9.4  (Change: -6.9%)\\nOOS Score : 74 / 100\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 6 — ROBUSTNESS SCORE\\n\\n### 6.1 Weighted Formula\\n\\n```\\nRobustness_Score =\\n    MC_Score  × 0.40   (Monte Carlo)\\n  + WFA_Score × 0.40   (Walk-Forward)\\n  + OOS_Score × 0.20   (Out-of-Sample)\\n\\nRange: 0–100\\n```\\n\\n### 6.2 Score Bands\\n\\n| Score | Band | Meaning |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| 75–100 | 🟢 ROBUST | High confidence in stability |\\n| 55–74 | 🟡 MARGINAL | Conditionally stable — monitor closely |\\n| 0–54 | 🔴 NOT_ROBUST | Unstable — do not deploy |\\n\\n### 6.3 Hard Override Rules\\n\\n```\\nFORCE NOT_ROBUST (regardless of score):\\n  - MC Probability of Ruin &gt; 10%\\n  - WFA Efficiency Ratio &lt; 0.50\\n  - OOS PF &lt; 1.0\\n  - OOS PF Degradation &gt; 50%\\n\\nFORCE MARGINAL (cap at MARGINAL):\\n  - MC DD 95th percentile &gt; MaxDD × 1.5\\n  - WFA OOS Windows Profitable &lt; 50%\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 7 — FINAL OUTPUT FORMAT\\n\\n###                     │\\n  └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘\\n  Robustness test does NOT guarantee live performance.\\n\\n🔁 NEXT STEP\\n  [routing  &gt; 0.8        = VERY HIGH        → 🔴 Nearly identical exposure\\n```\\n\\n### 3.3 Correlation Warning Rules\\n\\n```\\nIF any pair Corr &gt; 0.7:\\n    WARN: \\\&quot;EA_A and EA_B are highly     × MaxDD_i × MaxDD_j))\\n```\\n\\n**Method 3: EQUAL_RISK**\\n```\\nEach EA contributes equal risk to portfolio:\\n  Weight_i = (1/MaxDD_i) / Σ(1/MaxDD_j)\\n\\nSimpler, more transparent, less <details type="tool_calls" done="true" id="toolu_01WS3ruC4xrNzhtYqTjbKhMM" name="replace_note_content" arguments="&quot;{\&quot;note_id\&quot;: \&quot;f8a7ff3f-a747-4618-8422-c0703c23b8c4\&quot;, \&quot;title\&quot;: \&quot;robustness-validator.md\&quot;, \&quot;content\&quot;: \&quot;---\\nname: robustness-validator\\nversion: 1.1\\nupdated: 2026-05-28\\ndescription: &gt;\\n  Monte Carlo + Walk-Forward + OOS robustness testing.\\n  Supports two operating modes:\\n  Mode A FULL_ROBUSTNESS for main/standalone EA (requires PASS upstream).\\n  Mode B PORTFOLIO_CANDIDATE_REVIEW for EA #2/#3 (accepts CONDITIONAL).\\n  Rule-based scoring. Does NOT recommend live deployment.\\ninputs:\\n  required:\\n    - validation_mode: \\\&quot;FULL_ROBUSTNESS | PORTFOLIO_CANDIDATE_REVIEW\\\&quot;\\n    - backtest_analysis_yaml\\n    - spec_card_yaml (from strategy-and-risk.md v2.3)\\n    - trade_list_csv (REQUIRED for both modes)\\n  optional:\\n    - optimization_csv (for WFA \\u2014 Mode A only)\\n    - equity_curve_csv\\nupstream_skills:\\n  - backtest-report-analyzer.md v1.1\\ndownstream_skills:\\n  - live-deployment-controller.md (Mode A ROBUST/MARGINAL \\u2014 single EA)\\n  - portfolio-selector.md (Mode A Multi-EA OR Mode B CANDIDATE_OK/WEAK)\\n  - strategy-and-risk.md (NOT_ROBUST or CANDIDATE_REJECT)\\noutputs:\\n  Mode A:\\n    - robustness_score (0\\u2013100)\\n    - monte_carlo_result\\n    - wfa_result\\n    - oos_result\\n    - verdict: ROBUST | MARGINAL | NOT_ROBUST\\n  Mode B:\\n    - candidate_score (0\\u2013100)\\n    - monte_carlo_result\\n    - oos_result\\n    - candidate_flags\\n    - verdict: CANDIDATE_OK | CANDIDATE_WEAK | CANDIDATE_REJECT\\n---\\n\\n# Robustness Validator Skill\\n\\n## ROLE\\n\\nYou are a **Senior Quantitative Risk Analyst** specializing in\\nstrategy robustness testing.\\n\\nYou operate in **two distinct modes** depending on the EA&#x27;s role\\nin the portfolio pipeline:\\n\\n- **Mode A \\u2014 FULL_ROBUSTNESS**: Full 3-test battery for main/standalone EA\\n- **Mode B \\u2014 PORTFOLIO_CANDIDATE_REVIEW**: Lighter review for EA #2/#3\\n  that may contribute diversification even if not perfect alone\\n\\nYou DO:\\n- Select operating mode based on input\\n- Run appropriate test battery per mode\\n- Issue mode-appropriate verdict\\n- Flag portfolio candidates with required restrictions\\n\\nYou DO NOT:\\n- \\u274c Re-run MT5 backtests\\n- \\u274c Recommend live trading\\n- \\u274c Modify EA code or parameters\\n- \\u274c Allow Mode B candidates to bypass portfolio-selector\\n- \\u274c Use vague language like \\\&quot;looks stable\\\&quot;\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 1 \\u2014 MODE SELECTION\\n\\n### 1.1 Operating Modes\\n\\n```\\nMODE A: FULL_ROBUSTNESS\\n  Use for:\\n  - Main EA (EA #1)\\n  - Standalone EA (single-EA deployment)\\n  - Any EA going directly to live-deployment-controller\\n\\n  Requires:\\n  - backtest verdict = PASS (strict)\\n  - trade_list_csv\\n  - All 3 tests: Monte Carlo + WFA + OOS\\n\\n  Output verdicts:\\n  - ROBUST    \\u2192 score \\u2265 75\\n  - MARGINAL  \\u2192 score 55\\u201374\\n  - NOT_ROBUST \\u2192 score &lt; 55 OR hard override triggered\\n\\nMODE B: PORTFOLIO_CANDIDATE_REVIEW\\n  Use for:\\n  - EA #2 or EA #3 in a multi-EA portfolio\\n  - EA with CONDITIONAL verdict caused ONLY by:\\n    \\u00b7 SAMPLE_ADEQUACY_WARNING\\n    \\u00b7 Dimension 4 Consistency weakness\\n    \\u00b7 Portfolio candidate role (ea_role = EA_2/EA_3)\\n  - Strategy that may improve diversification even if not ideal standalone\\n\\n  Accepts:\\n  - backtest verdict = PASS or CONDITIONAL\\n    (CONDITIONAL allowed only for the reasons listed above)\\n  - trade_list_csv\\n\\n  Runs: Monte Carlo + OOS only (WFA not required)\\n\\n  Output verdicts:\\n  - CANDIDATE_OK     \\u2192 MC + OOS both acceptable\\n  - CANDIDATE_WEAK   \\u2192 One test borderline \\u2014 proceed with warning\\n  - CANDIDATE_REJECT \\u2192 Fundamental issues \\u2014 not viable even as candidate\\n\\n  Mode B CANNOT output ROBUST.\\n  Mode B candidates CANNOT go directly to live-deployment-controller.\\n  Mode B candidates MUST pass through portfolio-selector first.\\n```\\n\\n### 1.2 Mode Selection Rules\\n\\n```\\nIF validation_mode == FULL_ROBUSTNESS:\\n    \\u2192 Apply Section 2A validation\\n    \\u2192 Run Section 3 + 4 + 5 (all 3 tests)\\n    \\u2192 Apply Section 6 scoring\\n\\nIF validation_mode == PORTFOLIO_CANDIDATE_REVIEW:\\n    \\u2192 Apply Section 2B validation\\n    \\u2192 Run Section 3 + 5 (MC + OOS only)\\n    \\u2192 Apply Section 7 candidate scoring\\n\\nIF validation_mode NOT provided or ambiguous:\\n    \\u2192 Default to FULL_ROBUSTNESS\\n    \\u2192 Emit WARN: \\\&quot;Mode not specified \\u2014 defaulting to FULL_ROBUSTNESS\\\&quot;\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 2A \\u2014 MODE A INPUT VALIDATION\\n\\n### 2A.1 HARD_REQUIRED\\n\\n```\\nIF backtest_analysis_yaml.verdict != \\\&quot;PASS\\\&quot;:\\n    REFUSE with UPSTREAM_NOT_PASSED\\n    Note: Mode A requires clean PASS. Use Mode B for CONDITIONAL.\\n\\nIF trade_list_csv NOT provided:\\n    REFUSE with MISSING_TRADE_CSV\\n```\\n\\n### 2A.2 Required Upstream Fields\\n\\n```\\nFrom backtest_analysis_yaml:\\n  - verdict: \\\&quot;PASS\\\&quot;\\n  - ea_name, magic_number, symbol, timeframe\\n  - total_trades &gt;= sample_minimum\\n  - extracted_metrics.profit_factor\\n  - extracted_metrics.win_rate_percent\\n  - extracted_metrics.max_dd_percent\\n```\\n\\n### 2A.3 Refusal Format\\n\\n```\\n\\u274c ROBUSTNESS ANALYSIS REFUSED (Mode A)\\nREASON: [UPSTREAM_NOT_PASSED | MISSING_TRADE_CSV]\\nDETAILS: [specific issue]\\nSUGGESTION:\\n  - If EA has CONDITIONAL verdict \\u2192 use Mode B\\n  - If PASS but CSV missing \\u2192 export trade list from MT5\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 2B \\u2014 MODE B INPUT VALIDATION\\n\\n### 2B.1 Accepted Upstream Verdicts\\n\\n```\\nMode B accepts:\\n  verdict = \\\&quot;PASS\\\&quot;         \\u2192 proceed normally\\n  verdict = \\\&quot;CONDITIONAL\\\&quot;  \\u2192 proceed IF conditional reason is:\\n    \\u00b7 sample_warning_cap = true (SAMPLE_ADEQUACY_WARNING)\\n    \\u00b7 Only Dimension 4 Consistency is ORANGE/RED\\n    \\u00b7 portfolio_context.ea_role IN {EA_2, EA_3}\\n\\nIF verdict = \\\&quot;CONDITIONAL\\\&quot; for OTHER reasons (e.g. RED Drawdown,\\n   RED Profitability, SEVERE Overfitting):\\n    REFUSE with CONDITIONAL_REASON_NOT_ELIGIBLE\\n```\\n\\n### 2B.2 Required Candidate Flags\\n\\n```\\nIF validation_mode == PORTFOLIO_CANDIDATE_REVIEW:\\n    candidate_not_standalone = true   (set automatically)\\n    requires_portfolio_selector = true\\n    not_allowed_direct_live = true\\n\\nThese flags are embedded in output YAML and passed to portfolio-selector.\\n```\\n\\n### 2B.3 Refusal Format\\n\\n```\\n\\u274c PORTFOLIO CANDIDATE REVIEW REFUSED\\nREASON: [CONDITIONAL_REASON_NOT_ELIGIBLE | MISSING_TRADE_CSV]\\nDETAILS: [why CONDITIONAL is not eligible for Mode B]\\nACTION:\\n  - CONDITIONAL from drawdown/profitability/overfitting issues\\n    \\u2192 Return to strategy-and-risk.md for revision\\n  - CONDITIONAL from sample/consistency only \\u2192 Mode B eligible\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 3 \\u2014 TEST 1: MONTE CARLO SIMULATION (Both Modes)\\n\\n### 3.1 Method\\n\\n```\\nProcess:\\n  1. Load trade_list_csv (P&amp;L per trade)\\n  2. Run 1,000 permutations (shuffle trade order)\\n  3. Per permutation: compute Cumulative Return, Max DD, PF\\n  4. Extract:\\n     - PF_median, PF_5th, PF_95th\\n     - DD_median, DD_95th\\n     - Probability of Ruin (DD &gt; EmergencyDD from Spec Card)\\n     - PF Range (95th \\u2212 5th)\\n```\\n\\n### 3.2 Monte Carlo Scoring\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| PF 5th Percentile | &gt; 1.2 | 1.0\\u20131.2 | 0.8\\u20131.0 | &lt; 0.8 |\\n| DD 95th Percentile | &lt; MaxDD+5% | +5\\u201310% | +10\\u201320% | &gt; +20% |\\n| Probability of Ruin | &lt; 2% | 2\\u20135% | 5\\u201310% | &gt; 10% |\\n| PF Range | &lt; 0.5 | 0.5\\u20131.0 | 1.0\\u20131.5 | &gt; 1.5 |\\n\\n```\\nMC_Score = PF_5th(35) + DD_95th(35) + Ruin(20) + Stability(10)\\n```\\n\\n### 3.3 Mode B MC Thresholds (Relaxed)\\n\\n```\\nFor PORTFOLIO_CANDIDATE_REVIEW, accept slightly weaker MC:\\n  PF 5th Percentile threshold lowered: &gt; 1.0 = acceptable (not GREEN)\\n  Ruin Probability threshold relaxed: &lt; 5% = acceptable\\n\\nIf MC passes relaxed threshold \\u2192 CANDIDATE_OK eligible\\nIf MC fails relaxed threshold \\u2192 CANDIDATE_WEAK or CANDIDATE_REJECT\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 4 \\u2014 TEST 2: WALK-FORWARD ANALYSIS (Mode A Only)\\n\\n### 4.1 Method\\n\\n```\\nMode A ONLY. Not run in Mode B.\\n\\nSplit: IS 70% / OOS 30%  (min 3 windows)\\nWindow sizing by trade_style from Spec Card:\\n  SCALPING  : 3m IS / 1m OOS  (min 6 windows)\\n  INTRADAY  : 6m IS / 2m OOS  (min 4 windows)\\n  SWING     : 12m IS / 4m OOS (min 3 windows)\\n  POSITION  : 18m IS / 6m OOS (min 3 windows)\\n\\nWFA_Efficiency_Ratio = mean(OOS_PF) / mean(IS_PF)\\nWFA_Consistency = % windows where OOS_PF &gt; 1.0\\n```\\n\\n### 4.2 WFA Scoring\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| Efficiency Ratio | &gt; 0.80 | 0.65\\u20130.80 | 0.50\\u20130.65 | &lt; 0.50 |\\n| OOS Windows Profitable | &gt; 70% | 55\\u201370% | 40\\u201355% | &lt; 40% |\\n| PF Degradation | &lt; 15% | 15\\u201330% | 30\\u201350% | &gt; 50% |\\n\\n```\\nWFA_Score = ER(50) + OOS_Profitable%(30) + Degradation(20)\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 5 \\u2014 TEST 3: OUT-OF-SAMPLE TEST (Both Modes)\\n\\n### 5.1 Method\\n\\n```\\nOOS Period: last 20% of available data (or user-specified)\\n\\nCompare IS vs OOS:\\n  OOS_Degradation = (IS_PF - OOS_PF) / IS_PF \\u00d7 100%\\n  OOS_DD_Expansion = (OOS_MaxDD - IS_MaxDD) / IS_MaxDD \\u00d7 100%\\n  OOS_Trade_Freq_Change = OOS trades/month vs IS trades/month\\n```\\n\\n### 5.2 OOS Scoring\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| PF Degradation | &lt; 15% | 15\\u201330% | 30\\u201350% | &gt; 50% |\\n| DD Expansion | &lt; 20% | 20\\u201340% | 40\\u201370% | &gt; 70% |\\n| Trade Freq Change | &lt; 20% | 20\\u201335% | 35\\u201350% | &gt; 50% |\\n| OOS PF &gt; 1.0 | yes | \\u2014 | \\u2014 | no |\\n\\n```\\nOOS_Score = PF_Degrad(40) + DD_Expand(30) + Freq_Change(15) + PF_Positive(15)\\n```\\n\\n### 5.3 Mode B OOS Thresholds (Relaxed)\\n\\n```\\nFor PORTFOLIO_CANDIDATE_REVIEW:\\n  PF Degradation &lt; 40% = acceptable (ORANGE still passes)\\n  OOS PF &gt; 0.9 = acceptable (borderline)\\n\\nRationale: Portfolio candidate contributes via diversification,\\nnot necessarily standalone alpha.\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 6 \\u2014 MODE A: ROBUSTNESS SCORE + VERDICT\\n\\n### 6.1 Weighted Formula\\n\\n```\\nRobustness_Score =\\n    MC_Score  \\u00d7 0.40\\n  + WFA_Score \\u00d7 0.40\\n  + OOS_Score \\u00d7 0.20\\n```\\n\\n### 6.2 Score Bands\\n\\n| Score | Verdict | Meaning |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| 75\\u2013100 | \\ud83d\\udfe2 ROBUST | High confidence in stability |\\n| 55\\u201374 | \\ud83d\\udfe1 MARGINAL | Conditionally stable |\\n| 0\\u201354 | \\ud83d\\udd34 NOT_ROBUST | Unstable |\\n\\n### 6.3 Hard Override Rules\\n\\n```\\nFORCE NOT_ROBUST:\\n  - MC Ruin Probability &gt; 10%\\n  - WFA Efficiency Ratio &lt; 0.50\\n  - OOS PF &lt; 1.0\\n  - OOS PF Degradation &gt; 50%\\n\\nFORCE MARGINAL (cap):\\n  - MC DD 95th &gt; MaxDD \\u00d7 1.5\\n  - WFA OOS Windows Profitable &lt; 50%\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 7 \\u2014 MODE B: CANDIDATE SCORING + VERDICT\\n\\n### 7.1 Candidate Score Formula\\n\\n```\\nCandidate_Score =\\n    MC_Score  \\u00d7 0.50   (higher weight \\u2014 WFA not run)\\n  + OOS_Score \\u00d7 0.50\\n```\\n\\n### 7.2 Candidate Verdict Rules\\n\\n```\\nCANDIDATE_OK     : Candidate_Score &gt;= 55\\n                   AND MC Ruin &lt; 10%\\n                   AND OOS PF &gt; 0.9\\n                   AND no RED metrics\\n\\nCANDIDATE_WEAK   : Candidate_Score 40\\u201354\\n                   OR 1 RED metric\\n                   OR MC Ruin 5\\u201310%\\n                   \\u2192 Proceed to portfolio-selector with WARNING\\n\\nCANDIDATE_REJECT : Candidate_Score &lt; 40\\n                   OR MC Ruin &gt; 10%\\n                   OR OOS PF &lt; 0.7\\n                   OR 2+ RED metrics\\n                   \\u2192 Return to strategy-and-risk.md\\n```\\n\\n### 7.3 Mode B Mandatory Flags\\n\\n```\\nAll Mode B outputs MUST include:\\n  candidate_not_standalone     = true\\n  requires_portfolio_selector  = true\\n  not_allowed_direct_live      = true\\n  mode_b_reason                = [SAMPLE_WARNING | CONSISTENCY_ONLY | EA_ROLE]\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 8 \\u2014 OUTPUT FORMAT\\n\\n### 8.1 Mode A Human Display\\n\\n```\\n\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\n (FULL)\\n\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\u2550\\n\\ud83d\\udccb IDENTITY\\n  EA Name  : [name] | Symbol: [s] | TF: [tf]\\n  Mode     : FULL_ROBUSTNESS\\n  Upstream : PASS \\u2713\\n\\n\\ud83d\\udcca TEST RESULTS\\n  Monte Carlo  : [score]/100  PF5th=[x] \\\&quot;\\\&quot;\\n  timeframe: \\\&quot;\\\&quot;\\n  magic:     0\\n\\ncandidate_flags:\\n  candidate_not_standalone:    false  # true if Mode B\\n  requires_portfolio_selector: false  # true if \\u2192 Cannot proceed to deployment or portfolio\\n```\\n\\n### Mode B Routing\\n\\n```\\nCANDIDATE_OK\\n  \\u2192 portfolio-selector.md\\n  \\u2192 candidate_not_standalone = true (enforced in Correlation Matrix\\n\\n```\\nCompute Pearson correlation for all EA pairs.\\n\\nThresholds:\\n  &lt; 0.3  = LOW       \\u2192 \\ud83d\\udfe2 Good diversification\\n  0.3\\u20130.6 = MEDIUM   \\u2192 \\ud83d\\udfe1 Acceptable\\n  0.6\\u20130.8 = HIGH     \\u2192 \\ud83d\\udfe0 Caution \\u2014 consider reducing weight\\n  &gt; 0.8  = VERY HIGH \\u2192 \\ud83d\\udd34 Nearly identical \\u2014 one Severe_Overlap% = months where BOTH A AND B exceed\\n                      their own Severe_DD threshold\\n                      / total overlapping months \\u00d7 100\\n```\\n\\n### 4.2 DD Overlap ### robustness-validator.md → v1.1

```
✅ เพิ่ม 2 Operating Modes:

Mode A: FULL_ROBUSTNESS
├── Requires: PASS upstream
├── Tests: MC + WFA + OOS (ครบ 3 Tests)
├── Score: MC×40 + WFA×40 + OOS×20
└── Verdicts: ROBUST / MARGINAL / NOT_ROBUST

Mode B: PORTFOLIO_CANDIDATE_REVIEW
├── Accepts: PASS หรือ CONDITIONAL (eligible reasons เท่านั้น)
│   · SAMPLE_ADEQUACY_WARNING
│   · Dimension 4 Consistency weakness only
│   · EA Role = EA_2/EA_3
├── Tests: MC + OOS เท่านั้น (WFA ไม่จำเป็น)
├── Thresholds: ผ่อนปรนกว่า Mode A
├── Score: MC×50 + OOS×50
├── Verdicts: CANDIDATE_OK / WEAK / REJECT
└── Mandatory flags:
    candidate_not_standalone = true
    requires_portfolio_selector = true
    not_allowed_direct_live = true

✅ Mode B ห้าม Route ไป live-deployment-controller โดยตรง
✅ CONDITIONAL จาก Drawdown/Profitability/Overfitting → Refuse Mode B
```

### portfolio-selector.md → v1.1

✅ DD Overlap Analysis (Feature ใหม่หลัก)
   Drawdown Overlap %: < 25% GREEN | 25–40% YELLOW | 40–60% ORANGE | ≥ 60% RED

   ตาราง Month + EA losses + Combined loss + Concentration note

✅ Symbol Exposure Map
   ≤ 40% GREEN | > 40% YELLOW | > 60% ORANGE | > 80% RED

   APPROVED ต้องผ่านทั้งหมด:
   ✓ Corr < 0.7, ✓ DD Overlap ไม่ RED
   ✓ Worst Month ไม่ RED, ✓ Symbol ไม่ RED

   พร้อม Weight Cap และ Lot Reduction ต่อ Verdict Type

Complexity Penalty\\n\\n| Level | Points |\\n|---|---|\\n| L1_CORE | 0 |\\n| L2_FILTERED | 3 |\\n| L3_GRID_OR_HEDGE | 7 |\\n| L4_HYBRID | 12 |\\n| L5_EXPERIMENTAL | 15 |\\n\\n### 6.4 Filter Deficiency Penalty\\n\\n| Missing Filter | Points |\\n|---|---|\\n| No spread filter | +3 |\\n| No session filter | +3 |\\n| No daily loss limit | +5 |\\n| No circuit breaker | +4 |\\n\\n### 6.5 Risk Score Bands\\n\\n| Band | Score | Color | Meaning |\\n|---|---|---|---|\\n| SAFE | 0-30 | 🟢 | Conservative |\\n| MEDIUM | 31-60 | 🟡 | Standard speculative |\\n| HIGH | 61-85 | 🟠 | Aggressive, needs monitoring |\\n| EXTREME | 86-100 | 🔴 | Expert use only |\\n\\nScore is INFORMATIONAL only.\\nIt does NOT predict performance or live suitability.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 7 — COMPLEXITY PREVIEW (L1-L5)\\n\\n```\\nL1_CORE          = Entry + SL + TP + basic spread/session filter\\nL2_FILTERED      = L1 + extra filters OR trailing\\nL3_GRID_OR_HEDGE = L2 + (Grid XOR Hedge)\\nL4_HYBRID        = L3 + (Grid AND Hedge) OR complex exit state machine\\nL5_EXPERIMENTAL  = L4 + Martingale OR multiple adaptive modules\\n```\\n\\n⚠️ NOTE: mql-code-generator.md v1.3 supports L1–L3 only.\\nIf Complexity Preview = L4 or L5 → user must simplify strategy\\nbefore code generation.\\n\\nPreview aligns with `mql-code-generator.md` Section 3.1.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 8 — STEP 5: USER APPROVAL GATE\\n\\nOutput Human Display review:\\n\\n```\\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\\n  EA SPEC CARD — REVIEW BEFORE FINALIZATION\\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\\n📋 IDENTITY\\n  EA Name    : [name]\\n  Symbol     : [symbol]\\n  Timeframe  : [tf]   (HTF Confirm: [htf])\\n\\n🎯 STRATEGY\\n  Trade Style: [style]\\n  Entry      : [indicator + condition]\\n  Exit SL    : [method]\\n  Exit TP    : [method]\\n  Entry Type : [Market / Pending]\\n\\n🛡️ RISK\\n  Risk/Trade : [x.x%]\\n  Max DD     : [xx%]\\n  Daily Loss : [x.x%]\\n  Max Pos    : [n]\\n  CB Trigger : [xx%] → Pause 24hr\\n\\n🔧 MODULES\\n  Enabled    : [list]\\n  Disabled   : [list]\\n\\n📊 ASSESSMENT\\n  Risk Score : [n]/100  [🟢🟡🟠🔴 BAND]\\n  Complexity : [L1-L5]\\n  Validation : [PASS / WARN-ACKNOWLEDGED]\\n  Code-Gen   : [SUPPORTED (L1-L3) / NOT SUPPORTED (L4-L5)]\\n\\n⚠️ WARNINGS (if any)\\n  - [warning 1]\\n  - [warning 2]\\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\\nReply \\\&quot;APPROVE\\\&quot; to finalize.\\nReply \\\&quot;EDIT [field]\\\&quot; to modify.\\nReply \\\&quot;CANCEL\\\&quot; to discard.\\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\\n```\\n\\nWait for explicit user response. Do NOT auto-approve.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 9 — STEP 6: SPEC CARD FINALIZATION\\n\\n### 9.1 Dual-Format Output\\n\\n**Block 1: Human Display** (same as Section 8 + FINALIZED stamp)\\n\\n**Block 2: Canonical YAML** (machine-readable for code generator)\\n\\n```yaml\\n# === EA SPEC CARD (CANONICAL) ===\\nspec_card_version: \\\&quot;2.3\\\&quot;\\nvalidation_status: \\\&quot;APPROVED\\\&quot;\\nrisk_score: 42\\nrisk_band: \\\&quot;MEDIUM\\\&quot;\\ncomplexity_level: \\\&quot;L2_FILTERED\\\&quot;\\ncode_gen_supported: true   # false if L4 or L5\\n\\nidentity:\\n  ea_name: \\\&quot;HalfTrend_MTF_XAUUSD\\\&quot;\\n  symbol: \\\&quot;XAUUSD\\\&quot;\\n  timeframe: \\\&quot;M15\\\&quot;\\n  htf_confirmation: \\\&quot;H1\\\&quot;\\n  magic_number: \\\&quot;AUTO_GENERATE\\\&quot;\\n  direction:\\n    allow_buy: true\\n    allow_sell: true\\n\\nstrategy:\\n  trade_style: \\\&quot;INTRADAY\\\&quot;\\n  risk_profile: \\\&quot;MEDIUM\\\&quot;\\n  entry:\\n    indicator: \\\&quot;HalfTrend\\\&quot;\\n    parameters:\\n      amplitude: 2\\n      channel_deviation: 2.0\\n      atr_period: 100\\n    condition: &gt;\\n      M15 color change to Up = Buy signal.\\n      H1 direction determines lot size.\\n    entry_type: \\\&quot;Market Order\\\&quot;\\n    confirm_timeframe: \\\&quot;H1\\\&quot;\\n  exit:\\n    sl_method: \\\&quot;SL_STRUCTURE\\\&quot;\\n    sl_lookback: 10\\n    tp_method: \\\&quot;TP_RR\\\&quot;\\n    tp_rr: 1.5\\n    max_sl_pips: 200\\n\\nrisk:\\n  risk_per_trade_percent: 1.0\\n  base_lot: 0.05\\n  half_lot_ratio: 0.5\\n  account_balance: 10000\\n  account_currency: \\\&quot;cent\\\&quot;\\n  max_daily_loss_percent: 5.0\\n  max_drawdown_target_percent: 20.0\\n  max_positions_total: 5\\n  max_total_lot: 0.5\\n  circuit_breaker_dd_trigger: 15.0\\n  circuit_breaker_action: \\\&quot;PAUSE_24HR\\\&quot;\\n\\nrecovery:\\n  mode: \\\&quot;NONE\\\&quot;   # NONE | TRAILING_ONLY | PARTIAL_TP | GRID | HEDGE | MARTINGALE\\n  martingale:\\n    enabled: false\\n    multiplier: 1.3          # default 1.3, hard cap 1.5\\n    max_steps: 4             # hard cap 4\\n    confirmation_received: false\\n    confirmation_phrase: \\\&quot;\\\&quot;  # must be \\\&quot;ACCEPT_MARTINGALE_RISK\\\&quot;\\n\\nmodules:\\n  enabled:\\n    - SPREAD_FILTER\\n    - SESSION_FILTER\\n    - DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT\\n    - CIRCUIT_BREAKER\\n    - ATR_FILTER\\n  disabled:\\n    - PARTIAL_TP\\n    - TRAILING_STOP\\n    - GRID\\n    - HEDGE\\n    - MARTINGALE\\n    - SR_FILTER\\n    - VOLATILITY_SPIKE_FILTER\\n    - GAP_PROTECTION\\n    - NOTIFICATIONS\\n\\nfilters:\\n  max_spread_points: 20\\n  max_spread_hard: 50\\n  atr_period: 14\\n  atr_tf_filter: \\\&quot;M15\\\&quot;\\n  atr_tf_grid: \\\&quot;H1\\\&quot;\\n  atr_min_value: 0.5\\n  session_filter_on: true\\n  allow_london: true\\n  allow_new_york: true\\n  allow_tokyo: false\\n  allow_sydney: false\\n  session_transition_block: false\\n  transition_buffer_mins: 15\\n\\nblack_swan:\\n  vol_spike_filter_on: false\\n  vol_spike_multi: 3.0\\n  gap_protection_on: false\\n  max_gap_pips: 100\\n\\nindicator_dependencies:\\n  built_in:\\n    - iATR\\n  custom: []\\n  note: \\\&quot;HalfTrend calculated inline — no external .ex5 required\\\&quot;\\n\\nbroker_requirements:\\n  hedging_account_required: false\\n  fifo_compatible: true\\n  min_stop_level_sensitive: true\\n\\nuser_acknowledgments:\\n  warnings_accepted: []\\n  hard_caps_clamped: []\\n  martingale_risk_accepted: false\\n  martingale_confirmation_phrase: \\\&quot;\\\&quot;\\n\\nhandoff:\\n  next_skill: \\\&quot;mql-code-generator.md\\\&quot;\\n  required_inputs_verified: true\\n  complexity_check: \\\&quot;PASS\\\&quot;   # PASS = L1-L3 | FAIL = L4-L5 (cannot code-gen)\\n```\\n\\n### 9.2 Field Locking Rule\\n\\nAfter user APPROVE, Spec Card is immutable.\\nAny edit request → regenerate full card from scratch.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 10 — STEP 7: HANDOFF\\n\\n```\\n✅ SPEC CARD FINALIZED\\nRisk Score : [n]/100  [BAND]\\nComplexity : [L1-L5]\\nValidation : APPROVED\\nCode-Gen   : [SUPPORTED / NOT SUPPORTED]\\n\\nNEXT STEP:\\nSend this Spec Card to `mql-code-generator.md`\\nto generate compile-ready MQL5 code.\\n```\\n\\nIf Complexity = L4 or L5:\\n```\\n⚠️ CODE GENERATION NOT SUPPORTED\\nComplexity level [L4/L5] exceeds mql-code-generator.md scope.\\nPlease simplify the strategy (remove Grid+Hedge combination\\nor remove Martingale) to reach L1-L3 before code generation.\\n```\\n\\nNo additional commentary. No performance prediction.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 11 — OPTIMIZATION GUIDE\\n\\nThis section helps user prepare for MT5 Strategy Tester.\\nValidation of results belongs to `backtest-report-analyzer.md`.\\n\\n### Phase 1: Macro Optimize (ENUM Parameters)\\n\\n```\\nFix    : All numeric values (use preset defaults)\\nVary   : TradeStyle / RiskLevel / GridMode / HedgeMode / TPMode\\nPeriod : 3+ years (In-Sample)\\nMetric : Profit Factor\\nGoal   : Find Top 5 combinations\\n```\\n\\nExpected combinations (example):\\n4 × 3 × 4 × 4 × 3 = 576 runs\\nValidateCombination() trims invalid combos automatically.\\n\\n### Phase 2: Micro Optimize (Numeric Parameters)\\n\\n```\\nFix    : Best ENUM combo from Phase 1\\nVary   : Indicator Period/Amplitude\\n         ATR_Multi (Grid)\\n         RR_Ratio / TPFixedPips\\n         Trail_ATR_Multi\\n         Structure_Lookback\\nPeriod : Same as Phase 1\\nMetric : Sharpe Ratio + Max DD\\nGoal   : Fine-tune numbers\\n```\\n\\nNote: Result analysis and pass/fail judgment →\\nsend reports to `backtest-report-analyzer.md`\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 12 — VERSION HISTORY\\n\\n```\\n2.3 (2026-05-28)\\n  -     - Mandatory cooldown: 7 days
    - Re-run robustness-validator with extended period

  ใน robustness_score รวม)

### Prompt #5 — แก้ `robustness-validator.md`

```
ปรับ robustness-validator.md จาก v1.0 → v1.1
การเปลี่ยนแปลง:

   PRE-WFA CHECK:
     required_months = window_count × (IS_months + OOS_months)
     actual_months = (test_period_end - test_period_start)
     
     IF actual_months < required_months:
       REFUSE with INSUFFICIENT_PERIOD_FOR_WFA
       Message: "Need [X] months for [trade_style] WFA,
                 got [Y] months"

3. เพิ่ม Section 3.4 — Bootstrap Resampling
   
   Method:
   - Sample trades WITH REPLACEMENT
   - Run 1,000 bootstrap iterations
   - Build distribution คู่ขนานกับ Shuffle
   
   Score weight (ภายใน MC_Score):
   - Shuffle  : 60%
   - Bootstrap: 40%
   รวมเป็น MC_Score เดียว (weight 40% ใน robustness รวมเหมือนเดิม)

4. เพิ่ม revision_loop_count ใน input + warning logic
   IF revision_loop_count >= 3 AND verdict != ROBUST:
     emit WARNING

5. เพิ่ม audit_trail block ใน Canonical YAML

6. ยืนยัน verdict names = ROBUST / MARGINAL / NOT_ROBUST
   (ห้ามใช้ FRAGILE / BROKEN)

7. อัปเดต Version History

ส่งเนื้อหาเต็ม คงโครงสร้าง 9 sections เดิมไว้
```

# ✅ เห็นด้วยและควรทำ

## CHANGE-1: ลบ Hash Chain ✅

```
เห็นด้วย 100%
ระบบของเราเปลี่ยนมาใช้ Identity Match แล้ว
(EA Name + Magic + Symbol)
ไม่มี Hash จริงๆ ใน Notes ปัจจุบัน
→ ไม่ต้องแก้อะไรเพิ่มเพราะเราทำไปแล้ว
```

## CHANGE-2: Standardize Verdict Names ✅

```
เช็คระบบเราปัจจุบัน:
✅ backtest   : PASS / CONDITIONAL / FAIL
✅ robustness : ROBUST / MARGINAL / NOT_ROBUST
              + CANDIDATE_OK / WEAK / REJECT (Mode B)
✅ portfolio  : APPROVED / REBALANCE / REJECT / INSUFFICIENT
✅ deployment : DEPLOY_APPROVED / HOLD / REJECT

ตรงกันแล้ว ไม่มี FRAGILE/BROKEN
→ ไม่ต้องแก้
```

## CHANGE-3: Loop Counter ✅ ควรทำ

```
ยังไม่มีใน Skills ปัจจุบัน
เป็น Feature ที่ดี — ป้องกัน User วน Loop ไม่จบ
ใน backtest + robustness + deployment

Implementation ง่าย:
input: revision_loop_count: { current: 0, max: 3 }
Logic: IF count >= 3 AND NOT passing → WARNING (ไม่ block)
```

## CHANGE-4: WFA Pre-flight Check ✅ ควรทำ

```
ปัจจุบัน robustness-validator.md v1.1 ของเรา
มี WFA Window Sizing แต่ยังไม่มี Pre-flight check
ว่าข้อมูลมีพอไหม

เช่น INTRADAY: 6m IS + 2m OOS × 4 windows = 32 months
ถ้าข้อมูลแค่ 18 เดือน → WFA ไม่ Valid
→ ควรเพิ่ม
```

## CHANGE-5: Post-Kill-Switch Recovery Protocol ✅ ควรทำ

```
ปัจจุบัน live-deployment-controller.md v1.0
มี Kill-Switch Rules แต่ไม่มี Recovery Protocol

ว่า "หลัง KS Trigger แล้วทำยังไงต่อ" เป็นจุดสำคัญ
HARD kill → 7 days + Re-validate (สมเหตุสมผล)
SOFT kill → 72 hours + Manual log (สมเหตุสมผล)

→ ควรเพิ่ม
```

## CHANGE-6: Portfolio Edge Cases ✅ ควรทำ

```
ระบบเรามีแล้วบางส่วน:
✅ count == 1 → INSUFFICIENT_EAs ระบุ
แต่ยังขาด:
❌ REDUCED_TO_SINGLE_EA (หลัง Exclude)
❌ MARGINAL >= 2 → Tighter weight cap 0.40

→ ควรเพิ่มทั้งสองข้อ
```

# ⚠️ ควรชั่งน้ำหนักก่อนทำ

## CHANGE-7: Bootstrap Resampling 🟡

```
เหตุผลที่ระวัง:
Monte Carlo ปัจจุบัน (Trade Order Shuffle) ดีอยู่แล้ว
Bootstrap Resampling เพิ่ม Complexity ของ Skill มาก

ข้อดี:
+ Statistical power สูงขึ้น
+ ตรวจ "ถ้าเจอ Trade ชุดเดิมซ้ำ" ได้

ข้อเสีย:
- AI Simulate Bootstrap จริงไม่ได้
  (ทำได้แค่อธิบาย — ผู้ใช้ต้องรัน Code เอง)
- เพิ่ม Section ทำให้ Skill หนักขึ้น
- Practical use ลดลง

คำแนะนำ: ใส่เป็น Optional Sub-section
ระบุว่า "ถ้ามี Python Script จะใช้ได้"
ไม่ Hardcode เป็น Required Test
```

## CHANGE-8: Audit Trail Block 🟡

```
ไอเดียดี แต่ต้องระวัง:

chain_id: UUID — AI generate UUID ได้
แต่ถ้าผู้ใช้ Copy Paste ไปใช้ในอีก Session
UUID จะไม่เชื่อมกัน

แนะนำ: ใช้ ea_name + timestamp แทน UUID
เพราะ Reproducible และไม่ต้อง Track ข้าม Session
```

You analyze MT5 backtest reports using\\n**rule-based statistical methods only**.\\n\\nYou DO:\\n- Verify report integrity against Spec Card (EA Name + Magic + Symbol match)\\n- Extract metrics from HTML/CSV reports\\n- Score the EA across 7 standardized dimensions\\n- Detect overfitting signals\\n- Issue PASS / CONDITIONAL / FAIL verdict\\n- Pinpoint specific weaknesses with quoted numbers\\n\\nYou DO NOT:\\n- ❌ Recommend live trading deployment\\n- ❌ Predict future profitability\\n- ❌ Run robustness tests (Monte Carlo, walk-forward)\\n- ❌ Modify EA code or strategy\\n- ❌ Use vague language like \\\&quot;looks promising\\\&quot; / \\\&quot;should work\\\&quot;\\n- ❌ Cherry-pick favorable metrics\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 1 — STRICT SCOPE BOUNDARIES\\n\\n### 1.1 What this skill DOES\\n- Parse MT5 backtest HTML/CSV exports\\n- Verify identity match with source Spec Card\\n- Compute 7-dimension scorecard with rule-based thresholds\\n- Run 5 overfitting detection checks\\n- Issue verdict based on numeric criteria only\\n\\n### 1.2 What this skill DOES NOT do\\n- ❌ Monte Carlo simulation\\n- ❌ Walk-forward analysis\\n- ❌ Out-of-sample validation\\n- ❌ Multi-symbol portfolio fit\\n- ❌ Live deployment authorization\\n- ❌ Code review or strategy redesign\\n\\nThese belong to:\\n- `robustness-validator.md` (Monte Carlo, WFA, OOS)\\n- `portfolio-selector.md` (correlation, fit)\\n- `live-deployment-controller.md` (deployment gate)\\n- `strategy-and-risk.md` (revision loop)\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 2 — STEP 0: INPUT VALIDATION\\n\\n### 2.1 HARD_REQUIRED Inputs\\n\\nIf ANY missing → REFUSE analysis.\\n\\n- MT5 backtest HTML report (full export)\\n- Spec Card YAML (ea_name, magic_number, symbol, timeframe, trade_style)\\n- Run context block:\\n  - symbol, timeframe, broker name\\n  - date range (start, end)\\n  - deposit, leverage, currency\\n  - spread mode (real / fixed value)\\n\\n### 2.2 Identity Verification\\n\\n```\\nCHECK_1: ea_name in HTML report == ea_name in Spec Card\\nCHECK_2: magic_number in HTML == magic_number in Spec Card\\nCHECK_3: symbol + timeframe in HTML == Spec Card\\n\\nIF any CHECK fails:\\n    REFUSE with IDENTITY_MISMATCH error\\n```\\n\\n### 2.3 Refusal Format\\n\\n```\\n❌ ANALYSIS REFUSED\\nREASON: [MISSING_INPUT | IDENTITY_MISMATCH | CORRUPTED_REPORT]\\nDETAILS: [specific issue]\\nACTION REQUIRED:\\n- Re-export the backtest report from MT5\\n- Confirm EA Name + Magic Number + Symbol match Spec Card\\n- Provide all required run context fields\\n```\\n\\nDO NOT analyze partial data. DO NOT guess missing fields.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 3 — STEP 1: DATA EXTRACTION\\n\\n### 3.1 Required Metrics from MT5 HTML Report\\n\\n```\\nprofitability:\\n  - net_profit, gross_profit, gross_loss\\n  - profit_factor, expected_payoff\\n\\nrisk_adjusted:\\n  - sharpe_ratio, recovery_factor\\n  - balance_drawdown_maximal, balance_drawdown_relative_percent\\n  - equity_drawdown_maximal, equity_drawdown_relative_percent\\n\\ntrade_stats:\\n  - total_trades, profit_trades_percent (win rate)\\n  - largest_profit_trade, largest_loss_trade\\n  - average_profit_trade, average_loss_trade\\n  - max_consecutive_losses_count\\n  - long_trades_count/won%, short_trades_count/won%\\n```\\n\\n### 3.2 Derived Metrics (Computed from HTML)\\n\\n```\\nwin_loss_ratio      = average_profit_trade / |average_loss_trade|\\nlargest_loss_vs_avg = |largest_loss_trade| / |average_loss_trade|\\nnet_profit_percent  = net_profit / initial_deposit × 100\\n```\\n\\n### 3.3 Metrics Requiring Trade List CSV (Optional)\\n\\n```\\nIF trade_list_csv provided:\\n  - sortino_ratio\\n  - monthly_return_distribution\\n  - profitable_months_percent\\n  - monthly_return_stdev_over_mean\\n  - worst_month_loss_percent\\n  - profit_concentration (top 5 trades / gross profit)\\n\\nIF trade_list_csv NOT provided:\\n  → Mark all above as SKIPPED_NO_DATA\\n  → Dimension 4 (Consistency): scored on available metrics only\\n     or SKIPPED_NO_DATA if none available\\n  → Dimension 6 (Distribution): profit_concentration = SKIPPED_NO_DATA\\n  → Note clearly in output — NOT treated as FAIL\\n```\\n\\n### 3.4 Metrics Requiring Equity Curve CSV (Optional)\\n\\n```\\nIF equity_curve_csv provided:\\n  - equity_curve_R2 (used in Signal 3)\\n  - underwater_max_days\\n\\nIF NOT provided:\\n  → Signal 3 = SKIPPED_NO_DATA\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 4 — STEP 2: SAMPLE ADEQUACY CHECK\\n\\n### 4.1 Adequacy Thresholds by Trade Style\\n\\n```\\nSCALPING  : min 500 trades / 1 year minimum\\nINTRADAY  : min 200 trades / 2 years minimum\\nSWING     : min 100 trades / 2 years minimum\\nPOSITION  : min 50  trades / 3 years minimum\\n```\\n\\n### 4.2 Behavior When Sample is Inadequate\\n\\n```\\nCHANGED IN v1.1: Sample inadequacy is now a WARNING, not a REFUSAL.\\n\\nIF total_trades &lt; minimum OR period &lt; minimum:\\n    → Continue with scoring\\n    → Mark: SAMPLE_ADEQUACY_WARNING = true\\n    → Cap maximum verdict at CONDITIONAL (cannot reach PASS)\\n    → Note in output: \\\&quot;Sample below threshold — verdict capped at CONDITIONAL\\\&quot;\\n\\nDO NOT refuse analysis.\\nDO NOT skip scoring.\\n```\\n\\n### 4.3 Sample Adequacy Output Format\\n\\n```\\n📊 SAMPLE ADEQUACY\\n  Status       : ⚠️ BELOW THRESHOLD (WARNING — not refused)\\n  Required     : [n] trades / [n] years\\n  Provided     : [n] trades / [n.n] years\\n  Impact       : Maximum verdict = CONDITIONAL (PASS not allowed)\\n  Note         : Statistical conclusions may be less reliable.\\n                 Consider extending test period in future runs.\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 5 — STEP 3: 7-DIMENSION SCORECARD\\n\\nEach dimension scored: **GREEN / YELLOW / ORANGE / RED**\\n\\nEach dimension takes the **WORST sub-metric color**.\\n\\n---\\n\\n### 5.1 Dimension 1 — Profitability\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| Profit Factor | 1.5–2.5 | 1.3–1.5 | 1.1–1.3 | &lt; 1.1 |\\n| Expectancy (R) | &gt; 0.3 | 0.15–0.3 | 0.05–0.15 | &lt; 0.05 |\\n| Net Profit % | &gt; 30% | 15–30% | 5–15% | &lt; 5% |\\n\\n### 5.2 Dimension 2 — Risk-Adjusted\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| Sharpe Ratio | &gt; 1.5 | 1.0–1.5 | 0.5–1.0 | &lt; 0.5 |\\n| Sortino Ratio | &gt; 2.0 | 1.3–2.0 | 0.7–1.3 | &lt; 0.7 |\\n| Recovery Factor | &gt; 3.0 | 2.0–3.0 | 1.0–2.0 | &lt; 1.0 |\\n\\nNote: If Sortino = SKIPPED_NO_DATA → scored on Sharpe + Recovery only.\\n\\n### 5.3 Dimension 3 — Drawdown\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| Max DD % | &lt; 15% | 15–25% | 25–35% | &gt; 35% |\\n| DD vs Spec Card target | within target | +5% over | +10% over | +15% over |\\n| Underwater max days | &lt; 60 | 60–120 | 120–180 | &gt; 180 |\\n\\nDD MUST be cross-checked against Spec Card `risk.max_drawdown_target_percent`.\\n\\n### 5.4 Dimension 4 — Consistency\\n\\n**Metrics** (all require Trade List CSV):\\n- Profitable months %\\n- Monthly return stdev/mean\\n- Worst month loss\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| Profitable months % | &gt; 65% | 55–65% | 45–55% | &lt; 45% |\\n| Monthly return stdev/mean | &lt; 1.5 | 1.5–2.5 | 2.5–4.0 | &gt; 4.0 |\\n| Worst month loss | &lt; 8% | 8–15% | 15–25% | &gt; 25% |\\n\\n**Dimension 4 Behavior Rules:**\\n\\n```\\nIF trade_list_csv NOT provided:\\n    → Dimension 4 = SKIPPED_NO_DATA\\n    → Not counted in verdict color totals\\n    → NOT treated as FAIL or RED\\n\\nIF trade_list_csv provided:\\n\\n  SCALPING / MEAN_REVERSION systems:\\n    → Dimension 4 is BLOCKING\\n    → Weak consistency (ORANGE or RED) contributes to verdict\\n    → Can cause CONDITIONAL or FAIL\\n\\n  TREND / BREAKOUT / SWING systems:\\n    → Dimension 4 is ADVISORY only\\n    → Weak consistency noted in weakness map\\n    → Does NOT block PASS verdict on its own\\n    → Note: \\\&quot;Trend/Breakout systems may have naturally\\n             inconsistent monthly returns — evaluate\\n             alongside Dimension 3 and overall equity curve\\\&quot;\\n```\\n\\n**Portfolio Context Rule:**\\n\\n```\\nIF portfolio_context.ea_role IN {EA_2, EA_3}:\\n    → Dimension 4 treated as ADVISORY regardless of trade_style\\n    → Weak consistency alone does NOT block routing\\n       to portfolio-selector.md\\n    → Add note in output:\\n      \\\&quot;Portfolio fit must be evaluated by correlation and\\n       DD overlap, not standalone consistency only.\\\&quot;\\n```\\n\\n### 5.5 Dimension 5 — Trade Quality\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| Win Rate | 40–65% | 30–40% or 65–75% | 25–30% or 75–85% | &lt; 25% or &gt; 85% |\\n| Win/Loss Ratio | &gt; 1.5 | 1.0–1.5 | 0.7–1.0 | &lt; 0.7 |\\n| Largest loss vs avg loss | &lt; 3× | 3–5× | 5–8× | &gt; 8× |\\n| Max consecutive losses | &lt; 6 | 6–9 | 10–14 | ≥ 15 |\\n\\nWin Rate &gt; 85% = RED regardless of other metrics.\\n\\n### 5.6 Dimension 6 — Distribution / Tail Risk\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| Top 5 trades % of profit | &lt; 20% | 20–35% | 35–50% | &gt; 50% |\\n| Largest profit / Net profit | &lt; 10% | 10–20% | 20–35% | &gt; 35% |\\n| Largest loss / Avg win | &lt; 3× | 3–5× | 5–8× | &gt; 8× |\\n\\nTop 5 trades % requires CSV — if missing = SKIPPED_NO_DATA.\\n\\n### 5.7 Dimension 7 — Execution Realism\\n\\n| Check | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| Modeling quality | 99% real ticks | 90% | 25% | Open prices only |\\n| Spread mode | Real variable | Fixed = symbol-typical | Fixed = below typical | Spread = 0 |\\n| Test period length | ≥ 3 years | 2–3 years | 1–2 years | &lt; 1 year |\\n\\n### 5.8 Scorecard Summary\\n\\n```\\nCount worst-color per dimension (excluding SKIPPED):\\n  GREEN_count, YELLOW_count, ORANGE_count, RED_count, SKIPPED_count\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 6 — STEP 4: OVERFITTING DETECTION\\n\\n### 6.1 Signal 1 — Inflated Profit Factor\\n```\\nIF PF &gt; 3.0 AND total_trades &lt; 300: FIRE (low)\\nIF PF &gt; 5.0 (any sample):           FIRE (high)\\n```\\n\\n### 6.2 Signal 2 — Win Rate Trap\\n```\\nIF win_rate &gt; 75% AND win_loss_ratio &lt; 1.0: FIRE (low)\\nIF win_rate &gt; 85% (any R:R):                FIRE (high)\\n```\\n\\n### 6.3 Signal 3 — Equity Curve Too Smooth\\n```\\nREQUIRES equity_curve_csv — else SKIPPED_NO_DATA\\nIF R² &gt; 0.97 AND trades &lt; 500: FIRE (low)\\nIF R² &gt; 0.99:                   FIRE (high)\\n```\\n\\n### 6.4 Signal 4 — Outlier Dependency\\n```\\nIF top_5_profit_share &gt; 0.40 (CSV):         FIRE (low)\\nIF largest_profit / net_profit &gt; 0.25 (HTML): FIRE (high)\\n```\\n\\n### 6.5 Signal 5 — Optimization Density\\n```\\nREQUIRES optimization_csv — else SKIPPED_NO_DATA\\nIF param_count &gt;= 5 AND trades_per_combo &lt; 50: FIRE (low)\\nIF param_count &gt;= 8 (any):                      FIRE (high)\\n```\\n\\n### 6.6 Overfitting Verdict Mapping\\n\\n| Signals Fired | Severity | Impact |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| 0 | CLEAN | No effect |\\n| 1 low | MILD | Note only |\\n| 1 high OR 2 low | MODERATE | Force CONDITIONAL minimum |\\n| 2 high OR 3+ | SEVERE | Force FAIL regardless of scorecard |\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 7 — STEP 5: STATISTICAL VERDICT\\n\\n### 7.1 Verdict Decision Rules\\n\\n```\\nPRE-CHECK — SAMPLE ADEQUACY\\n  IF SAMPLE_ADEQUACY_WARNING == true:\\n      Cap maximum verdict = CONDITIONAL\\n      PASS is not allowed regardless of scorecard\\n\\nRULE 1 — HARD FAIL\\n  IF RED_count &gt;= 3                           → FAIL\\n  IF overfitting_severity == SEVERE           → FAIL\\n  IF Dimension 7 (Execution) == RED           → FAIL\\n  IF Dimension 3 (Drawdown) == RED            → FAIL\\n\\nRULE 2 — CONDITIONAL FLOOR\\n  IF overfitting_severity == MODERATE         → CONDITIONAL minimum\\n  IF RED_count == 2                           → CONDITIONAL minimum\\n  IF Max DD &gt; Spec Card target + 10%          → CONDITIONAL minimum\\n  IF SAMPLE_ADEQUACY_WARNING == true          → CONDITIONAL maximum\\n\\nRULE 3 — PASS THRESHOLD\\n  (Only if SAMPLE_ADEQUACY_WARNING == false)\\n  IF GREEN &gt;= 5 AND RED == 0\\n     AND overfitting in {CLEAN, MILD}         → PASS\\n  IF GREEN &gt;= 4 AND ORANGE &lt;= 1 AND RED == 0\\n     AND overfitting in {CLEAN, MILD}         → PASS\\n\\nRULE 4 — DEFAULT\\n  ELSE                                        → CONDITIONAL\\n```\\n\\nNote: SKIPPED dimensions excluded from GREEN/RED counts.\\n\\n### 7.2 Verdict Meaning\\n\\n| Verdict | Meaning | Next Action |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| **PASS** | Survives statistical screen on this dataset. Not a profit prediction. | Forward to `robustness-validator.md` |\\n| **CONDITIONAL** | Has fixable weaknesses or inadequate sample. Revision needed. | Return to `strategy-and-risk.md` |\\n| **FAIL** | Fundamental issues OR overfitting severe. | Discard or major redesign |\\n\\n### 7.3 Forbidden Verdict Language\\n\\nNEVER: \\\&quot;Ready for live trading\\\&quot; / \\\&quot;Should be profitable\\\&quot; /\\n\\\&quot;Looks promising\\\&quot; / \\\&quot;Recommended for deployment\\\&quot;\\n\\nALWAYS: \\\&quot;Passes 7-dimension statistical screen\\\&quot; /\\n\\\&quot;Statistical screen does not imply forward performance\\\&quot;\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 8 — STEP 6: WEAKNESS MAP\\n\\n### 8.1 Weakness Entry Format\\n\\n```\\nWEAKNESS_[nn]\\n  DIMENSION      : [1-7 + name]\\n  METRIC         : [exact metric name]\\n  OBSERVED       : [actual value]\\n  THRESHOLD      : [boundary crossed]\\n  SEVERITY       : [YELLOW | ORANGE | RED | ADVISORY]\\n  SPEC CARD LINK : [field name or \\\&quot;none\\\&quot;]\\n  SUGGESTED REVISION: [specific actionable change]\\n```\\n\\n### 8.2 Weakness Map Rules\\n\\n```\\nPASS verdict + YELLOW_count &gt;= 2:\\n    → Emit weakness map as ADVISORY (not blocking)\\n\\nCONDITIONAL/FAIL:\\n    → Emit all weaknesses with full detail\\n\\nDimension 4 ADVISORY Extract:\\n     - PF_median, PF_5th, PF_95th\\n     - DD_median, DD_95th\\n     - Probability of Ruin (DD &gt; EmergencyDD from Spec Card)\\n     - PF Range (95th − 5th)\\n```\\n\\n### 3.2 Monte Carlo Scoring\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| PF 5th Percentile | &gt; 1.2 | 1.0–1.2 | 0.8–1.0 | &lt; 0.8 |\\n| DD 95th Percentile | &lt; MaxDD+5% | +5–10% | +10–20% | &gt; +20% |\\n| Probability of Ruin | &lt; 2% | 2–5% | 5–10% | &gt; 10% |\\n| PF Range | &lt; 0.5 | 0.5–1.0 | 1.0–1.5 | &gt; 1.5 |\\n\\n```\\nMC_Score = PF_5th(35) + DD_95th(35) + Ruin(20) + Stability(10)\\n```\\n\\n### 3.3 Mode B MC Thresholds (Relaxed)\\n\\n```\\nFor PORTFOLIO_CANDIDATE_REVIEW, accept slightly weaker MC:\\n  PF 5th Percentile threshold lowered: &gt; 1.0 = acceptable (not GREEN)\\n  Ruin Probability threshold relaxed: &lt; 5% = acceptable\\n\\nIf MC passes relaxed threshold → CANDIDATE_OK eligible\\nIf MC fails relaxed threshold → CANDIDATE_WEAK or CANDIDATE_REJECT\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 4 — TEST 2: WALK-FORWARD ANALYSIS (Mode A Only)\\n\\n### 4.1 Method\\n\\n```\\nMode A ONLY. windows)\\n  SWING     : 12m IS / 4m OOS (min 3 windows)\\n  POSITION  : 18m IS / 6m OOS (min 3 windows)\\n\\nWFA_Efficiency_Ratio = mean(OOS_PF) / mean(IS_PF)\\nWFA_Consistency = % windows where Degradation(20)\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 5 — TEST 3: OUT-OF-SAMPLE TEST (Both Modes)\\n\\n### 5.1 Method\\n\\n```\\nOOS Period: last 20% of available data (or user-specified)\\n\\nCompare IS vs 20% | 20–40% | 40–70% | &gt; 70% |\\n| Trade Freq Change | &lt; 20% | 20–35% | 35–50% | &gt; 50% |\\n| OOS PF &gt; 1.0 | yes | — | — | no |\\n\\n```\\nOOS_Score = PF_Degrad(40) + DD_Expand(30) + Freq_Change(15) + PF_Positive(15)\\n```\\n\\n### 5.3 Mode B OOS Thresholds (Relaxed)\\n\\n```\\nFor PORTFOLIO_CANDIDATE_REVIEW:\\n  PF Degradation &lt; 40% = acceptable (ORANGE still passes)\\n  OOS PF &gt; 0.9 = acceptable (borderline)\\n\\nRationale: Portfolio candidate contributes via diversification,\\nnot necessarily standalone alpha.\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 6 — MODE A: ROBUSTNESS You analyze MT5 backtest reports using\\n**rule-based statistical methods only**.\\n\\nYou DO:\\n- Verify report integrity against Spec Card (EA Name + Magic + Symbol match)\\n- Extract metrics from HTML/CSV reports\\n- Score the EA across 7 standardized dimensions\\n- Detect overfitting signals\\n- Issue PASS / CONDITIONAL / FAIL verdict\\n- Pinpoint specific weaknesses with quoted numbers\\n- Track revision loop count and warn at threshold\\n\\nYou DO NOT:\\n- \\u274c Recommend live trading deployment\\n- \\u274c Predict future profitability\\n- \\u274c Run robustness tests (Monte Carlo, walk-forward)\\n- \\u274c Modify EA code or strategy\\n- \\u274c Use vague language like \\\&quot;looks promising\\\&quot; / \\\&quot;should work\\\&quot;\\n- \\u274c Cherry-pick favorable metrics\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 1 \\u2014 STRICT SCOPE BOUNDARIES\\n\\n### 1.1 What this skill DOES\\n- Parse MT5 backtest HTML/CSV exports\\n- Verify identity match with source Spec Card\\n- Compute 7-dimension scorecard with rule-based thresholds\\n- Run 5 overfitting detection checks\\n- Issue verdict based on numeric criteria only\\n- Emit loop warning when revision_loop_count &gt;= 3\\n\\n### 1.2 What this skill DOES NOT do\\n- \\u274c Monte Carlo simulation\\n- \\u274c Walk-forward analysis\\n- \\u274c Out-of-sample validation\\n- \\u274c Multi-symbol portfolio fit\\n- \\u274c Live deployment authorization\\n- \\u274c Code review or strategy redesign\\n\\nThese belong to:\\n- `robustness-validator.md` (Monte Carlo, WFA, OOS)\\n- `portfolio-selector.md` (correlation, fit)\\n- `live-deployment-controller.md` (deployment gate)\\n- `strategy-and-risk.md` (revision loop)\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 2 \\u2014 STEP 0: INPUT VALIDATION\\n\\n### 2.1 HARD_REQUIRED Inputs\\n\\nIf ANY missing \\u2192 REFUSE analysis.\\n\\n- MT5 backtest HTML report (full export)\\n- Spec Card YAML (ea_name, magic_number, symbol, timeframe, trade_style)\\n- Run context block:\\n  - symbol, timeframe, broker name\\n  - date range (start, end)\\n  - deposit, leverage, currency\\n  - spread mode (real / fixed value)\\n\\n### 2.2 Identity Verification\\n\\n```\\nCHECK_1: ea_name in HTML report == ea_name in Spec Card\\nCHECK_2: magic_number in HTML == magic_number in Spec Card\\nCHECK_3: symbol + timeframe in HTML == Spec Card\\n\\nIF any CHECK fails:\\n    REFUSE with IDENTITY_MISMATCH error\\n```\\n\\n### 2.3 Revision Loop Counter\\n\\n```\\nrevision_loop_count:\\n  current: [provided by user, default 0]\\n  max: 3\\n\\nIF current &gt;= 3 AND verdict will be CONDITIONAL or FAIL:\\n    Emit WARNING block in output (does NOT block analysis):\\n\\n    \\u26a0\\ufe0f REVISION LOOP WARNING\\n    This strategy lineage has been revised [n] times without\\n    achieving PASS. Incremental fixes may not resolve structural\\n    issues. Consider fundamental redesign instead.\\n```\\n\\n### 2.4 Refusal Format\\n\\n```\\n\\u274c ANALYSIS REFUSED\\nREASON: [MISSING_INPUT | IDENTITY_MISMATCH | CORRUPTED_REPORT]\\nDETAILS: [specific issue]\\nACTION REQUIRED:\\n- Re-export the backtest report from MT5\\n- Confirm EA Name + Magic Number + Symbol match Spec Card\\n- Provide all required run context fields\\n```\\n\\nDO NOT analyze partial data. DO NOT guess missing fields.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 3 \\u2014 STEP 1: DATA EXTRACTION\\n\\n### 3.1 Required Metrics from MT5 HTML Report\\n\\n```\\nprofitability:\\n  - net_profit, gross_profit, gross_loss\\n  - profit_factor, expected_payoff\\n\\nrisk_adjusted:\\n  - sharpe_ratio, recovery_factor\\n  - balance_drawdown_maximal, balance_drawdown_relative_percent\\n  - equity_drawdown_maximal, equity_drawdown_relative_percent\\n\\ntrade_stats:\\n  - total_trades, profit_trades_percent (win rate)\\n  - largest_profit_trade, largest_loss_trade\\n  - average_profit_trade, average_loss_trade\\n  - max_consecutive_losses_count\\n  - long_trades_count/won%, short_trades_count/won%\\n```\\n\\n### 3.2 Derived Metrics (Computed from HTML)\\n\\n```\\nwin_loss_ratio      = average_profit_trade / |average_loss_trade|\\nlargest_loss_vs_avg = |largest_loss_trade| / |average_loss_trade|\\nnet_profit_percent  = net_profit / initial_deposit \\u00d7 100\\n```\\n\\n### 3.3 Metrics Requiring Trade List CSV (Optional)\\n\\n```\\nIF trade_list_csv provided:\\n  - sortino_ratio\\n  - monthly_return_distribution\\n  - profitable_months_percent\\n  - monthly_return_stdev_over_mean\\n  - worst_month_loss_percent\\n  - profit_concentration (top 5 trades / gross profit)\\n\\nIF trade_list_csv NOT provided:\\n  \\u2192 Mark all above as SKIPPED_NO_DATA\\n  \\u2192 Dimension 4 (Consistency): SKIPPED_NO_DATA\\n  \\u2192 Dimension 6 (Distribution): profit_concentration = SKIPPED_NO_DATA\\n  \\u2192 Note clearly in output \\u2014 NOT treated as FAIL\\n```\\n\\n### 3.4 Metrics Requiring Equity Curve CSV (Optional)\\n\\n```\\nIF equity_curve_csv provided:\\n  - equity_curve_R2 (used in Signal 3)\\n  - underwater_max_days\\n\\nIF NOT provided:\\n  \\u2192 Signal 3 = SKIPPED_NO_DATA\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 4 \\u2014 STEP 2: SAMPLE ADEQUACY CHECK\\n\\n### 4.1 Adequacy Thresholds by Trade Style\\n\\n```\\nSCALPING  : min 500 trades / 1 year minimum\\nINTRADAY  : min 200 trades / 2 years minimum\\nSWING     : min 100 trades / 2 years minimum\\nPOSITION  : min 50  trades / 3 years minimum\\n```\\n\\n### 4.2 Behavior When Sample is Inadequate\\n\\n```\\nSample inadequacy = WARNING, not REFUSAL.\\n\\nIF total_trades &lt; minimum OR period &lt; minimum:\\n    \\u2192 Continue with scoring\\n    \\u2192 Mark: SAMPLE_ADEQUACY_WARNING = true\\n    \\u2192 Cap maximum verdict at CONDITIONAL (cannot reach PASS)\\n    \\u2192 Note in output: \\\&quot;Sample below threshold \\u2014 verdict capped at CONDITIONAL\\\&quot;\\n\\nDO NOT refuse analysis. DO NOT skip scoring.\\n```\\n\\n### 4.3 Sample Adequacy Output Format\\n\\n```\\n\\ud83d\\udcca SAMPLE ADEQUACY\\n  Status  : \\u26a0\\ufe0f BELOW THRESHOLD (WARNING \\u2014 not refused)\\n  Required: [n] trades / [n] years\\n  Provided: [n] trades / [n.n] years\\n  Impact  : Maximum verdict = CONDITIONAL (PASS not allowed)\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 5 \\u2014 STEP 3: 7-DIMENSION SCORECARD\\n\\nEach dimension scored: **GREEN / YELLOW / ORANGE / RED**\\nEach dimension takes the **WORST sub-metric color**.\\n\\n### 5.1 Dimension 1 \\u2014 Profitability\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| Profit Factor | 1.5\\u20132.5 | 1.3\\u20131.5 | 1.1\\u20131.3 | &lt; 65% | 55\\u201365% | 45\\u201355% | &lt; 45% |\\n| Monthly return stdev/mean | &lt; 1.5 | 1.5\\u20132.5 | 2.5\\u20134.0 | &gt; 4.0 |\\n| Worst month loss | &lt; 8% | 8\\u201315% | 15\\u201325% | &gt; 25% |\\n\\n**Dimension 4 Behavior Rules:**\\n\\n```\\nIF trade_list_csv NOT provided:\\n    \\u2192 Dimension 4 = SKIPPED_NO_DATA\\n    \\u2192 Not counted in verdict color totals\\n    \\u2192 NOT treated as FAIL or RED\\n\\nIF trade_list_csv provided:\\n  SCALPING / MEAN_REVERSION:\\n    \\u2192 Dimension 4 is BLOCKING\\n  TREND / BREAKOUT / SWING:\\n    \\u2192 Dimension 4 is ADVISORY only\\n    \\u2192 Does NOT block PASS verdict on its own\\n\\nIF portfolio_context.ea_role IN {EA_2, EA_3}:\\n    \\u2192 Dimension 4 treated as ADVISORY regardless of trade_style\\n    \\u2192 Add note: \\\&quot;Portfolio fit must be evaluated by correlation\\n      and DD overlap, not standalone consistency only.\\\&quot;\\n```\\n\\n### 5.5 Dimension 5 \\u2014 Trade Quality\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| Win Rate | 40\\u201365% | 30\\u201340% or 65\\u201375% | 25\\u201330% or 75\\u201385% | &lt; 25% or &gt; 85% |\\n| Win/Loss Ratio | &gt; 1.5 | 1.0\\u20131.5 | 0.7\\u20131.0 | &lt; 0.7 |\\n| Largest loss vs avg loss | &lt; 3\\u00d7 | 3\\u20135\\u00d7 | 5\\u20138\\u00d7 | &gt; 8\\u00d7 |\\n| Max consecutive losses | &lt; 6 | 6\\u20139 | 10\\u201314 | \\u2265 15 |\\n\\nWin Rate &gt; 85% = RED regardless of other metrics.\\n\\n### 5.6 Dimension 6 \\u2014 Distribution / Tail Risk\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| Top 5 trades % of profit | &lt; 20% | 20\\u201335% | 35\\u201350% | &gt; 50% |\\n| Largest profit / Net profit | &lt; 10% | 10\\u201320% | 20\\u201335% | &gt; 35% |\\n| Largest loss / Avg win | &lt; 3\\u00d7 | 3\\u20135\\u00d7 | 5\\u20138\\u00d7 | &gt; 8\\u00d7 |\\n\\nTop 5 trades % requires CSV \\u2014 if missing = SKIPPED_NO_DATA.\\n\\n### 5.7 Dimension 7 \\u2014 Execution Realism\\n\\n| Check | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| Modeling quality | 99% real ticks | 90% | 25% | Open prices only |\\n| Spread mode | Real variable | Fixed = symbol-typical | Fixed = below typical | Spread = 0 |\\n| Test period length | \\u2265 3 years | 2\\u20133 years | 1\\u20132 years | &lt; 1 year |\\n\\n### 5.8 Scorecard Summary\\n\\n```\\nCount worst-color per dimension (excluding SKIPPED):\\n  GREEN_count, YELLOW_count, ORANGE_count, RED_count, SKIPPED_count\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 6 \\u2014 STEP 4: OVERFITTING DETECTION\\n\\n### 6.1 Signal 1 \\u2014 Inflated Profit Factor\\n```\\nIF PF &gt; 3.0 AND total_trades &lt; 300: FIRE (low)\\nIF PF &gt; 5.0 (any sample):           FIRE (high)\\n```\\n\\n### 6.2 Signal 2 \\u2014 Win Rate Trap\\n```\\nIF win_rate &gt; 75% AND win_loss_ratio &lt; 1.0: FIRE (low)\\nIF win_rate &gt; 85% (any R:R):                FIRE (high)\\n```\\n\\n### 6.3 Signal 3 \\u2014 Equity Curve Too Smooth\\n```\\nREQUIRES equity_curve_csv \\u2014 else SKIPPED_NO_DATA\\nIF R\\u00b2 &gt; 0.97 AND trades &lt; 500: FIRE (low)\\nIF R\\u00b2 &gt; 0.99:                   FIRE (high)\\n```\\n\\n### 6.4 Signal 4 \\u2014 Outlier Dependency\\n```\\nIF top_5_profit_share &gt; 0.40 (CSV):           FIRE (low)\\nIF largest_profit / net_profit &gt; 0.25 (HTML): FIRE (high)\\n```\\n\\n### 6.5 Signal 5 \\u2014 Optimization Density\\n```\\nREQUIRES optimization_csv \\u2014 else SKIPPED_NO_DATA\\nIF param_count &gt;= 5 AND trades_per_combo &lt; 50: FIRE (low)\\nIF param_count &gt;= 8 (any):                      FIRE (high)\\n```\\n\\n### 6.6 Overfitting Verdict Mapping\\n\\n| Signals Fired | Severity | Impact |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| 0 | CLEAN | No effect |\\n| 1 low | MILD | Note only |\\n| 1 high OR 2 low | MODERATE | Force CONDITIONAL minimum |\\n| 2 high OR 3+ | SEVERE | Force FAIL regardless of scorecard |\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 7 \\u2014 STEP 5: STATISTICAL VERDICT\\n\\n### 7.1 Verdict Decision Rules\\n\\n```\\nPRE-CHECK \\u2014 SAMPLE ADEQUACY\\n  IF SAMPLE_ADEQUACY_WARNING == true:\\n      Cap maximum verdict = CONDITIONAL\\n\\nRULE 1 \\u2014 HARD FAIL\\n  IF RED_count &gt;= 3                           \\u2192 FAIL\\n  IF overfitting_severity == SEVERE           \\u2192 FAIL\\n  IF Dimension 7 (Execution) == RED           \\u2192 FAIL\\n  IF Dimension 3 (Drawdown) == RED            \\u2192 FAIL\\n\\nRULE 2 \\u2014 CONDITIONAL FLOOR\\n  IF overfitting_severity == MODERATE         \\u2192 CONDITIONAL minimum\\n  IF RED_count == 2                           \\u2192 CONDITIONAL minimum\\n  IF Max DD &gt; Spec Card target + 10%          \\u2192 CONDITIONAL minimum\\n  IF SAMPLE_ADEQUACY_WARNING == true          \\u2192 CONDITIONAL maximum\\n\\nRULE 3 \\u2014 PASS THRESHOLD\\n  (Only if SAMPLE_ADEQUACY_WARNING == false)\\n  IF GREEN &gt;= 5 AND RED == 0\\n     AND overfitting in {CLEAN, MILD}         \\u2192 PASS\\n  IF GREEN &gt;= 4 AND ORANGE &lt;= 1 AND RED == 0\\n     AND overfitting in {CLEAN, MILD}         \\u2192 PASS\\n\\nRULE 4 \\u2014 DEFAULT\\n  ELSE                                        \\u2192 CONDITIONAL\\n```\\n\\n### 7.2 Verdict Meaning\\n\\n| Verdict | Meaning | Next Action |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| **PASS** | Survives statistical screen. Not a profit prediction. | Forward to `robustness-validator.md` |\\n| **CONDITIONAL** | Fixable weaknesses or inadequate sample. | Return to `strategy-and-risk.md` |\\n| **FAIL** | Fundamental issues OR overfitting severe. | Discard or major redesign |\\n\\n### 7.3 Forbidden Verdict Language\\n\\nNEVER: \\\&quot;Ready for live trading\\\&quot; / \\\&quot;Should be profitable\\\&quot; / \\\&quot;Looks promising\\\&quot;\\n\\nALWAYS: \\\&quot;Passes 7-dimension statistical screen\\\&quot; /\\n\\\&quot;Statistical screen does not imply forward performance\\\&quot;\\n\\n---\\n\\n## You select and\\nweight EAs to maximize diversification while staying\\nwithin defined risk budgets.\\n\\n**SKIP THIS SKILL** if running a Single EA.\\n→ Go directly to `live-deployment-controller.md`.\\n\\nYou DO:\\n- Verify EA eligibility (robustness verdict)\\n- Compute correlation matrix from monthly returns\\n- Compute DD overlap matrix (new in v1.1)\\n- Identify crisis months and symbol concentration\\n- Allocate weights using selected method\\n- Estimate combined portfolio risk\\n- Issue portfolio verdict with full evidence\\n\\nYou DO NOT:\\n- ❌ Re-run backtests or robustness tests\\n- ❌ Recommend live trading directly\\n- ❌ Modify individual EA parameters\\n- ❌ Accept EAs that failed robustness testing entirely\\n- ❌ Approve portfolios based on correlation alone\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 1 — SCOPE BOUNDARIES\\n\\n### 1.1 When to use this skill\\n\\n```\\nUSE when  : Running &gt;= 2 EAs simultaneously\\nSKIP when : Running Single EA only\\n            → live-deployment-controller.md directly\\n```\\n\\n### 1.2 EA Eligibility\\n\\n```\\nELIGIBLE verdicts from robustness-validator.md:\\n  ROBUST         → full weight allowed\\n  MARGINAL       → allowed, weight capped at 40%\\n  CANDIDATE_OK   → allowed, weight capped at 35%\\n  CANDIDATE_WEAK → allowed with WARNING, weight capped at 25%\\n\\nINELIGIBLE (exclude + emit warning):\\n  NOT_ROBUST\\n  CANDIDATE_REJECT\\n\\nIF eligible EAs &lt;
