bars        │\\n// │ Trail Start  │ 10 pips  │ 20 pips  │ 50 pips  │ 80 pips        │\\n// │ Trail ATR    │ 0.5×     │ 1.0×     │ 1.5×     │ 2.0×           │\\n// └──────────────┴──────────┴──────────┴──────────┴────────────────┘\\ninput ENUM_TRADE_STYLE InpTradeStyle = STYLE_INTRADAY;\\n// ^ กำหนด Trade Style → Auto-fill ตารางด้านบน | Optimize: ✅\\n```\\n\\n**ตัวอย่าง RISK Section — แสดงว่าค่าถูก Override โดย Preset:**\\n```mql5\\ninput group \\\&quot;=== RISK ===\\\&quot;\\n// ⚠️ ค่าใน Section นี้ถูก Override โดย InpRiskLevel ใน PRESET\\n//    ค่าที่เห็นใน UI เป็นแค่ Default — EA ใช้ค่าจาก ApplyPreset() จริง\\n//    ถ้าต้องการ Override Manual → แก้ใน ApplyPreset() โดยตรง\\n\\ninput double  InpRiskPercent  = 1.0;\\n// ^ Risk % ต่อ Trade | SAFE=0.5 MEDIUM=1.0 AGGRESSIVE=2.0 | Optimize: ❌ FIXED\\n\\ninput double  InpMaxDD_Pct    = 20.0;\\n// ^ Max Drawdown ก่อนหยุดเทรด | SAFE=10% MEDIUM=20% AGGRESSIVE=35% | Optimize: ❌ FIXED\\n\\ninput double  InpDailyLoss_Pct = 5.0;\\n// ^ Loss ต่อวัน ก่อนหยุด | SAFE=3% MEDIUM=5% AGGRESSIVE=10% | Optimize: ❌ FIXED\\n\\ninput int     InpMaxPositions  = 5;\\n// ^ Max Open Positions | SAFE=3 MEDIUM=5 AGGRESSIVE=10 | Optimize: ❌ FIXED\\n\\ninput double  InpMaxTotalLot   = 0.5;\\n// ^ Max Total Lot ทั้งหมด | SAFE=0.1 MEDIUM=0.5 AGGRESSIVE=1.0 | Optimize: ❌ FIXED\\n\\ninput double  InpEmergencyDD   = 70.0;\\n// ^ DD% ฉุกเฉิน → ปิดทุก Position ทันที | Fix 70% ทุก Profile | Optimize: ❌ FIXED\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 5 — PRE-OUTPUT SELF-CHECK\\n\\nBefore emitting code, verify internally:\\n\\n- [ ] Spec Card complexity is L1, L2, or L3 (not L4/L5)\\n- [ ] All called functions have definitions\\n- [ ] All `#include` directives are used\\n- [ ] All declared inputs are referenced\\n- [ ] All globals initialized in `OnInit()`\\n- [ ] Every indicator handle has `IndicatorRelease()` in `OnDeinit()`\\n- [ ] No declared-but-unused variables\\n- [ ] No `OnTick` path that skips Safety Check Order\\n- [ ] No indicator handles created inside `OnTick()`\\n- [ ] Magic Number used consistently\\n- [ ] Naming convention consistent (Inp/g_/PascalCase)\\n- [ ] SL != 0 on every Order path\\n- [ ] `ApplyPreset()` called first in `OnInit()`\\n- [ ] `ValidateCombination()` called after `ApplyPreset()`\\n- [ ] ทุก Input มี Comment อธิบายตาม 4.7 Standard\\n- [ ] PRESET Section มีตาราง Auto-fill Table ครบทั้ง Risk และ Style\\n\\nIf ANY check fails → fix internally → re-check → THEN emit.\\nNever emit code that fails self-check.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 6 — ApplyPreset() + ValidateCombination() Templates\\n\\n### 6.1 ApplyPreset()\\n\\n```mql5\\nvoid ApplyPreset()\\n{\\n    // Trade Style → TP/SL/Grid/Filter defaults\\n    switch(InpTradeStyle)\\n    {\\n        case STYLE_SCALPING:\\n            InpTPFixedPips=15; InpStructureLookback=5;\\n            InpMaxSpreadPoints=10; InpATR_MinValue=0.0003;\\n            InpTrailStart_Pips=10; InpTrailATR_Multi=0;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_INTRADAY:\\n            InpTPFixedPips=40; InpStructureLookback=10;\\n            InpMaxSpreadPoints=20; InpATR_MinValue=0.0005;\\n            InpTrailStart_Pips=20; InpTrailATR_Multi=1.0;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_SWING:\\n            InpTPFixedPips=100; InpStructureLookback=20;\\n            InpMaxSpreadPoints=30; InpATR_MinValue=0.0008;\\n            InpTrailStart_Pips=50; InpTrailATR_Multi=1.5;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_TREND:\\n            InpTPFixedPips=200; InpStructureLookback=20;\\n            InpMaxSpreadPoints=30; InpATR_MinValue=0.0010;\\n            InpTrailStart_Pips=80; InpTrailATR_Multi=2.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n    // Risk Profile → Lot/DD/Position/CB defaults\\n    // Note: AGGRESSIVE MM default = LINEAR (not MARTINGALE)\\n    switch(InpRiskLevel)\\n    {\\n        case RISK_SAFE:\\n            InpRiskPercent=0.5; InpMaxDrawdownPct=10.0;\\n            InpDailyLossPct=3.0; InpMaxOpenPositions=3;\\n            InpMaxTotalLot=0.1; InpCB_DD_Trigger=8.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_MEDIUM:\\n            InpRiskPercent=1.0; InpMaxDrawdownPct=20.0;\\n            InpDailyLossPct=5.0; InpMaxOpenPositions=5;\\n            InpMaxTotalLot=0.5; InpCB_DD_Trigger=15.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_AGGRESSIVE:\\n            InpRiskPercent=2.0; InpMaxDrawdownPct=35.0;\\n            InpDailyLossPct=10.0; InpMaxOpenPositions=10;\\n            InpMaxTotalLot=1.0; InpCB_DD_Trigger=25.0;\\n            // MM_Mode is NOT set to MARTINGALE here\\n            // Martingale requires explicit Spec Card field\\n            break;\\n    }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n### 6.2 ValidateCombination()\\n\\n```mql5\\nvoid ValidateCombination()\\n{\\n    // SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND = Signal too slow\\n    if(InpTradeStyle == STYLE_SCALPING &amp;&amp;\\n       InpHedgeMode  == HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND)\\n    {\\n        InpHedgeMode = HEDGE_OFF;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: SCALPING+FOLLOW_TREND → Hedge forced OFF\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n    // TREND + FOLLOW_CANDLE = High false signal\\n    if(InpTradeStyle == STYLE_TREND &amp;&amp;\\n       InpHedgeMode  == HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE)\\n    {\\n        InpHedgeMode = HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: TREND+FOLLOW_CANDLE → Hedge forced FOLLOW_TREND\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n    // GRID_NONE + MARTINGALE = No grid to scale on\\n    if(InpGridMode == GRID_NONE &amp;&amp;\\n       InpMMMode   == MM_MARTINGALE)\\n    {\\n        InpMMMode = MM_FIXED;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: No Grid+MARTINGALE → MM forced FIXED\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n    // TP_DYNAMIC + Trail ON = Duplicate exit\\n    if(InpTPMode          == TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE &amp;&amp;\\n       InpTrailingStop_ON == true)\\n    {\\n        InpTrailingStop_ON = false;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: DYNAMIC_TP+Trail → Trail forced OFF\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n    // SCALPING + RANGE_TREND SL = SL too wide\\n    if(InpTradeStyle == STYLE_SCALPING &amp;&amp;\\n       InpSLMode     == SL_RANGE_TREND)\\n    {\\n        InpSLMode = SL_STRUCTURE;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: SCALPING+RANGE_TREND SL → SL forced STRUCTURE\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 7 — ENTRY CODE TEMPLATES\\n\\nReference when generating Entry Logic from Spec Card.\\n\\n### Template 1: Custom Indicator (iCustom)\\n\\n```mql5\\nint      h_custom;\\ndouble   g_bufUp[], g_bufDown[];\\n\\n// OnInit()\\nh_custom = iCustom(_Symbol, InpEntryTimeframe,\\n                   \\\&quot;IndicatorName\\\&quot;, Param1, Param2);\\nif(h_custom == INVALID_HANDLE)\\n{\\n    Print(\\\&quot;ERROR: Failed to create custom handle\\\&quot;);\\n    return INIT_FAILED;\\n}\\nArraySetAsSeries(g_bufUp,   true);\\nArraySetAsSeries(g_bufDown, true);\\n\\n// OnDeinit()\\n// if(h_custom != INVALID_HANDLE) IndicatorRelease(h_custom);\\n\\n// Entry Check (New Bar Only)\\nCopyBuffer(h_custom, 0, 0, 3, g_bufUp);\\nCopyBuffer(h_custom, 1, 0, 3, g_bufDown);\\n\\nbool buySignal  = (g_bufUp[1]   != EMPTY_VALUE &amp;&amp;\\n                   g_bufUp[2]   == EMPTY_VALUE);\\nbool sellSignal = (g_bufDown[1] != EMPTY_VALUE &amp;&amp;\\n                   g_bufDown[2] == EMPTY_VALUE);\\n```\\n\\n### Template 2: EMA Cross\\n\\n```mql5\\nint    h_emaFast, h_emaSlow;\\ndouble g_emaFast[], g_emaSlow[];\\n\\n// OnInit()\\nh_emaFast = iMA(_Symbol, InpEntryTimeframe,\\n                InpFastPeriod, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);\\nh_emaSlow = iMA(_Symbol, InpEntryTimeframe,\\n                InpSlowPeriod, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);\\nArraySetAsSeries(g_emaFast, true);\\nArraySetAsSeries(g_emaSlow, true);\\n\\n// Entry Check\\nCopyBuffer(h_emaFast, 0, 0, 3, g_emaFast);\\nCopyBuffer(h_emaSlow, 0, 0, 3, g_emaSlow);\\n\\nbool buySignal  = (g_emaFast[1] &gt; g_emaSlow[1]) &amp;&amp;\\n                  (g_emaFast[2] &lt;= g_emaSlow[2]);\\nbool sellSignal = (g_emaFast[1] &lt; g_emaSlow[1]) &amp;&amp;\\n                  (g_emaFast[2] &gt;= g_emaSlow[2]);\\n```\\n\\n### Template 3: RSI\\n\\n```mql5\\nint    h_rsi;\\ndouble g_rsiBuf[];\\n\\n// OnInit()\\nh_rsi = iRSI(_Symbol, InpEntryTimeframe, InpRSI_Period, PRICE_CLOSE);\\nArraySetAsSeries(g_rsiBuf, true);\\n\\n// Entry Check\\nCopyBuffer(h_rsi, 0, 0, 3, g_rsiBuf);\\n\\nbool buySignal  = (g_rsiBuf[1] &lt; InpRSI_Oversold  &amp;&amp;\\n                   g_rsiBuf[2] &gt;= InpRSI_Oversold);\\nbool sellSignal = (g_rsiBuf[1] &gt; InpRSI_Overbought &amp;&amp;\\n                   g_rsiBuf[2] &lt;= InpRSI_Overbought);\\n```\\n\\n### Template 4: Bollinger Bands\\n\\n```mql5\\nint    h_bb;\\ndouble g_bbUpper[], g_bbLower[];\\n\\n// OnInit()\\nh_bb = iBands(_Symbol, InpEntryTimeframe,\\n              InpBB_Period, 0, InpBB_Dev, PRICE_CLOSE);\\nArraySetAsSeries(g_bbUpper, true);\\nArraySetAsSeries(g_bbLower, true);\\n\\n// Entry Check\\nCopyBuffer(h_bb, 1, 0, 3, g_bbUpper);\\nCopyBuffer(h_bb, 2, 0, 3, g_bbLower);\\n\\ndouble closeNow  = iClose(_Symbol, InpEntryTimeframe, 1);\\ndouble closePrev = iClose(_Symbol, InpEntryTimeframe, 2);\\n\\nbool buySignal  = (closePrev &lt;= g_bbLower[2]) &amp;&amp;\\n                  (closeNow  &gt;  g_bbLower[1]);\\nbool sellSignal = (closePrev &gt;= g_bbUpper[2]) &amp;&amp;\\n                  (closeNow  &lt;  g_bbUpper[1]);\\n```\\n\\n### Template 5: MACD\\n\\n```mql5\\nint    h_macd;\\ndouble g_macdMain[], g_macdSignal[];\\n\\n// OnInit()\\nh_macd = iMACD(_Symbol, InpEntryTimeframe,\\n               InpMACD_Fast, InpMACD_Slow,\\n               InpMACD_Signal, PRICE_CLOSE);\\nArraySetAsSeries(g_macdMain,   true);\\nArraySetAsSeries(g_macdSignal, true);\\n\\n// Entry Check\\nCopyBuffer(h_macd, 0, 0, 3, g_macdMain);\\nCopyBuffer(h_macd, 1, 0, 3, g_macdSignal);\\n\\nbool buySignal  = (g_macdMain[1] &gt; g_macdSignal[1]) &amp;&amp;\\n                  (g_macdMain[2] &lt;= g_macdSignal[2]);\\nbool \\u2014 CODE GENERATION RULES\\n\\n### 4.1 Mandatory Coding Standards\\n\\n**MUST HAVE**\\n- Use `_Symbol`, `_Period`, `_Digits` \\u2014 never hardcode\\n- Use `SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, read by all logic\\n  double g_riskPercent = 1.0;\\n\\n  void ApplyPreset()\\n  {\\n      // Write to g_* only \\u2014 never to Inp*\\n      switch(InpRiskLevel)\\n      {\\n          case RISK_MEDIUM:\\n              g_riskPercent    = 1.0;\\n              g_maxDrawdownPct = 20.0;\\n              g_dailyLossPct   = 5.0;\\n              g_maxPositions   = 5;\\n              g_maxTotalLot    = 0.5;\\n              g_cbDDTrigger    = 15.0;\\n              break;\\n      }\\n  }\\n\\n  // All downstream logic reads g_* \\u2014 not Inp*\\n  bool CheckDrawdownLimit()\\n  {\\n      return (GetCurrentDD() &lt; g_maxDrawdownPct);  // \\u2705 g_*, not InpMaxDD_Pct\\n  }\\n```\\n\\n### 4.4 OnTick Safety Check Order (FIXED SEQUENCE)\\n\\n```\\n1. ResetDailyStats()\\n2. CheckEmergencyExit()        \\u2190 DD &gt;= g_emergencyDD \\u2192 CloseAll\\n3. CheckDrawdownLimit()        \\u2190 DD &gt;= g_maxDrawdownPct \\u2192 Stop\\n4. CheckDailyLossLimit()       \\u2190 DailyLoss &gt;= g_dailyLossPct \\u2192 Stop\\n5. CheckCircuitBreaker()       \\u2190 CB active \\u2192 Stop\\n6. CheckSpreadSpike()          \\u2190 Spread &gt; g_maxSpreadHard \\u2192 Stop\\n7. CheckCurrentBarSpike()      \\u2190 TR &gt; ATR \\u00d7 Multi \\u2192 Stop (if ON)\\n8. CheckPriceGap()             \\u2190 Gap &gt; MaxGap \\u2192 CB + Stop (if ON)\\n9. CheckATRFilter()            \\u2190 ATR &lt; g_atrMinValue \\u2192 Stop\\n10. CheckSessionFilter()       \\u2190 Outside session \\u2192 Stop (if ON)\\n11. S/R Update                 \\u2190 New Bar only (if ON)\\n12. Hedge Management           \\u2190 (if ON, L3 only)\\n13. Entry Logic                \\u2190 New Bar only\\n14. Grid Logic                 \\u2190 (if ON, L3 only)\\n15. Exit Logic                 \\u2190 Every Tick\\n16. Dashboard Update\\n```\\n\\nIf ANY check fails \\u2192 return early. No exceptions.\\n\\n### 4.5 File Section Template\\n\\n```mql5\\n//+------------------------------------------------------------------+\\n//| Section 1: Header &amp; Properties                                   |\\n//+------------------------------------------------------------------+\\n// #property copyright, version, strict\\n\\n//+------------------------------------------------------------------+\\n//| Section 2: Includes &amp; Defines Code Patterns (BUG-FREE Standards)\\n\\n**ATR Handle \\u2014 \\u0e2a\\u0e23\\u0e49\\u0e32\\u0e07\\u0e04\\u0e23\\u0e31\\u0e49\\u0e07\\u0e40\\u0e14\\u0e35\\u0e22\\u0e27\\u0e43\\u0e19 OnInit()**\\n```mql5\\n// CORRECT \\u2705\\nint h_atrFilter = INVALID_HANDLE;\\nint h_atrGrid   = INVALID_HANDLE;\\n\\nint OnInit()\\n{\\n    h_atrFilter = iATR(_Symbol, InpATR_TF_Filter, InpATR_Period);\\n    h_atrGrid   = iATR(_Symbol, InpATR_TF_Grid,   InpATR_Period);\\n    if(h_atrFilter == INVALID_HANDLE || h_atrGrid == INVALID_HANDLE)\\n        return INIT_FAILED;\\n}\\n\\n// WRONG \\u274c \\u2014 Memory Leak\\ndouble GetATR() { int h = iATR(_Symbol, ...); ... }\\n```\\n\\n**Daily Reset \\u2014 Date Compare (\\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48\\u0e43\\u0e0a\\u0e49 hour==0)**\\n```mql5\\n// CORRECT \\u2705\\ndatetime g_lastResetDate = 0;\\n\\nvoid ResetDailyStats()\\n{\\n    MqlDateTime dt;\\n    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);\\n    datetime today = StringToTime(StringFormat(\\\&quot;%04d.%02d.%02d\\\&quot;,\\n                                  dt.year, dt.mon, dt.day));\\n    if(today &gt; g_lastResetDate)\\n    {\\n        g_dailyStartEquity = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);\\n        g_lastResetDate    = today;\\n    }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n**OnDeinit \\u2014 Release \\u0e17\\u0e38\\u0e01 Handle**\\n```mql5\\nvoid OnDeinit(int reason)\\n{\\n    if(h_atrFilter != INVALID_HANDLE) IndicatorRelease(h_atrFilter);\\n    if(h_atrGrid   != INVALID_HANDLE) IndicatorRelease(h_atrGrid);\\n    ObjectsDeleteAll(0, \\\&quot;EA_\\\&quot;);\\n    Comment(\\\&quot;\\\&quot;);\\n    Print(\\\&quot;EA Deinitialized | Reason: \\\&quot;, reason);\\n}\\n```\\n\\n### 4.7 GetATR \\u2014 Use Pre-created Handle\\n\\n```mql5\\ndouble GetATR(int verify internally:\\n\\n- [ ] Spec Card complexity is L1, L2, or L3 (not L4/L5)\\n- [ ] All HARD_REQUIRED YAML paths present\\n- [ ] All called functions have definitions\\n- [ ] All `#include` directives are used\\n- [ ] All declared inputs are referenced\\n- [ ] All globals initialized in `OnInit()`\\n- [ ] Every indicator handle has `IndicatorRelease()` in `OnDeinit()`\\n- [ ] No declared-but-unused variables\\n- [ ] No `OnTick` path that skips Safety Check Order\\n- [ ] No indicator handles created inside `OnTick()`\\n- [ ] Magic Number used consistently\\n- [ ] Naming convention consistent (Inp/g_/PascalCase)\\n- [ ] SL != 0 on every Order path\\n- [ ] `ApplyPreset()` called first in `OnInit()`\\n- [ ] `ValidateCombination()` called after `ApplyPreset()`\\n- [ ] **ApplyPreset() writes ONLY to g_* variables, not Inp***\\n- [ ] **All runtime logic reads g_* variables, not Inp***\\n- [ ] \\u0e17\\u0e38\\u0e01 Input \\u0e21\\u0e35 Comment \\u0e2d\\u0e18\\u0e34\\u0e1a\\u0e32\\u0e22\\u0e15\\u0e32\\u0e21 4.8 Standard\\n- [ ] PRESET Section \\u0e21\\u0e35\\u0e15\\u0e32\\u0e23\\u0e32\\u0e07 Auto-fill Table \\u0e04\\u0e23\\u0e1a\\u0e17\\u0e31\\u0e49\\u0e07 Risk \\u0e41\\u0e25\\u0e30 Style\\n\\nIf ANY check fails \\u2192 fix internally \\u2192 re-check \\u2192 THEN emit.\\nNever emit code that fails self-check.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 6 \\u2014 ApplyPreset() + ValidateCombination() Templates\\n\\n### 6.1 ApplyPreset() \\u2014 Writes to g_* ONLY\\n\\n```mql5\\n// ============================================================\\n// Runtime variables \\u2014 written by ApplyPreset(), read by all logic\\n// RULE: ApplyPreset() writes to g_* only, NEVER to Inp*\\n// ============================================================\\ndouble g_riskPercent     = 1.0;\\ndouble g_maxDrawdownPct  = 20.0;\\ndouble g_dailyLossPct    = 5.0;\\nint    g_maxPositions    = 5;\\ndouble g_maxTotalLot     = 0.5;\\ndouble g_cbDDTrigger     = 15.0;\\nint    g_maxSpreadPoints = 20;\\ndouble g_atrMinValue     = 0.0005;\\nint    g_structureLookback = 10;\\ndouble g_tpFixedPips     = 40;\\ndouble g_trailStart_Pips = 20;\\ndouble g_trailATR_Multi  = 1.0;\\n\\nvoid ApplyPreset()\\n{\\n    // Trade Style \\u2192 writes to g_* runtime variables\\n    switch(InpTradeStyle)\\n    {\\n        case STYLE_SCALPING:\\n            g_tpFixedPips=15;  g_structureLookback=5;\\n            g_maxSpreadPoints=10; g_atrMinValue=0.0003;\\n            g_trailStart_Pips=10; g_trailATR_Multi=0.5;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_INTRADAY:\\n            g_tpFixedPips=40;  g_structureLookback=10;\\n            g_maxSpreadPoints=20; g_atrMinValue=0.0005;\\n            g_trailStart_Pips=20; g_trailATR_Multi=1.0;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_SWING:\\n            g_tpFixedPips=100; g_structureLookback=20;\\n            g_maxSpreadPoints=30; g_atrMinValue=0.0008;\\n            g_trailStart_Pips=50; g_trailATR_Multi=1.5;\\n            break;\\n        case STYLE_TREND:\\n            g_tpFixedPips=200; g_structureLookback=20;\\n            g_maxSpreadPoints=30; g_atrMinValue=0.0010;\\n            g_trailStart_Pips=80; g_trailATR_Multi=2.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n    // Risk Profile \\u2192 writes to g_* runtime variables\\n    // Note: AGGRESSIVE MM default = LINEAR (not MARTINGALE)\\n    switch(InpRiskLevel)\\n    {\\n        case RISK_SAFE:\\n            g_riskPercent=0.5;   g_maxDrawdownPct=10.0;\\n            g_dailyLossPct=3.0;  g_maxPositions=3;\\n            g_maxTotalLot=0.1;   g_cbDDTrigger=8.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_MEDIUM:\\n            g_riskPercent=1.0;   g_maxDrawdownPct=20.0;\\n            g_dailyLossPct=5.0;  g_maxPositions=5;\\n            g_maxTotalLot=0.5;   g_cbDDTrigger=15.0;\\n            break;\\n        case RISK_AGGRESSIVE:\\n            g_riskPercent=2.0;   g_maxDrawdownPct=35.0;\\n            g_dailyLossPct=10.0; g_maxPositions=10;\\n            g_maxTotalLot=1.0;   g_cbDDTrigger=25.0;\\n            break;\\n    }\\n    // Confirm: Inp* values are untouched \\u2014 only g_* changed\\n}\\n```\\n\\n### 6.2 ValidateCombination() \\u2014 References g_* after ApplyPreset\\n\\n```mql5\\nvoid ValidateCombination()\\n{\\n    // SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND = Signal too slow\\n    if(InpTradeStyle == STYLE_SCALPING &amp;&amp;\\n       InpHedgeMode  == HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND)\\n    {\\n        InpHedgeMode = HEDGE_OFF;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: SCALPING+FOLLOW_TREND \\u2192 Hedge forced OFF\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n    // TREND + FOLLOW_CANDLE = High false signal\\n    if(InpTradeStyle == STYLE_TREND &amp;&amp;\\n       InpHedgeMode  == HEDGE_FOLLOW_CANDLE)\\n    {\\n        InpHedgeMode = HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: TREND+FOLLOW_CANDLE \\u2192 Hedge forced FOLLOW_TREND\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n    // GRID_NONE + MARTINGALE = No grid to scale on\\n    if(InpGridMode == GRID_NONE &amp;&amp;\\n       InpMMMode   == MM_MARTINGALE)\\n    {\\n        InpMMMode = MM_FIXED;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: No Grid+MARTINGALE \\u2192 MM forced FIXED\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n    // TP_DYNAMIC + Trail ON = Duplicate exit\\n    if(InpTPMode          == TP_DYNAMIC_BALANCE &amp;&amp;\\n       InpTrailingStop_ON == true)\\n    {\\n        InpTrailingStop_ON = false;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: DYNAMIC_TP+Trail \\u2192 Trail forced OFF\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n    // SCALPING + RANGE_TREND SL = SL too wide\\n    if(InpTradeStyle == STYLE_SCALPING &amp;&amp;\\n       InpSLMode     == SL_RANGE_TREND)\\n    {\\n        InpSLMode = SL_STRUCTURE;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: SCALPING+RANGE_TREND SL \\u2192 SL forced STRUCTURE\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n### 6.3 Example: Runtime Logic Using g_* Variables\\n\\n```mql5\\n// CORRECT \\u2705 \\u2014 reads g_* set by ApplyPreset\\nbool CheckDrawdownLimit()\\n{\\n    if(GetCurrentDD() &gt;= g_maxDrawdownPct)\\n    {\\n        Print(\\\&quot;DD LIMIT: \\\&quot;, GetCurrentDD(), \\\&quot;% &gt;= \\\&quot;, Method\\n\\n```\\nWFA_Efficiency_Ratio = mean(OOS_PF_per_window) / mean(IS_PF_per_window)\\nWFA_Consistency = % windows where OOS_PF &gt; 1.0\\n```\\n\\n### 4.4 WFA Scoring\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| Efficiency Ratio | &gt; 0.80 | 0.65\\u20130.80 | 0.50\\u20130.65 | &lt; 0.50 |\\n| OOS Windows Profitable | &gt; 70% | 55\\u201370% | 40\\u201355% | &lt; 40% |\\n| PF Degradation | &lt; 15% | 15\\u201330% | 30\\u201350% | &gt; 50% |\\n\\n```\\nWFA_Score = ER(50) + OOS_Profitable%(30) + Degradation(20)\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 5 \\u2014 TEST 3: OUT-OF-SAMPLE TEST (Both Modes)\\n\\n### 5.1 Required Data\\n\\n```\\nOOS requires one of:\\n  A) oos_report \\u2014 separate backtest run on held-out period\\n  B) trade_list_csv with date range \\u2192 split at 80th percentile by date\\n\\nIF neither provided:\\n    OOS = SKIPPED_NO_DATA\\n\\n    Mode A: verdict CAPPED at MARGINAL\\n    Mode B: CANDIDATE score uses MC only (MC \\u00d7 100%)\\n    Note: \\\&quot;OOS skipped \\u2014 no separate OOS report or dated trade list.\\n           To enable OOS: provide either a separate OOS backtest\\n           report or a trade_list_csv with date-stamped trades.\\\&quot;\\n\\nDO NOT use the same aggregate data for both IS and OOS.\\nDO NOT fake OOS by comparing first half vs second half\\n  of the same optimization run.\\n```\\n\\n### 5.2 OOS Method (when data available)\\n\\n```\\nIS Period  = primary backtest period\\nOOS Period = separate held-out period (or last 20% of trade dates)\\n\\nOOS_Degradation  = (IS_PF - OOS_PF) / IS_PF \\u00d7 100%\\nOOS_DD_Expansion = (OOS_MaxDD - IS_MaxDD) / IS_MaxDD \\u00d7 100%\\nOOS_Freq_Change  = OOS trades/month vs IS trades/month\\n```\\n\\n### 5.3 OOS Scoring\\n\\n| Metric | GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| PF Degradation | &lt; 15% | 15\\u201330% | 30\\u201350% | &gt; 50% |\\n| DD Expansion | &lt; 20% | 20\\u201340% | 40\\u201370% | &gt; 70% |\\n| Trade Freq Change | &lt; 20% | 20\\u201335% | 35\\u201350% | &gt; 50% |\\n| OOS PF &gt; 1.0 | yes | \\u2014 | \\u2014 | no |\\n\\n```\\nOOS_Score = PF_Degrad(40) + DD_Expand(30) + Freq_Change(15) + PF_Positive(15)\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 6 \\u2014 MODE A: ROBUSTNESS SCORE + VERDICT\\n\\n### 6.1 Weighted Formula (Adjusts for Skipped Tests)\\n\\n```\\nIF WFA available AND OOS available:\\n    Robustness_Score = MC\\u00d70.40 + WFA\\u00d70.40 + OOS\\u00d70.20\\n\\nIF WFA = SKIPPED AND OOS available:\\n    Robustness_Score = MC\\u00d70.60 + OOS\\u00d70.40\\n    VERDICT CAPPED at MARGINAL\\n\\nIF OOS = SKIPPED AND WFA available:\\n    Robustness_Score = MC\\u00d70.50 + WFA\\u00d70.50\\n    VERDICT CAPPED at MARGINAL\\n\\nIF BOTH WFA and OOS = SKIPPED:\\n    Robustness_Score = MC\\u00d71.00\\n    VERDICT CAPPED at MARGINAL (cannot reach ROBUST)\\n```\\n\\n### 6.2 Score Bands\\n\\n| Score | Verdict | Condition |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| 75\\u2013100 | \\ud83d\\udfe2 ROBUST | Score + no caps |\\n| 55\\u201374 | \\ud83d\\udfe1 MARGINAL | Score OR any test skipped |\\n| 0\\u201354 | \\ud83d\\udd34 NOT_ROBUST | Score OR hard override |\\n\\n### 6.3 Hard Override Rules\\n\\n```\\nFORCE NOT_ROBUST:\\n  MC Ruin &gt; 10%\\n  OOS PF &lt; 1.0 (when OOS available)\\n  OOS PF Degradation &gt; 50% (when OOS available)\\n  WFA ER &lt; 0.50 (when WFA available)\\n\\nFORCE MARGINAL:\\n  MC DD 95th &gt; MaxDD \\u00d7 1.5\\n  WFA OOS Windows Profitable &lt; 50% (when WFA available)\\n  Any test = SKIPPED_NO_DATA\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 7 \\u2014 MODE B: CANDIDATE SCORING + VERDICT\\n\\n### 7.1 Candidate Score\\n\\n```\\nIF OOS available: Candidate_Score = MC\\u00d70.50 + OOS\\u00d70.50\\nIF OOS SKIPPED:   Candidate_Score = MC\\u00d71.00\\n```\\n\\n### 7.2 Verdict Rules\\n\\n```\\nCANDIDATE_OK     : Score &gt;= 55, MC Ruin &lt; 10%, OOS PF &gt; 0.9 (if available)\\nCANDIDATE_WEAK   : Score 40\\u201354 OR 1 RED OR MC Ruin 5\\u201310%\\nCANDIDATE_REJECT : Score &lt; 40 OR MC Ruin &gt; 10% OR OOS PF &lt; 0.7\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 8 \\u2014 OUTPUT FORMAT\\n\\n### 8.1 Mode A Human Silently clamp + emit WARN.\\n\\n| Field | Hard Cap | Reason |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| Risk_Per_Trade_Percent | ≤ 3.0% | Account survival |\\n| Grid_Max_Levels | ≤ 10 | Exposure containment |\\n| Hedge_Lot_Multiplier | ≤ 2.0 | Margin protection |\\n| Martingale_Multiplier | ≤ 1.5 | Drawdown spiral guard |\\n| Martingale_Max_Steps | ≤ 4 | Account survival |\\n| Max_Daily_Loss_Percent | ≤ 10.0% | Daily protection |\\n\\n### 4.3 Recovery Module Configuration\\n\\n**TRAILING_ONLY**\\n```\\nTrailingStop_ON      : true\\nTrail_Mode           : ATR / FIXED\\nTrail_ATR_Multi      : [auto from Style]\\nTrail_Fixed_Pips     : 20\\nTrail_Start_Pips     : [auto from Style]\\n```\\n\\n**PARTIAL_TP**\\n```\\nPartialTP_ON         : true\\nTP1_Mode             : PIPS / RR / ATR\\nTP1_Value            : 30\\nTP1_ClosePercent     : 50%\\nTP2_Mode             : PIPS / RR / ATR\\nTP2_Value            : 60\\nBreakEven_ON         : true / false\\nBreakEven_Buffer     : 5 pips\\n```\\n\\n**GRID**\\n```\\nGrid_Mode            : FIX / DYNAMIC / PA\\nGrid_Fix_Pips        : [auto from Style]\\nGrid_ATR_Multi       : 1.5\\nGrid_PA_Signal       : PIN_BAR / ENGULFING / INSIDE_BAR / DOJI\\nGrid_Max_Orders      : ≤ 10 (Hard Cap)\\nGrid_Direction       : SAME_SIDE\\nMM_Mode              : FIXED / LINEAR (no MARTINGALE with Grid alone)\\n```\\n\\n**HEDGE (3 Sub-Types)**\\n```\\nHedge_Mode:\\n  GRID_REVERSAL:\\n    Trigger          : DD% threshold\\n    Activation_DD    : 10% default\\n    Deactivation_DD  : 2% default\\n    Lot_Mode         : SYMMETRIC / ASYMMETRIC\\n    Scale Ladder:\\n      DD 10-15%  → 30% of Total Exposure\\n      DD 15-20%  → 50% of Total Exposure\\n      DD 20-25%  → 70% of Total Exposure\\n      DD &gt; 25%   → 100% Full Hedge\\n\\n  FOLLOW_CANDLE:\\n    Trigger          : Candle Body &gt; ATR × Multi\\n    HedgeCandle_ATRMulti : 2.0\\n    Best for         : Scalping / Intraday\\n\\n  FOLLOW_TREND:\\n    Trigger          : EMA Cross (reversal)\\n    Fast_EMA         : 9\\n    Slow_EMA         : 21\\n    Best for         : Swing / Trend\\n\\nCommon (all modes):\\n  Emergency_DD       : 70%\\n  Partial_Close_Pips : 10\\n  Account_Type       : HEDGING required (not NETTING)\\n```\\n\\n**MARTINGALE (AGGRESSIVE + Explicit Confirmation ONLY)**\\n\\n```\\n⚠️ MARTINGALE RULES:\\n  1. Allowed ONLY with Risk Profile = AGGRESSIVE\\n  2. Requires user to type \\\&quot;ACCEPT_MARTINGALE_RISK\\\&quot; explicitly\\n  3. NOT activated by selecting AGGRESSIVE profile alone\\n     → Must select Recovery_Mode = MARTINGALE separately\\n  4. NOT combined with Grid alone (must have Grid: FIX or DYNAMIC)\\n\\nConfiguration:\\n  MM_Mode              : MARTINGALE\\n  Martingale_Multi     : 1.3 (default) — Hard Cap ≤ 1.5\\n  Martingale_Max_Steps : ≤ 4 (Hard Cap)\\n  Grid_Mode            : Must be FIX or DYNAMIC (not NONE)\\n```\\n\\nMARTINGALE Confirmation Gate:\\n```\\n⚠️ MARTINGALE RISK CONFIRMATION REQUIRED\\nPROFILE    : AGGRESSIVE only\\nCONCERN    : Exponential lot increase — account blow risk\\nPARAMETERS :\\n  Default Multiplier : 1.3×  (Hard Cap: 1.5×)\\n  Max Steps          : 4     (Hard Cap: 4)\\n  Requires Grid      : FIX or DYNAMIC\\n\\nType \\\&quot;ACCEPT_MARTINGALE_RISK\\\&quot; to enable Martingale.\\nType \\\&quot;MODIFY\\\&quot; to choose different recovery mode.\\n\\nDO NOT proceed until \\\&quot;ACCEPT_MARTINGALE_RISK\\\&quot; is received.\\n```\\n\\n### 4.4 Grid + Hedge Behavior Rules\\n\\n```\\n✅ Grid เปิดต่อได้แม้ Hedge Active จนถึง Max Grid Orders\\n✅ Hedge Partial Close → Grid เปิดต่อได้ทันที\\n✅ Hedge ปิดแล้ว GridOrderCount ต่อจากเดิม — ไม่ Reset\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 5 — STEP 3: COMBINATION VALIDATION\\n\\n### 5.1 WARN List (Require User Confirmation)\\n\\nไม่ Refuse แต่ต้องขอ User Confirm ก่อน\\n\\n| Combination | Concern | Confirmation Required |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| MARTINGALE (any profile) | Extreme loss risk | ACCEPT_MARTINGALE_RISK |\\n| MARTINGALE + SAFE | Profile mismatch | ACCEPT_MARTINGALE_RISK |\\n| MARTINGALE + MEDIUM | Profile mismatch | ACCEPT_MARTINGALE_RISK |\\n| GRID + HEDGE + MARTINGALE (ทั้ง 3) | Triple-recovery extreme exposure | ACCEPT_RISK |\\n| GRID + AGGRESSIVE | High exposure tail risk | ACCEPT_RISK |\\n| HEDGE + SCALPING TF (M1/M5) | Spread cost spiral | ACCEPT_RISK |\\n| Dynamic TP + Trailing both ON | Exit logic conflict | ACCEPT_RISK |\\n| SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND Hedge | Signal ช้าเกิน | ACCEPT_RISK |\\n| TREND + FOLLOW_CANDLE Hedge | False Signal สูง | ACCEPT_RISK |\\n| GRID_NONE + MARTINGALE | ไม่มี Grid ให้ Scale | ACCEPT_RISK |\\n| Max_Positions &gt; 5 + GRID | Compounded position count | ACCEPT_RISK |\\n\\nWARN Response Format:\\n```\\n⚠️ COMBINATION WARNING\\nCOMBINATION : [combo]\\nCONCERN     : [reason]\\nRISK IMPACT : [what could happen]\\n\\nType \\\&quot;[CONFIRMATION_PHRASE]\\\&quot; to proceed.\\nType \\\&quot;MODIFY\\\&quot; to change.\\n```\\n\\nWait for user response. Do NOT auto-accept.\\n\\n### 5.2 Special: MARTINGALE Confirmation\\n\\n```\\nMARTINGALE requires: \\\&quot;ACCEPT_MARTINGALE_RISK\\\&quot;  (exact phrase)\\nAll others require : \\\&quot;ACCEPT_RISK\\\&quot;\\n\\nIF user types \\\&quot;ACCEPT_RISK\\\&quot; for MARTINGALE → NOT accepted\\n→ Re-prompt: \\\&quot;Please type ACCEPT_MARTINGALE_RISK to confirm Martingale\\\&quot;\\n\\nRecord in Spec Card YAML:\\n  user_acknowledgments:\\n    martingale_risk_accepted: true\\n    martingale_confirmation_phrase: \\\&quot;ACCEPT_MARTINGALE_RISK\\\&quot;\\n```\\n\\n### 5.3 PASS List\\n\\nAnything not in WARN → proceed silently to Step 4.\\n\\n### 5.4 Auto-Fix List (Silent Correction + WARN Note)\\n\\n| Invalid Combo | Auto-Fix | Note |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND Hedge | Hedge → OFF | WARN emitted |\\n| TREND + FOLLOW_CANDLE Hedge | Hedge → FOLLOW_TREND | WARN emitted |\\n| GRID_NONE + MARTINGALE | MM → FIXED | WARN emitted |\\n| TP_DYNAMIC + Trail ON | Trail → OFF | WARN emitted |\\n| SCALPING + RANGE_TREND SL | SL → STRUCTURE | WARN emitted |\\n| MARTINGALE without AGGRESSIVE | Refuse + prompt to change profile | — |\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 6 — STEP 4: RISK SCORE (0-100)\\n\\n### 6.1 Scoring Formula\\n\\n```\\nRisk_Score =\\n    (Risk_Per_Trade_Percent / 3.0) × 20    # max 20 pts\\n  + (Max_Drawdown_Target / 35.0) × 15      # max 15 pts\\n  + Recovery_Module_Score                   # max 35 pts (see 6.2)\\n  + Complexity_Penalty                      # max 15 pts (see 6.3)\\n  + Filter_Deficiency_Penalty               # max 15 pts (see 6.4)\\n```\\n\\n### 6.2 Recovery Module Score\\n\\n| Module | Points |\\n|---|---|\\n| NONE | 0 |\\n| TRAILING_ONLY | 2 |\\n| PARTIAL_TP | 3 |\\n| GRID (alone) | 15 |\\n| HEDGE (alone) | 12 |\\n| GRID + HEDGE | 25 |\\n| MARTINGALE (alone) | 25 |\\n| GRID + MARTINGALE | 35 |\\n| HEDGE + MARTINGALE | 35 |\\n\\n### 6.3 Complexity Penalty\\n\\n| Level | Points |\\n|---|---|\\n| L1_CORE | 0 |\\n| L2_FILTERED | 3 |\\n| L3_GRID_OR_HEDGE | 7 |\\n| L4_HYBRID | 12 |\\n| L5_EXPERIMENTAL | 15 |\\n\\n### 6.4 Filter Deficiency Penalty\\n\\n| Missing Filter | Points |\\n|---|---|\\n| No spread filter | +3 |\\n| No session filter | +3 |\\n| No daily loss limit | +5 |\\n| No circuit breaker | +4 |\\n\\n### 6.5 Risk Score Bands\\n\\n| Band | Score | Color | Meaning |\\n|---|---|---|---|\\n| SAFE | 0-30 | 🟢 | Conservative |\\n| MEDIUM | 31-60 | 🟡 | Standard speculative |\\n| HIGH | 61-85 | 🟠 | Aggressive, needs monitoring |\\n| EXTREME | 86-100 | 🔴 | Expert use only |\\n\\nScore is INFORMATIONAL only.\\nIt does NOT predict performance or live suitability.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 7 — COMPLEXITY PREVIEW (L1-L5)\\n\\n```\\nL1_CORE          = Entry + SL + TP + basic spread/session filter\\nL2_FILTERED      = L1 + extra filters OR trailing\\nL3_GRID_OR_HEDGE = L2 + (Grid XOR Hedge)\\nL4_HYBRID        = L3 + (Grid AND Hedge) OR complex exit state machine\\nL5_EXPERIMENTAL  = L4 + Martingale OR multiple adaptive modules\\n```\\n\\n⚠️ NOTE: mql-code-generator.md v1.3 supports L1–L3 only.\\nIf Complexity Preview = L4 or L5 → user must simplify strategy\\nbefore code generation.\\n\\nPreview aligns with `mql-code-generator.md` Section 3.1.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 8 — STEP 5: USER APPROVAL GATE\\n\\nOutput Human Display review:\\n\\n```\\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\\n  EA SPEC CARD — REVIEW BEFORE FINALIZATION\\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\\n📋 IDENTITY\\n  EA Name    : [name]\\n  Symbol     : [symbol]\\n  Timeframe  : [tf]   (HTF Confirm: [htf])\\n\\n🎯 STRATEGY\\n  Trade Style: [style]\\n  Entry      : [indicator + condition]\\n  Exit SL    : [method]\\n  Exit TP    : [method]\\n  Entry Type : [Market / Pending]\\n\\n🛡️ RISK\\n  Risk/Trade : [x.x%]\\n  Max DD     : [xx%]\\n  Daily Loss : [x.x%]\\n  Max Pos    : [n]\\n  CB Trigger : [xx%] → Pause 24hr\\n\\n🔧 MODULES\\n  Enabled    : [list]\\n  Disabled   : [list]\\n\\n📊 ASSESSMENT\\n  Risk Score : [n]/100  [🟢🟡🟠🔴 BAND]\\n  Complexity : [L1-L5]\\n  Validation : [PASS / WARN-ACKNOWLEDGED]\\n  Code-Gen   : [SUPPORTED (L1-L3) / NOT SUPPORTED (L4-L5)]\\n\\n⚠️ WARNINGS (if any)\\n  - [warning 1]\\n  - [warning 2]\\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\\nReply \\\&quot;APPROVE\\\&quot; to finalize.\\nReply \\\&quot;EDIT [field]\\\&quot; to modify.\\nReply \\\&quot;CANCEL\\\&quot; to discard.\\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\\n```\\n\\nWait for explicit user response. Do NOT auto-approve.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 9 — STEP 6: SPEC CARD FINALIZATION\\n\\n### 9.1 Dual-Format Output\\n\\n**Block 1: Human Display** (same as Section 8 + FINALIZED stamp)\\n\\n**Block 2: Canonical YAML** (machine-readable for code generator)\\n\\n```yaml\\n# === EA SPEC CARD (CANONICAL) ===\\nspec_card_version: \\\&quot;2.3\\\&quot;\\nvalidation_status: \\\&quot;APPROVED\\\&quot;\\nrisk_score: 42\\nrisk_band: \\\&quot;MEDIUM\\\&quot;\\ncomplexity_level: \\\&quot;L2_FILTERED\\\&quot;\\ncode_gen_supported: true   # false if L4 or L5\\n\\nidentity:\\n  ea_name: \\\&quot;HalfTrend_MTF_XAUUSD\\\&quot;\\n  symbol: \\\&quot;XAUUSD\\\&quot;\\n  timeframe: \\\&quot;M15\\\&quot;\\n  htf_confirmation: \\\&quot;H1\\\&quot;\\n  magic_number: \\\&quot;AUTO_GENERATE\\\&quot;\\n  direction:\\n    allow_buy: true\\n    allow_sell: true\\n\\nstrategy:\\n  trade_style: \\\&quot;INTRADAY\\\&quot;\\n  risk_profile: \\\&quot;MEDIUM\\\&quot;\\n  entry:\\n    indicator: \\\&quot;HalfTrend\\\&quot;\\n    parameters:\\n      amplitude: 2\\n      channel_deviation: 2.0\\n      atr_period: 100\\n    condition: &gt;\\n      M15 color change to Up = Buy signal.\\n      H1 direction determines lot size.\\n    entry_type: \\\&quot;Market Order\\\&quot;\\n    confirm_timeframe: \\\&quot;H1\\\&quot;\\n  exit:\\n    sl_method: \\\&quot;SL_STRUCTURE\\\&quot;\\n    sl_lookback: 10\\n    tp_method: \\\&quot;TP_RR\\\&quot;\\n    tp_rr: 1.5\\n    max_sl_pips: 200\\n\\nrisk:\\n  risk_per_trade_percent: 1.0\\n  base_lot: 0.05\\n  half_lot_ratio: 0.5\\n  account_balance: 10000\\n  account_currency: \\\&quot;cent\\\&quot;\\n  max_daily_loss_percent: 5.0\\n  max_drawdown_target_percent: 20.0\\n  max_positions_total: 5\\n  max_total_lot: 0.5\\n  circuit_breaker_dd_trigger: 15.0\\n  circuit_breaker_action: \\\&quot;PAUSE_24HR\\\&quot;\\n\\nrecovery:\\n  mode: \\\&quot;NONE\\\&quot;   # NONE | TRAILING_ONLY | PARTIAL_TP | GRID | HEDGE | MARTINGALE\\n  martingale:\\n    enabled: false\\n    multiplier: 1.3          # default 1.3, hard cap 1.5\\n    max_steps: 4             # hard cap 4\\n    confirmation_received: false\\n    confirmation_phrase: \\\&quot;\\\&quot; (Clarified)\\n\\n```\\nRULE: Preset-overridden parameters MUST use g_* runtime variables.\\n      Raw user-configured indicator parameters MAY read Inp* directly\\n      if they are NOT modified by CHECKLIST\\n\\n### 2.1 Single EA (13 Items)\\n\\n```\\n[R1] Robustness verdict = ROBUST or MARGINAL\\n[R2] Robustness Score &gt;= 55\\n[R3] MC Ruin Probability &lt; 10%\\n[R4] OOS PF &gt; 1.0 (if OOS computed)\\n\\n[A1] Live balance &gt;= Backtest_Deposit \\u00d7 0.5\\n[A2] Account type matches Spec Card\\n[A3] Leverage &gt;= minimum\\n[A4] Free Margin &gt; 3\\u00d7 expected max positions not blocking)\\n\\n[R1, R2, R3, A2] FAIL \\u2192 REJECT\\n[A1, A3, A4, E1\\u2013E4] FAIL \\u2192 HOLD\\n```\\n\\n### 2.2 Multi-EA Additional Items\\n\\n```\\n[P1] portfolio_yaml.verdict.result == \\\&quot;APPROVED\\\&quot;  \\u2190 APPROVED only\\n[P2] portfolio_yaml.combined_risk.expected_dd_pct &lt;= account budget\\n[P3] All CANDIDATE EAs have candidate_not_standalone=true AND are in HOLD\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 3 \\u2014 POSITION SIZING\\n\\n### 3.1 Single EA\\n\\n```\\nScale_Factor = Live_Balance / Backtest_Deposit\\nLive_BaseLot = Backtest_BaseLot \\u00d7 (Margin_Per_Lot \\u00d7 MaxPositions_i)\\n\\nCaps:\\n  &gt;= Broker_Min_Lot\\n  &lt;= portfolio_yaml.portfolio_composition[ea_name].max_lot\\n  CANDIDATE EAs: 20% additional reduction (already in portfolio_yaml)\\n  MARGINAL: 25% reduction on top of weight\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 4 \\u2014 MONITORING CRITERIA\\n\\n### 4.1 EA-Level\\n\\n```\\nALERT_DD          = Backtest_MaxDD \\u00d7 ## 4. Remaining Ambiguity

```
1. g_hedgeMode initialization ใน ApplyPreset():
   ปัจจุบัน ApplyPreset() initialize g_hedgeMode = InpHedgeMode
   ถ้า user ตั้ง InpHedgeMode ที่ UI แล้ว ValidateCombination() override
   Flow ถูกต้องแล้ว แต่ผู้ใช้ควรรู้ว่า UI value อาจถูก override

2. eligible_for_mode_b = EA_ROLE_PORTFOLIO:
   ถ้า ea_role = EA_2/EA_3 แต่ทุก dimension สีเขียว
   → eligible = true แม้ไม่จำเป็นต้องใช้ Mode B
   ใน practice ควรใช้ Mode A แต่ Mode B ก็ valid
   ไม่ได้ force Mode B เพราะ ea_role

3. portfolio_yaml.combined_risk.worst_same_month_loss_pct:
   Field นี้ถูกอ้างใน live-deployment-controller
   แต่ใน portfolio-selector.md YAML ชื่อ combined_risk.worst_same_month_loss_pct
   ตรงกันแล้ว — ไม่มี ambiguity
```

# G Rule คืออะไร?

**G Rule** คือ **กฎการแยก Input Variables กับ Runtime Variables** ใน MQL5 EA ที่เราออกแบบไว้ใน `mql-code-generator.md` v1.4 ครับ [1]

---

## หลักการง่ายๆ

```
Inp* = สิ่งที่ User เห็นใน MT5 UI (Display เท่านั้น)
g_*  = สิ่งที่ EA ใช้จริงในการทำงาน (Runtime)
```

---

## ทำไมต้องมี?

```
ปัญหาเดิม:
ApplyPreset() เขียนค่าลง InpRiskPercent โดยตรง
→ MQL5 ไม่อนุญาต — input variable เป็น read-only
→ Code Compile ได้ แต่ค่าไม่เปลี่ยนจริง
→ Bug เงียบที่หาไม่เจอ
```

---

## G Rule ทำงานยังไง?

```mql5
// ① Input — แสดงใน UI เท่านั้น
input double InpRiskPercent = 1.0;
input ENUM_RISK_LEVEL InpRiskLevel = RISK_MEDIUM;

// ② Runtime Variable — EA ใช้ค่านี้จริง
double g_riskPercent = 1.0;

// ③ ApplyPreset() เขียนลง g_* เท่านั้น
void ApplyPreset()
{
    switch(InpRiskLevel)
    {
        case RISK_MEDIUM:
            g_riskPercent   = 1.0;   // ✅ เขียนลง g_*
            g_maxDrawdownPct = 20.0;
            break;
        case RISK_AGGRESSIVE:
            g_riskPercent   = 2.0;   // ✅ เขียนลง g_*
            break;
    }
    // ❌ InpRiskPercent = 2.0;  ← ห้ามทำแบบนี้
}

// ④ Logic ทั้งหมดอ่านจาก g_*
bool CheckDrawdownLimit()
{
    return (GetCurrentDD() < g_maxDrawdownPct);  // ✅ ใช้ g_*
    // ❌ return (GetCurrentDD() < InpMaxDD_Pct);  ← ผิด
}
```

---

## สรุปกฎ 3 ข้อ

| กฎ | ใคร | ทำอะไร |
|---|---|---|
| **1** | `ApplyPreset()` | เขียนลง `g_*` เท่านั้น ห้ามแตะ `Inp*` |
| **2** | `ValidateCombination()` | เขียนลง `g_*` เท่านั้น (เช่น `g_hedgeMode = HEDGE_OFF`) |
| **3** | Runtime Logic ทั้งหมด | อ่านจาก `g_*` เสมอ (ยกเว้น indicator params ที่ไม่ถูก preset override) |

---

## ข้อยกเว้น — Indicator Params อ่าน Inp* ได้

```mql5
// ✅ OK — InpHT_Amplitude ไม่ถูก ApplyPreset() แตะ
h_ht = iCustom(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, "HalfTrend", InpHT_Amplitude);

// ✅ OK — InpRSI_Period ไม่ถูก Preset เปลี่ยน
h_rsi = iRSI(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, InpRSI_Period, PRICE_CLOSE);

// ❌ ผิด — Risk ถูก ApplyPreset() เปลี่ยน ต้องใช้ g_*
if(GetDD() > InpMaxDD_Pct) { ... }   // ← ใช้ g_maxDrawdownPct แทน
```

---

> สรุปสั้นๆ: **G Rule = "ของที่ Preset เปลี่ยนได้ ต้องเก็บใน g_* และอ่านจาก g_* เสมอ"** ครับ [1]

# G Rule มาจากไหน?

```
เป็นส่วนหนึ่งของ Single Responsibility Principle
และ Separation of Concerns ใน Software Engineering

ใน MQL5 โดยเฉพาะ:
input variable = READ-ONLY หลัง OnInit()
→ เขียนทับไม่ได้จริงๆ ในบาง Compiler
→ ถ้าเขียนได้ก็ไม่ควรทำ เพราะ Confusing มาก
```

---

# ทำไมถึงกลัวผิดยาวได้?

```
สมมติ ApplyPreset() เขียนลง Inp* แทน g_*:

ApplyPreset() รัน → InpRiskPercent = 2.0
แต่ CheckDrawdownLimit() อ่าน InpMaxDD_Pct (ค่าเก่า)

ผล:
- Compile ผ่าน ✅
- ไม่มี Error ✅
- แต่ EA ทำงานผิดตลอด ❌
- Backtest ผลเบี้ยว ❌
- หาสาเหตุยากมาก ❌
```

---

# วิธีป้องกันที่ดีที่สุด

## 1. Self-Check ใน Skill มีอยู่แล้ว [1]

```
Skill v1.4 มี Pre-Output Self-Check ที่ตรวจก่อน Emit Code:

- [ ] ApplyPreset() writes ONLY to g_* — not Inp*
- [ ] ValidateCombination() writes ONLY to g_* — not Inp*
- [ ] Preset-overridden params use g_* in runtime logic
```

## 2. Naming Convention ช่วยได้มาก

```
กฎง่ายๆ:
ถ้าเห็น Inp* ใน Logic Function → ❓ ถามตัวเองก่อน
"ตัวนี้ถูก ApplyPreset() เปลี่ยนไหม?"

ถ้าใช่ → ใช้ g_* แทน
ถ้าไม่ใช่ (indicator param) → Inp* ได้
```

## 3. Pattern ที่ชัดที่สุด

```mql5
// โครงสร้างที่ถูกต้องเสมอ:

//--- Section 4: Inputs (display only)
input double InpRiskPercent = 1.0;

//--- Section 5: Runtime (EA ใช้จริง)
double g_riskPercent = 1.0;

//--- Section 6: OnInit()
int OnInit()
{
    ApplyPreset();        // เขียนลง g_* ก่อนเสมอ
    ValidateCombination(); // adjust g_* ถ้าจำเป็น
    // จากนี้ไป ห้ามอ่าน Inp* สำหรับ Risk/DD/Mode
}

//--- ทุก Logic Function อ่านแค่ g_*
bool CheckDD() { return GetDD() < g_maxDrawdownPct; }
```

✅ ความกลัวสมเหตุสมผล — Bug แบบนี้หาไม่เจอ
✅ ป้องกันได้โดย:
   1. Naming Convention ชัดเจน (Inp* vs g_*)

   3. Pattern เดิมซ้ำๆ ทุก EA

> เพราะ Skill จะ Generate Code ตาม Template เดิมเสมอ ไม่ใช่คิดใหม่ทุกครั้ง

(Non-Negotiable)\\n\\n| Field | Hard Cap | Reason |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| Risk_Per_Trade_Percent | \\u2264 3.0% | Account survival |\\n| Grid_Max_Levels | \\u2264 10 | Exposure containment |\\n| |\\n\\n### 4.3 Recovery Module Configuration\\n\\n**GRID**\\n```\\nGrid_Mode: FIX / DYNAMIC / PA\\nGrid_Max_Orders: \\u2264 10 (Hard Cap)\\nMM_Mode: FIXED / LINEAR (no MARTINGALE with Grid LOGIC**\\n\\n```\\nIF Martingale + SAFE:\\n    REFUSE \\u2014 no override possible.\\n    Message: \\\&quot;SAFE profile prohibits Martingale.\\n              Change Recovery Mode to NONE/TRAILING_ONLY/PARTIAL_TP,\\n              or escalate Risk Profile to MEDIUM (capped) or AGGRESSIVE.\\\&quot;\\n\\nIF Martingale + MEDIUM:\\n    IF multiplier &gt; 1.3 OR max_steps &gt; 3:\\n        REFUSE.\\n        Message: \\\&quot;MEDIUM profile caps Martingale at 1.3x / 3 steps.\\n                  Reduce parameters or escalate to AGGRESSIVE.\\\&quot;\\n    ELSE:\\n        CONDITIONAL ALLOW.\\n        Require exact phrase: \\\&quot;ACCEPT_MARTINGALE_MEDIUM\\\&quot;\\n        profile_tier: \\\&quot;MEDIUM_CAPPED\\\&quot;\\n\\nIF Martingale + AGGRESSIVE:\\n    IF multiplier &gt; 1.5 \\\&quot;AGGRESSIVE\\\&quot;\\n\\nGrid_Mode: Must be FIX or DYNAMIC (not NONE) for all Martingale\\n```\\n\\n### 4.4 Grid + Hedge Behavior Rules\\n\\n```\\n\\u2705 Grid \\u0e40\\u0e1b\\u0e34\\u0e14\\u0e15\\u0e48\\u0e2d\\u0e44\\u0e14\\u0e49\\u0e41\\u0e21\\u0e49 Hedge Active \\u0e08\\u0e19\\u0e16\\u0e36\\u0e07 Max Grid Orders\\n\\u2705 Hedge Partial Close \\u2192 Grid \\u0e40\\u0e1b\\u0e34\\u0e14\\u0e15\\u0e48\\u0e2d\\u0e44\\u0e14\\u0e49\\u0e17\\u0e31\\u0e19\\u0e17\\u0e35\\n\\u2705 Hedge \\u0e1b\\u0e34\\u0e14\\u0e41\\u0e25\\u0e49\\u0e27 GridOrderCount List\\n\\n| Combination | Concern | Confirmation Required |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| MARTINGALE + AGGRESSIVE | Extreme loss risk | ACCEPT_MARTINGALE_RISK |\\n| GRID + HEDGE + MARTINGALE | Triple-recovery ValidateCombination()\\n{\\n    // SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND = Signal too slow\\n    // ✅ Fix: write to g_hedgeMode, NOT InpHedgeMode\\n    if(InpTradeStyle == STYLE_SCALPING &amp;&amp;\\n       g_hedgeMode  == HEDGE_FOLLOW_TREND)\\n    {\\n        g_hedgeMode = HEDGE_OFF;\\n        Print(\\\&quot;WARN: SCALPING+FOLLOW_TREND → g_hedgeMode forced OFF\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // POSITION + Print(\\\&quot;WARN: POSITION+FOLLOW_CANDLE → g_hedgeMode forced FOLLOW_TREND\\\&quot;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // GRID_NONE + MARTINGALE = No grid to scale on\\n    if(g_gridMode == GRID_NONE &amp;&amp;\\n Examples\\n\\n```mql5\\n// ✅ CORRECT — runtime logic reads g_*\\nbool CheckDrawdownLimit()\\n{\\n    return (GetCurrentDD() &lt; g_maxDrawdownPct);\\n}\\n\\nbool CheckDailyLossLimit()\\n{\\n    double Revise EA selection.\\n\\nINSUFFICIENT_EAs:\\n  &lt; 2 eligible EAs.\\n  → Use live-deployment-controller.md for single EA.\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 2 — EA ELIGIBILITY\\n\\n```\\nELIGIBLE:\\n  ROBUST         → full weight (max 60%; 40% if MARGINAL &gt;= 2 EAs)\\n  MARGINAL       → capped at 40%\\n  CANDIDATE_OK   → capped at 35%\\n  CANDIDATE_WEAK → capped at 25% + WARNING\\n\\nINELIGIBLE: VERY HIGH 🔴\\n\\nAny pair &gt; 0.7 → blocks APPROVED\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 4 — DD OVERLAP ANALYSIS\\n\\n### 4.1 Cumulative Equity Method\\n\\n```\\nFor each EA, build monthly cumulative equity:\\n  equity[0] = initial_deposit\\n  equity[m] = equity[m-1] × (1 + monthly_return[m])\\n  running_peak[m] = max(equity[0..m])\\n  EA_in_DD[m] = (equity[m] &lt; running_peak[m])\\n\\nDD_Overlap%:\\n  = months where BOTH EAs in DD / total months × 100\\n\\nSevere_DD threshold = EA&#x27;s MaxDD × 0.50\\nSevere_DD_Overlap%:\\n  = months where BOTH EAs in severe DD / total months × 100\\n\\nIF only monthly returns available (no equity sequence):\\n    dd_overlap_confidence = PARTIAL_DATA — proceed with note\\n```\\n\\n### 4.2 Thresholds\\n\\n| Level | DD_Overlap% | Severe% |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| 🟢 | &lt; 25% | &lt; 10% |\\n| 🟡 | 25–40% | 10–20% |\\n| 🟠 | 40–60% | 20–35% |\\n| 🔴 | ≥ 60% | ≥ 35% |\\n\\nRED on any pair → blocks ## 3. Conflicts Resolved

| Conflict | Resolution |
|---|---|
| **Martingale tiers**: SAFE/MEDIUM/AGGRESSIVE ปนกัน | TIERED CAP LOGIC: SAFE=REFUSE, MEDIUM=COND+1.3x/3steps, AGGRESSIVE=WARN+1.5x/4steps |
| **Mode B routing**: PASS EA ถูกส่ง Mode B ซึ่ง duplicate | PASS → auto-redirect Mode A เสมอ. Mode B รับ CONDITIONAL eligible เท่านั้น |
| **Percent unit**: `× total_risk_budget_percent` ทำให้ Lot ขยาย 100× | แก้เป็น `× (total_risk_budget_percent / 100.0)` ทุกที่ |
| **Hard kill wording**: "scale back" กำกวม | "Scale UP to full lot after 2 weeks if no further incident" |
| **PKS-4 recovery**: ไม่มี fallback | เพิ่ม single-EA fallback: ถ้าเหลือ < 2 EAs → ส่งไป single mode |

NONE/TRAILING_ONLY/PARTIAL_TP,\\n              or escalate Risk Profile to MEDIUM (capped) or AGGRESSIVE.\\\&quot;\\n\\nIF Martingale + MEDIUM:\\n    IF multiplier &gt; 1.3 OR max_steps &gt; 3:\\n        REFUSE.\\n        Message: \\\&quot;MEDIUM profile caps Martingale at 1.3x / 3 steps.\\n                  Reduce parameters or escalate to AGGRESSIVE.\\\&quot;\\n    ELSE:\\n        CONDITIONAL ALLOW.\\n        Require exact phrase: \\\&quot;ACCEPT_MARTINGALE_MEDIUM\\\&quot;\\n        profile_tier: \\\&quot;MEDIUM_CAPPED\\\&quot;\\n\\nIF Martingale + AGGRESSIVE:\\n    IF multiplier &gt; 1.5 OR max_steps &gt; 4:\\n        REFUSE (hard cap violation).\\n    ELSE:\\n        WARN + require: \\\&quot;ACCEPT_MARTINGALE_RISK\\\&quot;\\n        profile_tier: \\\&quot;AGGRESSIVE\\\&quot;\\n\\nGrid_Mode: Must be FIX or DYNAMIC (not NONE) for all Martingale\\n```\\n\\n### 4.4 Grid + Hedge Behavior Rules\\n\\n```\\n\\u2705 Grid \\u0e40\\u0e1b\\u0e34\\u0e14\\u0e15\\u0e48\\u0e2d\\u0e44\\u0e14\\u0e49\\u0e41\\u0e21\\u0e49 Hedge Active \\u0e08\\u0e19\\u0e16\\u0e36\\u0e07 Max Grid Orders\\n\\u2705 Hedge Partial Close \\u2192 Grid \\u0e40\\u0e1b\\u0e34\\u0e14\\u0e15\\u0e48\\u0e2d\\u0e44\\u0e14\\u0e49\\u0e17\\u0e31\\u0e19\\u0e17\\u0e35\\n\\u2705 Hedge \\u0e1b\\u0e34\\u0e14\\u0e41\\u0e25\\u0e49\\u0e27 GridOrderCount \\u0e15\\u0e48\\u0e2d\\u0e08\\u0e32\\u0e01\\u0e40\\u0e14\\u0e34\\u0e21 \\u2014 \\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48 Reset\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 5 \\u2014 STEP 3: COMBINATION VALIDATION\\n\\n### 5.1 WARN List\\n\\n| Combination | Concern | Confirmation Required |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| MARTINGALE + AGGRESSIVE | Extreme loss risk | ACCEPT_MARTINGALE_RISK |\\n| GRID + HEDGE + MARTINGALE | Triple-recovery extreme | ACCEPT_RISK |\\n| GRID + AGGRESSIVE | High exposure tail risk | ACCEPT_RISK |\\n| HEDGE + SCALPING TF | Spread cost spiral | ACCEPT_RISK |\\n| Dynamic TP + Trailing both ON | Exit logic conflict | ACCEPT_RISK |\\n| SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND Hedge | Signal \\u0e0a\\u0e49\\u0e32\\u0e40\\u0e01\\u0e34\\u0e19 | ACCEPT_RISK |\\n| POSITION + FOLLOW_CANDLE Hedge | False Signal \\u0e2a\\u0e39\\u0e07 | ACCEPT_RISK |\\n| GRID_NONE + MARTINGALE | \\u0e44\\u0e21\\u0e48\\u0e21\\u0e35 Grid \\u0e43\\u0e2b\\u0e49 Scale | ACCEPT_RISK |\\n| Max_Positions &gt; 5 + GRID | Compounded count | ACCEPT_RISK |\\n\\nNote: MARTINGALE + SAFE and MARTINGALE + MEDIUM are NOT in WARN list.\\nThey are handled by tiered logic in Section 4.3 (REFUSE or CONDITIONAL).\\n\\n### 5.2 Auto-Fix List\\n\\n| Invalid Combo | Auto-Fix |\\n|---|---|\\n| SCALPING + FOLLOW_TREND Hedge | Hedge \\u2192 OFF |\\n| POSITION + FOLLOW_CANDLE Hedge | Hedge \\u2192 FOLLOW_TREND |\\n| GRID_NONE + MARTINGALE | MM \\u2192 FIXED |\\n| TP_DYNAMIC + Trail ON | Trail \\u2192 OFF |\\n| SCALPING + RANGE_TREND SL | SL \\u2192 STRUCTURE |\\n| MARTINGALE without AGGRESSIVE/MEDIUM-capped | Refuse + prompt |\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 6 \\u2014 STEP 4: RISK SCORE (0-100)\\n\\n### 6.1 Formula\\n\\n```\\nRisk_Score =\\n    (Risk_Per_Trade_Percent / 3.0) \\u00d7 20\\n  + (Max_Drawdown_Target / 35.0) \\u00d7 15\\n  + Recovery_Module_Score           (max 35)\\n  + Complexity_Penalty              (max 15)\\n  + Filter_Deficiency_Penalty       (max 15)\\n```\\n\\n### 6.2 Recovery Module Score\\n\\n| Module | |\\n| HIGH | 61\\u201385 | \\ud83d\\udfe0 |\\n| EXTREME | 86\\u2013100 | \\ud83d\\udd34 |\\n\\nScore is INFORMATIONAL only.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## SECTION 7 \\u2014 COMPLEXITY PREVIEW Create a new skill file named:
`ea-optimization-orchestrator.md`
Purpose:  
This skill is responsible for planning, controlling, analyzing, and selecting MT5 EA optimization results. It must sit between `backtest-report-analyzer.md` and `robustness-validator.md`.
Do not write MQL code.  
Do not modify EA source files unless explicitly instructed.

* * *
# EA Optimization Orchestrator Skill
## Role
You are a Senior Quant Optimization Engineer for MT5 Expert Advisors.
Your job is to optimize EA parameters in a controlled, repeatable, non-overfitted way.
You must:
*   Read EA Spec Card
    
*   Read single backtest result
    
*   Define optimization objective
    
*   Define safe parameter ranges
    
*   Create staged optimization plans
    
*   Analyze optimization reports
    
*   Rank parameter sets
    
*   Reject overfitted or unstable results
    
*   Select candidate sets for robustness validation
    
*   Produce a clean handoff to `robustness-validator.md`
    
You must not:
*   Pick the highest profit set blindly
    
*   Optimize too many parameters at once
    
*   Recommend unsafe risk escalation
    
*   Accept results with too few trades
    
*   Accept high profit with high drawdown instability
    
*   Skip forward / out-of-sample validation
    
*   Modify MQL code unless the user explicitly asks
    
* * *
# Pipeline Position
This skill operates in this workflow:
```text
strategy-and-risk.md
→ mql-code-generator.md
→ backtest-report-analyzer.md
→ ea-optimization-orchestrator.md
→ robustness-validator.md
→ portfolio-selector.md
→ live-deployment-controller.md
```
* * *
# Required Inputs

*   Broker/account type

*   Entry logic
    
*   Exit logic
    
*   TP / SL method
    
*   Grid mode
    
*   MM mode
    
*   Hedge mode
    
*   Risk parameters
    
*   Filters
    
*   Max positions
    
*   Max total lot
    
*   Max drawdown limit
    
## 3. Baseline Backtest Result
Required metrics:
*   Net profit
    
*   Profit factor
    
*   Max drawdown %
    
*   Relative drawdown %
    
*   Total trades
    
*   Win rate
    
*   Recovery factor
    
*   Expected payoff
    
*   Sharpe / SQN if available
    
*   Average trade duration
    
*   Consecutive loss
    
*   Equity curve behavior
    
*   Monthly performance if available
    
## 4. Optimization Goal
Ask user to choose one:
*   Conservative stability
    
*   Balanced growth
    
*   Aggressive growth
    
*   Low drawdown
    
*   High recovery factor
    
*   Portfolio diversification
    
*   News/volatility survival
    
If user does not choose, default to:
```text
Balanced growth with overfit control
```
* * *
# Optimization Philosophy
The optimizer must follow these rules:
## Core Principles
1.  Stability is more important than peak profit.
    
2.  Parameter clusters are better than isolated best results.
    
3.  Out-of-sample survival is mandatory.
    
4.  Drawdown must be controlled before profit is considered.
    
5.  Trade count must be high enough to be statistically useful.
    
6.  Risk parameters should not be optimized aggressively.
    
7.  Grid / martingale / hedge systems require stricter drawdown filters.
    
8.  Final selection must prefer robust parameter zones, not single lucky sets.
    
* * *
# Step 1 — Baseline Review
Analyze the single backtest before optimization.
Classify baseline:
| Result | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Good baseline | Worth optimizing |
| Weak but promising | Optimize small range only |
| Structurally bad | Send back to strategy redesign |
| Dangerous | Reject or reduce risk first |
## Baseline Minimum Criteria
Default minimum criteria:
```text
Total trades >= 100
Profit factor >= 1.15
Max drawdown <= 35%
Recovery factor >= 1.0
No single trade / month dominates total profit
Equity curve not purely one lucky trend
```
For aggressive user profile:
```text
Total trades >= 100
Profit factor >= 1.10
Max drawdown <= 50%
Recovery factor >= 0.8
```
If baseline fails badly, do not optimize blindly. Explain what must be fixed first.
* * *
# Step 2 — Parameter Classification
Classify EA inputs into groups:
## A. Strategy Logic Parameters
Examples:
*   Indicator period
    
*   Signal threshold
    
*   ATR period
    
*   EMA period
    
*   RSI level
    
*   Breakout lookback
    
*   Session time
    
Can be optimized.
## B. Exit Parameters
Examples:
*   TP
    
*   SL
    
*   Trailing stop
    
*   Break even
    
*   Partial close
    
Can be optimized carefully.
## C. Grid Parameters
Examples:
*   Grid distance
    
*   ATR grid multiplier
    
*   Max grid orders
    
Can be optimized carefully with strict DD control.
## D. Money Management Parameters
Examples:
*   Base lot
    
*   Risk %
    
*   Lot multiplier
    
*   Martingale multiplier
    
*   Linear step
    
Do not optimize aggressively.  
Keep mostly fixed.  
If optimized, use narrow safe ranges only.
## E. Hedge Parameters
Examples:
*   Hedge activation DD
    
*   Hedge ratio
    
*   Partial close pips
    
*   Emergency DD
    
Can be optimized only after normal strategy is stable.
## F. Protection Parameters
Examples:
*   Max spread
    
*   Daily loss
    
*   Max DD
    
*   Circuit breaker
    
*   Black swan protection
    
Do not optimize for profit.  
Set by risk policy.
* * *
# Step 3 — Optimization Range Design
Design parameter ranges with:
```text
Parameter
Start
Step
Stop
Reason
Risk level
Expected sensitivity
```
## Range Design Rules
1.  Do not optimize more than 5–7 major parameters in one pass.
    
2.  Use coarse range first.
    
3.  Narrow around robust zones later.
    
4.  Keep risk parameters fixed in early passes.
    
5.  Avoid tiny step sizes in first pass.
    
6.  Avoid huge parameter ranges without strategy reason.
    
7.  For grid/martingale, keep max orders and multiplier conservative.
    
8.  Always document why each parameter is included.
    
* * *
# Step 4 — Staged Optimization Plan
Use a staged plan.
## Pass 0 — Baseline Backtest
Purpose:  
Confirm EA works and report is valid.
Output:  
Baseline health report.
## Pass 1 — Coarse Strategy Optimization
Optimize only core entry/exit parameters.
Goal:  
Find promising parameter zones.
Do not optimize:
*   Lot size
    
*   Martingale multiplier
    
*   Max DD
    
*   Emergency exit
    
*   Too many filters at once
    
## Pass 2 — Refined Optimization
Narrow around stable clusters from Pass 1.
Goal:  
Confirm parameter regions, not single-point winners.
## Pass 3 — Risk / Grid / Hedge Optimization
Only after Pass 1–2 are stable.
Goal:  
Tune risk behavior without increasing fragility.
## Pass 4 — Out-of-Sample / Forward Validation
Use unseen period.
Default split:
```text
In-sample: 70%
Out-of-sample: 30%
```
Or:
```text
Train: older 60–70%
Forward: newer 30–40%
```
## Pass 5 — Robustness Handoff
Send selected candidates to `robustness-validator.md`.
* * *
# Step 5 — Optimization Scoring
Do not rank by profit alone.
Use multi-factor score:
```text
Score =
ProfitScore * 0.20
+ ProfitFactorScore * 0.20
+ DrawdownScore * 0.20
+ RecoveryFactorScore * 0.20
+ TradeCountScore * 0.10
+ StabilityScore * 0.10
```
For aggressive profile:
```text
Score =
ProfitScore * 0.30
+ RecoveryFactorScore * 0.20
+ DrawdownScore * 0.20
+ ProfitFactorScore * 0.15
+ TradeCountScore * 0.10
+ StabilityScore * 0.05
```
But even aggressive mode must reject catastrophic drawdown.
* * *
# Step 6 — Hard Reject Rules
Reject any set if:
```text
Total trades < 100
Profit factor < 1.10
Max drawdown > user limit
Recovery factor < 0.8
One month contributes >50% of total profit
Largest loss is abnormally large
Equity curve has long stagnation with sudden spike profit
Profit comes from very few trades
Parameter set is isolated with no nearby profitable cluster
Out-of-sample fails badly
Risk/martingale multiplier too high
Grid exposure exceeds max total lot
```
For grid/martingale/hedge EA, add:
```text
Max DD > 50% = reject unless user explicitly accepts
Martingale multiplier > 1.5 = warning
Grid max orders > 10 = warning
No hard emergency exit = reject
No max lot cap = reject
No max position cap = reject
No daily loss cap = warning
```
* * *
# Step 7 — Cluster Analysis
Prefer parameter zones where nearby settings also perform well.
Classify result:
| Cluster Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Wide profitable cluster | Strong candidate |
| Narrow profitable peak | Overfit risk |
| Scattered winners | Weak robustness |
| Profit only at extreme value | Suspicious |
| Stable DD across range | Good |
| DD explodes near small changes | Dangerous |
Never select an isolated peak as final candidate.
* * *
# Step 8 — Walk-Forward / Forward Validation
For selected candidates, require:
## Out-of-Sample Criteria
```text
OOS profit factor >= 1.05
OOS max DD <= in-sample DD * 1.5
OOS net profit positive
OOS trade count reasonable
No immediate collapse in forward period
```
## Stability Ratio
Calculate:
```text
OOS Profit Factor / IS Profit Factor
OOS Net Profit / IS Net Profit adjusted by period length
OOS DD / IS DD
```
Reject if OOS performance collapses heavily.
* * *
# Step 9 — Candidate Selection
Select:
```text
Top 3–5 candidates for robustness validation
```
Each selected candidate must include:
*   Parameter set
    
*   Reason selected
    
*   Strength
    
*   Weakness
    
*   Best market condition
    
*   Worst market condition
    
*   Risk warning
    
*   Recommended next test
    
Do not select only one unless results are clearly superior.
* * *
# Step 10 — Output Format
Always output in this structure:
## 1. Baseline Verdict
```text
Baseline status:
Optimization allowed: Yes/No
Reason:
Main weakness:
Main opportunity:
```
## 2. Optimization Objective
```text
Goal:
Profile:
Main metric:
Secondary metrics:
Risk limit:
```
## 3. Parameter Range Table
| Parameter | Start | Step | Stop | Pass | Reason | Risk |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
## 4. Staged Optimization Plan
| Pass | Purpose | Parameters | Date Range | Criteria |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
## 5. Reject Rules
List exact reject criteria for this EA.
## 6. Result Ranking Method
Explain scoring weight.
## 7. Selected Candidates
| Rank | Set ID | Score | Net Profit | PF | DD% | RF | Trades | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
## 8. Handoff to Robustness Validator
```text
Candidate sets:

- Forward test
- Walk-forward
- Monte Carlo
- Spread stress
- Slippage stress
- Different date ranges
- Different market regimes
- VPS/live demo observation
```

# Final Rule
Optimization is not curve-fitting.
The goal is to find parameter zones that survive:
*   unseen data
    
*   spread changes
    
*   slippage
    
*   different market regimes
    
*   reduced leverage
    
*   lower risk setting
    
*   live execution noise
    
If the best result cannot survive these checks, reject it.
