void OnDeinit(int reason)
{
    if(h_atrDist != INVALID_HANDLE) IndicatorRelease(h_atrDist);
    if(h_atrSL   != INVALID_HANDLE) IndicatorRelease(h_atrSL);
    ObjectsDeleteAll(0, "HT_");
    Comment("");
    Print("EA Deinitialized | Reason: ", reason);
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| SECTION 7: OnTick() — Safety Order                               |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
void OnTick()
{
    // 1. Daily Reset (BUG-FIX: Date Compare)
    ResetDailyStats();

    // 2. Emergency Exit
    if(!CheckEmergencyExit()) return;

    // 3. Drawdown Limit
    if(!CheckDrawdownLimit()) return;

    // 4. Daily Loss Limit
    if(!CheckDailyLossLimit()) return;

    // 5. Spread Hard Cap (Real-time)
    if(!CheckSpreadHard()) return;

    // 6. Session Filter
    if(!CheckSessionFilter()) return;

    // 7. Update Confirm TF HalfTrend (New H1 Bar)
    if(IsNewBar(InpConfirmTF, g_lastBarH1))
        UpdateHalfTrend_Confirm();

    // 8. Hedge Management (Every Tick)
    if(InpHedgeEnabled)
        ProcessHedgeRecovery();

    // 9. Dynamic TP check (Every Tick — NET_ALL mode)
    if(InpTPMode == TP_DYNAMIC)
        CheckDynamicTP();

    // 10. Entry Logic (New Entry TF Bar only)
    if(!IsNewBar(InpEntryTF, g_lastBarM15))
    {
        ShowDashboard();
        return;
    }

    // 11. ATR Filter (Baseline Volatility)
    if(!CheckATRFilter()) return;

    // 12. Update Entry TF HalfTrend → Get Signal
    UpdateHalfTrend_Entry();

    // 13. Entry Decision
    EvaluateEntry();

    // 14. Dashboard
    ShowDashboard();
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| SECTION 8: HALFTREND BUILT-IN (Entry TF)                         |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
void UpdateHalfTrend_Entry()
{
    g_ht_prevTrend  = g_ht_trend;
    g_ht_buySignal  = false;
    g_ht_sellSignal = false;

    double highNow = iHigh(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
    double lowNow  = iLow(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);

    double atrBuf[];
    ArraySetAsSeries(atrBuf, true);
    double halfATR = 0;
    if(CopyBuffer(h_atrDist, 0, 1, 1, atrBuf) == 1)
        halfATR = atrBuf[0] * InpAmplitude / 2.0;

    if(g_ht_trend == 0) // Uptrend
    {
        g_ht_phigh = MathMax(g_ht_phigh, highNow);
        if(lowNow < g_ht_phigh - halfATR)
        {
            g_ht_trend     = 1;
            g_ht_plow      = lowNow;
            g_ht_sellSignal = true; // Trend changed: Up→Down
        }
    }
    else // Downtrend
    {
        g_ht_plow = MathMin(g_ht_plow, lowNow);
        if(highNow > g_ht_plow + halfATR)
        {
            g_ht_trend    = 0;
            g_ht_phigh    = highNow;
            g_ht_buySignal = true; // Trend changed: Down→Up
        }
    }
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| SECTION 8B: HALFTREND BUILT-IN (Confirm TF)                      |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
void UpdateHalfTrend_Confirm()
{
    double highNow = iHigh(_Symbol, InpConfirmTF, 1);
    double lowNow  = iLow(_Symbol, InpConfirmTF, 1);

    double atrBuf[];
    ArraySetAsSeries(atrBuf, true);
    double halfATR = 0;
    if(CopyBuffer(h_atrDist, 0, 1, 1, atrBuf) == 1)
        halfATR = atrBuf[0] * InpAmplitude / 2.0;

    if(g_hth_trend == 0)
    {
        g_hth_phigh = MathMax(g_hth_phigh, highNow);
        if(lowNow < g_hth_phigh - halfATR)
        {
            g_hth_trend = 1;
            g_hth_plow  = lowNow;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        g_hth_plow = MathMin(g_hth_plow, lowNow);
        if(highNow > g_hth_plow + halfATR)
        {
            g_hth_trend = 0;
            g_hth_phigh = highNow;
        }
    }
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| SECTION 9: DISTANCE MODULE                                       |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
double GetEffectiveDistance(int orderNumber)
{
    double dist = 0;
    switch(InpDistMode)
    {
        case DIST_NONE:
            return 0; // No distance constraint

        case DIST_FIXED:
            dist = InpFixedPips * _Point * 10;
            break;

        case DIST_LINEAR:
            // Distance increases per order: start + (N-1) × step
            dist = (InpLinearStart + (orderNumber - 1) * InpLinearStep) * _Point * 10;
            break;

        case DIST_ATR:
        {
            double atrBuf[];
            ArraySetAsSeries(atrBuf, true);
            if(CopyBuffer(h_atrDist, 0, 0, 1, atrBuf) == 1)
                dist = atrBuf[0] * InpATRMultiplier * InpATRDistMultiplier;
            break;
        }

        case DIST_PA:
            dist = InpPAMinDist * _Point * 10;
            break;
    }

    // Apply global distance multiplier
    return dist * InpDistMultiplier;
}

bool CheckDistanceCondition(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE orderType, int nextOrderNum)
{
    if(InpDistMode == DIST_NONE) return true;

    double lastPrice = (orderType == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? g_lastBuyPrice : g_lastSellPrice;
    if(lastPrice == 0) return true; // No previous order

    double currentPrice = (orderType == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
                          ? SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK)
                          : SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);

    double effectiveDist = GetEffectiveDistance(nextOrderNum);
    double actualDist    = MathAbs(currentPrice - lastPrice);

    return (actualDist >= effectiveDist);
}

bool CheckEntryTrigger(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE orderType)
{
    switch(InpEntryTrigger)
    {
        case TRIG_PRICE:
            // Distance already checked — open immediately
            return true;

        case TRIG_CLOSE:
        {
            // Price must be beyond distance AND current bar must be closed
            // (we only run this on new bar, so effectively = bar close trigger)
            return true;
        }

        case TRIG_PA:
            // PA Signal required (in addition to distance check)
            return DetectPASignal();

        case TRIG_SIGNAL:
            // HalfTrend direction change required
            if(orderType == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)  return g_ht_buySignal;
            if(orderType == ORDER_TYPE_SELL) return g_ht_sellSignal;
            return false;
    }
    return false;
}

bool DetectPASignal()
{
    double open1  = iOpen(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
    double close1 = iClose(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
    double high1  = iHigh(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
    double low1   = iLow(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
    double open2  = iOpen(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 2);
    double close2 = iClose(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 2);
    double body1  = MathAbs(close1 - open1);
    double body2  = MathAbs(close2 - open2);
    double range1 = high1 - low1;

    switch(InpPASignal)
    {
        case PA_ENGULFING:
            return (body1 > body2 * 1.1 &&
                    ((close1 > open1 && close2 < open2) ||
                     (close1 < open1 && close2 > open2)));

        case PA_PIN_BAR:
        {
            double upperWick = high1 - MathMax(open1, close1);
            double lowerWick = MathMin(open1, close1) - low1;
            return (upperWick > body1 * 2 || lowerWick > body1 * 2) && body1 < range1 * 0.3;
        }

        case PA_INSIDE_BAR:
        {
            double high2 = iHigh(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 2);
            double low2  = iLow(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 2);
            return (high1 < high2 && low1 > low2);
        }

        case PA_DOJI:
            return (body1 < range1 * 0.1 && range1 > 0);
    }
    return false;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| SECTION 10: LOT SIZING MODULE                                    |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
double CalcOrderLot(int orderNumber)
{
    double lot = InpBaseLot;

    switch(InpLotMode)
    {
        case LOT_FIXED:
            lot = InpBaseLot;
            break;

        case LOT_LINEAR:
            // lot_N = base + (N-1) × step
            lot = InpBaseLot + (orderNumber - 1) * InpLinearLotStep;
            break;

        case LOT_MARTINGALE:
            // lot_N = base × multiplier^(N-1)
            lot = InpBaseLot * MathPow(InpMartMultiplier, orderNumber - 1);
            break;

        case LOT_LOG:
        {
            // lot_N = base × factor^[log10(N) | ln(N)]
            // orderN=1 → exponent=0 → lot = base (always)
            if(orderNumber <= 1)
            {
                lot = InpBaseLot;
            }
            else
            {
                double n        = (double)orderNumber;
                double exponent = (InpLogType == LOG_TYPE_LN) ? MathLog(n) : MathLog10(n);
                lot = InpBaseLot * MathPow(InpLogFactor, exponent);
            }
            break;
        }
    }

    // Cap at max total lot
    double currentTotal = GetTotalOpenLot();
    if(currentTotal + lot > InpMaxTotalLot)
        lot = InpMaxTotalLot - currentTotal;

    return NormalizeDouble(MathMax(lot, 0.01), 2);
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| SECTION 11: ENTRY EVALUATION                                     |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
void EvaluateEntry()
{
    bool h1Up   = (g_hth_trend == 0); // H1 Uptrend
    bool h1Down = (g_hth_trend == 1); // H1 Downtrend

    // MTF Logic:
    // Case 1: M15 Buy + H1 Up   → Buy Full Lot
    // Case 2: M15 Buy + H1 Down → Buy Half Lot
    // Case 3: M15 Sell + H1 Up  → Buy Half Lot (contra)
    // Case 4: M15 Sell + H1 Down → Sell Full Lot

    // Buy conditions
    if(g_ht_buySignal && h1Up)
    {
        TryOpenGridOrder(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, 1.0); // Full lot
    }
    else if(g_ht_buySignal && h1Down)
    {
        TryOpenGridOrder(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, 0.5); // Half lot
    }
    else if(g_ht_sellSignal && h1Up)
    {
        TryOpenGridOrder(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, 0.5); // Contra half lot
    }
    else if(g_ht_sellSignal && h1Down)
    {
        TryOpenGridOrder(ORDER_TYPE_SELL, 1.0); // Full lot
    }
}

void TryOpenGridOrder(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type, double lotRatio)
{
    int nextOrderNum = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? g_gridCountBuy + 1 : g_gridCountSell + 1;

    // Max orders check
    if(nextOrderNum > InpGridMaxOrders) return;

    // Distance check
    if(!CheckDistanceCondition(type, nextOrderNum)) return;

    // Entry trigger check
    if(!CheckEntryTrigger(type)) return;

    // Margin check
    double lot = CalcOrderLot(nextOrderNum) * lotRatio;
    lot = NormalizeDouble(MathMax(lot, 0.01), 2);
    if(!CheckMargin(lot)) return;

    // Spread check
    if(!CheckSpreadNormal()) return;

    // Calculate SL
    double sl = CalcSL(type);
    if(sl == 0) return;

    // Calculate TP
    double tp = CalcTP(type, sl);

    // Open order
    string comment = "GRID_" + IntegerToString(nextOrderNum);
    bool result = false;
    if(type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
        result = Trade.Buy(lot, _Symbol, 0, sl, tp, comment);
    else
        result = Trade.Sell(lot, _Symbol, 0, sl, tp, comment);

    if(result && Trade.ResultRetcode() == TRADE_RETCODE_DONE)
    {
        if(type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
        {
            g_gridCountBuy++;
            g_lastBuyPrice = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
        }
        else
        {
            g_gridCountSell++;
            g_lastSellPrice = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
        }
        Print("Grid Order Opened | ", EnumToString(type), " | Lot:", lot,
              " | SL:", sl, " | TP:", tp, " | #", nextOrderNum);

        // Check Hedge trigger after new grid order
        if(InpHedgeEnabled)
            CheckHedgeTrigger(type, lot);
    }
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| SECTION 12: SL / TP CALCULATION                                  |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
double CalcSL(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type)
{
    double sl = 0;
    int digits = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);

    switch(InpSLMode)
    {
        case SL_FIXED:
        {
            double slDist = InpSLFixedPips * _Point * 10;
            sl = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
                 ? SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK) - slDist
                 : SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID) + slDist;
            break;
        }

        case SL_ATR:
        {
            double atrBuf[];
            ArraySetAsSeries(atrBuf, true);
            if(CopyBuffer(h_atrSL, 0, 0, 1, atrBuf) == 1)
            {
                double slDist = atrBuf[0] * InpSLATRMultiplier;
                sl = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
                     ? SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK) - slDist
                     : SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID) + slDist;
            }
            break;
        }

        case SL_STRUCTURE:
        {
            if(type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
            {
                double low = iLow(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
                for(int i = 2; i <= InpSLLookback; i++)
                    low = MathMin(low, iLow(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, i));
                sl = low - 3 * _Point * 10;
            }
            else
            {
                double high = iHigh(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
                for(int i = 2; i <= InpSLLookback; i++)
                    high = MathMax(high, iHigh(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, i));
                sl = high + 3 * _Point * 10;
            }
            break;
        }
    }

    // Enforce max SL
    double entry = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
                   ? SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK)
                   : SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
    double slPips = MathAbs(entry - sl) / (_Point * 10);
    if(slPips > InpMaxSLPips)
    {
        double maxSlDist = InpMaxSLPips * _Point * 10;
        sl = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? entry - maxSlDist : entry + maxSlDist;
    }

    return NormalizeDouble(sl, digits);
}

double CalcTP(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type, double sl)
{
    double tp = 0;
    int digits = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);
    double entry = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
                   ? SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK)
                   : SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);

    switch(InpTPMode)
    {
        case TP_FIXED:
        {
            double tpDist = InpTPFixedPips * _Point * 10;
            tp = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? entry + tpDist : entry - tpDist;
            break;
        }

        case TP_RR:
        {
            double slDist = MathAbs(entry - sl);
            double tpDist = slDist * InpRRRatio;
            tp = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? entry + tpDist : entry - tpDist;
            break;
        }

        case TP_DYNAMIC:
            tp = 0; // No fixed TP — managed dynamically
            break;
    }

    return (tp > 0) ? NormalizeDouble(tp, digits) : 0;
}

void CheckDynamicTP()
{
    if(InpTPMode != TP_DYNAMIC) return;

    double totalFloating = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < PositionsTotal(); i++)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(PositionSelectByTicket(ticket) &&
           PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) == InpMagic)
        {
            totalFloating += PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)
                           + PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SWAP);
        }
    }

    double target = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE) * (InpDynamicPct / 100.0);
    if(totalFloating >= target)
    {
        CloseAllByMagic();
        Print("Dynamic TP Hit | Net Profit: ", totalFloating, " | Target: ", target);
    }
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| SECTION 13: HEDGE MODULE                                         |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
void CheckHedgeTrigger(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE gridType, double newGridLot)
{
    if(GetCurrentDD() < InpHedgeTriggerDD) return;

    // Scale Ladder: every new grid order → add equivalent hedge lot
    double hedgeLot = CalcHedgeLot(newGridLot);

    ENUM_ORDER_TYPE hedgeType = (gridType == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
                                ? ORDER_TYPE_SELL
                                : ORDER_TYPE_BUY;

    if(!CheckMargin(hedgeLot)) return;

    string comment = "HEDGE";
    bool result = false;
    if(hedgeType == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
        result = Trade.Buy(hedgeLot, _Symbol, 0, 0, 0, comment);
    else
        result = Trade.Sell(hedgeLot, _Symbol, 0, 0, 0, comment);

    if(result && Trade.ResultRetcode() == TRADE_RETCODE_DONE)
    {
        g_hedgeActive    = true;
        g_totalHedgeLot += hedgeLot;
        Print("Hedge Opened | Lot:", hedgeLot, " | TotalHedge:", g_totalHedgeLot);
    }
}

double CalcHedgeLot(double triggerLot)
{
    switch(InpHedgeLotMode)
    {
        case HEDGE_MATCH:
            // Hedge = same lot as the triggering grid order
            return NormalizeDouble(triggerLot, 2);

        case HEDGE_TOTAL50:
        {
            // Hedge = 50% of total open grid lot
            double totalGrid = GetTotalGridLot();
            return NormalizeDouble(totalGrid * 0.5, 2);
        }

        case HEDGE_BOTH:
        {
            // First hedge = 50% of total; subsequent = match trigger
            if(!g_hedgeActive)
            {
                double totalGrid = GetTotalGridLot();
                return NormalizeDouble(totalGrid * 0.5, 2);
            }
            else
            {
                return NormalizeDouble(triggerLot, 2);
            }
        }
    }
    return NormalizeDouble(triggerLot, 2);
}

void ProcessHedgeRecovery()
{
    if(!g_hedgeActive) return;

    // Get hedge floating profit
    double hedgeProfit = GetHedgeFloatProfitPips();
    if(hedgeProfit < InpHedgeProfitThresh) return;

    // Close ALL grid orders farther than MinCloseDist from current price
    double currentPrice = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
    bool   closedAny    = false;

    for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != InpMagic) continue;
        if(PositionGetString(POSITION_COMMENT) != "GRID" &&
           StringFind(PositionGetString(POSITION_COMMENT), "GRID_") < 0) continue;

        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);
        double dist      = MathAbs(currentPrice - openPrice) / (_Point * 10);

        if(dist >= InpHedgeMinCloseDist)
        {
            Trade.PositionClose(ticket);
            closedAny = true;
            Print("Hedge Multi-Close | Grid ticket:", ticket, " | Dist:", dist, " pips");
        }
    }

    // Set TP 10 pips on hedge orders
    if(closedAny)
        ApplyHedgeTP();
}

void ApplyHedgeTP()
{
    double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
    double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
    int    digits = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);

    for(int i = 0; i < PositionsTotal(); i++)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != InpMagic) continue;
        if(PositionGetString(POSITION_COMMENT) != "HEDGE") continue;

        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE posType = (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);
        double tp = (posType == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)
                    ? NormalizeDouble(bid + InpHedgeTPPips * _Point * 10, digits)
                    : NormalizeDouble(ask - InpHedgeTPPips * _Point * 10, digits);

        Trade.PositionModify(ticket, PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SL), tp);
    }
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| SECTION 14: HELPER FUNCTIONS                                     |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
bool IsNewBar(ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf, datetime &lastBar)
{
    datetime current = iTime(_Symbol, tf, 0);
    if(current != lastBar) { lastBar = current; return true; }
    return false;
}

double GetCurrentDD()
{
    double equity  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
    double balance = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
    if(balance <= 0) return 0;
    return ((balance - equity) / balance) * 100.0;
}

double GetTotalOpenLot()
{
    double total = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < PositionsTotal(); i++)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(PositionSelectByTicket(ticket) &&
           PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) == InpMagic)
            total += PositionGetDouble(POSITION_VOLUME);
    }
    return total;
}

double GetTotalGridLot()
{
    double total = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < PositionsTotal(); i++)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != InpMagic) continue;
        string comment = PositionGetString(POSITION_COMMENT);
        if(StringFind(comment, "GRID") >= 0)
            total += PositionGetDouble(POSITION_VOLUME);
    }
    return total;
}

double GetHedgeFloatProfitPips()
{
    double totalProfit = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < PositionsTotal(); i++)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != InpMagic) continue;
        if(PositionGetString(POSITION_COMMENT) != "HEDGE") continue;

        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE posType = (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);
        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);
        double bid       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
        double pip       = (posType == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)
                           ? (bid - openPrice) / (_Point * 10)
                           : (openPrice - bid) / (_Point * 10);
        totalProfit += pip;
    }
    return totalProfit;
}

double GetLastOrderPrice() { return g_lastBuyPrice > 0 ? g_lastBuyPrice : g_lastSellPrice; }

bool CheckMargin(double lot)
{
    double req = 0;
    if(!OrderCalcMargin(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, _Symbol, lot,
                        SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK), req)) return false;
    return AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE) >= req * 1.5;
}

bool CheckSpreadNormal()
{
    return SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD) <= InpMaxSpreadPts;
}

bool CheckSpreadHard()
{
    return SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD) <= InpMaxSpreadHard;
}

bool CheckATRFilter()
{
    double atrBuf[];
    ArraySetAsSeries(atrBuf, true);
    if(CopyBuffer(h_atrSL, 0, 0, 1, atrBuf) < 1) return true;
    return atrBuf[0] >= InpATRMinValue;
}

bool CheckSessionFilter()
{
    if(!InpSessionFilter) return true;
    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeGMT(), dt);
    int h = dt.hour;
    if(InpAllowLondon && (h >= 7  && h < 16)) return true;
    if(InpAllowNY     && (h >= 13 && h < 22)) return true;
    return false;
}

bool CheckDrawdownLimit()
{
    return GetCurrentDD() < InpMaxDrawdownPct;
}

bool CheckDailyLossLimit()
{
    double eq   = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
    double loss = ((g_dailyStartEq - eq) / g_dailyStartEq) * 100.0;
    return loss < InpDailyLossPct;
}

bool CheckEmergencyExit()
{
    if(GetCurrentDD() < InpEmergencyDD) return true;
    CloseAllByMagic();
    Print("EMERGENCY EXIT triggered at DD: ", GetCurrentDD(), "%");
    return false;
}

void CloseAllByMagic()
{
    for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(PositionSelectByTicket(ticket) &&
           PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) == InpMagic)
            Trade.PositionClose(ticket);
    }
    g_gridCountBuy = g_gridCountSell = 0;
    g_hedgeActive  = false;
    g_totalHedgeLot = 0;
}

void ResetDailyStats()
{
    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);
    datetime today = StringToTime(StringFormat("%04d.%02d.%02d", dt.year, dt.mon, dt.day));
    if(today > g_lastResetDate)
    {
        g_dailyStartEq  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
        g_lastResetDate = today;
    }
}

void ShowDashboard()
{
    string distInfo = "";
    switch(InpDistMode)
    {
        case DIST_NONE:    distInfo = "NONE"; break;
        case DIST_FIXED:   distInfo = StringFormat("FIXED %d×%.1f", InpFixedPips, InpDistMultiplier); break;
        case DIST_LINEAR:  distInfo = StringFormat("LINEAR %d+%d×%.1f", InpLinearStart, InpLinearStep, InpDistMultiplier); break;
        case DIST_ATR:     distInfo = StringFormat("ATR×%.1f×%.1f", InpATRMultiplier, InpATRDistMultiplier); break;
        case DIST_PA:      distInfo = StringFormat("PA %d pips", InpPAMinDist); break;
    }

    string lotInfo = "";
    switch(InpLotMode)
    {
        case LOT_FIXED:      lotInfo = StringFormat("FIXED %.2f", InpBaseLot); break;
        case LOT_LINEAR:     lotInfo = StringFormat("LINEAR +%.2f", InpLinearLotStep); break;
        case LOT_MARTINGALE: lotInfo = StringFormat("MART ×%.1f", InpMartMultiplier); break;
        case LOT_LOG:        lotInfo = StringFormat("LOG%s ×%.1f", (InpLogType == LOG_TYPE_LOG10 ? "10" : "LN"), InpLogFactor); break;
    }

    Comment(StringFormat(
        "=== HalfTrend MTF Master v2.6 ===\n"
        "Symbol : %s  |  DD: %.1f%%\n"
        "Trend  : M15=%s  H1=%s\n"
        "Dist   : %s  |  Trigger: %s\n"
        "Lot    : %s\n"
        "Grid   : Buy#%d  Sell#%d\n"
        "Hedge  : %s (Total: %.2f lots)\n"
        "Balance: %.2f  Equity: %.2f",
        _Symbol, GetCurrentDD(),
        g_ht_trend == 0 ? "UP" : "DOWN",
        g_hth_trend == 0 ? "UP" : "DOWN",
        distInfo, EnumToString(InpEntryTrigger),
        lotInfo,
        g_gridCountBuy, g_gridCountSell,
        g_hedgeActive ? "ON" : "OFF", g_totalHedgeLot,
        AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE),
        AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY)
    ));
}

| **InpRRRatio** | 1.5 | RR Ratio | OPTIMIZE_SECONDARY |
| **InpSLMode** | SL_STRUCTURE | Stop Loss Mode | OPTIMIZE_DISCRETE |

| **InpHedgeEnabled** | true | เปิด/ปิด Hedge | OPTIMIZE_DISCRETE |
| **InpHedgeTriggerDD** | 15.0 | Hedge trigger at DD% | OPTIMIZE_RESTRICTED |
| **InpHedgeLotMode** | HEDGE_BOTH | Hedge Lot Mode | OPTIMIZE_DISCRETE |
| **InpHedgeTPPips** | 10 | Hedge TP pips | OPTIMIZE_SECONDARY |

โค้ดที่ Generate ไปมี Issues หลายจุดครับ วิเคราะห์และแก้ไขเลย

# 🔍 Issues ที่พบ

```
Bug 1: Multi-TF HalfTrend ใช้ h_atrDist handle เดียวกันสำหรับทั้ง M15 และ H1
       → ATR period ผิด TF

Bug 2: CheckEntryTrigger(TRIG_CLOSE) return true ทันที
       → Comment บอกว่า "effectively = bar close" แต่ไม่มี logic จริง

Bug 3: Linear Distance ใช้ g_gridCountBuy/Sell แต่ nextOrderNum คำนวณแยก
       → อาจ off-by-one

Bug 4: GetLastOrderPrice() return Buy หรือ Sell อย่างเดียว
       → ไม่แยก direction → distance check ผิดสำหรับ Sell side

Bug 5: CloseAllByMagic() reset g_gridCountBuy/Sell = 0
       → แต่ g_lastBuyPrice / g_lastSellPrice ไม่ reset → entry condition ผิดครั้งต่อไป

Bug 6: CheckHedgeTrigger ถูกเรียกใน TryOpenGridOrder ด้วย DD check
       → แต่ DD check อยู่ใน ProcessHedgeRecovery ไม่ใช่ CheckHedgeTrigger
       → Hedge จะเปิดทุกครั้งที่มีไม้ใหม่ ไม่ว่า DD จะถึงหรือไม่

Bug 7: ApplyHedgeTP ใช้ bid/ask สลับกันสำหรับ Sell position
       → Sell position: TP ควรอยู่ต่ำกว่าราคา ใช้ bid ไม่ใช่ ask
```

    Trade.SetExpertMagicNumber(InpMagic);
    Trade.SetDeviationInPoints(50);
    Trade.SetTypeFilling(ORDER_FILLING_IOC);

    // FIX 1: Create separate ATR handles per TF
    h_atrDist   = iATR(_Symbol, InpEntryTF,   InpDistATRPeriod);
    h_atrSL     = iATR(_Symbol, InpEntryTF,   InpSLATRPeriod);
    h_atrHT_M15 = iATR(_Symbol, InpEntryTF,   InpHT_ATR_Period);
    h_atrHT_H1  = iATR(_Symbol, InpConfirmTF, InpHT_ATR_Period);

    if(h_atrDist   == INVALID_HANDLE || h_atrSL     == INVALID_HANDLE ||
       h_atrHT_M15 == INVALID_HANDLE || h_atrHT_H1  == INVALID_HANDLE)
    {
        Print("ERROR: ATR handle creation failed");
        return INIT_FAILED;
    }

    // Init HalfTrend State from current bars
    g_ht_phigh  = iHigh(_Symbol, InpEntryTF,   1);
    g_ht_plow   = iLow (_Symbol, InpEntryTF,   1);
    g_hth_phigh = iHigh(_Symbol, InpConfirmTF, 1);
    g_hth_plow  = iLow (_Symbol, InpConfirmTF, 1);

    // Init Daily Stats
    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);
    g_lastResetDate = StringToTime(StringFormat("%04d.%02d.%02d", dt.year, dt.mon, dt.day));
    g_dailyStartEq  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);

    if(!SymbolSelect(_Symbol, true))
    { Print("ERROR: Symbol not found: ", _Symbol); return INIT_FAILED; }

    Print("=== HalfTrend MTF Master v2.61 (Bug-Fixed) ===");
    Print("EntryTF:", EnumToString(InpEntryTF),
          " ConfirmTF:", EnumToString(InpConfirmTF),
          " Dist:", EnumToString(InpDistMode),
          " Trigger:", EnumToString(InpEntryTrigger),
          " Lot:", EnumToString(InpLotMode));
    return INIT_SUCCEEDED;
}

{
    if(h_atrDist   != INVALID_HANDLE) IndicatorRelease(h_atrDist);
    if(h_atrSL     != INVALID_HANDLE) IndicatorRelease(h_atrSL);
    if(h_atrHT_M15 != INVALID_HANDLE) IndicatorRelease(h_atrHT_M15);
    if(h_atrHT_H1  != INVALID_HANDLE) IndicatorRelease(h_atrHT_H1);
    ObjectsDeleteAll(0, "HT_");
    Comment("");
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| SECTION 7: OnTick()                                              |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
void OnTick()
{
    ResetDailyStats(); // BUG-FIX: Date Compare
    if(!CheckEmergencyExit())  return;
    if(!CheckDrawdownLimit())  return;
    if(!CheckDailyLossLimit()) return;
    if(!CheckSpreadHard())     return;
    if(!CheckSessionFilter())  return;

    // Update Confirm TF HalfTrend on new bar
    if(IsNewBar(InpConfirmTF, g_lastBarConfirm))
        UpdateHalfTrend(InpConfirmTF, h_atrHT_H1,
                        g_hth_phigh, g_hth_plow, g_hth_trend,
                        false, false); // Confirm TF: no signal tracking

    // Hedge management every tick
    if(InpHedgeEnabled) ProcessHedgeRecovery();

    // Dynamic TP every tick
    if(InpTPMode == TP_DYNAMIC) CheckDynamicTP();

    // Entry logic on new Entry TF bar only
    if(!IsNewBar(InpEntryTF, g_lastBarEntry))
    { ShowDashboard(); return; }

    if(!CheckATRFilter()) return;

    // Update Entry TF HalfTrend
    UpdateHalfTrend(InpEntryTF, h_atrHT_M15,
                    g_ht_phigh, g_ht_plow, g_ht_trend,
                    g_ht_buySignal, g_ht_sellSignal);

    EvaluateEntry();
    ShowDashboard();
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| SECTION 8: HALFTREND BUILT-IN — Unified for both TFs             |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
void UpdateHalfTrend(ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf, int atrHandle,
                     double &phigh, double &plow, int &trend,
                     bool &buySignal, bool &sellSignal)
{
    buySignal  = false;
    sellSignal = false;

    double highNow = iHigh(_Symbol, tf, 1);
    double lowNow  = iLow (_Symbol, tf, 1);

    double atrBuf[];
    ArraySetAsSeries(atrBuf, true);
    double halfATR = 0;
    if(CopyBuffer(atrHandle, 0, 1, 1, atrBuf) == 1)
        halfATR = atrBuf[0] * InpAmplitude / 2.0;
    if(halfATR <= 0) return;

    if(trend == 0) // Uptrend
    {
        phigh = MathMax(phigh, highNow);
        if(lowNow < phigh - halfATR)
        {
            trend     = 1;
            plow      = lowNow;
            sellSignal = true;
        }
    }
    else // Downtrend
    {
        plow = MathMin(plow, lowNow);
        if(highNow > plow + halfATR)
        {
            trend    = 0;
            phigh    = highNow;
            buySignal = true;
        }
    }
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| SECTION 9: DISTANCE MODULE                                       |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

// FIX 3+4: Pass direction-specific last price
double GetEffectiveDistance(int orderNumber)
{
    double dist = 0;
    switch(InpDistMode)
    {
        case DIST_NONE:   return 0;
        case DIST_FIXED:  dist = InpFixedPips * _Point * 10; break;
        case DIST_LINEAR:
            // FIX 3: use orderNumber directly (caller passes correct value)
            dist = (InpLinearStart + (orderNumber - 1) * InpLinearStep) * _Point * 10;
            break;
        case DIST_ATR:
        {
            double atrBuf[];
            ArraySetAsSeries(atrBuf, true);
            if(CopyBuffer(h_atrDist, 0, 0, 1, atrBuf) == 1)
                dist = atrBuf[0] * InpATRMultiplier * InpATRDistMultiplier;
            break;
        }
        case DIST_PA:
            dist = InpPAMinDist * _Point * 10;
            break;
    }
    return dist * InpDistMultiplier;
}

// FIX 4: Use direction-specific last price
bool CheckDistanceCondition(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE orderType, int nextOrderNum)
{
    if(InpDistMode == DIST_NONE) return true;

    // FIX 4: Correct last price per direction
    double lastPrice = (orderType == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? g_lastBuyPrice : g_lastSellPrice;
    if(lastPrice == 0) return true; // No previous order this direction

    double currentPrice = (orderType == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
                          ? SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK)
                          : SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);

    double effectiveDist = GetEffectiveDistance(nextOrderNum);
    double actualDist    = MathAbs(currentPrice - lastPrice);
    return (actualDist >= effectiveDist);
}

bool CheckEntryTrigger(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE orderType)
{
    switch(InpEntryTrigger)
    {
        case TRIG_PRICE:
            // Distance already satisfied (checked before calling this)
            return true;

        case TRIG_CLOSE:
            // FIX 2: We only run on bar close (IsNewBar check in OnTick)
            // so TRIG_CLOSE = price has closed beyond distance level
            // Additional check: close must be beyond distance
            {
                double closePrice = iClose(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
                double lastPrice  = (orderType == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
                                    ? g_lastBuyPrice : g_lastSellPrice;
                if(lastPrice == 0) return true;
                double closedDist = MathAbs(closePrice - lastPrice) / (_Point * 10);
                int nextNum = (orderType == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
                              ? g_gridCountBuy + 1 : g_gridCountSell + 1;
                double needed = GetEffectiveDistance(nextNum) / (_Point * 10);
                return closedDist >= needed;
            }

        case TRIG_PA:
            return DetectPASignal();

        case TRIG_SIGNAL:
            // HalfTrend direction change
            if(orderType == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)  return g_ht_buySignal;
            if(orderType == ORDER_TYPE_SELL) return g_ht_sellSignal;
            return false;
    }
    return false;
}

bool DetectPASignal()
{
    double o1 = iOpen (_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
    double c1 = iClose(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
    double h1 = iHigh (_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
    double l1 = iLow  (_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
    double o2 = iOpen (_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 2);
    double c2 = iClose(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 2);
    double body1  = MathAbs(c1 - o1);
    double body2  = MathAbs(c2 - o2);
    double range1 = h1 - l1;
    if(range1 <= 0) return false;

    switch(InpPASignal)
    {
        case PA_ENGULFING:
            return (body1 > body2 * 1.1 &&
                    ((c1 > o1 && c2 < o2) || (c1 < o1 && c2 > o2)));
        case PA_PIN_BAR:
        {
            double upperWick = h1 - MathMax(o1, c1);
            double lowerWick = MathMin(o1, c1) - l1;
            return (upperWick > body1 * 2 || lowerWick > body1 * 2)
                   && body1 < range1 * 0.3;
        }
        case PA_INSIDE_BAR:
            return (h1 < iHigh(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 2) &&
                    l1 > iLow (_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 2));
        case PA_DOJI:
            return body1 < range1 * 0.1;
    }
    return false;
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| SECTION 10: LOT SIZING                                           |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
double CalcOrderLot(int orderNumber)
{
    double lot = InpBaseLot;
    switch(InpLotMode)
    {
        case LOT_FIXED:
            lot = InpBaseLot;
            break;
        case LOT_LINEAR:
            lot = InpBaseLot + (orderNumber - 1) * InpLinearLotStep;
            break;
        case LOT_MARTINGALE:
            lot = InpBaseLot * MathPow(InpMartMultiplier, orderNumber - 1);
            break;
        case LOT_LOG:
            if(orderNumber <= 1)
            {
                lot = InpBaseLot; // orderN=1 → exponent=0 → lot=base (always)
            }
            else
            {
                double n = (double)orderNumber;
                double exponent = (InpLogType == LOG_TYPE_LN)
                                  ? MathLog(n) : MathLog10(n);
                lot = InpBaseLot * MathPow(InpLogFactor, exponent);
            }
            break;
    }

    // Total lot cap
    double currentTotal = GetTotalLotByMagic();
    if(currentTotal + lot > InpMaxTotalLot)
        lot = InpMaxTotalLot - currentTotal;

    return NormalizeDouble(MathMax(lot, 0.01), 2);
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| SECTION 11: ENTRY EVALUATION                                     |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
void EvaluateEntry()
{
    bool h1Up   = (g_hth_trend == 0);
    bool h1Down = (g_hth_trend == 1);

    if(InpAllowBuy)
    {
        if((g_ht_buySignal && h1Up) || (g_ht_buySignal && h1Down))
            TryOpenGridOrder(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, (h1Up ? 1.0 : 0.5));
        else if(g_ht_sellSignal && h1Up)
            TryOpenGridOrder(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, 0.5); // Contra
    }
    if(InpAllowSell)
    {
        if(g_ht_sellSignal && h1Down)
            TryOpenGridOrder(ORDER_TYPE_SELL, 1.0);
    }
}

void TryOpenGridOrder(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type, double lotRatio)
{
    // FIX 3: Use correct count per direction
    int nextOrderNum = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
                       ? g_gridCountBuy + 1
                       : g_gridCountSell + 1;

    if(nextOrderNum > InpGridMaxOrders) return;
    if(!CheckDistanceCondition(type, nextOrderNum)) return;
    if(!CheckEntryTrigger(type)) return;

    double lot = NormalizeDouble(CalcOrderLot(nextOrderNum) * lotRatio, 2);
    lot = MathMax(lot, 0.01);
    if(!CheckMargin(lot)) return;
    if(!CheckSpreadNormal()) return;

    double sl = CalcSL(type);
    if(sl == 0) return;
    double tp = CalcTP(type, sl);

    string comment = "GRID_" + IntegerToString(nextOrderNum);
    bool result = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
                  ? Trade.Buy (lot, _Symbol, 0, sl, tp, comment)
                  : Trade.Sell(lot, _Symbol, 0, sl, tp, comment);

    if(result && Trade.ResultRetcode() == TRADE_RETCODE_DONE)
    {
        if(type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
        {
            g_gridCountBuy++;
            g_lastBuyPrice = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK); // FIX 4
        }
        else
        {
            g_gridCountSell++;
            g_lastSellPrice = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID); // FIX 4
        }
        Print("Grid Opened | ", EnumToString(type), " #", nextOrderNum,
              " Lot:", lot, " SL:", sl, " TP:", tp);

        // FIX 6: Check hedge trigger only if DD condition is met
        if(InpHedgeEnabled && GetCurrentDD() >= InpHedgeTriggerDD)
            OpenScaleLadderHedge(type, lot);
    }
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| SECTION 12: SL / TP                                              |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
double CalcSL(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type)
{
    double sl    = 0;
    int    digs  = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);
    double ask   = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
    double bid   = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
    double entry = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? ask : bid;

    switch(InpSLMode)
    {
        case SL_FIXED:
        {
            double d = InpSLFixedPips * _Point * 10;
            sl = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? entry - d : entry + d;
            break;
        }
        case SL_ATR:
        {
            double atrBuf[];
            ArraySetAsSeries(atrBuf, true);
            if(CopyBuffer(h_atrSL, 0, 0, 1, atrBuf) == 1)
            {
                double d = atrBuf[0] * InpSLATRMultiplier;
                sl = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? entry - d : entry + d;
            }
            break;
        }
        case SL_STRUCTURE:
        {
            if(type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
            {
                double low = iLow(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
                for(int i = 2; i <= InpSLLookback; i++)
                    low = MathMin(low, iLow(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, i));
                sl = low - 3 * _Point * 10;
            }
            else
            {
                double high = iHigh(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, 1);
                for(int i = 2; i <= InpSLLookback; i++)
                    high = MathMax(high, iHigh(_Symbol, InpEntryTF, i));
                sl = high + 3 * _Point * 10;
            }
            break;
        }
    }

    // Enforce max SL
    double slPips = MathAbs(entry - sl) / (_Point * 10);
    if(slPips > InpMaxSLPips)
    {
        double maxD = InpMaxSLPips * _Point * 10;
        sl = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? entry - maxD : entry + maxD;
    }

    return NormalizeDouble(sl, digs);
}

double CalcTP(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE type, double sl)
{
    if(InpTPMode == TP_DYNAMIC) return 0;

    double ask   = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
    double bid   = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
    double entry = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? ask : bid;
    double tp    = 0;
    int    digs  = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);

    switch(InpTPMode)
    {
        case TP_FIXED:
        {
            double d = InpTPFixedPips * _Point * 10;
            tp = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? entry + d : entry - d;
            break;
        }
        case TP_RR:
        {
            double slDist = MathAbs(entry - sl);
            double tpDist = slDist * InpRRRatio;
            tp = (type == ORDER_TYPE_BUY) ? entry + tpDist : entry - tpDist;
            break;
        }
        default: break;
    }
    return (tp > 0) ? NormalizeDouble(tp, digs) : 0;
}

void CheckDynamicTP()
{
    double total = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < PositionsTotal(); i++)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(PositionSelectByTicket(ticket) &&
           PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) == InpMagic)
            total += PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)
                   + PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SWAP);
    }
    double target = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE) * (InpDynamicPct / 100.0);
    if(total >= target)
    {
        CloseAllByMagic();
        Print("Dynamic TP Hit | Net:", total, " Target:", target);
    }
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| SECTION 13: HEDGE MODULE                                         |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

// FIX 6: Called only when DD condition is already satisfied
void OpenScaleLadderHedge(ENUM_ORDER_TYPE gridType, double newGridLot)
{
    double hedgeLot = CalcHedgeLot(newGridLot);
    if(hedgeLot <= 0) return;

    ENUM_ORDER_TYPE hedgeType = (gridType == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
                                ? ORDER_TYPE_SELL
                                : ORDER_TYPE_BUY;
    if(!CheckMargin(hedgeLot)) return;

    bool result = (hedgeType == ORDER_TYPE_BUY)
                  ? Trade.Buy (hedgeLot, _Symbol, 0, 0, 0, "HEDGE")
                  : Trade.Sell(hedgeLot, _Symbol, 0, 0, 0, "HEDGE");

    if(result && Trade.ResultRetcode() == TRADE_RETCODE_DONE)
    {
        g_hedgeActive    = true;
        g_totalHedgeLot += hedgeLot;
        if(!g_hedgeFirstDone) g_hedgeFirstDone = true;
        Print("Hedge Opened | Lot:", hedgeLot, " TotalHedge:", g_totalHedgeLot);
    }
}

double CalcHedgeLot(double triggerLot)
{
    double lot = triggerLot;
    switch(InpHedgeLotMode)
    {
        case HEDGE_MATCH:
            lot = triggerLot;
            break;
        case HEDGE_TOTAL50:
            lot = GetTotalGridLot() * 0.5;
            break;
        case HEDGE_BOTH:
            // First hedge = 50% of total grid lot
            // Subsequent = match trigger lot (scale ladder)
            lot = (!g_hedgeFirstDone)
                  ? GetTotalGridLot() * 0.5
                  : triggerLot;
            break;
    }
    return NormalizeDouble(MathMax(lot, 0.01), 2);
}

void ProcessHedgeRecovery()
{
    if(!g_hedgeActive) return;

    double hedgeProfit = GetHedgeFloatProfitPips();
    if(hedgeProfit < InpHedgeProfitThresh) return;

    double currentBid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
    bool   closedAny  = false;

    for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != InpMagic) continue;

        string comment = PositionGetString(POSITION_COMMENT);
        if(StringFind(comment, "GRID") < 0) continue; // Only close GRID orders

        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);
        double dist      = MathAbs(currentBid - openPrice) / (_Point * 10);
        if(dist >= InpHedgeMinCloseDist)
        {
            Trade.PositionClose(ticket);
            closedAny = true;
        }
    }

    if(closedAny) ApplyHedgeTP();
}

void ApplyHedgeTP()
{
    double bid  = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
    double ask  = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
    int    digs = (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS);

    for(int i = 0; i < PositionsTotal(); i++)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != InpMagic) continue;
        if(PositionGetString(POSITION_COMMENT) != "HEDGE") continue;

        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE posType = (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);
        double tp;
        // FIX 7: correct price reference per position type
        if(posType == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)
            tp = NormalizeDouble(bid + InpHedgeTPPips * _Point * 10, digs);
        else
            tp = NormalizeDouble(ask - InpHedgeTPPips * _Point * 10, digs); // FIX 7

        Trade.PositionModify(ticket, PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SL), tp);
    }
}

//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| SECTION 14: HELPERS                                              |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
bool IsNewBar(ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf, datetime &lastBar)
{
    datetime current = iTime(_Symbol, tf, 0);
    if(current != lastBar) { lastBar = current; return true; }
    return false;
}

double GetCurrentDD()
{
    double bal = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
    double eq  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
    if(bal <= 0) return 0;
    return ((bal - eq) / bal) * 100.0;
}

double GetTotalLotByMagic()
{
    double total = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < PositionsTotal(); i++)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(PositionSelectByTicket(ticket) &&
           PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) == InpMagic)
            total += PositionGetDouble(POSITION_VOLUME);
    }
    return total;
}

double GetTotalGridLot()
{
    double total = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < PositionsTotal(); i++)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != InpMagic) continue;
        if(StringFind(PositionGetString(POSITION_COMMENT), "GRID") >= 0)
            total += PositionGetDouble(POSITION_VOLUME);
    }
    return total;
}

double GetHedgeFloatProfitPips()
{
    double total = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < PositionsTotal(); i++)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(!PositionSelectByTicket(ticket)) continue;
        if(PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != InpMagic) continue;
        if(PositionGetString(POSITION_COMMENT) != "HEDGE") continue;

        ENUM_POSITION_TYPE posType = (ENUM_POSITION_TYPE)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);
        double openPrice = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);
        double bid       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
        double ask       = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
        double pip;
        // FIX 7: correct current price per direction
        if(posType == POSITION_TYPE_BUY)
            pip = (bid - openPrice) / (_Point * 10);
        else
            pip = (openPrice - ask) / (_Point * 10);
        total += pip;
    }
    return total;
}

bool CheckMargin(double lot)
{
    double req = 0;
    if(!OrderCalcMargin(ORDER_TYPE_BUY, _Symbol, lot,
                        SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK), req)) return false;
    return AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE) >= req * 1.5;
}

bool CheckSpreadNormal() { return SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD) <= InpMaxSpreadPts; }
bool CheckSpreadHard()   { return SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD) <= InpMaxSpreadHard; }

bool CheckATRFilter()
{
    double atrBuf[];
    ArraySetAsSeries(atrBuf, true);
    if(CopyBuffer(h_atrSL, 0, 0, 1, atrBuf) < 1) return true;
    return atrBuf[0] >= InpATRMinValue;
}

bool CheckSessionFilter()
{
    if(!InpSessionFilter) return true;
    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeGMT(), dt);
    int h = dt.hour;
    if(InpAllowLondon && h >= 7  && h < 16) return true;
    if(InpAllowNY     && h >= 13 && h < 22) return true;
    return false;
}

bool CheckDrawdownLimit()  { return GetCurrentDD() < InpMaxDrawdownPct; }

bool CheckDailyLossLimit()
{
    double eq   = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
    double loss = ((g_dailyStartEq - eq) / g_dailyStartEq) * 100.0;
    return loss < InpDailyLossPct;
}

bool CheckEmergencyExit()
{
    if(GetCurrentDD() < InpEmergencyDD) return true;
    CloseAllByMagic();
    Print("EMERGENCY EXIT | DD:", GetCurrentDD(), "%");
    return false;
}

// FIX 5: Reset ALL state variables on full close
void CloseAllByMagic()
{
    for(int i = PositionsTotal() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
    {
        ulong ticket = PositionGetTicket(i);
        if(PositionSelectByTicket(ticket) &&
           PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) == InpMagic)
            Trade.PositionClose(ticket);
    }
    // FIX 5: Reset all state — including price trackers
    g_gridCountBuy   = 0;
    g_gridCountSell  = 0;
    g_lastBuyPrice   = 0; // FIX 5
    g_lastSellPrice  = 0; // FIX 5
    g_hedgeActive    = false;
    g_totalHedgeLot  = 0;
    g_hedgeFirstDone = false;
}

void ResetDailyStats()
{
    MqlDateTime dt;
    TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);
    datetime today = StringToTime(StringFormat("%04d.%02d.%02d",
                                  dt.year, dt.mon, dt.day));
    if(today > g_lastResetDate)
    {
        g_dailyStartEq  = AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);
        g_lastResetDate = today;
    }
}

void ShowDashboard()
{
    Comment(StringFormat(
        "=== HalfTrend MTF Master v2.61 ===\n"
        "%s | DD:%.1f%% | Spread:%d\n"
        "M15:%s  H1:%s  Signal: Buy=%s Sell=%s\n"
        "Dist:%s × %.1f | Trigger:%s\n"
        "Lot:%s | Grid Buy#%d Sell#%d\n"
        "Hedge:%s | Total:%.2f lots",
        _Symbol, GetCurrentDD(),
        (int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol, SYMBOL_SPREAD),
        g_ht_trend  == 0 ? "UP" : "DN",
        g_hth_trend == 0 ? "UP" : "DN",
        g_ht_buySignal  ? "✓" : "-",
        g_ht_sellSignal ? "✓" : "-",
        EnumToString(InpDistMode), InpDistMultiplier,
        EnumToString(InpEntryTrigger),
        EnumToString(InpLotMode),
        g_gridCountBuy, g_gridCountSell,
        g_hedgeActive ? "ON" : "OFF",
        g_totalHedgeLot
    ));
}

## 📋 Bug Fix Summary

| # | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| **1** | ATR handle เดียวกันสำหรับ M15 และ H1 | สร้าง `h_atrHT_M15` และ `h_atrHT_H1` แยกกัน |
| **2** | `TRIG_CLOSE` return true ทันที | ตรวจ Close price vs Distance จริงๆ |
| **3** | `nextOrderNum` อาจ off-by-one | ใช้ `g_gridCountBuy+1` / `g_gridCountSell+1` ตรงๆ |
| **4** | `GetLastOrderPrice()` ไม่แยก direction | แยกเป็น `g_lastBuyPrice` / `g_lastSellPrice` |
| **5** | `CloseAllByMagic()` ไม่ reset price trackers | Reset `g_lastBuyPrice/Sell` และ `g_hedgeFirstDone` ด้วย |
| **6** | Hedge เปิดทุกครั้งที่มีไม้ใหม่ | ตรวจ `GetCurrentDD() >= InpHedgeTriggerDD` ก่อน |
| **7** | `ApplyHedgeTP()` ใช้ bid/ask สลับกัน | Sell position ใช้ `ask - pips` แทน `bid + pips` |
